Ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga nganye, ninikele umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova: iintombi ezimbini ezincinci zegusha, nomntwana omncinci omnye, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezilishumi elinambini ezineminyaka enye ubudala; zonke zingabi necala.

Nomnikelo wokudla wesonka, ulungiselele nenyama yenkomo nganye inkunzi yebhokhwe enye, umgubo ocoliweyo omxutywe neoli, ubuncinane iitoni ezilishumi elinambini, nomgubo ocoliweyo omxutywe neoli, ubuncinane iitoni ezintathu;

Nceda unikezele nenyama yenkomo nganye, inkunzi yebhokhwe nganye, isilivere elinamashumi amabini anesixhenxe engqongwe ngeoli; ibe yidini eliqhutywa limlilo, isonka esilungiselelwe ngomlilo sephunga elimnandi kuYehova.

Iintsontelo zabo zokusela ziya kuba ngamalitha amabini ewayini nganye inkunzi yebhokhwe, namalitha alishumi elinambini ngemvu, namalitha alishumi elinambini ngomntwana ngamnye. Lo ngumnikelo womlilo wenyanga nganye yonyaka.
Nceda nilungiselele inkunzi yebhokhwe enye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono kuYehova, ngaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nesonka saso sokunqunyulwa.
Kwinyanga yokuqala, ngomhla weshumi elinesine wonyaka, iPasha kaYehova iya kuba.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe wale nyanga, ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu walo, kuya kubakho isikhumbuzo; nidla iintsuku ezisibhozo isonka esingenasiqhamo.
Ngomhla wokuqala, kubekho kuni isibingelelo esingcwele; musa ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi.

Ninikele umnikelo owenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova, idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi: inkunzi yebhokhwe ezimbini ezincinci, nenkomo enye, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezine ezineminyaka elishumi elinanye ubudala, zonke zingabi nengxaki.
Bazinikezele ngazo isonka somnikelo wesono, isikhunta esicoliweyo esixutywe neoli, esiya kuba yimitha ezilishumi elinanye ngebhokhwe nganye; ibe ziimitha ezilishumi elinambini ngemvu.
Kuzo zonke iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisixhenxe, zinikele isiqingatha sekhilogram.
Nceda uthabathe inkunzi yenkomo enye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ukuze uyilungise phambi koThixo.
Nizilungiselele ezi zinto, ngaphandle kwesonka esiqhutywa ngumnqamlezo sokusasa.
Nikwenze njalo mihla le, iintsuku ezisixhenxe; kukutya kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, ivumba elithandekayo kuYehova; nizilungiselele ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo nomnikelo wayo wokudla.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe, kubekho kuni isibingelelo esingcwele; musa ukwenza msebenzi othile.
Ngomhla wokuqala wokuvuna, xa ninika umnikelo weentyatyambo ezitsha kuYehova emthendelekweni weeveki, kufuneka kubekho isibingelelo esingcwele; musa ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi.
Nizilungiselele idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, inkunzi yebhokhwe ezimbini ezincinci, nenkomo enye, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezine ezineminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala; ibe yivumba elimnandi kuYehova.
Nazo nizilungiselele izipho zesonka, ingqolowa encinane eqhutywa ngeoli, ezimalunga neshumi elinanye lesilivere nganye yenkomo, nezilishumi elinambini lesilivere nganye yomnquma;
nesiqingatha sekhilogram ngasinye sazo zonke iintlanzi ezisixhenxe.
Nceda uthabathe ibhokhwe enye, ukuba uyilungise phambi koThixo.
Nizilungiselele zonke ezi zinto, namadini abo okusela, ngaphandle kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nesonka sayo sokutya; nize nibone ukuba akukho monakalo kuzo.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, ngomhla wokuqala wonyaka, nibe nengqungquthela engcwele; musa ukwenza nantoni na yomsebenzi othile: ngusuku lokudubula kweebhokhwe.
Ninikele idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, libe yivumba elimnandi kuYehova: inkunzi yebhokhwe enye, nemvunye enye, neenkomo ezine ezineminyaka elishumi elinambini ubudala, zonke zingabikho monakalo kuzo.
Nazo nizilungiselele izipho zesonka, ingqolowa encinane eqhutywe neoli, ezimalunga neekhilogram ezilishumi elinambini nganye inkunzi yenkomo, nezilishumi elinambini nganye inkunzi yemvu,
nesiqingatha sekhilogram ngasinye sazo zonke iintlanzi ezisixhenxe.
Nceda uthabathe inkunzi yenkomo enye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ukuze uyilungise phambi koThixo.

Le nto ngaphezu kwesonka somlilo senyanga entsha, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesonka somlilo esiqhubekayo, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nezidini zawo zokusela, ngokwemithetho; yimifuno eqhutywa ngamanzi, ivumba elithandekayo kuYehova.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe wale nyanga yesixhenxe, nibe nengqungquthela engcwele; musa ukutya nantoni na, musani ukwenza msebenzi.

Ninikele umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, njengevumba elithandekayo: inkunzi yenkomo enye, nomntwana omncinci womntu omnye, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezilishumi elinambini ezineminyaka emine ubudala, zingabikho monakalo kuzo zonke.
Nazo nizilungiselele izipho zesonka, ingqolowa encinane eqhutywe neoli, ezimalunga neekhilogram ezilishumi elinambini nganye inkunzi yenkomo, nezilishumi elinambini nganye inkunzi yemvu,
nesiqingatha sekhilogram ngasinye sazo zonke iintlanzi ezisixhenxe.
Nceda uthathe ibhokhwe enye, ibe yidini lesono; ngaphezu kwedini lesono lokuxolela abantu, nedini eliqhutywa ngamanzi eliqhubekayo, nomnikelo walo wokudla, nezidini zayo zokusela.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, ngemini yeshumi elinesihlanu iya kubakho isibingelelo esingcwele; musa ukwenza nantoni na imisebenzi yomsebenzi: yenzani isikhumbuzo kuYehova iintsuku ezisibhozo.

Ninikele idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, umnikelo owenziwe ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuYehova: iintombi ezincinci ezilishumi elinambini, izimvu ezimbini, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezineminyaka emibini zilishumi elinambini; zonke zingabi necala.

Nazo nizilungiselele izipho zesonka, ingqolowa encinane eqhutywe neoli, ezimalunga neekhilogram ezilishumi elinambini nganye yeenkunzi zeenkomo ezilishumi elinamithathu, nezingaphezu kweekhilogram ezilishumi elinambini nganye ngeenkomo ezimbini;
nesiqingatha sekhilogram ngasinye sazo zonke izimvu ezilishumi elinane.
Nceda unciphise ibhokhwe enye, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; ezi zinto zingaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nesonka sayo sokudla, nesonka sayo sokusela.
Ngomhla wesibini, iinkunzi zeenkomo ezilishumi elinambini, neenkunzi zeegusha ezimbini, neenkunzi zeebhokhwe ezineminyaka emibini ubudala ezilishumi elinane; azikho nakuphi na ukubi kuzo.
Ngeenkomo, neenkunzi zeenkomo, neentlanzi ezincinci, ninikele umnikelo wazo wokudla, nezipho zazo zokusela, ngokwenani lezinto eziphilayo, njengoko kuthethwa.
Nceda nilungiselele inkunzi yenkomo enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesonka sayo sokumwa.
Ngomhla wesithathu, iinkunzi zeenkomo ezilishumi elinambini, neenkunzi zeegusha ezimbini, neenkunzi zeebhokhwe ezineminyaka emibini ubudala ezilishumi elinane; azikho nakuphi na ukubi kuzo.
Ngeenkomo, neenkunzi zeenkomo, neentlanzi ezincinci, ninikele umnikelo wazo wokudla, nezipho zazo zokusela, ngokwenani lezinto eziphilayo, njengoko kuthethwa.
Nceda nilungiselele inkunzi yenkomo enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesonka sayo sokumwa.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe, inkunzi yenkomo ezilishumi, iinkunzi zeenkomo ezimbini, neenkunzi zeegusha ezinomnyaka mnye ezilishumi elinambini; azibi nakuphi na ukubi.
Ngeenkomo, neenkunzi zeenkomo, neentlanzi ezincinci, ninikele umnikelo wazo wokudla, nezipho zazo zokusela, ngokwenani lezinto eziphilayo, njengoko kuthethwa.
Nceda nilungiselele inkunzi yenkomo enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesonka sayo sokumwa.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe, iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisixhenxe, neenkunzi zeegusha ezimbini, neentlanzi ezineminyaka elishumi elinane ubudala, zingenamonakalo.
Ngeenkomo, neenkunzi zeenkomo, neentlanzi ezincinci, ninikele umnikelo wazo wokudla, nezipho zazo zokusela, ngokwenani lezinto eziphilayo, njengoko kuthethwa.
Nceda nilungiselele inkunzi yenkomo enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesonka sayo sokumwa.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe, iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisibhozo, neenkunzi zebhokhwe ezimbini, neenkunzi zeebhokhwe ezineminyaka elishumi elinane ubudala, zingabikho monakalo kuzo.
Ngeenkomo, neenkunzi zeenkomo, neentlanzi ezincinci, ninikele umnikelo wazo wokudla, nezipho zazo zokusela, ngokwenani lezinto eziphilayo, njengoko kuthethwa.
Nceda nilungiselele inkunzi yenkomo enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesonka sayo sokumwa.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe, inkunzi yenkomo ezisixhenxe, iinkunzi zeenkomo ezimbini, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezineminyaka elishumi elinane ubudala, zingenamonakalo.
Ngeenkomo, neenkunzi zeenkomo, neentlanzi ezincinci, ninikele umnikelo wazo wokudla, nezipho zazo zokusela, ngokwenani lezinto eziphilayo, njengoko kuthethwa.
Nceda nilungiselele inkunzi yenkomo enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesonka sayo sokumwa.
Ngomhla wesibhozo, nibe nentlanganiso ekhethekileyo; musa ukwenza msebenzi oqhelekileyo.

Nceda ninike idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, umnikelo owenziwe ngomlilo, wevumba elimnandi kuYehova: inkunzi yenkomo enye, umkhweli omnye, iintombi ezilishumi elinambini ezineminyaka emine ubudala, zonke zingabi necala.
Ngendoda yenkomo, nenkunzi yebhokhwe, neenkunzi zeenkomo, ninikele umnikelo wazo wokudla, nezipho zazo zokusela, ngokwenani lezinto eziphilayo, njengoko kuthethwa.
Nceda nilungiselele inkunzi yenkomo enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ngaphezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngamandla, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesonka sayo sokumwa.

Nizilungiselele loo zinto kuYehova ezimini zeentlanganiso zenu; zingaphezulu kwezibingelelo zenkcubeko yenu, nezinikezelo zezandla zenu, nokuba yimiboniso eqhutywa ngamanzi, nokuba yimiboniso yesonka, nokuba yimiboniso yokusela, nokuba yimiboniso yoxolo.
Wathetha ke uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, konke oko iNkosi wamwiselayo.
Wathi ke uMoses kubathetheli bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, esithi, Le nto iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngayo:

Xa umntu esenza isibingelelo esikhethekileyo kuYehova, okanye ebhiyozela umlomo wakhe, ukuze abambe ilizwi lakhe, ukuba liyenze into ethile, akuyi kuyiphulaphuli ulwimi lwakhe; onke amagama akhe aya kuwalungisa.
Xa ibhinqa elincinci, lihlala endlwini kayise, lisenza isibingelelo kuYehova, okanye libeka intliziyo yakhe phantsi koxanduva,
ukuba ubaba lwakhe luthe lwaliva idini lakhe, okanye isibophelelo sakhe, yaye aluthethi nto kuye; zonke izibophelelo zakhe, nazo zonke izibophelelo zakhe, ziya kuhlala.
Ke kaloku, ukuba ubaba wakhe wamisa loo nto ngaloo mini ayaziyo, akukho nanye injongo yakhe, nokuba yeyiphi na imimiselo yakhe, iya kuhlala; iNkosi uya kumxolela, ngokuba ubaba wakhe wammisa.
Ke kaloku, ukuba ubhiyozela umtshato wakhe, emehlweni akhe kukho isibingelelo, okanye kukho isibophelelo esingenanto esenzayo;
ukuba umyeni wakhe afundile oko, kodwa engathethi nto kuye ngaloo mini afundileyo loo nto; ke ngoko izibingelelo zakhe nezibophelelo zakhe ziya kuhlala.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umfazi wakhe, ngaloo mini ayifumeneyo, wayemthintela, ke yena uya kuyicima idini lakhe elizimeleyo, negunya lakhe elinobuxoki elithethayo; iNkosi uya kumxolela.
Nasiphi na isibophelelo okanye isithembiso esithe senziwe ngumfazi okhulelweyo okanye umfazi otshatileyo kufuneka sigcinwe.
Ke kaloku, xa umfazi okhulelweyo esenza isibingelelo, okanye eveza isandla sakhe ngesibonda, ehlala ekhaya lomyeni wakhe,
ukuba umfazi wakhe eva ngalo, kodwa engathethi nto kuye, angayithinteli loo nto; zonke izibingelelo zakhe, nazo zonke izibophelelo zakhe, ziya kuhlala.

Ke kaloku, ukuba umfazi wakhe ayisayi kuziphulaphula ngaloo mini ayaziyo, akukho nanye yezibingelelo zakhe, okanye izibophelelo zakhe ezithethayo, ezakuba ikhona; umfazi wakhe waziyaziphulaphula, ke iNkosi uya kumxolela.
Umfazi wakhe unokumvumela, okanye unokuwucima nawuphi na umyalelo awenzayo, nangawo nawuphi na umyalelo wokuba angabi nezinto.

Ke kaloku, ukuba umfazi wakhe wanyamalala kuye ukususela namhlanje ukuya kumhla olandelayo, ke yena uya kuzivumela zonke izibingelelo zakhe, nazo zonke izibophelelo zakhe; ngenxa yokuba wanyamalala kuzo ngaloo mini ayaziyo, wavuma.
Ukuba ke, emva kokuba efundile ngaloo nto, ayisayi kuziphula, uya kuba netyala ngenxa yobuxoki bakhe.
Ezi zimiyalelo iNkosi wamwisela uMoses, phakathi komntu nomfazi wakhe, phakathi koyise nonyana wakhe oneminyaka emincinci, ohlala ekhaya.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Wathi ke uNdikhoyo kuYakobi, Yiya uxelele ooMidiyani oko bakwenzayo oonyana bakaSirayeli; emva koko uza kufa, uza kudityaniswa nabantu bakho.
Wathi ke uMoses kubo bonke abantu, Nceda nilungiselele phakathi kwenu amadoda amabini empilweni, ukuba ahambe kuMidiyani, aphumeze phezu kwabo isigwebo sikaYehova.
Nceda nithumelele amadoda amawaka ngalinye esiqithi ngasinye samaSirayeli, ukuba abe ngumkhosi.
Ke kaloku kwakhethwa amadoda amawaka amathathu esiqhingi ngasinye, phakathi kwamawaka amakhulu kaSirayeli, amadoda amawaka alishumi elinambini alungiselelwe ukulwa.
Ke kaloku uMoses wabathumela emkhosini, amawaka eqela ngalinye, noPhenehashe unyana ka-Elazare ukumkani; wathabatha Phenehashe ngesandla sakhe izinto zendawo engcwele, nezithunywa zokudubula.
Bahlasela amaMidiyani, njengokuba iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses; babulala bonke amadoda.
Ke kaloku phakathi kwabo abafayo kwabakho ookumkani abahlanu bakaMidiyani, uEvhi, noRekem, noTsuri, noHuri, noRebha; babulala ke ngekrele noBhalamu unyana kaBeore.
Amadoda aseSirayeli athabathe amadoda namabhinqa amaMidiyani, nabantwana babo; athathe zonke iinkomo zabo, nezimvu zabo, nempahla yabo.
Zazitshisa zonke iidolophu zabaMidiyani, apho behlala khona, nazo zonke izixeko zabo.
Bathabatha zonke iintaka, nazo zonke izinto ababezithathela, nokuba ngumfazi okanye inkomo.

Bathi ke baya kuMoses, noElazare umbingeleli, nebandla lakwaSirayeli, abo babulawayo, nezilwane, nezinto ezilahlekileyo, kwithafa labo, ezindaweni eziphakamileyo zakwaMowabi, ngaseYordan, emveni kweYericho.
Waphuma ke uMoses, noElazare umbingeleli, namadoda amakhulu onke ebandla, ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi, ukuba adibana nabo.
Ke kaloku uMoses waxoka kumadoda amakhulu emkhosini, abathetheli bamawaka, nabathetheli bamawaka, ababuyayo kumfazwe.
Wababuza wathi kubo, Nibashiye na ubomi amadoda onke?
Baye ke abo bahamba ngemiyalelo kaBhileham, babangela ukuba abantwana bakaSirayeli babe nesono kuYehova ngoPeori; ngenxa yoko kwathiwa isifo kubo bonke abantu bakaYehova.
Ke ngoko, bulala bonke oonyana abancinci, nokubulala wonke umfazi olele nomntu.
Ke kaloku niyigcineni intombazana nganye, engatshatanga nomntu;

Nabani na phakathi kwenu obulala umntu, nabani na phakathi kwenu onqumle umfazi, nihlale phantsi ngaphandle komkhosi iintsuku ezisixhenxe; ngoLwesithathu nomhla wesixhenxe nihlambuluke, nina neentombi zenu.
Nazo zonke iimpahla, nazo zonke izinto ezenziwe ngesikhumba, nazo zonke iinwele zebhokhwe, nazo zonke izinto ezenziwe ngomthi, zicoceke.
Wathi uElezare, umbingeleli, kubakhonzi bakhe abathe baphuma emkhosini, Lo ngumthetho womthetho owawunika iNkosi uMoses:
igolide, nesilivere, nobhedu, nentsimbi, netin, nesilivere,
Nayiphi na into enokumelana nobushushu, iya kugqitywa emlilweni, ibe icocekile. Ke kaloku iya kugqitywa ngamanzi okuhlamba; nantoni na engakwazi ukumelana nobushushu, iya kugqitywa ngamanzi.
Nizihlamba iimpahla zenu ngemini yesixhenxe, nihlale nicocekile; emva koko niza kungena emkhosini.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Ke wena, noElazare umbingeleli, namadoda amakhulu eentsapho zakwaSirayeli, babala bonke abantu nabafileyo, nenyama.
Yazihlukanise zibe ziinxalenye ezimbini ezilinganayo: enye yabafazi abathe baphuma emkhosini, nenye kwabasekuhlaleni.
Kwisiqingatha sabathunywa, ubeke inxalenye yomnikelo kaYehova: omnye kumakhulu amahlanu, nokuba ngumuntu, nokuba yibhokhwe, nokuba yieseyile, nokuba ziinkomo, nokuba ziinkunzi.
Zithabathe ezi zinto kumaphesenti abo, zizinike kuElayazare umbingeleli, zibe ngumnikelo othile kaYehova.

Kwisiqingatha sabantwana bakaSirayeli, uthathe omnye kumakhulu amahlanu, nokuba ngumuntu, nokuba yibhokhwe, nokuba yieseyile, nokuba ziinkomo, nokuba ziinkunzi zeegusha, nokuba ziphi na izinto eziphilayo; uzinike ooLevi, abaphatha iimpahla ezingcwele zikaYehova.
Wakwenza ke uMoses noElazare ukumkani, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo uMoses.
Ke kaloku iinkomo, nezimvu, neentyatyambo, neengcuka, neenkunzi zeegusha, neentlanzi, neentyatyambo, neentyatyambo, neentyatyambo.
iinkomo ezimashumi asixhenxe anesibini amawaka,
iinkunzi zeegusha ezimashumi amathandathu ananye amawaka,
nabafazi abamashumi mathathu anesibini amawaka, abazange bahlangane nomntu.
Nesiqingatha sabantu abaqeqeshiweyo kwaba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu amathathu, anamanci asixhenxe anamakhulu amahlanu eebhokhwe,
Inxalenye kaYehova yaba ngamakhulu amathandathu, anamanci asixhenxe anesihlanu.
Iinkomo zaba ngamawaka amashumi mathathu anesithandathu; inxalenye kaYehova yaba ngamawaka asixhenxe anambini.
Iibhokhwe zaba ngamawaka amashumi mathathu anamakhulu amahlanu; inxalenye kaYehova yaba ngamawaka angamashumi asixhenxe ananye.
Kwaba ngamawaka alishumi elinamithandathu; inxalenye kaYehova yayimashumi amathathu anesibini.
UMoses wamnika uElayazare, ukumkani, inxalenye kaYehova, njengomnikelo othile; njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Ke kaloku isiqingatha saso saba yinxalenye yabantu bakaSirayeli; esi siqingatha uMoses wasisibeka icala, esuka kwinxalenye yabafazi.
Isiqingatha sebandla saba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu amathathu, anamanci asixhenxe, namawaka amane anamakhulu mahlanu, oonyana bakaSirayeli;
iinkomo ezimashumi mathathu anesithandathu amawaka,
iinkunzi zebhokhwe ezimashumi mathathu amawaka anamakhulu amahlanu,
namadoda amawaka alishumi elinamithandathu.

Wathabatha ke uMoses kwisiqingatha sabantwana bakaSirayeli, umntu ngamnye kumashumi amahlanu abantu, nenyama yeenkomo, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo umthetho; wabanika ooLevi, abaphathayo umsebenzi wendawo engcwele kaYehova.
Bafika ke kubo uMoses abaphathi bamaqela emkhosini, abaphathi bamawaka, nabaphathi bamawaka.
Bathi kuye, Sinabo abakhonzi bakho babala oonyana bakaSirayeli abaphantsi komyalelo wethu; akukho namnye uphelelwe ngumntu.

Siyazisa ngoko umnikelo kuYehova, ngazo zonke izinto ezenziweyo zegolide, ezithe sazifumana nganye kuthi: izikhonkwane, neengxowa-mali, nezihlangu, neebhanti, neentyatyambo; sizisa ezo zinto, ukuze sizilungise phambi koYehova.
Ke kaloku uMoses noElazare ukumkani, bathabatha igolide kubo; yenziwe yonke le nto ibe zizinto zokuhombisa.
Igolide yonke, abaphathi bamawaka nabaphathi bamawaka ababeyinikela njengomnikelo othile kuYehova, yaba ngamawaka alishumi elinambini anamakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mahlanu eeshekeli.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakaSirayeli bonke bathabathe iimpahla zabo.
Ke kaloku uMoses noElazare, umbingeleli, bathabatha igolide yabaphathi bamawaka nabaphathi bamawaka, bayingenisa kwitenki yokuhlangana, ukuba ibe ngumbulelo kuYehova kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku ooRubhen noGadi babe neentyatyambo nezimvu ezininzi kakhulu; babone ke ilizwe laseYazeri, neGiliyadi, ukuba lilungile lezo ntyatyambo.
Bafika ke oonyana bakaGadi noRubhen kuMoses, noElazare umbingeleli, namadoda amakhulu ebandla, besithi,
neAtarathi, neDiboni, neYasere, neNimra, neHeshbon, neEleale, neShebham, neNebo, neBeon;
Eli lizwe, iNkosi alifumene kulo mkhosi wamaSirayeli, lilizwe elilungileyo lezinto eziphilayo; thina abakhonzi bakho sinezinto eziphilayo ezininzi.
Bathi ke, Ukuba ubona ukuba silungile phambi kwakho, linikezelwe eli lizwe kubakhonzi bakho, libe yindawo yethu; musa ukusishiya sidlula eJordan.
Wathi uMoses kubo oonyana bakaGadi noRubhen, Ingaba abazalwana benu, ooSirayeli, baya kungena emfazweni, nihlalani apha?
Kutheni na ke ukuba nithi, Musani ukutyhala izandla zabantwana bakaSirayeli, ukuze bangayi kungena ezweni iNkosi awabanika lona?
Yaye loo nto bayenze ooyise benu, xa ndabathumela eKadeshe-barnea ukuba bajonge eli lizwe.
Baye benyuka bafike eNtaba ka-Eshkole, bajonge ilizwe; batyhala intliziyo yabantu bakaSirayeli, ukuba bangangeni kwilizwe iNkosi awabanika lona.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxhaphaza ngaloo mini, wathi,

Ngokuba akukho namnye kubo aphumayo eYiputa, oneminyaka engama-mashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, oza kubona ilizwe endilibazile lona uAbraham, noIsake, noYakobi, ngokuba bangandilandelanga ngentliziyo yabo yonke.
Ke kaloku uKalebe, unyana kaYefune, umKenizi, noYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, baya kuyibona; ngokuba balandela iNkosi intliziyo yabo yonke.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxhaphaza amaSirayeli, wabashiya behamba-hamba emasikweni iminyaka emashumi mane, de kube sekuphele isizukulwana sonke esisenza okubi phambi kwakhe.
Ke ngoko, nantsini niye, imbewu entsha yamadini, nithatha indawo yabafazi benu, ukuze niphindenise iNkosi inkanuko kuSirayeli.
Ukuba ke niyayeka ukumlandela, uThixo uya kuphinda ashiye aba bantu bonke kuloo mfula; niza kuba yingozi kubo.
Bafika ke kuye uMoses, besithi, Siza kwakha apha iinkomo zethu, nezindlu zabantwana bethu.

Ke thina siza kwenza isithuthi sethu, siya kuqhuba oonyana bakaSirayeli emfazweni, de sibangenise ezweni labo; ke abantwana bethu baya kuhlala emizini enezindlu eziqinileyo, bekhuselekile kubahlali baloo ndawo.
Asiyi kubuyela kumakhaya ethu, de bathathe amaSirayeli wonke ilizwe lakhe.
Asiyi kuthatha nabo ilizwe ngaphaya kweYorodani; ngokuba sithathe ilizwe lethu apha, ngaphesheya koMlambo iYorodani, emazantsi elanga.
Wathi kubo uMoses, Ukuba niza kwenza loo nto, ukuba niza kuzisa izithunywa zenu emkhosini phambi koYehova,
namadoda akho onke alungiselelwe ukulwa athabathe iYorodani phambi koYehova, de aphumeze izitha zakhe phambi kwakhe;
Ke kaloku, xa eli lizwe liqhutywe phambi koYehova, niya kubuya; niza kwenza umsebenzi wenu kuYehova, nakwaSirayeli; le lizwe liya kuba yintsapho yenu phambi koThixo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba ningazi kwenza loo nto, niza kuyilungisa idini lenu kuYehova, niyazi ukuba idini lenu liya kunifumana.
Yakha imizi kubantwana benu, neengqungquthela zezimvu zenu; zenza ke izinto oza kuzithethayo.
Bathi oonyana bakaGadi noRubhen kuMoses, Siza kwenza abakhonzi bakho, njengoko utshoyo, nkosi yam.
Abantwana bethu, namadoda ethu, nezimvu zethu, nazo zonke iinkomo zethu ziya kuhlala apha emizini kaGiliyadi.
Ke thina bonke abakhonzi bakho siza kudlula, wonke umntu oqeqeshiweyo emfazweni, ukuhlasela phambi koYehova, njengoko utshoyo, nkosi yethu.
Wathi ke uMoses kuye uElezare, ukumkani, noYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, namadoda amakhulu eentsapho zezizwe zakwaSirayeli.

Wathi kubo, Ukuba oonyana bakaGadi noRubhen baya kudlula nani iJordan, bonke abantu abalungiselelwe ukulwa, phambi koYehova; ukuba eli lizwe liqhutywa phambi kwenu, nibanike ilizwe laseGiliyadi libe yindawo yabo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba abayi kuhamba nabo ngemikhosi, bathabathe inxalenye yabo nawe ezweni laseKanan.
Baphendula ke oonyana bakaGadi noRubhen, besithi, Njengelizwi likaYehova siza kwenza abakhonzi bakho.
Siza kuhamba sikhuselwe phambi koYehova, sifike ezweni laseKanan; kodwa ilizwe lethu lomhlaba luya kuba ngapha kwelinye icala leJordan.

Wabanika ke uMoses oonyana bakaGadi, noRubhen, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase unyana kaYosefu, ubukumkani bukaSihon ukumkani wamaAmori, nobukumkani bukaOgi ukumkani waseBhashani; wabanika ilizwe lonke, needolophu zayo, nelizwe labo elijikelezayo.
Amadoda aseGadi ayewalungisa kwakhona iDiboni, neAtarathi, neAroere,
uAtrothi-Shofani, noYasere, noYogbeha,
iBhethinimra, neBhethini-hareni, ziidolophu ezinemigangatho eqinileyo; bazenza izindlu zokugcina iintlanzi zabo.
Bathi oonyana bakaRubhen baphinde bakwakha iHeshbon, neEleale, neKiriyatayim,
noNebo, noBhaali-meon (abatshintshile amagama abo), noShibma; babeka amagama amatsha kumadolophu abo, abawalungisa.
Baye oonyana bakaMahiri, unyana kaManase, beya eGiliyadi, bayithabatha, bakhupha abo Amamori abahlala khona.
UMoses wamnika uGiliyadi oonyana bakaMakiri, unyana kaManase; bahlala khona.
Ke kaloku uYahiri, umzalwana kaManase, wathabatha izixeko, waza wababiza ngokuba ziidolophu zikaYahiri.
UNobha wahlasela iKenathi, nezixeko zayo ezijikelezayo, wayibiza ngokuba yiNobha, ngegama lakhe.
Ezi ziintsuku zokuhamba kwabo oonyana bakaSirayeli, xa bephuma eYiputa ngamaqela abo, phantsi koMoses noAron.
Wabhala ke uMoses, ngokwemiyalelo kaYehova, iindawo abasuka kuzo, ngazo zonke iintsuku zokuhamba kwabo; ezi ziintsuku zokuhamba zabo, ukusuka kwindawo enye yokuqalisa ukuya kwinto enye.
Basuka ke oonyana bakaSirayeli eRamesi, ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu wenyanga yokuqala, ngomhla olandelayo kwePasika; baphuma ngokunyanisekileyo phambi kobuso bonke bamaYiputa.
njengokuba abaYiputa bezibhiyozela bonke oonyana babo abazalwa kuqala, abo iNkosi wababulalayo. UThixo wabo wagwetywa nguYehova.
Basuka ke abantu bakaSirayeli eRameshe, bamisa itente eSukoti.
Basuka eSukothi, bamisa itente eEthame, esiphelweni sesiqithi.
Basuka eEtham, babuyela ePi-Hahirothi, esempumalanga yeBhaali-tsefoni, bamisa itente eMigdoli.
Basuka ePi-Hahirothi, bahamba phakathi kolwandle, befika emhlabathini omnyama; bahamba iintsuku ezintathu emhlabathini omnyama waseEthame, bamisa izindlu eMara.
Basuka eMara, bafika eElim; apho kwakukho imilambo yamanzi elishumi elinambini, nezityalo zeziqhamo ezimashumi asixhenxe; bamisa khona inqaba.
Basuka eElim, bamisa iintaba elwandle oluMnyama.
Basuka elwandle oluMnyama, bamisa iintaba emlilweni weSin.
Basuka eYiputa, bathabathela eSini, bamisa iintaba eDofka.
Basuka eDophka, bamisa itente eAlushe.
Basuka eAlushe, bamisa itente eRefidim; kwakungekho khona amanzi abantu abawaseleyo.
Basuka eRefidim, bamisa iintaba emlilweni waseSina.
Basuka eSinayin, bamisa iintaba eKibrothi-hataava.
Basuka eKibrothi-hataava, bamisa itente eHaseroti.
Basuka eHaserothi, bamisa itente eRitama.
Basuka eRithama, bamisa itente eRimon-perezi.
Basuka eRimon-perezi, bamisa itente eLibna.
Basuka eLibna, bamisa iintaba eRisa.
Basuka eRisa, bamisa iintaba eKehelatha.
Basuka eKehelatha, bamisa iintaba emnqamlezweni kaShefer.
Basuka emnqamlezweni weShefer, bamisa itente eHarada.
Basuka eHarada, bamisa itente eMakheloti.
Basuka eMakhelothi, bamisa itente eTahati.
Basuka eTahati, bamisa iintaba eTera.
Basuka eTera, bamisa iintaba eMitka.
Basuka eMithaka, bamisa itente eHashmona.
Basuka eHashmona, bamisa iintaba eMoserethi.
Basuka eMoserethi, bamisa itente eBhene-Yaakan.
Basuka eBhene-Yaakan, bamisa itente eHori-Hagidigadi.
Basuka eHori-Hagidgadi, bamisa itente eYotbata.
Basuka eYotbata, bamisa iintaba eAbrona.
Basuka eAbronah, bamisa itente eEzion-Gebere.
Basuka eEzion-gebere, bamisa itente eKadeshe, emhlabathini omnyama waseZin.
Basuka eKadeshe, bamisa iintaba emnqamlezweni kaHori, entliziyweni yelizwe laseEdom.
Waya ke uAron, umbingeleli, emnqamlezweni weHori, ngokwemiyalelo kaYehova; wafa khona ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yesihlanu, kunyaka omashumi mane emva kokuphuma kwabantu bakaSirayeli eYiputa.
UAron wayeneminyaka engama-123 ubudala, xa wafa eNtlambo kaHori.
Wava ke ukumkani waseArad, umKanana, ohlala eNtshonalanga, ezweni laseKanan, ukuba abantu bakaSirayeli bafika.
Basuka emnqamlezweni weHori, bamisa iintaba eSalmona.
Basuka eSalmona, bamisa itente ePunon.
Basuka ePunoni, bamisa iintaba eObhothi.
Basuka eObhothi, bamisa iintaba eIye-Abarim, kumda kaMowabi.
Basuka eIyim, bamisa iintaba eDiboni-Gadi.
Basuka eDiboni-Gadi, bamisa itente eAlmon-diblathaim.
Basuka eAlmon-diblathaim, bamisa iintaba kumatye eAbarim, ngaseNebo.
Basuka emazantsi entaba kaAbarim, bamisa iintaba kwiindawo eziphakamileyo zaseMowabhi, ecaleni komlambo iYorodani, ngaseJerikho.
Bamisa khona itente emazantsi eMowabi, ngaseYordan, ukusuka eBhethe-yeshimote waya eAbeli-shityim.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuMoses, kwiindawo eziphakamileyo zaseMowabhi, ngaseYordan ecaleni kweYericho, esithi,
Utsho uNdikhoyo kuMoses, uthi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Nithi, Xa nidlula iJordan nifike ezweni laseKanan,
Nizikhuphe zonke iintlanga ezihlala kuloo lizwe phambi kwenu; nizilahle zonke iintaka zabo, nemifanekiso yabo eqingqiweyo, nizihlambulule zonke iindawo zabo eziphakamileyo.
Niyithathe ilizwe, nihlale kulo; ngokuba ndiyaninika le lizwe ukuba libe likhaya lakho.

Yahlula umhlaba phakathi kweenkcubeko zakho ngokufaka iilothi. Nceda unike inxaxheba enkulu kwinkcubeko enkulu kwaye inxaxheba encinci kwiinkcubeko ezincinane. Nayiphi na ilizwe eliya kuyo iloto yeklani nganye izakuba yiyo. Yahlula phakathi kweentlobo zakho zakudala.
Ke kaloku, ukuba ningawakhuphi abahlali baloo lizwe, baya kuba ngamatye emehlo enu, namagqabi emilenzeni yenu abo nibazishiyayo; baya kuba yintlungu entliziyweni yenu kuloo lizwe nihlala kulo.
Ke kaloku ndiya kukwenza kuni, njengokuba ndacinga ukuba ndenze kubo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Uthi ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, Yimise umthetho oonyana bakaSirayeli, uthi: Xa nifika ezweni laseKanan, eli lizwe liza kunikwa libe yipropathi yenu; le mimandla yayo.
Icala lenu elisemazantsi liza kuba yinxalenye yesiqithi sikaZin, esiya kumda kaEdom; icala lenu elisemazantsi liza kuba lisuka kwisiphelo samantshona selwandle olufayo.
ujikeleze emazantsi eNtshona yeNtaba kaSkorpion, uhambe waya eZin, uye emazantsi eKadeshe-barnea; uhambe waya eHazari-addare, uhambe waya eAsmoni.
Ukusuka eAzmoni ujikeleze waya kumlambo, umda waseYiputa, ufike emlanjeni weMedithera.
Umda wenu wasempuma, ulwandle lweMedithera luza kuba ngumda wenu wempuma. Lo mda uya kuba ngumda wenu wempuma.
Ngomda wakho wasempuma, uzoba umgca osuka elwandle lwaseMedithera ukuya entlango kaHori;
ukusuka emnqamlezweni kaHore, ukuya kwindlela eya eHamati; umda uhambe waya eSedadi;
uqhubekeke waya eSiphroni, uphele eHazari-enani. Lo ngumhlathi wenu wasempuma.
Ngomda wakho wasempumalanga, uzoba umgca osuka eHazari-enani waya eShefamini.
Ukusuka eShefam, umda uya kuhla ufike eRibleha, ecaleni lasempumalanga le-Ayin; ukusuka apho uya kuhamba ngeendawo eziphakamileyo zaselwandle lwaseGaliliya.
Ke kaloku umda uthabathe umlambo iJordan, ufike elwandle olufayo; luza kuba lilizwe lenu, nalawo masango ajikelezayo.
UMoses wabawisela umthetho oonyana bakaSirayeli, wathi, Eli lilizwe niza kulihlula phakathi kwenu ngesandla; iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ukuba linikezelwe izizukulwana ezithoba nesibhozo.
Kuba izizwe zakwaRubhen nezakwaGadi, ngosapho lwazo, naphesheya kwesizukulwana sikaManase, zisele zithathe ilizwe lazo.
La maqela amabini anesiqingatha athathe ilifa labo ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani, ecaleni likaYeremiya, kunyakatho-mpuma.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Lemi amagama eendoda eziza kunihlula ilizwe, ibe yinxalenye yenu: uEleyazare umbingeleli, noYoshuwa unyana kaNun.
Ke kaloku ukhethe umphathi omnye kwisizukulwana ngasinye, ukuba ancedise ukuhlula ilizwe.
Lemi amagama abo: kwisizukulwana sikaYuda, uKalebe unyana kaYefune.
Kwisizwe sikaSimeon, nguShemuyeli unyana ka-Amihudi.
Kwisizwe sikaBhenjamin, nguElidada unyana kaKislon.
Kwisizwe sikaDan, ngukumkani uBhukuki unyana kaYogli.
Oonyana bakaYosefu: kwisizukulwana sikaManase, nguHaniyeli unyana kaEfodi, umlawuli;
Kwisizwe sikaEfrayim, ngukumkani uKemuyeli unyana kaShiftan.
Kwisizwe sikaZebulon, nguElishafane unyana kaFarnaki, umlawuli.
Kwisizwe sika-Isayakare, ngukumkani uPalethiyeli unyana ka-Atsan.
Kwisizwe sika-Ashere, ngukumkani uAhihu unyana kaShelomi.
Kwisizwe sikaNafetali, nguPedayeli unyana ka-Amihudi, umthetheli.
Baye ke abo amadoda awiselelwe nguYehova ukuba ahlukanise ilizwe likaKanan phakathi kwabaSirayeli.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuMoses, kwiindawo eziphakamileyo zaseMowabhi, ngaseYordan ecaleni kweYericho, esithi,

Utsho uNdikhoyo uThixouThixo kaSirayeli kuMoses, sithi: Yimise umthetho oonyana bakaSirayeli, ukuba banike amaLevi imizi yokuhlala kuyo, ezweni labo lelifa; babenikele namaLevi nezixeko eziphakathi kwezimizi.
La madolophu aya kuba yindawo yabo yokuhlala, nemihlaba yayo iya kuba yinkomo yabo, neentyatyambo zazo, nazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.
Iindawo zokuhlala ezijikeleze umzi ngamnye, niwunike ooLevi, kufuneka zifike kumngxunya womzi ngaphaya kweemitha ezingamawaka amane namashumi amahlanu.

Ngaphaya komzi, mlinganisele iinkunzi zeenkomo ezilishumi elinanye ecaleni lasempumalanga, neentliziyo ezilishumi elinanye ecaleni lasempumalanga, neentliziyo ezilishumi elinanye ecaleni lasemantla, neentliziyo ezilishumi elinanye ecaleni lasentshonalanga; nomzi uphakathi kwabo. Oku kuya kuba yindawo yabo yokutya.
Ezi zidolophu ezintandathu, nizinike ooLevi, zibe ziidolophu zokukhusela, ukuba umntu obulalayo akwazi ukutyelela kuzo; ngaphezu kwazo nizinike ezinye izixeko ezimashumi mane anesibini.
Zonke ezi zixeko nizinike kumaLevi, zibe zizixeko ezimashumi mane anesixhenxe nezindlu zangasemva zazo.

Iidolophu oza kuzinika ooLevi ziya kuvela ezweni labantwana bakaSirayeli. Kuzo izizukulwana ezikhulu nizinike iinqwelo-moya ezininzi, kuzo izizukulwana ezincinci nizinike iinqwelo-moya ezincinane; isizukulwana ngasinye sinike ooLevi iinqwelo-moya zayo, ngokwenani lelizwe laso.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho uNdikhoyo kuMoses, uthi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Nithi, Xa nidlula iJordan nifike ezweni laseKanan,
ukhethe ezinye iidolophu ukuba zibe ziidolophu zakho ezikhuselekileyo. Umntu obulala umntu ngokungxamisekileyo angahamba khona ukuze akhuseleke.

La madolophu aya kuba yindawo ekhuselekileyo kulowo unxulumene naye, ofuna ukubuyisela umonakalo wokubulala; ukuze umntu oxhaphakileyo ngokubulala angafa phambi kokuba ahlale enkundleni phambi kohlanga.
Iidolophu ezisixhenxe oza kuzinika, ziya kuba ziidolophu zethutyana.
Nizinike izixeko ezithathu ngaphaya kweYorodani, ekumntla; nezixeko ezithathu ezweni laseKanan; zibe ziidolophu zokukhusela.

Lezi zidolophu ezintandathu ziya kuba yindawo yokhuselo kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, nalowo uphumayo phakathi kwabo, nalowo uhlala phakathi kwabo; ukuze wonke umntu obulala umntu ngaphandle kokufunayo akwazi ukutyelela apho.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ebetha umntu ngesixhobo sentsimbi, aze amfa, ngumfazi; umfazi ke kufuneka aphele.
Ukuba umntu unelitye esandla sakhe, elinokubulala, wabetha omnye umntu, wabafa; ungumfazi obulalayo; umfazi lowo kufuneka aphele.
Ukuba umntu unesixhobo somthi esikwisandla sakhe, esinokufa, wabetha omnye umntu, waza wafa, yena ungumbulala; lowo umbulalayo kufuneka aphele.
Umfazi owenza umvuzo wokubulala, yena uya kumbulala loo mfazi; xa efumaneke kuye, kufuneka amfe.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ephazamisa umntu, ngenxa yokuba umchukumisayo, okanye esiyalela into kuye ukusuka kwindawo efihlakeleyo, aze amfa;

okanye, ukuba umdubula ngesandla sakhe ngenxa yobuxoki bakhe, aze amfa, lowo wamdubula ke kufuneka afile; ungumbulala-ntliziyo. Umngcwabi wokubulala uya kumbulala lo mbulala-ntliziyo, xa efumane yena.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ephazamisa omnye umntu ngaphaya kwendlela, angamthandanga, okanye ethutha into kuye, engacingi ngayo,
okanye, angabonakaliyo, athabathe phezu kwakhe ilitye elinobungozi bokufa, aze amfa; akanguye umkhosi wakhe, akawufunanga umonakalo.
Ke kaloku ibandla kufuneka ligweme phakathi komfazi nomhlobo wakhe ofuna ukubuyisela umfazi, ngokulandelela ezi mithetho.
Ke kaloku ibandla liya kumkhusela umfazi ebantwini bakhe, liwubuyisele emzini wakhe wokhuselo, apho wafudukela khona; aze ahlale khona kude kube sekufa umbingeleli omkhulu, otywinwe ngeoli engcwele.
Ke kaloku, ukuba lo mfazi uphuma ngaphandle komda womzi wakhe wokhuselo, apho wabaleka khona,
ukuba umhlobo wakhe umfumane ngaphandle komzi, amfakele; lo mhlobo wakhe awuzukuba ngumfakeli.
Umele ahlale kuloo mzi wokhuselo lwakhe, de kufa umbingeleli omkhulu; emva kokufa kombingeleli omkhulu ke yena uya kubuyela ezweni lakhe.
Zimimiselo, zimiyalelo yenu, nakwazo zonke iintsapho zenu, kuzo zonke izixeko zenu.
Nabani na obulala umntu, kufuneka afunyanwe njengomfazi ngelizwi lamagqwetha; akukho mntu uya kufa ngenxa yelizwi lemagqwetha omnye.
Musani ukuthabatha umvuzo, ukuze nigcine ubomi bomfazi ofanele ukuba afile; kufuneka aphele.
Musani nokuthatha intlawulo, ukuba umntu othe wabaleka waya kumzi wokhuselo, abuye ahlale ezweni lakhe, phambi kokuba umbingeleli omkhulu aphele.
Musani ukulibazisa ilizwe nihlala kulo; kuba ukubulala kulibazisa ilizwe, yaye akukho nto ingasindisa ilizwe phambi koThixo, emva kokuba umntu ebulawa, ngaphandle kokufa kombulalayo.
Musani kutshabalalisa ilizwe nihlala kulo, elizweni endihlala kulo; ngokuba mna iNkosi ndihlala phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.

Ke kaloku bafike abathetheli beentsapho zosapho lwakwaGiliyadi; uGiliyadi ngunyana kaMahiri, unyana kaManase, kusapho lwabafazi bakaYosefu. Bathetha ke kubo uMoses nabathetheli, abathetheli beentsapho zakwaSirayeli.

Bathi, Nkosi yam, iNkosi wamwisela umthetho, ukuba uyihlukanise ilizwe phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; wakumwisela umthetho ke iNkosi ukuba uyinike ilizwe likaZelofehadi, umzalwana wethu, oonyana bakhe.

Ke kaloku, ukuba babhiyozela amadoda ezinye izizwe zakwaSirayeli, ilizwe labo liya kususwa kwilizwe leentsapho zethu, lidityaniswe nelizwe lesizukulwana ababhiyozela kuso; ngoko ke inxalenye yethu iya kuba ncinci.
Ke kaloku, xa unyaka womnyaka omtsha wabaSirayeli ufikayo, ilizwe labo liza kudityaniswa nelifa labafazi babo; liya kuthunyelwa ezweni lesizwe sabafazi bethu, ukuze libe ngcono.
UMoses wamisa oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngokwemiyalelo kaYehova, wathi, Izinto ezithethayo isizukulwana samaYuda uYosefu zilungile.
Le nto iNkosi awawisela umthetho ngayo ngeentombi zikaZelofehadi, esithi, Bakwazi ukunika indodana kwabo banqwenelayo; kuphela ukuba babe yindodana yosapho lwesizwe sikayise.
Akuyi kudlula ilizwe ezweni likaSirayeli, lisuka kwisizukulwana sinye lifike kwisizukulwana esinye; bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli baya kuyigcina ilizwe lesizukulwana sabafazi babo.
Yonke intombi efumana ilizwe, kulo naluphi na ulutsha lwakwaSirayeli, kufuneka ibe ngumfazi wosapho lwesizukulwana soyise; ukuze ke abaSirayeli bonke bathathe ilizwe labafazi babo.
Akuyi kubakho ilizwe elisuka kwisizukulwana sisinye lisiya kwesizukulwana esinye; ngokuba isizukulwana ngasinye samaSirayeli siya kuhlala sinelizwe laso.
Zazenza ke iintombi zikaZelofehadi, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo uMoses.
Oonyana bakaZelofehadi, uMahala, noThirsa, noHogla, noMilka, noNowa, bazala oodadewabo abakwicala loyise.
Bafazisela kusapho lwabantwana bakaManase, unyana kaYosefu; ilizwe labo lahlala kusapho lukayise, kwisizukulwana sakhe.
Ezi zimimiselo nemithetho iNkosi wabawisela ngayo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngesandla sikaMoses, kwiindawo eziphakamileyo zaseMowabhi, ngaseYordan ecaleni kweYericho.
Deut: Lawona mazwi athethayo uMoses kubo bonke amaSirayeli, ngaphaya komlambo iYorodani, kwelasempumalanga, entlango yeYorodani ecaleni kweSufi, phakathi kukaParan noTofel, noLaban, noHaserothi, noDizahabi.
Iintsuku ezilishumi elinanye zokuhamba ukusuka emnqamlezweni kaSinayini, zifike eKadeshe-barnea, ngendlela ehamba kwelaseSeiri.
Ngonyaka omashumi mane, ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yeshumi elinanye, uMoses wathetha kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli zonke izinto awamwisele umthetho ngazo iNkosi.
Kwathi ke, emva kokuba ebetha uSihon ukumkani wamaAmoreti, owayekumkani eHeshbon, noOg ukumkani waseBhashani, owayekumkani eAshtarothi, eEdrei.
Kwakhona, ngasentshonalanga yeJordan, ezweni laseMowabi, uMoses waqalisa ukuchaza imfundiso kaThixo, esithi,
UYehova uThixo wethu wathi kuthi, sakuba sisenyuvesi yaseSinayi, Nihlala ixesha elide kuloo nyuvesi.

Yiya, nihambeni, nifike ezweni eliphakamileyo lama-Amori, nakwazo zonke iindawo ezijikelezayo, elunxwemeni lweYorodani, nelizwe eliphakamileyo, nelizwe eliphantsi, neNtshona, naselwandle; nifike ezweni lakwaKanan, naseLibanoni, ukuya kumlambo omkhulu uEfrayim.
Yabona, ndimise eli lizwe phambi kwenu; ningeneni, niyithathe ilizwe iNkosi wathetha ukuba liya kulinika ooyise benu uAbraham, noIsake noYakobi, nembewu yabo emva kwabo.
Ndathi kuni ngaloo xesha, Andikwazi ukuwuthabatha umthwalo wam mna kuphela, ukuba ndibakhokele bonke.
UYehova uThixo wenu wakwenza ukuba nikhule, nabonani namhlanje ningaba yinkwenkwezi emlilweni ngokuninzi.
UYehova, uThixo wabafazi benu, anikhuphele ngaphezu kwamakhulu amabini, anibhaptize, njengokuba wathi.
Ndingazithwala njani ke, mna kuphela, zonke iingxaki zenu, nezithuthi zenu, neengxabano zenu?
Nceda nithatheni amadoda anamandla, anengqondo, ayaziwayo phakathi kwezizukulwana zenu; ndiya kuwamisa abe ngabathetheli kwenu.
Waphendula mna, uthi, Kulungile into oyithethayo.

Ndathi ke, ndithabathe abathetheli bezizwe zenu, amadoda anobulumko, ayaziwayo, ndabamisela ukuba babe ngabathetheli kwenu; babe ngamawaka, nabamakhulu, nabamashumi amahlanu, nabalishumi, babe ngabaphathi beentsapho zenu.

Ke kaloku ndiwisela umthetho abagwebi benu ngaloo xesha, ndikuthi, Nxibelelanise phakathi kwabantu bakho; nithethe ngokuchanekileyo phakathi kwamadoda amabini aseSirayeli, naphakathi komntu waseSirayeli nomnye umkhenkce ohlala kuni.

Xa niyilungisa ityala, musa ukujongana necala; thetha nomncinane nomkhulu ngokulinganayo. Musani ukuxolela nabani na; ngokuba ityala nguThixo. Naliphi na ityala elinzima kakhulu kuni, lenze ukuba lifike kum, ndiya kuliva.
Ndathi kuni ngaloo xesha zonke izinto omele nizenza.

Sahamba ke, sasuka emnqamlezweni weSinayi, sadlula kuloo mfula mkhulu, onobungozi obubonayo. Ngendlela yomhlaba ophakamileyo wamaAmori, safika eKadeshe-barnea, njengokuba iNkosi uThixo wethu wamwisela umthetho;
Ndathi kuni, Nifike ezweni eliphakamileyo lamaAmori, elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wethu kuthi.
Yabona, iNkosi uThixo wakho uyibeke phambi kwakho le lizwe; nyuka niyigcine, njengoko iNkosi uThixo wabasetyhini benu abesithi kuwe; musa ukuxoka, mnakele.
Niza kum bonke, nithi, Sithumelele abantu phambi kwethu, ukuba sijonge ilizwe, ukuze bathubeke ngendlela esiya kuyo, nakwiidolophu esiza kuzifika kuzo.
Yathi loo nto ilungile kum, ndathatha phakathi kwenu abantu abalishumi elinambini, isizukulwana ngasinye umntu omnye.
Baya phezulu ezweni eliphakamileyo, bafika elunxwemeni lwase-Eshkoli, baya kulikhangela.
Bathabatha imbewu yelizwe, basithumelela phantsi; baphendula bathi, Ilizwe elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wethu lilizwe elilungileyo.
Ke kaloku, nithe ningathandabuzi ukunyuka; nani ke, nithixolela umyalelo kaYehova uThixo wenu.
Bathi ke, Kuba iNkosi usixhalabile nathi, waphuma eYiputa, ukuba asinikezele emlonyeni wama-Amori, ukuze athabathe isiphelo sam.
Bathi, Abantu abakhoyo apho banamandla kakhulu, bephakame ngaphezu kwethu; imizi yabo inkulu, iinqanawa zazo zifike emazulwini; siye sabona nalapho ooAnaki, abemi abakhulu kakhulu.
Ndathi ke kuni, Musani ukukhathazeka, ningabakhoyi.
UYehova uThixo wenu, ohamba phambi kwenu, yena uya kulwa ngenxa yenu, njengokuba nakubonayo ekwenzeni kwenu eYiputa.
Ke kaloku emhlabathini, ubone ukuba iNkosi uThixo wakho wamthabatha njani, njengokuba umntu ethwala unyana wakhe, yonke indlela, de nifike kule ndawo.
Ke kaloku, nangaphaya koko, ningamthembeki iNkosi uThixo wenu;
owahamba phambi kwenu ekuhambeni kwenu, ukuba akuboneni indawo yokumisa khona itente yenu; wambonisa indlela yokuya ngayo ngomlilo ngemini, nefuthe lilanga.
Wava ke iNkosi amagama enu, waxoka, wathi loo nto ingcwele:
Ke kaloku, akukho namnye kubo bonke abantu balo hlobo olubi, oza kubona ilizwe elilungileyo endithe ndathi ndiya kulinika ooyise benu,
ngaphandle kukaKalebe unyana kaYefune; yena uya kuyibona; ilizwe ebelihamba kulo ndiya kulinika kuye nosapho lwakhe, ngokuba walandela iNkosi intliziyo yakhe yonke.
Ke mna ke iNkosi waxoka ngenxa yenu, wathi, Awuza kungena kuloo lizwe nawe.
UYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, umkhonzi wakho, yena uya kungena kuloo ndawo; mncede; ngokuba yena uza kuzisa amaSirayeli athathe ilizwe njengelifa.
Bathi ke oonyana benu abancinci, ababesithi baya kuba yimikhosi yobuhlanga, abangaziyo into elungileyo nantoni na engalunganga, baya kungena kuloo mhlaba; ndiya kuwunika kubo, bayithathe njengelifa.
Ke nina, buyelani, nihambe ezweni elibi, ngendlela yelwandle oluMnyama.

Nithi ke kuni kum, Sisindise iNkosi; siza kukhupha sife, njengokuba iNkosi uThixo wethu asiwisela umthetho ngayo. Nathi ke nizigqogqa zonke izithuthi zenu, nicinga ukuba kuya kuba lula ukuphakama entlango.
Wathi ke iNkosi kum, Uthi kubo, Musani ukunyuka nibhiyozele; kuba mna andikho phakathi kwenu, ukuze ningabinjwa ngabathunywa benu.
Ndathi ke kuni, kodwa ningamkeli umyalelo kaYehova; niyiphulaphule loo myalelo kaYehova, nikhuphe izandla zenu ezweni eliphakamileyo.
Ke kaloku amaAmori, ahlala kuloo ndawo intaba-mlilo, waphuma waya kuniphulaphula, wabaphazamisa, njengamakhoboka eentyatyambo, eSeyiri nakwiHora.
Ke kaloku nibuyela, nalilila phambi koYehova; kodwa iNkosi akayi kuniphendulanga, akayi kukuxelela.
Nihlala ke eKadeshe iintsuku ezininzi, zonke iintsuku zokuhlala kwenu khona.
Ke kaloku sabuyela, sahamba sisuka ezweni elimnyama, ngendlela yolwandle oluMthubi, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngayo; sajikeleza imihla emininzi intaba kaSeiri.
Wathi ke iNkosi kum,
Uthe ke uYesu kubo: "Nisele nihamba ixesha elide kuloo mmandla womnqamlezo; ngoku buyelani emntla.
Nceda ubize abantu, usithi, Niya kudlula ezweni labazalwana benu, oonyana bakaEsawu, abahlala eSeyiri; baya kukuxolelani; qaphelani ke nize kakhulu.
Musani ukulwa nabo; ngokuba andikukunika nanye inxalenye yelizwe labo, nokuba yindawo ethe nkqo yonyawo lwakho. Ndiye ndayinika uEsau imilambo yaseSeiri, ibe yintsapho yakhe.
Nibahlawulele ngemali isonka esidlayo, namanzi asidlayo.
uyise, uThixo wakho, iNkosi yakho, iNkosi yakho, iNkosi yakho, iNkosi yakho, iNkosi yakho, iNkosi yakho, iNkosi yakho, naseYurophu, nakwiindawo zesizwe, izindlu zezidolophu.
Sathi ke, sadlula kubazalwana bethu, oonyana bakaEsawu, abahlala eSeyiri; sashiya indlela yoMlambo iYordan, enyukayo ukusuka eElathi noEsiyon-Gebere, sajika, sahamba ngendlela yesiqithi sikaMowabi.
Wathi ke iNkosi kum, Musa ukucaphukisa amaMowabhi, ungabi nemfazwe nabo; kuba ndiza kukunika nantoni na ezweni labo; ngokuba ndabanika oonyana bakaLote iAr ukuba ibe yindawo yabo.
Aba-Emi babehlala khona ngaphambili; baba ngabantu abanamandla, baninzi ngokwenani labo, bephakame njengeeAnaki.
Babizwa ngokuba nguRefayim, njengabaEnakim; kodwa amaMowabhi abiza ngokuthi nguEmim.
ESeyiri kwahlala ngaphambili amaHori; kodwa oonyana baka-Esau babebakhupha, bababulala, bafudukela endaweni yabo, njengokuba bakwenzela uSirayeli ezweni iNkosi awayewanika ukuba libe lilifa labo.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Yiya ngoku, nihambe ngaphezu kwelali kaZerede. Sahamba ke ngaphezu kwelali kaZerede;

Kuphela iminyaka emashumi mathathu anesibhozo yadlula ukususela ekuhambeni kwethu eKadeshe-barnea, safika sadlula emlanjeni uZerede; kwathi ke ngoko, lo hlobo lonke lwabafazi bokulwa luphelile ngaphandle komkhosi, njengoko iNkosi abewiselayo.
Ke kaloku isandla sikaYehova sakuba phezu kwabo, de baphelelwe lixesha ekungeneni kwabo emkhosini.
Ke kaloku, xa befa abo baphelileyo phakathi kwabantu, amadoda okulwa,
ke iNkosi wathi kum,
Namhlanje niya kudlula eArini, emda weMowabi.
Ke kaloku, xa ufike ezweni labantwana baka-Ammon, musa ukuwaphazamisa, ningabahlasela; kuba andikukunika nantoni na ezweni labantwana baka-Ammon; ngokuba ndayinika oonyana bakaLote ibe yindawo yabo.
Ke kaloku eli lizwe laziwa ngokuba yilizwe lamaRefayi, abahlala khona; amaAmmon athi kubo ngamaZamzumimi.
Babantu abanamandla, baninzi ngokwenani labo, bephakame njengeeAnaki. UYehova wababulala phambi kwabantwana baka-Ammon; babewakhupha, bahlala endaweni yabo.
Wakwenza njalo iNkosi kubo oonyana bakaEsawu, abahlala eSeyiri; wabulala amaHori phambi kwabo; bathabathela indawo yabo, behlala endaweni yabo, de kube ngaloo mini.
Ke kaloku amaAvhi, ahlala ezidolophini ukuya eGaza, babulawa ngabaKafthori, abasuka eKrete, babehlala endaweni yabo.
Yiya ke ngoku, vuka udlule emlanjeni ka-Arnon; bona, ndimnikela phambi kwakho uSihon, ukumkani waseHeshboni, umAmoreti, nelizwe lakhe. Qalisa uyithathele, uye kumhlasela.
Ndiya kuqalisa namhlanje, ndiza kwenza ukuba zonke iintlanga eziphantsi kwezulu zize zibe noxinzelelo nokukhathazeka kuwe; xa zithe zava igama lakho, ziya kutshisa, ziza kugwetywa ngenxa yakho.
Ndithumelele abathunywa, besuka emlanjeni weKedemothi, kuSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni, ngoxolo; bathi,
Ndithi, Siyadlula ezweni lakho; siza kuhlala kwindlela enkulu; asiyi kujika ngasekunene nakwesobunxele.
Nceda uthengise kuthi isonka ukuba sisele, namanzi ukuba sisele; siza kukuhlawula ngemali; siya kudlula nje ngeenyawo.
njengokuba bakwenze oonyana bakaEsawu abahlala eSeyiri, nabaMowabhi abahlala eAr; sihambe ke, sidlule iJordan, sifike kwilizwe elisinika lona iNkosi uThixo wethu.

Ke kaloku uSihon, ukumkani waseHeshboni, akazange asivumele sihambe ngaphaya. UYehova uThixo wakho wamnqula umphefumlo wakhe, waza wamnqula intliziyo yakhe, ukuze amnike phambi kwakho, njengokuba ekwenzeleyo namhlanje.
Wathi iNkosi kum, Yabona, ndaqala ukunikela phambi kwakho uSihon nelizwe lakhe; qalisa ke ngoku ukuba likhaya lakho ilizwe lakhe.
Waphuma ke uSihon, naye wonke umkhosi wakhe, ukuba athabathe intshayelelo eYahazi.
UYehova uThixo wethu wamnikela phambi kwethu, sawubetha yena nabantwana bakhe, neqela lakhe lonke.
Sazithatha zonke iidolophu zakhe ngaloo xesha, saziphelisa ngokugqithiseleyo, amadoda, namadodakazi, nabantwana; asiyi kushiya mnye.
Zonke iinkomo, nempahla esuka kumadolophu esiwathathela, sazigcina thina ukuba siyilahle.

Ukusuka eAroere, esembindini weNtaba kaArnoni, nomzi okwiNtaba kaArnoni, nakwiindlela zonke eziya eGiliyadi, akukho mzi ube nedonga eliphakamileyo ngaphezu kwethu; iNkosi uThixo wethu wazisa kuzo zonke.

Ngelo lizwe labantwana baka-Ammon ke, aweni yenu, nakwindawo ejikeleze umlambo uYabhoki, nakwiidolophu zesixeko esiphakamileyo, nakweyiphi na indawo iNkosi uThixo wethu abesithi, Musani ukudlula kuyo.
Ke kaloku sajika, sanyuka sesiya eBhashani. Waphuma uOg ukumkani waseBhashani, naye wonke umkhosi wakhe, ukuba athabathe intshayelelo nathi eEdrei.
Wathi ke iNkosi kum, Musa ukumkhokela; kuba ndimnikela phambi kwakho, yena neqela lakhe lonke, nelizwe lakhe; wenze kuye njengokuba wenza kuSihon, ukumkani wamaAmori, owayehlala eHeshbon.
Wathi ke iNkosi uThixo wethu, wamnikela phambi kwethu noOg ukumkani waseBhashani, naye neqela lakhe lonke; sawubetha, asishiyenga mnye.
Sazithatha zonke izixeko zakhe ngaloo xesha; kwakungekho sixeko ngasinye sazo, esingayithathelanga: ziidolophu ezimashumi asixhenxe, ilizwe lonke laseArgobhi, ubukumkani bukaOg eBhashani.
Zonke ezi dolophu zazinomqolomba ophakamileyo, neengcango nezitshixo; kwakunye neelali ezingenamgquba.
Siyazibulala zonke, njengokuba sakwenzela uSihon ukumkani waseHeshbon; siyazibulala yonke idolophu, amadoda namadoda nabantwana.
Zonke iinkomo, nazo zonke izinto ezisuka kumadolophu, sazithabatha njengento yobuxoki kuthi.
Ke kaloku sathabatha kuloo xesha ilizwe elunxwemeni lweYorodani, ukusuka emlanjeni ka-Arnon, ukuya kumnxweme weHermon, kukumkani ababini bakaAmori.
Amadoda aseSidon abiza intaba kaHermon ngokuba yiSiriyon; amaAmori ke abizwa ngokuba yiSenire.
Zonke iidolophu zendawo ephakamileyo, yonke iGiliyadi, nayo yonke iBhashani, sazithabatha, siye eSaleka noEdreyi, izixeko zokumkani ka-Og eBhashani.

UOg, ukumkani waseBhashani, wayeye wagqiba ooRefayim, abo bakhulu. Ibhedi yakhe yayiyintsimbi; ihlala mihla le eRabha, emzini wama-Amoni. Ubude bayo beyimitha ezisibhozo, ububanzi bayo beyimitha ezibini, ngokwemilinganiselo.
Kude ku-Aroere, elunxwemeni lweArnoni, kwelasempuma, ndabanika ooRubheni nabaGadi ilizwe lethu, salihlawula ngaloo mini, nesiqingatha selizwe eliphakamileyo laseGiliyadi needolophu zayo.
Ezinye zeGiliyadi, nazo zonke iBhashani, ubukumkani bukaOgi, ndazinika isiqingatha sesiqithi sikaManase. Wonke ummandla weArgobhi, eBhashani, wabizwa ngokuba yilizwe lamaRefayi.

UYaire, wesizwe sikaManase, wathabatha lonke ilizwe laseremu, ukuya kumda wamaGeshuri namaMaakathi; wababiza ngokuba ziidolophu zikaYaire, ngegama lakhe, izixeko zaseBhashani, nanjengoko zibizwa ngelo xesha.
Ndamnika uGiliyadi kuMahiri.
KwabaRubheni nakwaGadi ndabanika ilizwe elisuka eGiliyadi, lifike emlanjeni weArnoni, nephakathi komlanjeni ibe ngumda; yafika ke iye kumlambo weYabhoki, umda wamaAmmoniti.
Umhlaba wabo waba yiNtaba yeYorodani, umlambo iYorodani ube ngumda wayo, ukususela elwandle lwaseGalili ukuya kulwandle olufayo, phantsi kweendawo eziphakamileyo zePisga, emazantsi.

Ke kaloku ndathi kuni ngaloo xesha, iNkosi uThixo wenu uya kukunika eli lizwe ukuba lilungu lenu; bonke abantu bakho abanobuchule bokulwa baya kudlula bekhuselekile phambi kwabazalwana benu ooSirayeli.
Amabhinqa enu, nabantwana benu, nezinto zenu eziphilayo (ndiyazi ukuba ninezinto zenu eziphilayo ezininzi), baya kuhlala kumadolophu amnika wona;

kude kube iNkosi wanikela isixokelelwano kubahlobo benu, njengokuba wenza kuni; nabo ke bathathe ilizwe, elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wenu ngaphesheya kweYorodani; emva koko niya kubuyela ngamnye kuni kwilizwe endilininike lona.

Ke kaloku ndiwisela umthetho uYoshuwa ngaloo xesha, ndithi, Amehlo akho akubona zonke izinto awazenzayo iNkosi uThixo wenu kubo bonke abakumkani ababini; ngoko ke iNkosi uya kuzisenza kuzo zonke izikumkani oza kudlula kuzo.
Musani ukuxoka kubo; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wenu, yena uya kulwa ngenxa yenu.
Ke kaloku ndathandaza kuYehova ngaloo xesha,
UThixo wam, Nkosi yam, uqale nje ukunibonisa umkhonzi wakho ukuba ungumntu omkhulu nonamandla. Nguwuphi na lo Thixo ezulu, okanye ehlabathini, onokwenza izinto zakho ezikhulu nezinamandla?
Nceda, ndiya kudlula, ndibone eli lizwe lilungileyo elunxwemeni lwaseJordan, iintaba ezilungileyo, neLebanon.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxoka kum ngenxa yenu, akandiphendulanga. Wathi ke iNkosi kum, Kulungile; musa ukuqhubeka uthetha nam ngaloo nto.
Yiya phezulu kwisiqithi sePisga, ujonge emazantsi, nasempumalanga, nasentshona, nasempumalanga; ujonge ilizwe ngamehlo akho; kuba awuyi kudlula loo Yordan.
Ke kaloku, misela uYoshuwa ukuba abe ngukumkani wakho; unciphise umphefumlo wakhe, unyamkele; ngokuba yena uya kudlula esi sihlwele, naye uya kubanceda bathathe ilifa lelizwe oza kulibona.
Ke kaloku sahlala emlanjeni, ecaleni kweBhete-peori.
Ke ngoko, Israel, phulaphula imiyalelo nemimiselo endikuzifundisayo, uyigcine, ukuze niphile, ningene niyithathe njengelifa ilizwe elinika lona iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi benu.
Musani ukongeza nantoni na kumyalelo wam, ningawukhuphi nantoni na kuwo; nizithobele kuphela imimiselo kaYehova uThixo wenu, endiyikumkela.
Yabona amehlo enu into awayeyenza iNkosi ngoBhaali-fehore; bonke abo balandela uBhaali-fehore, idini likaThixo wakho, iNkosi uThixo wakho wabacima phakathi kwenu.
Ke nina bonke abathe bathabathela kuYehova uThixo wenu, niphila namhlanje.
Yabona, ndinifundile imimiselo nemimiselo yomthetho, njengoko iNkosi uThixo wam amwiselayo; ukuze nizigcine kuloo lizwe niya kuyo niyithathe njengelifa.

Nizigcine, nizigcine; kuba oku kuya kwenza ukuba ilizwe likwazi ubulumko benu nokuqonda kwenu. Bathi, xa beva ngazo zonke ezi mithetho, bathi, Ngokuqinisekileyo abantu abanobulumko nokuqonda balapha kuloo lizwe likhulu.
Nguwuphi na lo mmandla omkhulu, onegama likaThixo elifutshane kuye, njengokuba iNkosi uThixo wethu efana nathi, xa sithandaza kuye?
Nguwuphi na ke lo mhlaba omkhulu, onemimiselo nemimiselo elungileyo, njengawo onke la mazwi ndiwabeka phambi kwenu namhlanje?

Ke ngoko, nizigcineni, nizikhusele ngokungqongqo iintliziyo zenu, ukuze ningazibali izinto ezibonayo amehlo enu; zingabikho ziphuma entliziyweni yenu zonke imihla yobomi bakho; nizifundise oonyana benu nabantwana beentsana zenu.

Yakhumbula imini ohlala ngayo phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, emnqamlezweni kaSinayi, xa wathi kum iNkosi, Zihlanganiseni abantu phambi kwam, ukuze bazive amagama am; ukuba bafunde ukumkhokela yonke imihla yobomi babo phezu kwehlabathi, bazifundise oonyana babo.
Niye nifike, nihlale phantsi komnqamlezo wentaba; yathi intaba iqhutywa ngumlilo, ufike ezulu; yayimnyama kakhulu, ibe yinkungu emhlophe.
Wathetha ke kuni iNkosi phakathi komlilo; niva ilizwi lezinto, kodwa ningabona nasiphi na isibonakaliso; kwakukho nje ilizwi.
Wathetha kuni umnqophiso wakhe, imiyalelo elishumi, awawisela umthetho ngayo ukuba niyenze; wazibhalela kwiitafile ezimbini zelitye.
Wathi ke kum iNkosi ngaloo xesha, ukuba ndikufundise imimiselo nemimiselo yomthetho, ukuze niyenze ezweni lenu eliphumayo ukuba lilungu lenu.
UYehova wathetha nani emnqamlezweni kamlilo, endlwini yenduli yaseSinayi; ningabona nasiphi na isibonakaliso ngaloo mini; ngoko ke, qaphelani kakhulu.
Musani nokuzibulala, niyenze imifanekiso engumqondiso yento nantoni na, nokuba yimifanekiso yomfazi, nokuba yimifanekiso yomfazi;
nokuba yintoni na into ephilayo emhlabeni, nokuba yintoni na intaka enqumlayo emanzini,
nakweyiphi na into ehambayo phezu komhlaba, nakweyiphi na intlanzi enamanzi phantsi komhlaba.

Nakuba ujonge phezulu emazulwini, uzibone ilanga nenyanga neenkwenkwezi zonke ezikhanyayo emlilweni wezulu; ungaze ube ngumnqweno wokuvakala ngazo, uyeke ukuzinikela kuzo: ngenxa yokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho wazisa kuwo onke amazwe aphantsi kwehlabathi.
Nini ke iNkosi wamthabatha, waphuma nisuka eYiputa, kwifuthe lentsimbi, ukuze nibe ngabantu bakhe abakhethekileyo, njengokuba ninjalo namuhla.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxoka kum ngenxa yenu, waza wanquma ukuba andiyi kudlula iJordan, ndingene ezweni elilungileyo iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona ukuba libe lilifa lakho.
Ndiya kufa apha kuloo lizwe; andiyi kudlula iJordan; ke nina niza kuyidlula, niyithathe leyo lizwe elilungileyo.
Khumbulani, musa ukulibala umnqophiso kaYehova uThixo wenu, owawenza nani; musa ukwenza kuni imifanekiso engumqondiso, nantoni na efana nayo, leyo iNkosi uThixo wakho ayichazile.
Kuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, ngumlilo otshisa yonke into; uThixo ozinikeleyo yena, akakunikezeli ububele bakho nomnye.

Xa ubele abantwana, nabantwana bezintwana zakho, nihlale ixesha elide kuloo lizwe, ningabi nani nomonakalo, niyenze imifanekiso engumqondiso, nayiphi na imilo, nikwenze okubi phambi koYehova uThixo wenu, ukuze niyamcaphuke.

Ndizibiza izulu nehlabathi namhlanje, ukuba zibe ngamaxwebhu kuni, ukuba niza kulahleka ngokukhawuleza kwilizwe lenu elidlulayo eJordan, ukuze ningabikho kulo; aniyi kuhlala khona ixesha elide, kodwa niya kuqhutywa.
UYehova uya kukusasaza phakathi kwamazwe; niya kuba ncinane, ningabikho phakathi kwamazwe, apho iNkosi akuthutha khona.
Uza kukhonza khona amadini ayenziwe ngezandla zabantu, imithi nelitye, angabonanga, angavanga, angadlanga, angafumanga.
Ke kaloku, xa ukhangela khona iNkosi uThixo wakho, uya kumfumana, ukuba ukhangela kuye intliziyo yakho yonke nomoya wakho wonke.
Ke kaloku, xa uphelelwe lixesha, zifike kuwe zonke ezi zinto; ngoko ke, ekupheleni kweentsuku, niya kubuyela kuYehova uThixo wenu, ningamthobeli.
Kuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, nguThixo onobubele; akakushiyelanga, akakulahleki; akakulibalanga umnqophiso wakhe, awawubhiyozela ngaye ooyise.

Yabuza ke ngoku, ngemihla eyadlulayo ngaphambili kwakho, ukususela kumhla uThixo awenza khona umntu phezu komhlaba; yabuza ukusuka kwelinye icala lesibhakabhaka ukuya kwelinye icala lesibhakabhaka: Ingaba kwenzeka ntoni na into enjalo enkulu? Ingaba kukho umntu owaziyo into enjalo?
Ingaba kukho umntu owaziyo ilizwi likaThixo lithethayo phakathi komlilo, njengokuba ukubonayo wena, waphila?

Ingaba kukho uThixo othe wazama ukuthabatha isizwe esisuka kwisizwe, ngovavanyo, ngemiqondiso, ngezimangalo, ngokulwa, ngesandla sakhe esinamandla, nemqolo yakhe eqinileyo, ngezinto ezinkulu ezibuhlungu? Kunjalo oko iNkosi uThixo wenu awakwenzayo kuni eYiputa, phambi kwamehlo akho.
Ziboniswe kuwe ezi zinto, ukuze wazi ukuba iNkosi nguThixo; akukho namnye uThixo ngaphandle kwakhe.
Wakwenza uzive ilizwi lakhe, ezulu, ukuze akufundise; emhlabeni wakwenza ubone umnxeba wakhe omkhulu, wathetha amazwi akhe phakathi komlilo.
Ngokuba wayewathanda ooyise bakho, wakhetha iziqhamo zabo emva kwabo, wamkhupha ngesandla sakhe eYiputa ngobukrelekrele bakhe obukhulu,
ukuze akhuphe izizwe ezikhulu, ezinamandla kunawe, aze akufake ezweni labo, akunike lona libe lilifa lakho, njengokuba kunjalo namhlanje.
Yazi ngoko namhlanje, uyibeke entliziyweni yakho, ukuba iNkosi nguThixo phezu kwezulu, naphantsi komhlaba; akukho mnye.
Nizigcine izithembiso zakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, endikuwiselayo namhlanje; ukuze kube lula kuwe, nabantwana bakho emva kwakho, nihlale ixesha elide ezweni iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona, mihla le.
Ke kaloku uMoses wahlula imimandla emithathu ngaphaya kweYorodani, kwelasempumalanga;
apho umntu obulala umntu ngengozi, ngaphandle kokumxolela ngaphambili, angakwaziyo ukutyibilika ekhuselweni; angatyibilika esinye sazo izixeko, agcine ubomi bakhe.
Iidolophu zazi: iBesere, entlango ephakamileyo, yabaRubeni; neRamoti, eGiliyadi, yabaGadi; neGolan, eBhashani, yabaSizwe sikaManase.
Lowo ngumfundiso kaMoses, owawuthi kubantwana bakaSirayeli.
La macebiso ke, nemimiselo, nemimiselo kaMoses, awawathetha kubo, xa bephuma eYiputa,
ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani, elunxwemeni oluseBeth-peori, ezweni likaSihon ukumkani wamaAmori, owayelawula eHeshbon; uMoses nonyana bakaSirayeli bamphikisa loo mfana, xa bephuma eYiputa.
Bafumana ilizwe lakhe, nelizwe likaOgi ukumkani waseBhashani, ookumkani ababini bakaAmori, abasemazantsi eJordan.
Ukusuka eAroere, esembindini weNtaba kaArnoni, waya emnxwemeni waseSiyon, lowo ngumnxweme waseHermon;
iqulethe yonke intaba-mlilo yaseYorodani, ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani, iye elwandle olufayo, phantsi kweendawo eziphakamileyo zePisga.
UMoses wayalela bonke amaSirayeli, wathi kubo: Yiva, maSirayeli, imimiselo nemithetho endithetha ngayo kuni namhlanje; zifundeni, nizigcineni, niziphumeze.
UYehova, uThixo wethu, wenza nathi umnqophiso emthini waseSinayi.
UYehova akawenzanga lo mnqophiso nabafazi bethu kuphela, kodwa nathi sonke esiphilayo apha namhlanje.
UYehova wathetha nani ngobuso-bubuso, emnqamlezweni womlilo, entliziyweni yentaba.
Mna ke ndahlala phakathi kukaYehova nani ngaloo xesha, ukuba ndithi kuni ilizwi likaYehova; ngokuba niye naphoxeka ngenxa yomlilo, ningayinyuka intaba. Wathi iNkosi,
Ndiye ndinguYehova uThixo wenu, owenza ukuba niphume eYiputa, ezweni lemisebenzi yezandla.
Akubakho kuni amadini athile phambi kwam.
Musa ukwenza kuwe imifanekiso engumqondiso, nantoni na efana nento ekwizulu ngasentla, nantoni na ekwihlabathi ngezantsi, nantoni na elwandle phantsi komhlaba.
Mna iNkosi, uThixo wakho, ndinguThixo ozinikeleyo, enqumlayo intlungu yabazali kubantwana, kuye kuhlobo lwesithathu nolwesine lwabamxhalabisayo; mna iNkosi, uThixo wakho.
Ke mna ndibonisa ububele kumakhulu amawaka osapho lwabathandekayo bam, abagcina imiyalelo yam.
Musa ukulisebenzisa igama likaYehova uThixo wakho ngento engafanelekanga; ngokuba iNkosi uya kulilungisa igama lakhe elisetyenziswa ngento engafanelekanga.
Uyigcine imini yeSabbathi ibe yingcwele, njengoko iNkosi uThixo wakho akuwiselayo umthetho.
Unazo iintsuku ezintandathu zokwenza yonke imisebenzi yakho.

ke loo mini wesixhenxe ngusuku lokuphumla loYehova uThixo wakho; akukho namnye oza kwenza ngalo nantoni na, wena, nonyana wakho, nonyanakazi lwakho, nomkhonzi wakho, nomkhonzikazi wakho, nenkomo yakho, neeseyile yakho, nazo zonke izitho zakho eziphilayo, nokuba ungumkhenkce ohlala ngaphakathi kwezithuthi zakho. Umkhonzi wakho, nomkhonzikazi wakho, kufuneka baphumle njengokuba wena uphumla.

Uya kukhumbula ukuba waba ngabakhonzi eYiputa, waza iNkosi uThixo wakho wakususa khona ngesandla sakhe esinamandla, nomqolo wakhe oqinileyo; ngenxa yoko iNkosi uThixo wakho akuwisela umthetho wokugcina imini yesikhumbuzo.
Khumbula utata wakho nomama wakho, njengoko iNkosi uThixo wakho akuwiselayo umthetho; ukuze ubomi bakho bude, kube lula kuwe kwilizwe elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wakho.
Musa ukubulala.
Musa ukubhiyozela isini.
Musa ukurhoxa.
Musa ukuthetha ubuxoki malunga nomhlobo wakho esidlangalaleni

Musa ukunqwenela umfazi womhlobo wakho; musa ukunqwenela ikhaya lomhlobo wakho, nokuba yindawo yakhe, okanye umkhonzi wakhe, okanye inkomo yakhe, okanye isilwanyana sakhe, okanye nantoni na eyiyo yomhlobo wakho.

Wathetha ke iNkosi la mazwi kwintlanganiso yenu yonke, ngelizwi elikhulu, phezulu entlango, phakathi komlilo, nefuthe, nobumnyama; akathethi nto engaphezulu. Wazibhalela kwiithayile ezimbini zamatye, wamnika.
Ke kaloku, xa niliphulaphule ilizwi elivela ngaphakathi kwesibhaka-bhaka, ngelixa intaba iqhuma ngomlilo, nani bonke abathetheli bezizwe zenu, namadoda amakhulu enu, nifike kum.
Nithi, UYehova uThixo wethu usixelele ubutyebi bakhe nobukhulu bakhe; saziva ilizwi lakhe phakathi komlilo. Namhlanje sibone ukuba uThixo unokuthetha nomntu, naye ahlale ubomi.
Ke ngoko, singafa ntoni na? Lo mzi omkhulu uya kusitshisa. Ukuba siza kuqhubeka siva ilizwi likaYehova uThixo wethu, siya kufa.
Nguwuphi na umntu owaziyo ilizwi likaThixo ophilayo lithetha phakathi komlilo, njengokuba siye saziyo, waphila?
Ufike wena, udibanise zonke izinto athethayo iNkosi uThixo wethu; nantoni na athethayo iNkosi uThixo wethu kuwe, utsho kuthi; siza kuziva, siyazithobela.
Wava ke iNkosi amazwi endinithethayo; wathi mna iNkosi, Ndiva into abathi yona abantu abo kuwe; zonke izinto abazithethayo zilungileyo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba injalo intliziyo yabo, ukuba bayigcine yonke imimiselo yam mihla le, ukuze bandise ukholo lwabo kum; ngoko kuya kuba lula kubo nabantwana babo ngonaphakade.
Yiya, uthethe nabo ukuba babuye kwizindlu zabo.
Ke wena, uhlale apha nam; ndiya kukuxelela yonke imimiselo, nemimiselo nemithetho, omele ubafundise yona, ukuze bayiphumeze kwilizwe endibanika lona ukuba libe lilifa labo.
Niyigcine ke loo nto, niyenze njengoko iNkosi uThixo wenu akuwisele umthetho ngayo; musa ukusuka kuyo ngasekunene nakwesobunxele.
Nihambe ngeendlela zonke iNkosi uThixo wenu awawisela umthetho ngazo; ukuze niphile, niphile kakuhle, nihlale ixesha elide ezweni elinokuba likhaya lenu.
Ke kaloku la mazwi, nemimiselo, nemimiselo yomthetho, iNkosi uThixo wenu wamwisela umthetho ukuba ndikufundise yona; ukuze nizigcine kuloo lizwe niya kudlula kulo ukulithwabela.

ukuze ukhathazeke ngoYehova uThixo wakho, ugcine zonke izithethe zakhe nemimiselo yakhe endikuwiselayo, wena nonyana wakho, nonyana wonyana wakho, onke amaxesha okuphila kwakho; ukuze uhlale ubomi obude.
Yiva, Israyeli, ucinge ukuba uya kwenza; ngoko kuya kuba lula kuwe, nawe uza kuba luhlanga olukhulu, ezweni eliphumayo ubisi nenkukhu, njengokuba iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi bakho, akuthethileyo.
Liva, Israyeli: UYehova nguThixo wethu; iNkosi omnye kuphela.
Uya kumthanda iNkosi uThixo wakho ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nangomphefumlo wakho wonke, nangommandla wakho wonke.
La mazwi, endikuwiselayo mna namhlanje, ahlale entliziyweni yakho.
Nizifundise kakuhle abantwana benu, nithetha ngazo xa nihlala ekhaya, xa nihamba phantsi kwendlela, xa nilala, xa nivuka.
Yazibophelela izandla zenu zibe ngumqondiso, nizibeke emehlweni enu zibe ngukumbuso.
Yazibhalela phezu kweengcango zomnyango wendlu yakho, nakwiingcango zakho.

Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi uThixo wakho ekukhokela ukuba ufike kwilizwe awayethetha ngalo kumafama akho, kuAbraham, noIsake, noYakobi, wathi uya kukunika lona, elizweni lemizi emikhulu nentle, ongayikhanga wena;
Iindlu ezigcwele izinto ezintle, ongazifakwanga ngazo; iziqulatho, ongazifakanga ngazo; izityalo zenkomo nezityalo zeoliva, ongazifaki ngazo. Ke xa usele, ube mnandi,
qaphela ukuba ungamlibali iNkosi, owayenikhuphe eYiputa, ilizwe lemisebenzi yakho yobulungisa.
UYehova uThixo wakho uya kuwukhathalela, uya kumkhonza, uze wenze izibingelelo zakho ngegama lakhe.
Musani kulandela amanye amadini, amadini eentlanga ezijikelezileyo.
Kuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, ophakathi kwakho, nguThixo onobuxoki; ukuba nilandela amadini athile, ngoko ke inkanuko yakhe iya kuqhuma phezu kwenu, ibe ikuzisusa phezu komhlaba.
Musani ukumtyhila iNkosi uThixo wenu, njengokuba wamtyhila eMasa.
Zigcineni ngokungqongqo imimiselo kaYehova uThixo wenu, nemimiselo yakhe, nezigqibo zakhe, awaziwiselayo.
Yenza oko kulungileyo, okulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, ukuze kube ngonaphakade kuwe; ningene ke ngoko, niyigcine ilizwe elilungileyo, iNkosi alilithethele ooyise benu.
aze akhuphe bonke abathunywa bakho phambi kwakho, njengoko wathi.
Ke kaloku, xa nithi abantwana benu ngemihla ezayo, Yintoni na le mimiselo, nemimiselo, nemimiselo, awawawiselayo iNkosi uThixo wethu?
Nithi kubo, Sibe ngabakhonzi bakaFaro eYiputa; iNkosi wasikhupha eYiputa ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.
Wathumela iNkosi imiqondiso emikhulu, nemimangaliso emibi, eYiputa, kuFaro nosapho lwakhe lonke, phambi kobuso bethu.
Wasikhupha khona, ukuba asingenise kuloo mhlaba, ukuba asinike lona, eli lizwe athethe ngalo kubazali bethu.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuthi, Siyenze loo mimiselo yonke, siyihloniphe iNkosi uThixo wethu, ukuze sibe noxolo mihla le, aze asigcinele ubomi, njengokuba esenza ngoku.
Ukuba ke siyazigcina sizenza zonke ezi mithetho phambi koYehova uThixo wethu, njengokuba asiwisela umthetho ngayo, siza kuba ngumthetho kuye.

Xa iNkosi uThixo wakho ekufumaneni kwakho ilizwe oza kungena kulo ukuba lilungu lakho, aze akhuphe phambi kwakho iintlanga ezininzi: amaHeti, namaGirgasi, namaAmori, namaKanani, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaYebhusi, iintlanga ezisibhozo ezikhulu, ezinamandla kunawe.
Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi uThixo wakho awazinikela phambi kwakho, uze uzihlasela, uya kuzibulala zonke; musa ukwenza umnqophiso nabo, nize ningazikhathaleli.
Musani ukuthatha omnye wabo ukuba ngumfazi wenu; abazalwana benu bangabi ngamadodana abo, nabantwana benu bangabi ngamadodana abo.
Kuba baya kuguqula abantwana benu, ukuba bangandithobeli mna, bakhonza amadini athile; ngoko ke uzuko lukaYehova luza kuqhuma phezu kwenu, aze akukhulule ngokukhawuleza.
Le nto niyenzayo kubo: Nizikhuphe izibingelelo zabo, nizibhole iinkunzi zebhokhwe zabo, niziphule iiAsheri zabo, nizitshise ngomlilo imifanekiso yabo engumqondiso.
Kuba uThixo wakho, iNkosi, ungumntu okhethekileyo kuwe; uThixo wakho, iNkosi, wakukhethela ukuba ube yimpahla yakhe ekhethekileyo, phakathi kwazo zonke iintlanga ezikwihlabathi.
Akuba ngenxa yokuba nininzi kunazo zonke iintlanga, ke iNkosi wamthanda, waza wamkhetha; kuba nakuba nincinci kunazo zonke iintlanga,

Ngokuba iNkosi wathandana nani, ngenxa yokuba wagcina ilizwi lakhe alilithetha ooyiseni benu; ngoko ke wamkhupha ngesandla sakhe esinamandla, wamkhulula endlwini yobuxoki, phantsi kwesandla sikaFaro ukumkani waseYiputa.
Uyazi ke ukuba iNkosi uThixo wakho, yena uThixo, uThixo othembekileyo, ogcina umnqophiso wakhe, nothando lwakhe, kubo abamthandayo, nabagcina imiyalelo yakhe, kumashumi amawaka eminyaka.
Ke kaloku, uyasibuyisela esidlangalaleni abo abamchukumisayo, ukuba athabathe isigqibo sabo; Akuyi kuphinda-phinda ukusibuyisela esidlangalaleni abo abamchukumisayo.
Gcina ngoko, ukuba uyenze imimiselo, nemimiselo, nemimiselo, endikucebisa yona namhlanje.
Ke iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kukugcina kuwe umnqophiso wakhe, nobubele bakhe, njengoko wathetha ngaye kubafazi bakho, ukuba niyiphulaphule le mimiselo, niyigcine niyenze.

Uya kukuthanda, uya kukubhaptiza, uya kukwenza ukhule; uza kukubhaptiza ngeenyana ezininzi, neziqhamo ezilungileyo, nengqolowa, newayini entsha, neoli yeoli; uza kukubhaptiza iinkomo zakho ngeenkunzi zebhokhwe, nezimvu zakho ngeenkunzi zeegusha, ezweni awayethetha ngazo kubafazi bakho ukuba akubanike lona.
Uya kuba mkhulu kunazo zonke iintlanga; akukho mntu wakho, nokuba ngumfazi wakho, oza kuba mnyama; akukho mntu wezinto zakho eziphilayo ozakuba mnyama.
UYehova uya kukukhusela kuzo zonke iintsholongwane; akayi kukuzibeka phezu kwakho nanye yezifo ezibi, owaziyo eYiputa; azibeke phezu kwabo bonke abakuxolayo.
Uya kuzibulala zonke iintlanga, iNkosi uThixo wakho azinikelayo kuwe; musa ukuxolela kubo, ningawukhonzanga uThixo wabo; kuba oko kuya kukwenza ukuba ube ngumqolo kuwe.
Ukuba nithi entliziyweni yenu, Ezi lizwe zinamandla kunathi; siya kuzikhupha njani?
Musani ukuxoka kubo; khumbula kakuhle loo nto iNkosi uThixo wakho ayenze kuFaro, nakuyo yonke iMisir.

Amehlo akho abone zonke ezo ntlungu ezinkulu, nezibonakaliso, nezimangaliso, nesandla esinamandla, nomqolo oqinileyo, iNkosi uThixo wakho akukhuphe ngazo; ngoko ke iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kwenza kuzo zonke iintlanga, ongazixolela ngazo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kuzisa phakathi kwabo inkanuko, de bakhululwe abo bafihlakele kuwe.
Musa ukukhathazeka ngenxa yabo; ngokuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, unguwe; nguThixo omkhulu, onobubi.
UYehova uThixo wakho uya kuzikhupha ezi zinto zizwe phambi kwakho, ngenyameko; awunakukwazi ukuzibulala zonke ngaxeshanye, ukuze iintaka zehlabathi zingabaninzi kuwe.
Ke iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kuzinikela phambi kwakho, aze azigxininise ngamandla amakhulu, de bakhululwe.
Uya kubanikela phambi kwakho ookumkani babo, nawe uya kucima amagama abo phantsi kwezulu; akukho mntu uza kukwazi ukumelana nawe; uya kuwabulala bonke.

Iimifanekiso eqingqiweyo yamadini abo nizitshise emlilweni; isilivere naleyo golide ikwizinto zazo, musa ukuyilahla, musani ukuzithabatha kwenu, ukuze ingabi yintloko yenu; kuba iNkosi uThixo wenu uyichonga loo nto.

Musani ukungenisa endlwini yenu nanye yazo ezi zinto zixhaphakileyo, ukuze ungabikho uthuthuzelana nazo. Zithuthuzeleni ngokugqithisileyo, nize nizithuthuzele ngazo; ngokuba zithuthuzelwe ukuba zithuthuzeleke.
Nceda niyigcine imimiselo yam yonke, endikuwiselayo namhlanje, ukuba niyenze; ukuze niphile, nikhuleni, nifike niyithathe ilizwe iNkosi awathethileyo ngalo kubafazi benu.

Uya kukhumbula ukuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, wakukhokela loo minyaka imashumi mane yonke elwandle, ukuze akuxolele, ukuze akuvavanye, ukuze akwazi izinto ezisentliziyweni yakho, ukuba uya kuzigcina na imigaqo yakhe, nokuba awuzigcinenga.

Wakuxolela, wakwenza ukuba ube nesifo sokutya; waza wamnika i-manna yokudla, ongayaziyo wena, nabazali bakho, ukuze akufundise ukuba umntu akaphila ngesonka kuphela, kodwa ngawo onke amazwi aphuma emlonyeni kaYehova.
Izihlangu zakho azithengiswanga, nemilenze yakho ayitshizi, kule minyaka imashumi mane.
Yazi ngoko entliziyweni yakho, ukuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, uyayinyamezela, uyinyamezela, njengokuba umzali enyamezela unyana wakhe.
Zithobele imimiselo kaYehova uThixo wakho, nihambe ngeendlela zakhe ezithandekayo, ningamkhokeli.
Kuba iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kukungenisa ezweni elilungileyo, ilizwe lemilambo nemithombo, enamanzi aphumayo phantsi komhlaba, aya kumagqabi nakwiinduli.
ilizwe lengqolowa, nesheyile, neentyatyambo zewayini, namatye omnquma, neentyatyambo zegranate; ilizwe leoli ye-olive, nenyathelo.
Uya kulula ukutya okuninzi kuloo lizwe, awuyi kuphulukana nantoni na; iithayile zayo zinentsimbi ngaphakathi kwazo, kwaye uya kukhupha isinyithi kumatye ayo.
Ke kaloku, xa usele uphelelwe, uya kubonga iNkosi uThixo wakho, ngenxa yelizwe elilungileyo alinika lona.
Jonga ukuba ungalibali ilizwi likaYehova uThixo wakho, ukuba awugcinenga umyalelo wakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nezigqibo zakhe, endikuwiselayo namhlanje.
Ke kaloku, xa nidla, naphezu kokutya kwenu; ke kaloku, xa nilungiselela izindlu ezintle, nihlala kuzo;
xa iinkomo zakho nezimvu zakho zikhula, xa isilivere yakho negolide yakho ikhula, nazo zonke izinto ozinayo zikhula;
musa ukubhiyozela, ungalibali iNkosi uThixo wakho, owenza ukuba uphume eYiputa, ilizwe lomsebenzi womkhonzi.
Wakuqhuba ngeendawo eziphakamileyo, nezibuhlungu zesihlabathi, neengcongconi ezinobungozi, neebhokhwe, ilizwe elincinane, elingamanzi; wakwenza amanzi aphuma kumthi oqinileyo.
Wakuxolela i-manna, engazange bayiqonde ooyise bakho, ezweni elibi; ukuze akuhloniphe, ukuze akuvavanye, ukuze kube lula kuwe kwixesha elilandelayo.
Musani kuthetha entliziyweni yenu, Nithi, Ndizifumana zonke ezi zinto ngesandla sam nobuchule bam.
Ke wena uya kukhumbula iNkosi uThixo wakho; ngokuba nguye okunika amandla ukuba ube mkhulu, ukuze agcine umnqophiso wakhe, awayethetha ngawo kubafazi bakho, njengoko kwenzekayo namhlanje.
Ukuba ke uya kulibala iNkosi uThixo wakho, uze ulandele amadini athile, ubezikhonza, ubezihlangula; ndithi kuni namhlanje, ukuba niya kuthotywa.
njengokuba iNkosi ebulala iintlanga phambi kwenu, niza kubulawa na; ngenxa yokuba ningamthobeli iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Liva, Israyeli! Namhlanje uya kudlula umlambo iYorodani, ukuba uthabathe ilizwe leentlanga ezikhulu, ezinamandla kunawe, imimandla emikhulu, enamagqabi afike emazulwini.
Babantu abanamandla, baphakamileyo; baya kuba ngamaAnaki. Uyazi loo nto, ukhe wava ukuba kuthethwa, Nguwuphi na oza kuhlala phambi kwamaAnaki?

Uyazi ke loo nto namhlanje, ukuba iNkosi uThixo wakho nguwo ohamba phambi kwakho, njengomlilo onqumlayo; yena uya kuzicima, aze azihlambulule phambi kwakho; wena uya kuzikhupha, uya kuzibulala ngokukhawuleza, njengoko iNkosi esithi kuwe.

Musani kuthetha entliziyweni yenu, xa iNkosi uThixo wenu ewazikhupha phambi kwenu, esithi, Ngokuba mna ndilungileyo, iNkosi wandingenise ukuba ndiyithathe le lizwe; kuba ngenxa yokuba ezi zizwe zibi, iNkosi uzikhupha phambi kwenu.

Awuya kungena uthathe ilizwe labo, ngenxa yobulungisa bakho, nokuba yinyaniso intliziyo yakho; kuba zizinto ezibi ezizweni ezo, ngoko ke iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kuzikhupha phambi kwakho, ukuze agcine ilizwi lakhe awayelithetha ooyise bakho, uAbraham, noIsake noYakobi.
Yazi ke ngoko, ukuba iNkosi uThixo wakho akuninika loo mhlaba omhle wokuba ngumnikazi wakhe, akunjalo ngenxa yobulungisa bakho; kuba ngaba bantu bemilenze emide.
Khumbula, ungalibali nantoni na into oyenzayo iNkosi uThixo wakho ukuba acamngce engqondweni yakho esiqwini; ukususela kumhla wokuphuma kwakho eYiputa, kuze kube ufika apha, iNkosi uyakuxhaphaza.
Nasentlango kaSinayi, niyenzile iNkosi ukuba acamngce, ukuze akucaphukele.

Ndaya phezulu entlango, ukuba ndizithathe iitoti zekhonkrithi, iitoti zomnqophiso iNkosi awayewenza nani; ndahlala entlango iintsuku ezimashumi mane neentsuku ezilishumi elinambini; andidlanga inyama, andisele amanzi.
Wandisela ke iNkosi iitoti ezimbini zamatye, ezibhalwe ngomnwe kaThixo; kuzo zonke ezo zinto wathetha ngazo iNkosi kuni emnqamlezweni, phakathi komlilo, ngaloo mini nize nihlangane.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimashumi mane nemini elishumi elinambini, iNkosi wamnika iitoti ezimbini zamatye, iitoti zomnqophiso.

Wathi ke iNkosi kum, Yiya phantsi apha ngokukhawuleza; kuba abantu bakho abawenzileyo ukuba baphume eYiputa, baphelelwe lithemba. Basuka ngokukhawuleza kuloo nto ndiyabawiselayo, benzenise imifanekiso engumqondiso yokhuni.
Wathi ke iNkosi kum, Ndibabona aba bantu, bona banzima kakhulu intamo yabo.
Ndimshiye, ndibasindise, ndikucime igama labo phantsi kwelanga; mna ke ndiya kukwenza ube lilizwe elinamandla, likhulu kunale.
Ndajika ke, ndawela phantsi emnqamlezweni; umnqamlezo wawutshisa umlilo; iitoti ezimbini zomnqophiso zazisesandla sam.
Ndajonga ke, ndabona ukuba nithe naphezu kuYehova uThixo wenu; nikhe niyenze inkunzi yebhokhwe eyenziwe ngomthi; nanikhe nihambe ngaphaya kwendlela iNkosi awawisela yona umthetho.
Ndazithabatha ke izityalo ezibini, ndazikhupha ezandla zam, ndazitshisa phambi kobuso benu.

Kwathi ke, ndiye ndatyhala ubuso bam phambi koYehova iintsuku ezimashumi mane nemini elishumi elinambini; andidlanga isonka, andisele amanzi; ngenxa yesono sam sonke ebenisenzayo, ukuba niyenze into engalunganga emehlweni kaYehova, ukuze niyamcaphukele.
Ndiye ndakhathazeka ngenxa yobuxoki bukaYehova, ngokuba wayexhalabile ukunibulala; ke iNkosi wandiphulaphula kwakhona.
Ke kaloku noAron iNkosi waxoka kakhulu, ukuba amsindise; ndathandaza ke ngoAron ngaloo xesha.

Ndayithabatha ke inkunzi yebhokhwe, eyenziwe nguThixo wenu, ndayitshisa emnqamlezweni; ndayiphucula, ndayitywina ibe ngumgubo omncinci, ngathi ngumgubo, ndawubeka umgubo walo kumlambo owela phantsi komlambo.
NaseTabera, naseMasha, naseKibrothi-hataava, niyenzile iNkosi ukuba agxeke.
Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi ekusithumela eKadeshe-barnea, esithi, Yiya, niyithathe ilizwe endiseyinike lona. Nithi ke, ningamthobeli umyalelo kaYehova uThixo wenu; ningamthembeli, ningamphulaphuli.
Niye nithe phantsi phambi koYehova, ukususela ngemihla endiyikwaziyo.
Wathi ke iNkosi kum: "Uya kusini na?" Ndawumisa ngoko umlomo wam phambi koYehova iintsuku ezimashumi mane, neenkwenkwezi ezimashumi mane; ngokuba iNkosi wathi ukuba uya kunibulala.

Ndathandaza kuYehova, ndathi, Nkosi yethu uThixouThixo, musa ukucima abantu bakho, abantu bakho abakhethiweyo, owabasindisela ngobunamandla bakho obukhulu, wabakhupha eYiputa ngesandla sakho esinamandla.
Khumbula abakhonzi bakho, uAbraham, noIsake, noYakobi; ungabonanga ukuba abantu banobuxoki obukhulu, nokuba bangabikho lungisa, nokuba banede.

Musani na ukuba abantu belizwe, elisisikhuphile kulo, bathethe bathi: Kuba iNkosi akakwazanga ukuwangenisa ezweni awayewawuthetha ngalo kubo; waza wabaxolela; ngoko ke waphuma waya kubabulala emlilweni.
Ke bona babantu bakho, abantu bakho abakhethiweyo, owabakhupha ngaphandle ngobukrelekrele bakho obukhulu, nomlomo wakho onamandla.
