Wathi ke iNkosi kum ngaloo xesha, Uthabathe iziqhoboshi ezimbini zelitye, njengezokuqala, uzikhuphe kum endlwini yomnxweme; wenze ibhokisi yemithi.
Ndiya kubhalela ezi bhodini amazwi asuka kwezi bhodi zakuqala, owazitshisayo; ke wena uya kuzibeka kwibhokisi.
Ndayenza ke ibhokisi yomthi we-acacia, ndazitshisa iibhodi ezimbini zelitye njengezokuqala; ndaya phezulu entlango, ndizithabatha iibhodi ezibini ezandla zam.

Wazibhala ke iNkosi phezu kweetheyibhile ezi, ngokwencwadi yakhe yokuqala, imiyalelo elishumi, awathetha ngayo kuni emnqamlezweni, phakathi komlilo, ngemini yokuhlangana kwenu. Wazinika ke iNkosi kum.
Ndajika, ndawela emnqamlezweni, ndazibeka iithayile esityeni endiyenzileyo; nazo zikhona, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho.
(Basuka ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, besuka kwiintaba zabafazi bakaYahan, bafika eMosera; wafa khona uAron, wabanjwa khona. UElezare unyana wakhe waba ngumbingeleli endaweni yakhe.
Basuka apho bahamba besiya eGudhoda, besuka eGudhoda besiya eYotbata, ilizwe lemilambo yamanzi.
Ngelo xesha iNkosi wahlula isizwe sikaLevi, ukuba sithwale ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, ukuba sihlale phambi koYehova, sisebenze kuye, sibhaptize ngegama lakhe; basenza njalo namhla.
Ngenxa yoko abaLevi bangabi nenxalenye yomhlaba phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe; iNkosi nguye inxalenye yabo, njengoko wathi iNkosi uThixo wakho kubo.
Ke mna ndahlala phezu kwentaba iintsuku ezimashumi mane, neentlanga ezimashumi mane, njengokuba ndahlala kuqala; iNkosi wandiphendula kwakhona, akakulahleki.
Wathi ke iNkosi kum, Yiya, uqhubele phambili abantu, ukuba bafike bathathe ilifa elizweni endithe ndathetha ngaso kubafazi babo ukuba ndiya kuwanika.

Ke ngoko, Israel, yintoni na iNkosi uThixo wakho oyifunayo kuwe? Ukumkhokela iNkosi uThixo wakho, ukuba uhambe ngeendlela zakhe, nokumthanda, nokumkhonza iNkosi uThixo wakho ngentliziyo yakho yonke nomphefumlo wakho wonke;
ukuba ugcine imiyalelo kaYehova, nemimiselo yakhe, endiyikumkisayo namhlanje, ukuze ube ngcono.
Yabona, izulu, nezulu lezinto eziphakamileyo zezulu, nguYehova uThixo wakho; nayo ihlabathi nazo zonke izinto zayo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wawathanda ooyise bakho, wabathandela; waza wakhetha iziqhamo zabo kuwe, phezu kwazo zonke iintlanga, njengokuba kunjalo namhlanje.
Ke ngoko, tshintshani intliziyo zenu, musa ukuba neentloko ezinde.
Kuba iNkosi, uThixo wenu, nguThixo wamadini onke, noKumkani wamakumkani onke; uThixo omkhulu, onamandla, onobungozi, yena; akajongi isizwe, akayi kuthatha intlawulo.
Uyamlungisa unyana-mntwana, nowesifazane; umthanda nomkhenkce ohlala phakathi kwakho, wamnika ukudla nokugqoka.
Ke nina ke, nithandani abakhenkethi; ngokuba ningabakhenkethi nakwaYiputa.
UYehova uThixo wakho uya kuwuxolela, uya kumkhonza; uyamnyamezela, uyenzile izibingelelo zakho ngegama lakhe.
UThixo wakho nguye, owenzayo kuwe zonke ezi zinto zikhulu, nezibuhlungu, amehlo akho azibonayo; uThixo wakho nguye.
Babemashumi asixhenxe abazalwana bakho, xa bewela eYiputa; kodwa ngoku iNkosi uThixo wakho wakwenza ukuba nininzi njengeenkwenkwezi ezizulu.
Uthandani ke iNkosi uThixo wenu, nigcine imimiselo yakhe, nezigqibo zakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe yonke.

Khumbulani namhlanje izinto owazifundileyo; kuba andithethanga oonyana benu, abangaziyo nabangaziboniyo ukuba iNkosi uThixo wakho wakubaphazela njani; abazange babone ubukhulu bakhe, nesandla sakhe esinamandla, nomqolo wakhe omde,
nezimanga zakhe, nezinto azenzayo eYiputa kuFaro ukumkani waseYiputa, nomhlaba wakhe wonke.

Bathe bakubona into awayeyenza kumkhosi wamaYiputa, ngeenqanawa zawo, neenqanawa zokulwa zazo; indlela awawenza ngayo amanzi eMlambo oMthubi ukuba ahambe phezu kwabo, xa bekukulandelela kwenu; iNkosi wabaphazamisa ngokugqibeleleyo, baye baphela nanjengoko benjalo namhlanje.
Abazange babone into awayeyenza kuni esiqwini, de nifike apha;

nento awayeyenza kuDathani noAbironi, oonyana bakaElibha, baseRubeni; apho umhlaba wavula umlomo wakhe phambi kobuso bonke bamaSirayeli, wabathwala nabo, nezindlu zabo, neetente zabo, nazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezibe nazo.
Ngokuba amehlo enu ayebona zonke ezo zinto ezinkulu iNkosi azenzayo.
Niyigcine ke loo myalelo onke, endiya kukuwisela wona mna namhlanje; ukuze nibe nobukrelekrele, nifike niyithathe ilizwe lenu, elidlulayo nilithathe.
ukuze nihlale ixesha elide ezweni, awayesithi iNkosi ukuba awabaniki ooyise benu nosapho lwabo, ilizwe eliphumayo ubisi nenyama yenkomo.
Kuba eli lizwe, onalo ukungena kulo ukulilawula, alifana neYiputa, nalapho niphuma khona; apho wamisa khona isiqhamo sakho, wasiyalela ngamanzi ngesandla sakho, njengegadi yeentyatyambo.
Ke loo mhlaba niwudlulayo niwuthathe, yilizwe leenduli neelali, lidla umhlwa ovela emlilweni.
Eli lilizwe iNkosi uThixo wakho elizikhathaleleyo; amehlo akhe ahlala kulo, ukususela ekuqalekeni konyaka ukuya kukuphela kwakhe.
Ukuba ke, niyiphulaphule ngokungqongqo imimiselo yam, endiyiwisela kuwe namhlanje, nithandane noYehova uThixo wenu, nikhonzane naye intliziyo yenu yonke, nomphefumlo wenu wonke;
uya kuzisa imvula kwilizwe lakho ngexesha layo, ebusika nasentwasahlobo, ukuze ugcine iziqhamo zakho, newayini yakho entsha, neoli.
Uza kuzisa iziqhamo ezindaweni zakho, ukuze zidla iinkomo zakho; uya kufumana ukutya okuninzi.
Khumbulani, musa ukunyanzelwa ukuba utshintshe umva, nikhonzane namanye amadini, niyihlole.

Ke kaloku, xa nikwenza njalo, inkanuko kaYehova iya kuqhuma phezu kwenu; uya kuzivala izulu, ingabikho mvula, ilizwe lingazalisi iziqhamo zayo; niza kufa ngokukhawuleza ezweni elilungileyo iNkosi aninika lona.
Ke kaloku, gcinani amazwi am entliziyweni yenu, nengqondo yenu; nizibophe njengephawu ezandla zenu, nizibeke emehlweni enu, zibe ngumbulelo.
Nizifundise oonyana benu, nithetha ngazo xa nihlala endlwini yenu, noxa nihamba ngendlela, noxa nilala, noxa niphuma.
Yazibhalela phezu kweengcango zomnyango wendlu yakho, nakwiingcango zakho;
ukuze nihlale ixesha elide, nina nabantwana benu, ezweni awayesithi iNkosi ukuba baya kulinika kubafazi benu, njengokuba zihlala iintlanga phezu komhlaba.
Ukuba ke niyilungisa imiyalelo leyo yonke, endiyiwisela kuwe, ukuba nithanda iNkosi uThixo wenu, nihambe ngeendlela zakhe ezithandekayo, nizibophele kuye,
ke iNkosi uya kuzikhupha ezi zinto zonke iintlanga phambi kwakho; uza kuzinikela ilizwe leentlanga ezikhulu, ezinamandla kunawe.
Yonke indawo apho ubeka khona inyawo lakho, iya kuba yakho; ukususela emasikweni ukuya eLibanoni, ukusuka kumlambo uEfrayim ukuya kulwandle olukhulu, luya kuba lumhlaba wakho.
Akukho namnye oza kukwazi ukumelana nawe; iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kwenza ukuba bonke abantu belizwe, apho ufika khona na, bakhathazeke ngenxa yakho, njengoko wathi kuwe.
Yabona, mna namhlanje ndinibeka phambi kwenu phakathi kokubhaptizwa nokulahla.
Uya kuba ngumsindisi, ukuba uphulaphule imimiselo kaYehova uThixo wakho, endikuwiselayo namhlanje.
Uya kuba ngumlamli, ukuba ningawuphulaphulanga umyalelo kaYehova uThixo wenu; ukuba nisuka kwindlela endiyiwisela umthetho ngayo namhlanje, nilandele amadini amanye, angaziwa.
Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi uThixo wakho akungenise ezweni oza kulifumana ilifa lakho, uya kubeka isibhengezo phezu komnxweme waseGerizim, nesalathiso phezu komnxweme waseEbhali.
Iinduli ezi ngasentshonalanga yomlambo iYorodani, ecaleni kokutshona kwelanga, kwilizwe lamaKanani ahlala emlanjeni weYorodani, elunxwemeni lwaseGalgali, kufutshane neentyatyambo zeMore.
Kuba nithe nidlula eJordan, ukuba ningangeni niyithathe ilizwe elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wenu; niyithatheni, nihlale kulo.
gcinani ukuba nizigcine zonke izigqibo zam, nemimiselo yam, endiyibeka phambi kwakho namhlanje.
Ezi zimimiselo nemimiselo, niyigcineni, nizisebenzele, ezweni iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi bakho, akunike lona ukuba lilifa lakho, zonke iintsuku zobomi benu phezu komhlaba.
Zonke iindawo, apho izizwe oza kuzikhupha ngazo, zakhonza khona amadini abo, ziqhekezeni ngokugqithiseleyo, kumatye aphakamileyo, nasezindulini, naphantsi komthi wonke oluhlaza.
Nizikhuphe izibingelelo zabo, nizibhole iinkunzi zeenkomo zabo, nizitshise ngomlilo ii-ashere zabo; nizithabathe imifanekiso engumqondiso yamadini abo, nizicime amagama abo kuwo onke amagumbi.
Musa ukukhonza iNkosi uThixo wakho, njengokuba bakhonza khona amadini abo.
Ke yena iNkosi, uThixo wenu, uya kukhetha phakathi kwezizukulwana zenu zonke indawo apho abeke khona igama lakhe, niya kuyo; nizame indawo apho ehlala khona, niye kuyo.

Nizise khona izibingelelo zenu eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zenu, ishumi lenu, neentyatyambo zenu, nezibingeleli zenu, nezipho zenu ezisuka emlonyeni, nabantwana abazalwa kuqala kwezilwanyana zenu zasekhaya, nezimvu.
Nidle khona phambi koYehova uThixo wenu, nina neentsapho zenu, niphumle ngomsebenzi wenu wonke, ngenxa yokuba iNkosi uThixo wenu wakubhaptizile.
Musani ukwenza njengoko sisenza apha namhlanje, apho wonke umntu eyenza into acinga ukuba ilungile.
Kuba ningazange nifike kwindawo yokuphumla, ilizwe iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona ukuba libe lilifa lakho.
Ke kaloku niza kudlula iJordan, nihlale ezweni elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wenu ukuba libe likhaya lenu; aze aninike ukuphumla kuzo zonke iintshaba zenu ezingqongileyo, nihlalise ngokukhuselekile.

Uza kuzithabatha zonke izinto endikuwiselayo, uze uzithumelele apho iNkosi uThixo wakho akhethayo ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe: izibingelelo zakho eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zakho, ishumi lakho, neentyatyambo zakho, nazo zonke izinto ezilungileyo owazinikelayo kuYehova.
Niphumle khona phambi koYehova uThixo wenu, nina nabantwana benu, neentombi zenu, nezikhonzi zenu, nezikhonzi zenu, nabaLevi abasezidolophini zenu, ababengenayo inxalenye yelizwe labo.
Khumbula ukuba ungazinikela khona naziphi na izibingelelo zakho eziqhutywayo.
Kulapho ke iNkosi akhethayo, esinye sezizukulwana zakho, apho uya kuzinikela khona; uza kuzenza khona zonke izinto endikuwiselayo umthetho ngazo.

Ke wena unokubhiyozela, uphile inyama, kuwo onke amasangoremu akho, ngokweminqweno yomoya wakho, ngokwesibhakabhaka sikaYehova uThixo wakho osinikayo; ongcolileyo naye ococekileyo angadla yona, njengokuba edla i-gazela okanye i-eagle.
Ke igazi, musa ukulidla; uya kulikhupha phezu komhlaba njengolwandle.

Musani ukuzidla ezi zinto ngaphakathi kwezixeko zakho: ishumi lembewu yakho, newayini yakho entsha, neoli yakho, nabantwana abatsha beentlanzi zakho, nabantwana abatsha beebhokhwe zakho, nantoni na oyibhiyozelayo, naziphi na izinto ozinikelayo ngokukhululekileyo, naziphi na izinto ozinikelayo.

Uya kuzidla phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, kwindawo ayiyikhethela yona, wena nonyana bakho, neentombi zakho, nomkhonzi wakho, nomkhonzi wakho, nomLevi ohlala ngaphakathi kwezithuthi zakho; uya kuthandazela phambi koYehova uThixo wakho ngazo zonke izinto ozisebenzelayo.
Gcina ukuba ungawalibalanga amaLevi onke amaxesha okuhlala kwakho ezweni lakho.
Xa iNkosi, uThixo wakho, esenza ilizwe lakho libe libanzi, njengokuba wathi kuwe, ukuba unqwenele ukudla inyama, uthi, Ndifuna ukudla inyama; ungadla inyama ngokwamathanda akho.

Ukuba lide kuwe indawo iNkosi uThixo wakho akhethayo ukuba libe khona igama lakhe, ke uya kulila iinkomo zakho nezimvu ozinike zona iNkosi, njengokuba ndikumwiselayo umthetho; uya kulula ngaphakathi kwezixeko zenu, ngokweminqweno yakho.
Njengokutya i-gazela, nokuba yi-eagle, uya kulila loo nto; nalowo ungcolileyo naye ococekileyo angalidla.
Ke kaloku, qaphela ukuba ungadli igazi; ngokuba igazi ngubomi; musa ukutya bobomi kunye nenyama.
Musani ukuyidla igazi layo; liqhutywe phezu komhlaba njengamanzi.
Musa ukuyidla, ukuze kuphile kakuhle kuwe, nabantwana bakho emva kwakho; ngokuba uza kwenza okulungileyo ebusweni bakaYehova.
Zonke izinto zakho ezingcwele, nazo zonke izibingelelo zakho, uzithathe, uhambe uye kwindawo ebeyikhethayo iNkosi.

Uya kuzinikela izibingelelo zakho ezitshiswayo, inyama negazi, phezu kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uThixo wakho; igazi leenyama zakho zosindiso liya kuqhutywa phantsi kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uThixo wakho; inyama ke uyidle.
Zigcine, uzithobele onke la mazwi ndikuwiselayo; ukuze kube lula kuwe nabantwana bakho emva kwakho mihla le, ukuba wenze oko kulungileyo nokuthe nkqo phambi kobuso bukaYehova uThixo wakho.
UYehova uThixo wakho uya kuzicima iintlanga phambi kwakho, kwilizwe oza kungena kulo ukulifumana; xa ubezikhuphile, uze uhlale ezweni labo.

qaphela, ukuze ungabi ngumthwalo, ukuba uhambe ngeendlela zabo, emva kokuba bakhululwe phambi kwakho. Musa ukubuza ngoThixo wabo, uthi, Ngayiphi na indlela ezi zizwe zikhonza ngayo ooThixo babo, siza kuyenza njalo.

Musa ukukhonza iNkosi uThixo wakho ngendlela yabo; ngokuba yonke into enobuxoki kuYehova, eyamkhokelayo, bayayenza yizithixo zabo; nabantwana babo neentombi zabo bazitshisa emlilweni, zibe yimibingelelo izithixo zabo.
Zonke izinto endikukuwisela umthetho ngazo, uzigcinele ukuba uzenze; ungazikhuphi nantoni na kuyo, ungayisuse nantoni na kuyo.
Ukuba uprofeti, okanye umntu ochaza iphupha, uya kuvela phakathi kwakho, aze akuxelele umqondiso okanye isimanga.
Ke kaloku, ukuba kwenzeke loo mqondiso, naloo mmangaliso athetha ngawo, wathi ke, Silandele amadini athile, amadini awawaziyo, sikhonzane nawo;
musa ukuphulaphula umprofeti lowo, okanye umphuphi lowo; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wenu uyakuvavanya, ukuze akwazi ukuba nimthanda na iNkosi intliziyo yenu yonke nomoya wenu wonke.
Ulandele iNkosi uThixo wakho, uyendezele kuye; uzigcine imiyalelo yakhe, uyiphulaphule; umkhonze yena, uncede naye.

Lo mprofeti lowo, okanye loo mphuphi, kufuneka aphele; ngokuba wathetha kuni ukuba nigweme iNkosi, uThixo wenu, owayenikhuphe ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze akusindise endlwini yobulungisa, ukuze anikhulise kwindlela awawiseleyo yona iNkosi, uThixo wakho, ukuba nihambe ngayo. Ke ngoko, nizisuse ezi zinto zibi phakathi kwenu.

Ukuba unyana wakho, okanye unyana wakho, okanye intombi yakho, okanye umfazi wesandla sakho, okanye umhlobo wakho osemphefumlweni wakho, uya kuzama ukutyumza ngokufihlakeleyo, esithi, Siye sikhonze amanye amadini, amadini awawazi wena nabazalwana bakho;
amadini eentlanga ezingqongileyo kwenu, aphakathi naphezu kwenu, ukususela kwisiphelo esisodwa sehlabathi ukuya kwesiphelo esinye.
Musa ukuthobela kubo, ungabaphulaphuli; musa ukuba neentloni ngenxa yabo, ungabakhathaleli, ungabakhuseli.
Uya kubabulala ngokuqinisekileyo; isandla sakho siza kuqala ukuwabetha, ke ngoko izandla zaba bantu bonke.
Bathabathe iithayile, babafa; ngokuba bafuna ukunisusa kuYehova uThixo wakho, owakuphumeza eYiputa, ezweni lomsebenzi wakho.
Bathi ke bonke amaSirayeli baya kukwazi, baza bakhathazeke; akukho namnye phakathi kwenu oza kuphinda ayenze le nto ibi.
ukuba ufundile, esinye sezixeko zenu iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika zona ukuba uhlale kuzo,
Baphuma phakathi kwakho abantu ababi, bakhohlisa amadoda asemzini wabo, besithi, Siya kuhamba sikhonza amadini athile, amadini awawaziyo.
Ke ngoko, uya kuyijonga loo nto, uyijonge, uyibuze ngokucokisekileyo; ukuba ikhona inyaniso, ukuba ibonakale, ukuba le nto yobuxoki yenziwe phakathi kwenu,
niwubulala ke wonke umntu ohlala kuloo mzi ngeqhwa; niwuphelise ngokupheleleyo, nalowo ukhoyo kuwo, nenyama yakhe.

Uza kuzihlanganisa zonke izinto ezilahlekileyo zomzi phakathi kwendlela yayo, uthabathe umzi wonke, nezinto zonke ezikuyo, uzitshise ngamanzi, zibe ngumnikelo kuYehova uThixo wakho; ibe ngumthi weentyatyambo ngonaphakade, ingakhiwanga.
esiya kukwenza, uThixo wakho uya kwenza; uThixo wakho uya kwenza, uThixo wam, uThixo wam, uThixo wam, uThixo wam, nasandleni zabo.
Ukuba uya kumthobela iNkosi uThixo wakho, ukuba ugcine yonke imimiselo yakhe endikuwiselayo namhlanje, ukuba wenze oko kulungileyo phambi kobuso bukaYehova uThixo wakho.
Niye nina oonyana bakaYehova uThixo wenu; xa umntu efa, nize ningazitshixi iinwele zenu, nize ningaziqulethe iinwele zentloko yenu.
Kuba uThixo wakho, iNkosi, ungumntu okhethekileyo kuwe; uThixo wakho, iNkosi, wakukhethela ukuba ube yimpahla yakhe ekhethekileyo, phakathi kwazo zonke iintlanga ezikwihlabathi.
Musani ukutya nantoni na enobuxoki kuYehova.
Ezi zizinto eziphilayo oza kuzidla: inkomo, nengulube, nebhokhwe,
iinkunzi zeegusha, neengcuka, neengcuka zeenkomo, neentlanzi zolwandle, neentlanzi ezimnyama, neentlanzi zasendle, nezimvu zasendle.
Ungadla nasiphi na isilwanyana esinomqolo ogqityiweyo ohlukaniswe ibe zimbini kwaye sitshisa iinwele.

Ke kaloku, phakathi kwazo zonke iintaka ezidla ngotywala, nakwiinyama ezinomqolo ophindwe kabini, ningakululi iingelosi, nebhokhwe, nebhokhwe yolwandle; ngenxa yokuba zidla ngotywala, kodwa akukho mqolo ophindwe kabini kuzo; ziya kuba zimbi kuni.
Ingulube nayo iya kuba mnyama kuni; inenkqubo ephindwe kabini, kodwa ayitshiyi. Musani kulila inyama yawo, ningawucoci mphefumlo wakhe.
Kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo emanzini, nantoni na enamaphiko neengxowa-mali, nizidle.
Ke kaloku nantoni na engenaziqhamo neziqhoboshi, musa ukuyidla; iya kuba yinyani kuni.
Ungadla nayiphina intaka ecocekileyo.
Ezi ziintaka zenu aziyi kuzidla: i-eagle, ne-eagle encinci, ne-osprey,
ibhokhwe ebomvu, ibhokhwe emnyama, nayiphi na indidi yebhokhwe
naluphi na uhlobo lweqhwa,
i-ostriche, i-owl, i-seagull, nayiphi na indidi ye-hawk;
i-owl encinci, ne-owl enkulu, ne-owl enezikhonkwane,
i-pelican, ne-eagle, ne-cormorant,
i-stork, nayiphi na indidi ye-heron, i-hoopee, ne-bat.
Zonke iintlanzi ezibhabhayo ziya kuba zimbi kuni; musa ukuzidla.
Nayiphi na into ecocekileyo enamaphiko, niyidle.

Musani kulila nantoni na ephilayo; ungamnika umkhenkce ohlala ezindlwini zakho, ukuba alule, okanye uyithengise kumkhenkce; ngokuba wena unguhlanga olukhethekileyo, ungcwele kuYehova uThixo wakho; musa ukupheka inkunzi yeegusha emlilweni womntwana wayo.
Unyaka ngamnye uqiniseke ukuba ubeka phantsi ishumi elinalinye lazo zonke iziqhamo eziveliswa ziimihlaba yakho.

Uya kuzidla ishumi lembewu yakho, newayini yakho entsha, neoli yakho, nabantwana abazalisekileyo beebhokhwe zakho nezimvu zakho, phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, kwindawo ayifumeneyo ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe; ukuze ufunde ukumkhokela iNkosi uThixo wakho yonke imihla.
Ke kaloku iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kukubhaptiza, ukuba indawo ebeya kuyikhethela igama lakhe ibe lide kakhulu kuwe, nendlela ibe yindibaniselwano, ukuze ungathutha khona ishumi lakho.
Ke ngoko, uyithengise ngemali; uze uthathe imali emlonyeni wakho, uye kwindawo ebeya kuyikhetha iNkosi uThixo wakho.

Zithengise ngazo zonke izinto ezifunayo intliziyo yakho, iinkomo, nezimvu, newayini, nesiselo esiqinileyo, nantoni na oyifunayo intliziyo yakho; nidle khona phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, wena nosapho lwakho, niphile.
AbaLevi ke, abahlala ezidolophini zakho, musa ukuwalibala; ngokuba akukho nxalenye yelizwe labo.
Kwisiphelo seminyaka emithathu nganye, niyingenise ishumi elipheleleyo lemveliso yonyaka lowo, niyigcine ezidolophini zenu.

Ke kaloku uya kungena uLevi, ongeke abe nenxalenye yelizwe lakhe, nomkhenkce, nabantwana abafileyo, nabafazi abangamabhinqa abahlala ezindlwini zakho; baza badla baya kuthotywa. UYehova uThixo wakho uza kukubhaptiza ngazo zonke izinto ozisenzayo.
Kwisiphelo seminyaka esixhenxe nganye, kufuneka ususe zonke iindleko.

Kunjalo ke okuya kwenziwa: wonke umntu onika imali umhlobo wakhe waseremu, kufuneka ahlawulele. Akuyi kuhlawuliswa ngumhlobo wakhe, nokuba ungumzalwana wakhe; ngokuba ixesha likaYehova lokuhlawula livunyiweyo.
Unako ukucela ubuyiselo kumthandi wakho, kodwa uya kwenza ukuba umthandi wakho, umSirayeli, angabi netyala kuwe.
Akuyi kubakho phakathi kwakho umntu omncinane; ngokuba iNkosi uya kukubhaptiza ngokukhulu, ezweni elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wakho ukuba libe lilifa lakho.
ukuba nje uthandaza kuYehova uThixo wakho ngokholo olukhulu, ukuba ugcine ukwenze onke la mazwi ndiya kukuwisela wona namhlanje.
Kuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, uya kukubhaptiza, njengoko wathi; uza kunika ityala iintlanga ezininzi, wena ke awuzukuthatha intlawulo. Uza kulawula iintlanga ezininzi, kodwa aziyi kukulawula wena.

Ukuba kukho umhlwempu phakathi kwabazalwana bakho, kuwo onke amadolophu elizwe lakho iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona, ungabi nomsindo entliziyweni yakho, ungabi nomonde ngesandla sakho kumhlwempu lowo.
Ke ngoko, nizivule izandla zenu, nizinikezele ngokukhululekileyo nantoni na efunekayo.

Khumbula, ungabikho umbono ombi entliziyweni yakho, uthi, Unyaka wesixhenxe, unyaka wokukhutshwa kwetyala, usekufutshane; ungabikho ubuso bakho bumnyama kubazalwana bakho abahlwempu, ungabaniki nantoni na; ukuze bangaze bathandaza kuYehova ngenxa yakho, ube nesono.
Yazinikela kubo, ungabi nomsindo xa unikela; ngokuba ngenxa yoko iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kukubhaptiza kuwo onke amanyathelo akho, nakuzo zonke izinto ozenzayo.
Kuza kubakho abafazi ezweni; ngenxa yoko ndikuwisela umthetho, ukuba uvule isandla sakho kubazalwana bakho, abafazi nabafazi abafunayo ezweni lakho.
Ukuba umhlobo wakho, umHebhere, uthengiswe kuwe, nokuba ngumfazi okanye ngumntu wesifazane; ukuba esebenza kuwe iminyaka emithandathu, kunyaka wesixhenxe uya kumkhulula.
Ke kaloku, xa nibavumelayo ukuba bahambe, ningabathumeli bengenanto.
Uncede ngazo iinkomo zakho, namahlathi akho, namachiza akho ewayini; uncede ngazo, njengoko iNkosi uThixo wakho akubhaptizileyo.
Uya kukhumbula ukuba waba ngabakhonzi eYiputa, waza iNkosi uThixo wakho wakukhulula; ngenxa yoko ndikuwisela umthetho ngaloo mini.
Ke kaloku umkhonzi wakho angathi kuwe, Andiyi kukushiya; ngokuba uthanda wena nosapho lwakho, ngenxa yokuba ingqondo yakhe iphumle kuwe.
Ke ngoko, uthathe isixhobo esithe nkqo, uyitshise emlonyeni wendlebe yakhe emnyango; aze abe ngumkhonzi wakho ubomi bakhe bonke; wenze njalo nomkhonzi wakho.

Musa ukucinga ukuba kunzima ukushiya umkhonzi wakho ekhululekileyo; kuba iminyaka emithandathu yomsebenzi wabo ilingana neminyaka emibini yomsebenzi womqeshwa. UYehova uThixo wakho uya kukubhaptiza ngazo zonke izinto ozenzayo.

Yonke inkunzi yebhokhwe yakho, nebhokhwe yomntwana wakho, ibhinqa elilodwa eliqalayo, uyibeke kuYehova uThixo wakho; awuyi kwenza ukuba isebenze inkunzi yebhokhwe yakho, nalowo uqalayo webhokhwe yomntwana wakho, awuyi kumnquma.
Uya kuzidla phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, wena nosapho lwakho, ngonyaka ngamnye, kwindawo aze ayikhethe.
Ukuba inkunzi yebhokhwe inesiphene, ukuba iphindwe, okanye ibe mnyama, okanye ibe nesiphene nasiphi na esibi, musa ukuyinikela kuYehova uThixo wakho.
Eminaweni yenu niyidle; lowo ungcolileyo, nolowo ucocekileyo, bobabini baya kuyidla, njengokuba bedla i-gazela, nokuba bedla intaka.
Ke igazi, musa ukulidla; uya kulikhupha phezu komhlaba njengolwandle.
Yenza iPasha kuYehova uThixo wakho, kwinyanga ka-Abhibhi; ngokuba ngomhla wenyanga ka-Abhibhi iNkosi uThixo wakho waphuma kuwe eYiputa ngemini.
Umele ubhiyozele into ephilayo kuYehova uThixo wakho, ibe yipasha, emveni kweebhokhwe zakho, nakwiinkomo zakho, kwindawo ebeya kuyikhetha iNkosi ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe.

Musani ukuyidla nesonka esixutyiweyo; iintsuku ezisixhenxe niyidle isonka esingaxutywanga, isonka sokulibaziseka; ngokuba waphuma eYiputa ngokukhawuleza; ukuze niyikhumbula le mini, nalapho waphuma khona eYiputa, yonke ubomi benu.
Akuyi kubakho umgubo ezweni lakho lonke, iintsuku ezisixhenxe; nenyama oyinikelayo ngobusuku bemini yokuqala, akukho nto iya kuhlala kude kube mhlwa.
Awuyi kubhiyozela iPasha nakweyiphi na imimandla yakho, oyinika iNkosi uThixo wakho.
Kulapho kuphela iNkosi uThixo wakho akhetha khona igama lakhe ukuba lihlale khona, apho uya kunikela khona; emini, xa ilanga liphumayo, ngaloo xesha lemini naleyo waphuma kuyo iYiputa.
Uyitshizise, uyidle kwindawo iNkosi uThixo wakho aza kuyikhethela; kusasa ke nibuye endlwini yenu.
Iintsuku ezintandathu uya kudla isonka esingenasiqhamo; ngomhla wesixhenxe kubekho isibingelelo esikhethekileyo kuYehova uThixo wakho; awuzukwenza nantoni na umsebenzi.
Bala iiveki ezisibhozo, ukususela ekuqaleni kwenu kokuvuna iziqhamo ezindaweni.
Uza kwenza ke imini yeentsuku ezisixhenxe kuYehova uThixo wakho, ngomnikelo osuka entliziyweni; uya kunikela ngokungqinelana nemithandazo kaYehova uThixo wakho oyinikayo.

Uya kuphumla phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, kwindawo ayibokhethayo ukuba lihlale kuyo igama lakhe; uya kuthandana nawe oonyana bakho, neentombi zakho, nabakhonzi bakho, nabakhonzanzana bakho, noLevi osemzini wakho, nomkhenkce, nomntwana omncinci, namabhinqa amabhinqa, aphakathi kwakho.
Khumbulani ukuba nibe ngabakhonzi eYiputa, nizigcinele ezi mithetho, nizenza.
Umele ugcine imini yeentlanganiso ngeentsuku ezisixhenxe, xa uthabathe iziqhamo zendawo yakho yokuhlambela iinkomo, nesonka sewayini yakho.
Uza kuphumla ngaloo mini, wena, oonyana bakho, neentsana zakho, umkhonzi wakho, nomkhonzi wakho, noLevi, nomkhenkce, nomntwana omncinci, namabhinqa amabini, ahlala endlwini yenu.

Iintsuku ezisixhenxe uza kwenza isikhumbuzo kuYehova uThixo wakho, kwindawo ebeya kuyikhetha iNkosi; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kubambisa zonke iziqhamo zakho, nazo zonke izinto ozisebenzelayo izandla zakho; nothando lwakho luza kuba lugcwele.

Iintsuku ezithathu ngonyaka, wonke umfana wakho kufuneka afike phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, kwindawo awayekuyikhethela; kwiholide yeentlanzi ezingaxutywanga, nefestile yeeviki, nefestile yezindlu zangasese. Akukho namnye oza kungena phambi koYehova engenanto.
Yonke intliziyo yenu iya kunikela, ngokwento enokuyenza izandla zenu, ngokungqinelana nozuko lukaYehova uThixo wenu olukunika lona.
Uza kumisela abagwebi nabaphathi phakathi kwezizwe zakho, kuzo zonke izixeko zakho iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika zona; baya kugweba abantu ngenyameko.
Musa ukujikelezisa inyaniso, ungabi necala; musa ukuthatha umvuzo; ngokuba umvuzo uncamathelisa amehlo owaziyo, uguqula amagama abo abangenasono.
Inyaniso niyilandele, inyaniso kuphela; ukuze niphile, niyithathe ilifa ilizwe iNkosi uThixo wenu akunika lona.
Musa ukubeka isibonda se-Ashere esenziwe ngomthi, ecaleni kwesibingelelo osenza kuYehova uThixo wakho;
Musa ukumisela iikona ezingcwele; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho ubaxolela.
Musa ukunikela kuYehova uThixo wakho inkomo, okanye inkunzi yebhokhwe, enesiphene nasiphi na; kuba iNkosi uThixo wakho uyixolela loo nto.
Xa kuthe kwafunyanwa indoda, okanye indoda, esinye sezixeko zakho iNkosi uThixo wakho akunikazo, isenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova uThixo wakho, iphula umnqophiso wakhe.
ukuba ahambe, akhonze amadini amanye, aze amgxeke, nokuba yilanga, nokuba linyanga, nokuba ziinkwenkwezi ezisemhlabeni, ezo ndazithintelayo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba kuthethwa kuwe ngaloo nto, okanye ukuba uyifumene loo nto, khangela ke ngokucokisekileyo; ukuba ikhona into ecacileyo, ukuba le nto inobuxoki yenziwe kumaSirayeli,
uya kumthabatha umfazi, nokuba ngumfazi, owenza loo nto ilungileyo, waya emngxunyeni wedolophu yakho, uyityhalele ngepetroli, aze aphele.
Ngelizwi lamagwebo amabini, okanye ngamagwebo amathathu, umntu uya kufa; ngelizwi lamagwebo omnye kuphela, akukho mntu uya kufa.
Abashushisi baya kuqala ukutyhila iithayile kumntu lowo; ke ngoko bonke abantu baya kuqala ukutyhila iithayile kumntu lowo, ukuze ukhuphe okubi phakathi kwenu.

Ukuba kukho izigwebo ezifika phambi kweekomiti zakho zendawo, zinzima kakhulu kuwe ukuzigqiba, njengezigwebo zokubulala, nezigwebo zomnqamlezo, nezigwebo zokulimala; ke ngoko uya kuzithabatha ziye kwindawo iNkosi uThixo wakho aza kuyikhetha.
Uya kungena kubo ababingeleli, ooLevi, nomgwebi oza kubakho ngaloo mini; ubabuze malunga netyala; baya kukuxelela isinqumo sabo.
Uya kwenza oko baya kukuxelela ngawo, kwindawo iNkosi aza kuyikhethela; ujonge ukuba wenze zonke izinto abazithiyo.
Zigcine izifundo zabo, nezigqibo zabo; Musa ukujika-jika ekunene nakwesobunxele kwizinto abazithethayo kuwe.
Wonke umntu oza kwenza ubulukhuni, angamthobeli umbingeleli ohlala khona ekhonza iNkosi uThixo wakho, okanye umgwebi, kufuneka aphele; nawe uya kususa okubi phakathi kwaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu baya kukubona, baza bakhathazeka, bangabi nakwenza ngcono.
Xa ufike ezweni elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wakho, uze uyithathe ibe likhaya lakho, uhlale kulo; ungathi ke, Siyakwenza ukumkani phezu kwethu, njengokuba kukho iintlanga zonke ezijikelezileyo.
Ke ngoko, qiniseka ukuba usenza ukumkani wakho abe ngulowo iNkosi uThixo wakho awazikhethela yena; aze abe ngumntu wakho; musa ukumisela phezu kwenu umntu othile, ongasekho kubantwana bakaSirayeli.
Ke ngoko ukumkani akayi kukwazi ukulungiselela amahashe amaninzi kuye, aze abuyisele abantu eYiputa, ukuze akhuphe amahashe amaninzi; ngokuba iNkosi wathi kuni, Musani kuphinda nibuye kuloo ndlela.
Akuyi kuba namabhinqa amaninzi, ukuze intliziyo yakhe ingaphazamisi iNkosi; akuyi kuba nesilivere negolide eninzi ngokwayo.
Ke kaloku, xa ehlala phezu kwesihlalo sakhe sokumkani, abhale kuye ikopi yalo mthetho kwincwadi, evela kumfanekiso ogcinwe ngababingeleli abaLevi.
Uya kuba nayo, aze afunde kuyo yonke imihla yobomi bakhe; ukuze afunde ukuxolela iNkosi uThixo wakhe, ukuba agcine ekwenzeni onke amagama walo mthetho nalawo malungiselelo.

Akuyi kuba ngcono engqondweni yakhe kunabo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, akuyi kutshintshela ngasekunene nakwesobunxele kumyalelo; aze abe ngukumkani wakhe kumaSirayeli, yena nosapho lwakhe, iintsuku ezininzi.
Ababingeleli abaLevi, bonke isizukulwana samaLevi, bangabi nenxalenye ezweni lakwaSirayeli; baya kuphila ngeempawu zesonka esiqhutywa limlilo sikaYehova, eziye zaba yinxalenye yabo.
Akuyi kubakho ilizwe labo phakathi kweentlanga; iNkosi ke yena umyinge wabo, njengoko wathi kubo.
Le nto iya kuba yiyo oombingeleli, kubantu abanikelayo umnikelo, nokuba yinkunzi yenkomo, okanye ibe ngumntwana webhokhwe: imilenze, neziqhamo, neentlungu.
Zinike nazo izinto zokuqala zengqolowa yakho, newayini yakho entsha, neoli yeoli, nezinto zokuqala zesundu lweentyatyambo zakho.
Kuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, wabakhethela kubo phakathi kwezizukulwana zenu zonke, ukuba bahlale bekhonza igama likaYehova mihla le.
ULevi angasuka kuwo onke amadolophu aseSirayeli apho ehlala khona, aze afike, ngenxa yothando lwakhe olukhulu, kwindawo iNkosi aza kuyikhetha.
Athi asebenze khona ngegama likaYehova uThixo wakhe, njengabo bonke abazalwana bakhe abaLevi, abasebenza khona phambi koYehova.
Umele athathe inxaxheba elinganayo kwisonka, nokuba unemali ngenxa yokuthengiswa kwempahla yakhe yosapho.
Xa ufike ezweni elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wakho, musa ukufundiswa ukuba wenze ngokweendlela ezibi zeentlanga zalapho.
Musa kufumaneka phakathi kwakho umntu omisa unyana wakhe, okanye intombi yakhe, emlilweni, nokuba ungumprofeti, nokuba ungummangalisi, nokuba ungumxoki, nokuba ungummangalisi,
okanye enze izibingelelo, okanye athethe nezidumbu, okanye abe ngummangali, okanye azame ukuthetha nabafayo.
UYehova uthandazela wonke umntu owenza ezi zinto; ngenxa yazo zonke ezi zinto zixhaphakileyo, iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kuzikhupha izizwe ezo phambi kwakho.
Umele uhlale uthembekile ngokupheleleyo kuYehova uThixo wakho.
Iintlanga, oza kuzikhupha kuzo, ziya kwenza ukuba zivuke ilizwi labo abamangali, nabaprofeti; kodwa iNkosi uThixo wakho akakuvumelekanga ukuba wenze oko.
UYehova, uThixo wakho, uya kukuvusa umprofeti phakathi kwabantu bakho, njengam; niya kumxelela yena.

ngoko nalowo wawucelayo iNkosi uThixo wakho emnqamlezweni kaSinayi, ngaloo mini yentlanganiso yenu, esithi, Musani ukusiphulaphula kwakhona ilizwi likaYehova uThixo wethu, nokubona kwakhona lo mzi mkhulu, ukuze singafa.
Wathi iNkosi kum, Ilungile into abathe bayitshoyo.
Ndiya kubavusa umprofeti phakathi kwabantu babo, njengawe; ndiya kuzibeka ilizwi lam emlonyeni wakhe, aze athethe nabo zonke izinto endiyamwisela umthetho ngazo.
Nabani na ongaziphulaphulanga amazwi am, athethayo lo mprofeti ngegama lam, ndiya kumxelela ntoni?
Ke kaloku umprofeti othi, uthethe ngegama lam, into endiyiwiselanga ukuba ayithethe, okanye athethe ngegama lamanye amadini, lowo mprofeti uya kufa.
Ke wena ungathi, Siyazi njani ukuba akukho myalezo uphuma kuYehova?
Xa umprofeti ethetha ngegama likaYehova, yaye into athethayo ayiphumeleli, ingabikho, loo myalezo awusukanga kuYehova; lo mprofeti uthetha ngobukrelekrele bakhe; musa ukumxolela.
UYehova uThixo wakho uya kuzibulala iintlanga ezinika ilizwe labo kuwe; uza kuzikhupha, nawe uza kuhlala emizini yabo nakwiindlu zabo.
niyikhetheni imizi emithathu, ezweni iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona ukuba lilifa lakho.
Yakha izithuthi zazo, uyihlukanise ilizwe iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona ukuba libe likhaya lakho, ibe ziinxalenye ezintathu; ukuze wonke obulalayo umntu ahambe esinye sezixeko.
Leyo ke imithetho yomntu obulala umntu, ehamba khona ukuze agcine ubomi bakhe: kufuneka ukuba abemfakile umhlobo wakhe ngokungxama, ngaphandle kokumxolela.

Umzekelo, xa umntu esiya kumthi nomhlobo wakhe, ukuba athabathe imithi; ke xa enqumle umqolo wakhe ukuba athabathe imithi, intloko yakhe iya kukhupha isibambo sayo, ibe yabetha umhlobo wakhe, wayibulala; lo mntu uya kubaleka waya komnye wale mizi, aze agcine ukuphila kwakhe.

Ukuba ke umhlobo womfazi, omele agwebe umfazi, angamthobela emnqamlezweni; ukuba uhambo lude, angamfumana, ambulala, nanjengoko lo mntu akafanelekanga ukufa, ngokuba wayesazi ukuba uyamxolela umfana wakhe.
Ngenxa yoko ndithi kuni, Nizikhethele imimandla emithathu.
UYehova uThixo wakho alungise ilizwe lakho, njengoko wathetha ngazo izizukulwana zakho, aze akunike lonke ilizwe awayethetha ngalo kubo.

ukuba niyigcine imiyalelo leyo yonke, ndikuwisela umthetho ngayo namhlanje, niyenze, nithandane noYehova uThixo wakho, nihambe phambi kwakhe iintsuku zonke; ke ngoko, nizikhethele izixeko ezintathu ezingaphezulu kwazo ezithathu.
Uyenze loo nto, ukuze umntu ongenatyala angafa, ezweni iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona ukuba libe likhaya lakho; ukuze ungabi netyala ngenxa yokufa kwabo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umntu unqula umnqamlezo wakhe, efihlakele, alinde kuye, ahlasele, amfaze, ahambe esinye sezixeko ezi.
Abaphathi bedolophu yakhe baya kumthumela, bayamkhupha emzini wakhe, babemnika engqondweni yomphefumlo wakhe, ukuba agwebe umfazi, aze aphele.
Musa ukuba neentloni ngenxa yakhe; kuba uya kwenza uxolo phakathi kwabantu bakaSirayeli, ukuze kube lula kuwe konke.
Musa ukushenxisa umda womhlobo wakho, abawubeke abo bangaphambili kwakho, kwilizwe oza kulifumana njengelifa lakho, ezweni iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona ukuba uluthathele.
Umshushisi omnye akayi kufezekisa into yokuba umntu unobuxoki, nakweyiphi na inkohlakalo, nakwesiphi na isono esenzayo; ngelizwi lamashushisi amabini, okanye amathathu, kufuneka kubekho into.
Xa umshushisi okhohlakeleyo evuka, agwebe umntu ngento engafanelekanga,
abo bantu ababini abanengxaki baya kuhlala phambi koYehova, phambi kwababingeleli nabagwebi abaya kuba khona ngaloo mini.
Ke kaloku abagwebi baya kuyijonga loo nto; ukuba lo mshushisi ubonakala ngathi ungumntu okhohlakeleyo, ethetha ubuxoki malunga nomhlobo wakhe waseSirayeli,
ngoko ke, njengokuba lo mshushisi wayeya kwenza komnye umntu, nawe uya kwenza kumshushisi okhohlakeleyo; ukuze ususe okubi phakathi kwenu.
Izinto eziseleyo zabasetyhini ziya kuziva, ziza kuxoka; akukho mntu uza kwenza kwakhona phakathi kwakho into enjalo yobubi.
Musa ukuba neentloni kubo; kuba kufuneka kube ngokulinganayo, ubomi ngempilo, iliso ngeliso, intamo ngentando, isandla ngesandla, inyawo ngenyawo.
Xa uphuma ukulwa nabachasi bakho, ubona iinkunzi zeebhokhwe, nezithuthi-mlilo, umkhosi omkhulu kunawe, musa ukuxolela kubo; kuba iNkosi uThixo wakho, owakukhupha ezweni laseYiputa, unguwe.
Xa niza kungena emfazweni, umbingeleli kufuneka afike phambi kwenu, athethe namadoda.
Uthi, Lila, Israyeli! Namhlanje niphumani kulwa nabachasi benu; musa ukulahleka intliziyo yenu, ningabi noxolo, ningabi noxinzelelo, musani ukukhathaza ngenxa yabo.
Kuba iNkosi, uThixo wenu, yena ohamba nani; uya kulwa ngenxa yenu nabachasi benu, ukuze akusindise.

Bathi ke abathetheli kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Ngubani na owenza indlu entsha, angayilungiseleli? Yaye ahambe endlwini yakhe, ukuze angabi ngumfazi emkhosini, ibe kukho umntu oza kuyilungiselela.
Ingaba kukho umntu okhulele igadi yewayini, angayidla intyatyambo yayo? Yaye ahambe endlwini yakhe, ukuze angabi mnyama emfazweni, ibe enye idla intyatyambo yayo.
Ingaba kukho umntu othe wabhiyozela umfazi, akazange amthobele? Ahambe endlwini yakhe, ukuze angabi mnyama emfazweni, ke umyeni wakhe abe mnye.
Bathi ke abaphathi, Ukuba kukho umntu okhokelayo, okanye uphelelwe lithemba, ahambe endlwini yakhe, ukuze abo bahlobo bakhe abakhonzi bangaphelelwa lithemba.
Xa abaphathi begqibile ukuthetha kumkhosi, kufuneka bakhethe abakumkani ukuba bayiqhube.
Xa uphuma ukuhlasela umzi, kuqala unqumle abantu bakhe ngoxolo.
Ukuba bakumkela, bakuvulela izivalo zabo kuwe, bonke abantu abakhoyo kuyo baya kuba ngabasebenzi bakho, baya kukhonza.
Ke kaloku, ukuba akayi kwenza uxolo nawe, akayi kukulwa nawe, ke wena uya kugubungela lo mzi, uyihlasele.
Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi uThixo wakho ekunika yona phambi kwakho, uya kuyibulala ngeqhwa bonke amadoda akhona.
Ke amadoda, nabantwana, nezinto eziphilayo, nazo zonke izinto ezikwidolophu, uzithathele wena; usebenzise iintaka zabachasi bakho, abo iNkosi uThixo wakho akubanika bona.
Uya kukwenza njalo kumadolophu onke angaphandle kwakho, kumadolophu angabakho phakathi kwezizwe ezikufutshane nawe.
Ke kaloku, kumadolophu eemfazwe iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika wona ukuba ube yindawo yakho, musa ukushiya ubomi nantoni na ephilayo.
Uya kuzibulala zonke, ooHeti, nabaAmori, nabaKanani, nabaPerizi, nabaHivi, nabaYebhusi, njengoko iNkosi uThixo wakho akuwiselayo umthetho.
Musani ke ukuba nifundiswe ngazo zonke izinto ezibi abazenzayo kuThixo wabo, ukuze ningabi nesono kuYehova uThixo wenu.
Xa ujikeleze umzi, uyihlasele ixesha elide, ukuwuthabatha, musa ukulahla izityalo zayo, uzithabathe ngeqhina; ungadla imbewu yawo, awuthabathenga. Zithini na izityalo zasendle, ukuba uzithathele?
Ke kaloku imithi oyaziyo ukuba ayinakudla, ungayitshisa; uyisebenzisele ukwakha izikhuselo zokulwa umzi onxulumana nawe emfazweni, de ube phantsi.
Xa kuthe kwafunyanwa umntu ebulalayo, ehleli esidlangalaleni, kwilizwe iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona ukuba lube lilifa lakho; akukho namnye owaziyo lowo wambulalayo.
Baya kuphuma abathetheli bakho nabagwebi bakho, balinganise ubude obusuka kumphefumlo waya kumadolophu ajikeleze.
Ke kaloku abaphathi bedolophu ekufuphi nenyama bathathe inkunzi yenkomo encinci, engasebenziswanga ngaphambili, ingabikho phantsi kweyoko.
Baya kumthabatha, bayamkhupha phantsi emlanjeni onemilambo iphumayo, apho umhlaba wawungenakuqhutywa khona, nalapho ukhula khona; baya kuyitshisa khona emlanjeni intamo yenkomo.

Bafike ke ababingeleli, oonyana bakaLevi; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho wabakhetha ukuba babe ngabakhonzi bakhe, ukuba babhaptize ngegama likaYehova; nabo baya kugqiba yonke into engquzulwano, nayo yonke into enobungozi.
Ke kaloku bonke abathetheli bomzi, abasecaleni lomntu ofileyo, baya kuhlamba izandla zabo phezu kwenkunzi yenkomo encinci, enqamlezwe intamo yayo kuloo mlambo.
Bathi ke, Izandla zethu aziwubulalanga lo mntu, Amehlo ethu akayibona loo nto.
UYehova, usindise abantu bakho bakaSirayeli, abawenzileyo ubomi obutsha; ungabafaki engozini abantu bakho bakaSirayeli, ukuba babulala umntu ongenatyala. Baya kuthotywa ngenxa yokufa kwabo.
Ke ngoko niza kwenza njalo, nize ningabi netyala lokufa komntu ongenasono; ngenxa yokuba niza kwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova.
Xa uphuma ukulwa nabachasi bakho, ukuba iNkosi uThixo wakho awanikezele phambi kwakho, wena uthabathe abadumileyo kubo;
ukuba ubone phakathi kwabagwetywa indoda ebukekayo, ube nomnqweno kuye, unqwenele ukumnika umtshato.
Uya kumthabatha endlwini yakho, aze athabathe intloko yakhe, athathe iinwele zakhe,
uthabathe iimpahla zakhe, ezo wayezigqoke xa ethathwa; ahlale endlwini yakho, abe neentlungu ngoyise noyise iminyaka emininzi; emva koko ungaya kuye, ube ngumfazi wakhe, aze abe ngumfazi wakho.
Ke ukuba awuthandanga kuye, umyeke ahambe apho enqwenela khona; ungamthengi ngemali, ungamsebenzisi njengomkhonzi, ngenxa yokuba uyamxolela.
Ukuba umntu uneenkosikazi ezimbini, ethanda enye, akayithanda enye; ke kaloku ababini bamzalile oonyana, unyana ozalwa kuqala ube nguwe lowo akayithanda.
Xa enika ipropathi yakhe oonyana bakhe, akayi kunika ilungelo lokuzalwa kokuqala kunyana womyeni wakhe othandekayo, endaweni yonyana womyeni wakhe ongathandangayo, lowo ke ukuphela komzali.

Umele athabathe unyana womfazi awayeyamthandanga, abe ngummelwane wakhe wokuqala, amnike inxalenye ephindwe kabini yezinto zakhe zonke; kuba unyana lowo ngumqondiso wesiqalo sobuchule bukabawo wakhe, ibe lilungelo lakhe lokuqala.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umntu unenyana oqinileyo, onobuxoki, ongenakumthobela utata wakhe, nokuba ngumama wakhe; nakuba babemxelela, akawaphulaphuli.
utata wakhe nomama lakhe baya kumthabatha, baya kumthwala kumadoda amakhulu emnyango wedolophu yakhe.
Bathi kumadoda amakhulu edolophu leyo, Lo mntwana wethu unobuxoki nobuxoki; akayi kusiphulaphula ilizwi lethu; udla kakhulu, usela.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda edolophini yakhe athabathe iithayile aze amfa; uyasikhupha ngoko ububi phakathi kwakho, ukuze bonke amaSirayeli bacinge ngalo, babe nomonde.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu esenza isono esifanele ukufa, bafa, batshiswe emnqamlezweni;

musa ukushiya umphefumlo wakhe utshixiwe emnqamlezweni ngobusuku bonke; qiniseka ukuba uya kumthisa ngaloo mini; ngokuba wonke umntu otshixiwe emnqamlezweni ngumhlaza kaThixo. Musa ukuhlambalaza ilizwe iNkosi, uThixo wakho, akunika lona ukuba libe likhaya lakho.
Xa ubona inkunzi yenkomo yomhlobo wakho, okanye ingulube yakhe, ihamba ngaphaya kwendlela, musa ukuthi awuyibonanga; uyibuyisele ngokuqinisekileyo kumnini wayo.
Ukuba umnini wayo akahlali kufutshane nawe, okanye awuyazi ukuba ngumnini wayo, uyithathe ekhaya uze uyigcine kude kube umnini wayo efika efuna yona. Emva koko uyibuyisele.
Ukuba ufumana isilwanyana sabo, okanye iingubo zabo, okanye nantoni na elahlekile kubo, yenza njalo; musa ukucinga ukuba awuyiboni.
Ukuba ubona ibhokhwe yomhlobo wakho, okanye isilwanyana sasekhaya, silele ecaleni kwendlela, musa ukucinga ukuba awuyiboni; nceda umnini wayo aphinde ayibeke emehlweni.
Umfazi akayi kugqoka iimpahla zamadoda, naye umfazi akayi kugqoka iingubo zamadoda; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho unqula wonke umntu owenza loo nto.
Ukuba udibana nentlabathi yentaka ecaleni kwendlela, emthini okanye phantsi komhlaba, kwaye intama ihlala kwiintaka ezincinci okanye kwii-eggs, musa ukuthabatha intama kunye neentaka.
Ungazithabatha iinkunzi, kodwa ucinge ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba uyishiye inkomo; ukuze kube lula kuwe, ibe ubomi bakho bude.
Xa ukwakha indlu entsha, yenza idonga eliphantsi lijikeleze umngxunya wendlu yakho, ukuze ungabi netyala lokufa komntu, ukuba ewela kuyo.
Musa ukutyala iziqhamo ezibini engqondweni yakho; ukuba uyenze, imbewu yakho yonke iya kulahleka, nembewu oyityalayo, nemveliso yengqolowa.
Musa ukulima ngebhokhwe kunye neshedyuli zidityaniswe.
Musa ukugqoka iimpahla ezenziwe ngoboya kunye nelinen ethe tyaba.
Yenza iziqhoboshi kwiikona ezine zesibhakabhaka osigqokayo.
Uthi umntu atshate umfazi, ahlale naye; ke ngoko abuyele kuye.
Uthetha ngaye izinto ezinobuxoki, uyalahla igama lakhe, esithi, Ndimzala lo mfazi; ke kaloku xa ndimthandana naye, ndafumanisa ukuba akazange abe ngumfana.
Ke kaloku uyise noyise womfazi omncinci baya kuzisa isiqinisekiso sokuba ungumkakhe, kubaphathi bomzi, emnyango.
Wathi uyise kubo abathetheli, Ndamnika lo mntu intombi yam ukuba abe ngumfazi wakhe; ke yena wabuyela kuye.

Ke kaloku wathetha ngaye izinto ezinobuxoki, esithi, Ndiyaziviwa ukuba intombi yakho ayikho inkosikazi; ke le nto ibonisa ukuba intombi yam yindodana yomfazi. Bathi ngoko ooyise nodadewabo bakhuphe isigqomo phambi kwamadoda amakhulu edolophu.
Abaphathi balo mzi baya kumthabatha lo mfazi, bagwebe.

Bathi bagwebe ishekeli ezilishumi zesilivere, bazinike uyise wendodakazi; ngenxa yokuba lo mntu wabeka igama elingenanto kwindodakazi yeSirayeli. Waba ngumfazi wakhe; akazukumshiya yonke imihla yobomi bakhe.
Ke kaloku, ukuba le nto ithethayo inyaniso, nokuba akufumaneki ubungqina bokuba ngumkakhe,

baya kumthwala emnyango wendlu kayise; amadoda asedolophini yakhe aya kumthabatha ngethayile, aze aphele; ngenxa yokuba wenza into engalunganga kumaSirayeli, wadibana nomntu, ehlala endlwini kayise; ngoko ke uya kususa okubi phakathi kwenu.
Ukuba umntu ufunyenwe ethandana nomyeni womntu omnye, baya kufa bobabini, indoda nomfazi; nawe uya kususa ububi kwelakwaSirayeli.
Ukuba umntu udibana edolophini nomfana omtshakazi, oneminyaka engamashumi amabini anesithoba ubudala, omtshakalelwe ngumntu omnye, walala naye.

Bathabathe bonke ababini emnyango wedolophu leyo, bathabathe iithayile, babefa; umfazi omncinci wathabatha iithayile, ngokuba wayesedolophini, akazange anqume; nomntu ke wathabatha iithayile, ngenxa yokuba waphulaphulela umkakhe oza kuba ngumyeni wakhe; ukuze ususe okubi phakathi kwenu.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu edibana ezweni nomfana omtshato wakhe ugqityiwe, emnyanzela ukuba ahlale naye, lowo mntu wakwenza loo nto yena kuphela uya kufa.
Musani ukwenza nantoni na kulowo mntwana; akubikho kuye isono esifanele ukufa. Le nto ifana nento yokuba umntu ahlasele umhlobo wakhe, ambulala,
Kuba lo mntu wamfumana ezweni. Wayitsho ke loo ndoda incinci, kodwa kwakungekho namnye wamkhuselayo.
Ukuba umntu udibana nomfana omtshakazi, engatshatanga, angabhalwanga; athabathele kuye, alele naye, bafunyanwe.
Uya kumnika utata wakhe iisekeli zesilivere ezimashumi mahlanu; ke ngoko uya kumnika indoda yakhe, ngenxa yokuba wamnqula. Akuyi kuyamshiya yonke ubomi bakhe.
Umfazi wenkosikazi kayise akayi kuyinika intsapho yakhe, angayiphazamisa iNkosi yakhe, ehlala naye.
Akukho namnye umntu otywinwe, okanye othunyelwe iinwele zakhe, ukuba afike kwintlanganiso kaYehova.
Akukho namnye oza kuba ngumntwana womtshakazi, angaya kwibandla likaYehova; akukho namnye kusapho lwabo angaya kulo, nakwiminyaka elishumi.
Akukho mAmoni, nokuba nguMowabhi, oza kungena kwintlanganiso kaYehova; akukho namnye kubo oza kungena kuyo ngonaphakade, nakwiminyaka elishumi.
Kuba abazange bakuvukele ngesonka namanzi, ekuhambeni kwenu, xa niphuma eYiputa; baqeshe noBhalamu unyana kaBeore, wasePethore eMesopotamia, ukuba akulamle wena.
Ke kaloku iNkosi, uThixo wakho, akafuni ukumphulaphula uBhileham; ke iNkosi, uThixo wakho, wamguqula lo msindo ube kukusindiso kuwe; ngokuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, wakuthanda.
Xa uphila, musa ukuzama ukuzinceda ukuba baphile ngoxolo okanye baphumelele.
Musa ukumchukumisa uEdom, ngokuba uEdom ungumhlobo wakho; musa ukumchukumisa uYiputa, ngokuba ube ngumkhenkce ezweni labo.
Abantwana abazaliselwe kubo, ubuncinane beminyaka emithathu, baya kungena kwisibingelelo sikaYehova.
Xa nithi nitshabalalise, nibe nokulwa nabachasi benu, musani kungena nantoni na eyenza ukuba nibi.
Ke kaloku, ukuba kukho umntu kumadoda akho oza kwenzakalisa ngenxa yento eya kwenzeka kuye ngemini, uya kuphuma ngaphandle komkhosi, ahlale khona.
Ke kaloku, xa kuphelelwa lixesha, kufuneka ahlamba ngamanzi; xa liphelelwe lixesha ilanga, kufuneka afike entabeni.
Kufuneka ube nendawo ngaphandle kwesiqithi apho ungaya khona kwigumbi lokuhlambela.
Nceda uthathe isampula encinci kunye nezixhobo zakho. Xa usiya kwigumbi lokuhlambela, xhube umngxunya ngayo, kwaye emva koko ugubungele iinkunkuma zakho

Kuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, ehamba phakathi kwethafa lakho, ukuze akukhusele, aze akunike izithunywa zakho phambi kwakho; ngoko ke ithafa lakho liya kuba lingcwele, ukuze angabona nantoni na engalunganga phakathi kwenu, abuye kuwe.
Xa umkhonzi ephuma kumphathi wakhe, efika kuwe ukuze akhuseleke, musa ukumbuyisela kumphathi wakhe.
Athi ahlale phakathi kwakho, emzini onokuwukhethela, apho kulungileyo kuye; musa ukumncina.
Akukho mntu wesiSirayeli, indoda nawesifazane, oza kwenzakalisa iTempile.
Musa ukungenisa imali yebhinqa elizinzileyo, nokuba libhinqa elizinikeleyo, endlwini kaYehova uThixo wakho, ukuze uhlawule naziphi na izibophelelo; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho ubaxolela bonke.
Musa ukuhlawula umrhumo kumhlobo wakho uSirayeli, nokuba yimali, nokuba yinyama, nokuba yintoni na eyenza umrhumo.

Kuthile ongaphandle kwelizwe unokuhlawula umvuzo, kodwa kumhlobo wakho uSirayeli awuzukwenza njalo; ukuze iNkosi uThixo wakho akubhiyozele ngazo zonke izinto ozenzayo ezweni oza kungena kulo ukulilawula.
Xa usenza isibingelelo kuYehova uThixo wakho, musa ukulibazisa ukuba uyigcine; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kuyifuna ngokuqinisekileyo kuwe; nawe uza kuba nesono, ukuba awuyigcinanga.
Ukuba ke ukhetha ukuba ungabi nethemba, awuzukuba nobubi.
Zonke izinto ozithethayo ukuba uza kuzisenza, uqiniseke ukuba uya kuzilungisa; ngenxa yokuba ngemilomo yakho wanikela isibingelelo sakho ngokukhululekileyo kuYehova uThixo wakho, kufuneka uyigcine.
Xa ufika kwigadi yewayini yomhlobo wakho, ungadla iziqhamo ezininzi kangangokuba unqwenela; kodwa awuyi kubeka ebhokisini lakho.
Xa ufika engqondweni yomhlobo wakho, unokuthabatha ngesandla sakho iziqhamo zengqolowa; kodwa awuyi kutywina ingqolowa yakhe ngesiqhoboshi.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ebhiyozela umfazi, akayithandana naye ngenxa yokuba wafumanisa kuye into engalunganga; ke ngoko umbhalela incwadi yokwahlula, wamnika yona, amkhuphe ekhaya lakhe.
Emva kokuba ephuma ekhaya lakhe, angaba ngumfazi womntu omnye.
ke umfazi wakhe owamva uya kungena kuye, ambhalele iphepha lokwabelana ngesondo, amnike lona, amkhuphe endlwini yakhe; ukuze angafa umfazi wakhe oyamva.

Ke yena umfazi wakhe wokuqala, owamshiyayo, akakwazi ukubuyela kuye; kuba wahlambalaza. Kuzakuba kukunyanzeleka kuYehova oko, ukuze ungabi nesono kwilizwe iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona ukuba libe likhaya lakho.
Ukuba umntu utshatile, akufuneki athunyelwe emfazweni, okanye anikezelwe nayiphi na enye imisebenzi. Unyaka omnye uya kuba khululekile ukuba ahlale endlwini yakhe, athande umyeni wakhe omtsha.
Musa ukuthabatha isibini seentyatyambo zesinyithi, okanye nangaphezulu nje kwentyatyambo yesinyithi esiphezulu, njengenkxaso yetyala. Oku kuya kususa indlela yokuphila komntu.
Xa kuthe kwafunyanwa umntu ephucula umhlobo wakhe, unyana kaSirayeli, ukuba abe ngumkhonzi kuye, okanye ukuba amthengise, lo mntu ophuculayo kufuneka aphele; ngoko ke uya kususa okubi phakathi kwenu.

Ke kaloku, ukuba kukho intsholongwane ephumayo emlonyeni wakho, qaphela ngokungqongqo ukuba uyenze yonke into ababingeleli bakaLevi baya kukuxelela yona; khumbulani ukuba niyenze yonke into endibawiselayo.
Khumbula oko iNkosi, uThixo wakho, awakwenzayo kuMariyam kwindlela yakho, xa niphuma eYiputa.
Xa udlulisa into kumhlobo wakho, musa ukuya endlwini yakhe, ukuze uthathe into anika yona njengetyala.
Nceda uhlale ngaphandle, ukuze umntu ofuna ukuwuhlawula akwazi ukuyikhupha kuwe.
Ukuba lo mntu uxakekile, musa ukuya kuhlala ngelixa ugcina isiqinisekiso sakhe
Ufanele uqiniseke ukuba uya kuzibuyisela iimpahla zabo phambi kokuba liphele ilanga, ukuze bahlale zilala kuzo; ngoko ke baya kukubhaptiza; iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kuyibona into elungileyo oyenze.
Musani ukuxhaphaza umqeshwa-mali, ukuba ungumfazi, okanye ungumhlwempu, nokuba ngunyana wakho, nokuba ngumkhenkce ohlala endlwini yakho.
Uza kubanika umvuzo wabo mihla le, phambi kokuba liphele ilanga; ngokuba bahlwempu, befuna ukuwufumana; ukuze bangabikho bekhala kuYehova ngenxa yenu, nibe nesono.
Abazali bangafa ngenxa yento abayenzayo abantwana babo, nabantwana bangafa ngenxa yento abayenzayo abazali babo; umntu ngamnye uya kufa ngenxa yobulungisa bakhe.
Musa ukunyanzelisa inyaniso kumkhenkce, nomntwana osemncinci; musa ukuthabatha iingubo zendodana yomfazi, ukuba zibe yityala.
Uya kukhumbula ukuba waba ngabakhonzi eYiputa, waza iNkosi uThixo wakho wakukhulula khona; ngenxa yoko ndikuwisela umthetho wokwenza oku.

Xa uthabathe isiqhamo sakho engqondweni yakho, uze usazisela umquba wesiqhamo, awuyi kubuyela ukuwuthabatha; uyishiye kumkhenkce, nomntwana omncinci, nowesifazane; ukuze iNkosi uThixo wakho akubhiyozele kuwo onke umsebenzi wezandla zakho.
Xa uthabathe iziqhamo zomthi wakho weoliveni, musa ukutyibilika phezu kwezityalo; shiya okuseleyo kumkhenkce, nomntwana osemncinci, nomfazi.
Xa uthabathe iziqhamo zewayini yakho, musa ukutyelela kwakhona iziqhamo zakho; shiya okuseleyo kumkhenkce, nomntwana omncinci, nomfazi.
Khumbulani ukuba nibe ngabakhonzi eYiputa; ngenxa yoko ndithi kuni, yenzakeni oku.
Xa abantu befuna ukungqubana, bamele bafike endlwini yomthetho; abagwebi baya kugqiba ityala; bamele bacacise ukuba umntu ongenasono ulungile, kwaye lowo unetyala ukhohlakeleyo.
Ukuba umntu owinile ufanele ukuba aqhutywe, umgwebi uya kumnqula ebhedini, aze aqhutywe phambi kwakhe, ngenani leengqumbo ezifunekayo ngenxa yobubi bakhe.
Umgwebi akayi kwenza ngaphezulu kweentloko ezimashumi mane; ukuba ezenza ngaphezulu kwazo, umhlobo wakho uSirayeli uya kuxhaphazwa phambi kwakho.
Musa ukugubungela umlomo wenkomo, ukuze ayithintele ekudleni ngelixa iqhuba ukutya.

Ke kaloku, ukuba kukho abazalwana behlala ndawonye, omnye wabo efa engazali ndoda, umfazi wakhe ongatshatanga akayi kunikwa umntu ongaphandle kosapho lwakhe. Unyana womyeni wakhe uya kumnika umtshato wakhe, abe ngudade wesifazane.
Unyana wakhe omtsha uya kuthatha igama lomzalwana wakhe ofileyo, ukuze igama lakhe lingacimi kuSirayeli.

Ke kaloku, ukuba umntu akathandabuzi ukumnika umfazi womyeni wakhe, umyeni wonyana wakhe uya kungena emnyango kumadoda amakhulu edolophu yakhe, athi, Unyana wam wesifazane akavumi ukuzisa igama lomzalwana wakhe kumaSirayeli; akayi kunikwa ilungelo lenkosikazi yam.
Ke kaloku abaphathi bedolophu yakhe baya kumbiza, bathethe naye; ukuba ke eqhubeka esithi, Andifuni ukumnika umfazi,
emele indlu yakhe, phantsi kwendlela yakhe, phantsi kwendlela yenkosi yakhe, phantsi kwendlela yesizwe sakhe, phantsi kwendlela yelizwe lakhe, phantsi kwendlela yelizwe lakhe.
Ukusuka ngaloo mini usapho lwakhe luza kuthiwa eSirayeli, Usapho lomntu othunyelwe izihlangu zakhe.
Xa amadoda amabini adibana, kwaye umfazi womntu omnye efika ukuze amkhusele umyeni wakhe kumntu owubethayo, wamisa isandla sakhe, wamthabatha lo mntu ngemisipha yakhe,
ke ngoko, kufuneka uthabathe isandla sakhe; musa ukumxolela.
Musa ukuthwala iitoni ezimbini ezahlukeneyo kwibhokisi yakho, enye enzima nenye ekhanyayo.
Musa ukubeka endlwini yakho imilinganiselo emibini, enye enkulu, enye incinane.
Uyisebenzise imilinganiselo nobunzima obuchanekileyo, obuthembekileyo; ukuze uhlale ixesha elide ezweni iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona.
Kuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, unqula wonke umntu owenza ezi zinto, onke amacala.
Khumbula into abayenzayo kuwe amaAmaleki, ekuhambeni kwakho, xa niphuma eYiputa.
Ke kaloku, xa nithe nixakekile, naphezu kokungakhathali kwenu, badibana nani endlelani, bathabathela kuwo onke amehlo abo, bonke abakhubazekileyo, nabahamba ngasemva; bangamkhokeli uThixo.

Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi uThixo wakho ekusinika ukuphumla kuzo zonke iintshaba zakho ezikufutshane nawe, kwilizwe iNkosi uThixo wakho akunike lona ukuba lube lilifa lakho, uya kuyicima inkumbulo kaAmaleki phantsi kwelanga; musa ukuyilibala.
Ke kaloku, xa ungene ezweni iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona ukuba libe likhaya lakho, uze uyithathe njengelifa lakho, ube yindawo yokuhlala kuyo;

uthabathe ezona zinto ziphambili kuzo zonke iziqhamo ozivunayo kwilizwe eliya kukunika lona iNkosi uThixo wakho, uzibeke emgqomeni, uze uye kwindawo ebeyikhetha yona iNkosi uThixo wakho ukuba lihlale kuyo igama lakhe.
Uya kungena kumbingeleli oza kubakho ngaloo mini, usithi kuye, Ndithi namhlanje kuYehova uThixo wakho, ukuba ndingene kuloo lizwe, iNkosi awathethile ngaye ooyise bethu ukuba alisinika lona.
Ke yena umbingeleli uya kuthatha ibhokisi esandla sakho, ayibeke phambi kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uThixo wakho.
Wathi ke phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, Unyana wam wayengumSirayeli ohamba-hamba, wafa; wahla waya eYiputa, wahlala khona namadoda ambalwa; waza waba lilizwe elikhulu, elinamandla, nelifa elikhulu.
Ke kaloku abaYiputa basenza kakuhle kuthi, bakwenza sihlupheke; basenza ukuba sisebenzele ngomsebenzi onzima, njengezikhonzi.
Sathi ke kuYehova, uThixo wabafazi bethu; wathetha iNkosi ngelizwi lethu, wayibona intlungu yethu, nomsebenzi wethu onzima, nokuba siqhutywa.
Wathi ke iNkosi ukuba siphume eYiputa ngesandla sakhe esinamandla, nomqolo wakhe oqinileyo, ngoxolo olukhulu, ngamaphawu namathandabuzo.
wazisa nathi kule ndawo, waza wasinika eli lizwe, ilizwe eliphumayo ubisi nomvu.
Ke ngoko, Nkosi yam, ndinithumelele imbewu yokuqala yelizwe olinikayo; ubeke isiqulatho phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, unyuke, uyikhonze phambi kwakhe.
ke nizithande zonke izinto ezilungileyo iNkosi uThixo wakho awazininika wena nendlu yakho, nina nalabaLevi, namaSirayeli ahlala phakathi kwenu.

Ngomnyaka wesithathu, lowo ngunyaka weentsuku ezilishumi, xa ugqibile ukunikela iintsuku ezilishumi zezityalo zakho zonke, uya kuzinika kumaLevi, nomkhenkce, namatyala, nabafazi abafileyo; babedla ngaphakathi kweedolophu zakho, bathobe.

Uthi ke kuYehova uThixo wakho, Ndithathele ekhaya lam izinto ezingcwele, ndazinika kumaLevi, nomkhenkce, nomntwana omncinci, namabhinqa amabini, njengokuba umwisela umthetho; andihambi ngaphaya kwemimiselo yakho, ndiyilibala.
Andiyi kuthabatha nto yazo, xa ndithixolisa; andiyi kuthatha nto yazo, xa ndingenakucoceka; andibonisi nto yazo kubo abafileyo. Ndimthobele iNkosi uThixo wam; ndazenza zonke izinto oziwisela ngazo.
Thobela phantsi ukusuka ezulu, kwindawo yakho engcwele, ubhaptize abantu bakho bakaSirayeli, nelizwe elisinike lona, njengokuba wathetha ngaso kubafazi bethu, ilizwe elinobubele bomnquma nomvu.
Namhlanje iNkosi, uThixo wakho, akuwisela umthetho ukuba wenze la manani nalawo malungiselelo; uya kuzigcina uzisebenzele intliziyo yakho yonke nomoya wakho wonke.
Uthi namhlanje, ukuba iNkosi abe nguThixo wakho; ukuba uhambe ngemimiselo yakhe, ugcine imimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, ukuba uyithobele.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuni namhlanje ukuba nibe ngabantu bakhe, nempahla yakhe ekhethekileyo, njengoko wathiyo, ukuze nigcine yonke imimiselo yakhe.
Uya kukubeka phezulu phezu kwazo zonke iintlanga azenzayo, akunike uzuko nobudumo nobuhle; uza kuba ngabantu abangcwele abakhethekileyo kuYehova uThixo wakho, njengoko wathi.
Ke kaloku uMoses, nabathetheli bakaSirayeli, bawisela umthetho abantu, besithi, Zigcine zonke imiyalelo yam endithetha ngayo kuni namhlanje.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini nidlulayo umlambo iYorodani, nifike ezweni iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona, nizibeke iintyatyambo ezinkulu, nizigubungele ngetywina.

Uya kuzibhalela kuwo onke amagama kwalo mthetho, xa nidlularemu; ukuze nifike ezweni elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wakho, ilizwe elinobubele bomnqamlezo nenkukhu, njengokuba iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi bakho, wathi kuwe.
Ke kaloku, xa nidlula eYordan, nizibeke ezi zinto iithayile emnqamlezweni weEbhali, njengoko ndithiyo kuni namhlanje, nizigqume ngodonga.
Uza kwakha khona isibingelelo kuYehova uThixo wakho, isibingelelo samatye; awusayi kusebenzisa isixhobo sentsimbi ngazo.
Uyivule isibingelelo sikaYehova uThixo wakho ngezinto zesizwe, zingenayo inkunkuma; unikezele phezu kwayo izipho eziqhutywa ngamandla kuYehova uThixo wakho.
Nizilungiselele khona izibingelelo zoxolo, nizidle; niyonwabele phambi koYehova uThixo wenu.
Yazibhalela phezu kwezityalo oza kuzibeka, onke amagama alo mthetho, ngokucacileyo.
Wathetha ke uMoses, nababingeleli abaLevi, kubo bonke amaSirayeli, esithi, Yimkeleni, nivake, maSirayeli; namhlanje niye waba ngabantu bakaYehova uThixo wenu.
Ke ngoko, phulaphula amazwi kaYehova uThixo wakho, ugcine imiyalelo yakhe nemimiselo yakhe, endikuwiselayo namhlanje.
Ke kaloku uMoses wamisa abantu ngaloo mini, wathi,
Ke kaloku, xa nidlula eYordan, ezi zihlanga ziya kuhlala emnqamlezweni weGerizim, zibhaptize abantu: uSimeon, noLevi, noYuda, noIsayakare, noYosefu, noBhenjamin.
Ezi zizizwe ziya kuhlala emnqamlezweni ka-Ebhali, ukuze zithethe isibingelelo: uRubhen, noGadi, noAshere, noZebulon, noDan, noNafetali.
Bathi ke amaLevi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli,

Yalahlwa umntu wonke owenza imifanekiso engumqondiso, imifanekiso engumzobo, okanye imifanekiso engumbhobho, amise efihlakeleni; kumsebenzi wezandla zomenzi wobugcisa loo nto; iNkosi uyixolela. Baphendule ke bonke abantu, bathi, Amen.
Wathi ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, "Kulahlwa umntu onqumlayo utata wakhe nomama wakhe." Bathi bonke abantu, Amen.
Uthi, Kubulawe lowo utshintshela umda womhlobo wakhe. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen.
Uthi ke, Ilahlekile loo nto iqhuba umntu okhohlakeleyo phantsi kwendlela. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen;
Uthotywe wonke umntu othi, Akukho mntu unokumlungisa umkhenkce, unyana omncinci, nomfazi. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen.
Uthi, Ilahlekile loo nto ihlala nomyeni kayise; ngokuba uyamxolela uyise. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen.
Uthotywe wonke umntu odibana nenyama, nokuba yeyiphi na. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen.
Ubiwe lowo ulala nodade wakhe, nokuba ngunyana kayise, nokuba ngunyana kayise. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen.
Wathi ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, Kubikele umntu onxibelelana nomyeni wakhe. Bathi bonke abantu, Amen.
Uthotywe lowo ubulala umhlobo wakhe ngokufihlakeleyo. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen.
Yalahlwa umntu wonke othatha umvuzo, ukuba abulala umntu ongenatyala. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen.
Uthotywe wonke umntu ongagcinanga amazwi alo mthetho, ukuba ayenze. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen.

Ukuba uya kumthobela ngokugqibeleleyo iNkosi uThixo wakho, ukuba ugcine uyenze yonke imimiselo yakhe endikuwiselayo namhlanje, iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kukubeka phezulu phezu kwazo zonke iintlanga zehlabathi.
Zonke ezi mbandezelo ziya kukusikelela, ziya kuhlala kuwe, ukuba uya kumthobela iNkosi uThixo wakho.
Uza kuba ngumbingeleli kumzi, ube ngumbingeleli ezweni.
Abafazi bakho baya kuba ngumbulelo, neziqhamo zesizwe sakho, nabantwana bezinyama zakho eziphilayo, neenkomo zezimvu zakho, neentlanzi zeebhokhwe zakho.
Ibhokisi yakho, nebhotile yesonka sakho, ziya kuba ngcwele.
Uza kuba ngumsindisi xa ufika, ube ngumsindisi xa uphuma.
UYehova uya kwenza ukuba abathunywa bakho, abathe bahlasele kuwe, baqhutywe phambi kwakho; baya kuza kuwe ngaphaya kwendlela enye, kodwa baya kubaleka kuwe ngaphaya kwezintathu.
UYehova uya kuzisa ubutyebi kwiintyatyambo zakho, nakwezo zonke izinto ozenzayo; iNkosi uThixo wakho uza kukusindisa ezweni alikunika lona.
UYehova uya kwenza ukuba ube ngabantu bakhe abangcwele, njengokuba wathi kuwe, xa nigcina imiyalelo kaYehova uThixo wenu, nihamba ngeendlela zakhe.
Zonke iintlanga zehlabathi ziya kubona ukuba iNkosi unguwe; ziya kuxoka kuwe.
UYehova uya kwenza ukuba ukhulele ngezinto ezilungileyo, ngabantwana abaninzi, neenkomo ezininzi, neentyatyambo ezintsonkothileyo, ezweni awayesithi wabanika ooyise.

UYehova uya kuvula izulu, indawo yakhe yokugcina izinto ezilungileyo, ukuba anikezele umhlwa ezweni lakho ngexesha lakhe, ukuze asindise yonke imisebenzi yezandla zakho; uza kuxhasa iintlanga ezininzi, wena ke awuzukuxhaswa.

UYehova uya kwenza ukuba ube yintloko, ungabi ngumsila; uza kuqhubeka uphezulu, awuzukuhlala uphantsi; xa ukuluphulaphula umyalelo kaYehova uThixo wakho, endiyiwiselayo mna namhlanje, ukuze uyigcinele.
Musani ukusuka kuwo onke la mazwi, endiwawisela umthetho ngawo namhlanje, uhambe ngasekunene nakwesobunxele, nilandele amadini athile, nikhonzane nabo.

Ke kaloku, ukuba awuyi kuphulaphula ilizwi likaYehova uThixo wakho, ukuze uyigcine yonke imimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe endiyikumiselwayo namhlanje, ukuba uyigcine, ziya kuza kuwe zonke ezi zibulali, ziza kukufikelela.
Uza kuba ngumlamli edolophini, ube ngumlamli ezweni.
Ibhokisi yakho, nebhotile yesonka sakho, ziya kubhalelwa.
Abafazi bakho baya kuba lilahleko, neentyatyambo zesizwe sakho, neenkomo zeenkomo zakho, nezimvu zezimvu zakho.
Uza kuba ngumlamli xa ufika, ube ngumlamli xa uphuma.

UYehova uya kukuthutha phezu kwakho isilumkiso, nokuphazamisa, nokungaphumeleli, kuwo onke amanyathelo akho okwenzayo, de uphelelwe lixesha, ube ngumonakalo okhawulezayo, ngenxa yobubi obuwenzayo, ekuhambeni ngaphaya kum.
UYehova uya kwenza ukuba iintsholongwane ezibulalayo zithiwe kuwe, de akucime ezweni oza kudlula kulo ukulithathela.
UYehova uya kukubetha ngomhlaza, noxinzelelo, nomkhuhlane, noxinzelelo olukhulu, nokutshisa, nokufa kweentyatyambo, neentyatyambo ezincinane; ziya kukuzilandela ezi zinto, de uphele.
Izulu elunxwemeni lwakho liza kuba ngubhedu, ihlabathi phantsi kweenyawo zakho liza kuba yintsimbi.
UYehova uya kuzisa phezu kwelizwe lakho, kungekhona imvula, kodwa umgubo nothuli oluvela emlilweni, de uphele.

UYehova uya kwenza ukuba uhlaselwe phambi kwabatshaba bakho; uza kufika kubo ngendlela enye, kodwa uya kubaleka phambi kwabo ngeendlela ezisixhenxe; uza kuba yimiboniso ebuhlungu kubo bonke ubukumkani behlabathi.
Iinkunzi zakho ziya kuba yinyama yeentaka zonke, nezithixo zehlabathi; akuyi kubakho mntu wokuzikhumbuza.
UYehova uya kukubetha ngeentlungu zesiYiputa, neengxowa-mali, nezilonda, neentlungu, ezingenakuphiliswa.
UYehova uya kukubetha ngobuxoki, nokungaboni, nokuphazamiseka komoya.

Ngomhla weshumi elinanye, uya kuhamba ujikeleze, njengokuba umntu okhohlakeleyo emnyama; awuyi kuphumelela nantoni na oyenzayo. Uya kuba sengozini yonke imihla, uya kuqhutywa yonke imihla, akukho mntu uza kukukhusela.
Uza kuqhawula umtshato nomyeni, kodwa omnye umntu uya kumthabatha, ahlale naye; uza kwakha indlu, kodwa awusayi kubakho kuyo; uzotyala igadi yeentyatyambo, kodwa awusayi kuyidla.
eliza kutshalwa phambi kwakho, awuza kutholwe; uThixo wakho uya kunika ilizwe lakho; uThixo wakho uya kunika isizwe sakho, ulapisile ilizwe lakho.
Oonyana bakho neentombi zakho ziya kunikezelwa kwintlanga enye; amehlo akho aya kwenzakaliswa ngazo yonke imihla, kodwa akusayi kubakho amandla akho.
Izinto zakho zelizwe lakho, nemisebenzi yakho yomsebenzi wakho, ziya kuzidla iintlanga ongazaziyo; uya kuba ngumngcipheko wakho, nobubi bakho zonke imihla yakho.
Izinto ozibonayo ziya kukwenza uzive ukhohlakeleyo
UYehova uya kuzibetha iingelosi zakho nemilenze yakho ngeentlungu ezibi, ezingayi kuthotywa; ziza kuvela ezingxoweni zamehlo akho, zifike emazantsi entloko yakho.
UYehova uya kukuthutha wena nokumkani owenzayo phezu kwakho, kuhlanga olungaziyo nawe nabazalwana bakho; uza kuhlala khona ukhonza amadini athile, amadini emithi nelitye.
Uya kuba yinto ebuhlungu, ibe yinkcazo-mpikiswano, ibe ngumbulelo kuzo zonke iintlanga, apho iNkosi akuthumela khona.
Uza kulima iziqhamo ezininzi ezweni lakho, kodwa uza kuzivuna ezincinci; ngokuba izakuzidla iintaka.
Uza kulima izityalo zewayini, uze uzikhathalele; kodwa awuyi kusela iwayini, awuyi kuthabatha iinkomo, ngokuba iza kuzidla iintsholongwane.
Uya kuba nemithi yeolivini kuwo onke amacala akho, kodwa awuyi kusebenzisa ioli; ngokuba iolivini yakho iya kuphelela.
Uza kuba neentombi nabantwana, kodwa awunakubakho nabo; ngokuba baya kuthabatha ubomi babo bebhaptizo.
Zonke iintyatyambo zakho, neziqhamo zelizwe lakho, ziya kuzidla iintsholongwane.
Abasemagunyeni abahlala phakathi kwakho baya kunyuka baphakame ngaphezu kwakho, ke wena uya kuhla uphantsi.
Baza kukuxolela wena, kodwa wena awusoze uxolele kubo; baya kuba yintloko, nawe uya kuba ngumqolo.
Zithi zonke ezi zibulali zifike kuwe, zikulandelele, zikufikise, de ube lihlwempu; ngenxa yokuba ungamthobeli iNkosi uThixo wakho, ukuba uyigcine imimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe eyamwiselayo.
Zonke ezi zinto ziza kuba ngumqondiso, nomyalelo kuwe nosapho lwakho ngonaphakade.
Akuyi kukhonza iNkosi uThixo wakho ngovuyo nobubele, xa ubenazo zonke izinto ezininzi.

Uya kukhonza ooonodoli, abo iNkosi aza kuwathumela kuwe; uza kuba neswekile, uze ube nesifo solwandle, ube noboya obugqwesileyo, uyeke izinto zonke. Uza kuyibeka intsontelo yentsimbi emlonyeni wakho, de akukhulule.
UYehova uya kukuzisa phezu kwakho ilizwe livela kude, lisuka ekugqibeleni kwehlabathi, lihamba phantsi njengeebhokhwe; liya kuba lilizwe ongaziqondayo ulwimi lwalo.
ilizwe elinobungozi bobuso, elingazikhathaleli izihlwele, elingenakuzonwabisa abancinci.

Iya kulila iziqhamo zezinto zakho eziphilayo, neziqhamo zelizwe lakho, de uphelelwe lixesha; ayikushiyelanga inkukhu yakho, newayini yakho entsha, neoli yakho, nabantwana benkomo zakho, namadoda amakhulu akho, de upheliswe.

Ziya kujikeleza, ziye zahlasela zonke izixeko zakho, kuzo zonke iindawo zelizwe lakho, de zibe phantsi iingcango zakho eziphakamileyo neziqinileyo, ozithembele kuzo; ziya kuhlaselwa zonke izixeko zakho, kuzo zonke iindawo zelizwe lakho iNkosi uThixo wakho akunika lona.
Uya kulila oonyana bakho, inyama yabantwana bakho namadodakazi akho, awanikayo iNkosi uThixo wakho, ngenxa yoxinzelelo olukhulu oluya kukunika lona umqolo wakho, xa uza kulwa.
Ke kaloku umfazi othambileyo, onobubele phakathi kwakho, akayi kwenzakalisa intliziyo yakhe kumzalwana wakhe, nomyeni wakhe othandekayo, nabantwana bakhe abaseleyo.

Akayi kubanika nabani na kubo inxenye yenyama yabantwana bakhe, ayayidlayo; ngokuba iya kuba yintoni kuphela eyakhe ngaphambili, ngenxa yoxinzelelo olukhulu oluya kukunika lona umnqamlezo wakho kuzo zonke izixeko zakho.

Umfazi othambileyo, othambileyo phakathi kwakho, othambileyo ngokwaneleyo ukuba angaze athabathe intloko yenyawo lakhe, ukuba athabathe isandla sakhe ehlabathini, akawukhathaleli unyana wakhe okanye intombi yakhe.
Uya kulila ngokufihlakeleyo iziqhamo zesibeleko sakhe, nabantwana abazalayo, ngenxa yokuba akukho nto ayidlayo; ngenxa yoxinzelelo olukhulu olukunika lona umqolo wakho ezidolophini zakho.
Ukuba ningazikhathaleli ukuba niyigcine yonke imithetho yalo mthetho ebhaliweyo kulo ncwadi, ukuze nikhathazeke ngaloo igama eliqaqambileyo elibuhlungu, iNkosi uThixo wenu,
iNkosi uya kuzisa phezu kwakho, naphezu kwembewu yakho, iintlungu ezibuhlungu, nezihlala ixesha elide, neentlungu ezibuhlungu, nezihlala ixesha elide.
Uya kuzibuyisela phezu kwakho zonke izifo zesiYiputa, owazixhalabisa ngazo; ziya kuthethwa kuwe.
Nazo zonke izifo, nazo zonke iintsholongwane, ezingabhalwa kulo ncwadi yomthetho, iNkosi uya kuzizisa kuwe, de ube wukhululwe.
Nakuba niyininzi njengeenkwenkwezi zezulu, niza kushiya nje abantu abancinci; ngenxa yokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho akawuphulaphuli umlomo wakhe.

Ngoko ke, njengokuba iNkosi wathanda ukukwenza ukuba ube ngcono kuni nakuba nikhule ngonaphakade; ngoko ke uya kukuthanda ukumnqula nani nokukucimani. Uza kutyunyelwa ngaphandle kwelizwe lenu eliya kulo lokulifumana ilifa.

UYehova uya kukusasaza phakathi kwamazwe onke, ukususela kwisiphelo esisodwa sehlabathi ukuya kwisiphelo esinye; uza kukhonza khona amagama amanye amadini, ongawaziyo wena nabazalwana bakho, imithi nelitye.
Ke phakathi kwazo zonke iintlanga awuzukufumana uxolo, nandawo yokuphumla kwenyawo lakho; apho iNkosi uya kukunika khona intliziyo ekhatywayo, namazinyo athambileyo, nomphefumlo ophelelwe lithemba.
Intliziyo yakho iya kuba phantsi kwengcindezi yonke imihla; uya kukhathazeka ubusuku nobusuku, ungaqinisekanga ukuba uza kuphila.
Ngomso uza kuthetha, Kungenjalo ukuba kube limini! Ngomso ke uza kuthetha, Kungenjalo ukuba kube limini! Ngokuba ukhathazekile intliziyo yakho, ngenxa yezinto ozibona ngamehlo akho.
UYehova uya kukubuyisela eYiputa ngeenqanawa, ngendlela endithe ndathi awuyi kuphinda uyihambe; nalapho niza kuthengwa khona abathunywa benu, ningamakhonzi namakhoboka; akusayi kubakho othenga.
Ezi zizinto zamagama omnqophiso, iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngawo uMoses, ukuba akwenze nabantwana bakaSirayeli ezweni laseMowabhi, ngaphandle komnqophiso awayewenza nabo entlango yaseSina.
UMoses wababiza bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, wathi kubo: Amehlo enu abone zonke izinto awazenzayo iNkosi eYiputa, kuFaro, nakuzo zonke iinkomo zakhe, nelizwe lakhe lonke.
Wabona iintlungu ezinkulu, iimpawu ezimangalisayo, nezimangaliso ezinkulu.
Ke kaloku, iNkosi akunikeni intliziyo eyaziyo, namehlo abonayo, neentloko ezivayo, kude kube namhlanje.
Kwaba minyaka imashumi mane ndiniqhubele emasikweni; ngale mihla iimpahla zenu azithengiswanga, nezihlangu zenu azithengiswanga ezinyawo zakho.
Isonka awazidlanga, iwayini nasiphi na isiselo esinamandla asiswelanga; ukuze nikwazi ukuba yena iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Ke kaloku, nifike kuloo ndawo, waphuma uSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni, noOg ukumkani waseBhashani, ukuba bathuthe nathi; sababetha.
Sayithabatha ilizwe labo, salibanika amaRubhen namaGadi, nesiqingatha sesiqithi sikaManase, ibe yinxalenye yabo.
Nizigcine ke amazwi alo mnqophiso, niwugcine, ukuze niphumelele kuzo zonke izinto ozenzayo.
Nihlalani namhlanje phambi koYehova uThixo wenu, nina abathetheli benu, nezizwe zenu, namadoda amakhulu enu, nabaphathi benu, bonke amadoda aseSirayeli;
nabantwana benu, nabafazi benu, namaSirayeli asemakhayeni akho, abo batshisa imithi yakho, abathwala amanzi akho.
Nisekho apha, ukuba ningene kumnqophiso noYehova uThixo wenu, umnqophiso owenza kuni namhlanje, ukuze anityhilele ngethemba.
Namhlanje uya kwenza ukuba ube ngumntu wakhe, yena ke abe nguThixo wakho, njengoko wathethayo kuwe, nanjengoko wathetha ooyise bakho uAbraham, noIsake, noYakobi.
Andiyi kwenza lo mnqophiso, nethemba lakhe, nani kuphela;
abo bakhona apha nathi namhlanje phambi koYehova uThixo wethu; ndiya kwenza ke nalowo akakho apha nathi namhlanje.
Niyazi ukuba sahlala njani eYiputa, nokuba sadlula njani phakathi kweemfazwe, xa sifika apha.
Wazibona izinto zabo ezibi, nezithixo zabo, imithi nelitye, isilivere negolide.

Musani ukuba kubekho phakathi kwenu mna, nokuba ngumfazi, nokuba ngusapho, nokuba luhlanga, namhlanje, entliziyweni yakhe esuka kuYehova uThixo wethu, ahambe akhonze izitha zazo zonke iintlanga; musani ukuba kubekho phakathi kwenu ingcambu ekhulayo intlungu.

Ke ngoko, xa umntu onjalo ephulaphule amazwi alo mnqamlezo, aze abhaptize ngokwakhe entliziyweni yakhe, athi, Ndiya kukhuseleka, nokuba ndihamba ngendlela yam yobuxoki; ke oko kuya kwenza ukuba kubekho umonakalo kwilizwe elimanzi, nakwilizwe elimanzi.

UYehova akaze athande ukumxolela; ke ngoko, inkanuko yakheremu yakhe iya kuqhuma phezu kwaloo mntu, ibe ngumlilo; nazo zonke izithsaba ezibhalwe kulo ncwadi ziya kuba phezu kwabo; iNkosi uya kulisusa igama labo phantsi kwezulu.
UYehova uya kubahlukanisa phakathi kwezizukulwana zonke zakwaSirayeli, abe yingozi kubo, ngokwezo zonke izilamlo zomnqophiso obhalwe kulo ncwadi yomthetho.
Baya kubona oonyana bakho abaza kuvela emva kwenu, namaSirayeli asuka ezweni elunxwemeni olude, iintsholongwane eziye zahlasela eli lizwe, nezifo iNkosi awazisa kuzo.

Ilizwe lonke liza kuba ngumlilo wesulfure neoli; akukho nto izakutywina, akukho nto izakukhula, akukho mbewu izakubakho. Liya kuba njengengqungquthela yeSodoma neGomora, i-Adma neTseboyim, eyangqunyulwa ngazo nguYehova ngoxolo lwakhe olukhulu.
Zonke iintlanga ziya kuthetha, UYehova wenza ntoni na kule lizwe? Uthini na uxolo lwakhe olukhulu?
Bathi ke, Ngokuba bashiye umnqophiso kaYehova, uThixo wabafazi babo, umnqophiso awayewenza nabo, xa wayewakhupha ezweni laseYiputa.
Baye baya, bakhonza amadini athile, bewanikela kuwo, amadini abengawaziyo, amadini angabaniki wona iNkosi.
Ke kaloku, inkanuko kaYehova yaqhuma kuloo lizwe, ukuba athabathe phezu kwayo zonke iinzala ezibhalwe kuloo ncwadi.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wabasusa ezweni labo, ngoxolo olukhulu nobuxoki, wabeka phantsi kwabo ilizwe elinye, bafike apho namhlanje.
Izinto ezifihlakeleyo ziye kuYehova uThixo wethu; kodwa izinto azibonisayo kuthi, ziye kuthi nathi nabantwana bethu ngonaphakade, ukuze sigcine onke amagama kwalo mthetho.
Ke kaloku, xa zithe zafika phezu kwakho zonke ezi zinto zilungileyo nezibi, endizibeke phambi kwakho, uya kuzikhumbula phakathi kwezizwe apho iNkosi uThixo wakho akufunxa khona.
Ke ukuba ubuyela kuYehova uThixo wakho, wena nonyana bakho, nimthobele ngentliziyo yenu yonke, nangomphefumlo wenu wonke, nikwenze zonke izinto endikubawisela umthetho ngazo namhlanje;
ke iNkosi, uThixo wakho, uya kukubuyisela ekubondeni kwakho; uya kukuzinikela kuwe, nawe uya kukuqoqa phakathi kwazo zonke iintlanga, apho awiselayo khona.
Nakuba abathunyelwe kuwe bafika ekugqibeleni komhlaba phantsi kwelanga, iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kukuthabatha nalapho, akubuyisele.
UYehova uThixo wakho uya kukuthabatha uye kwilizwe lababukumkani bakho, ube likhaya labo; uya kukwenza ukuba ube ngcono kunabakumkani bakho, abe mkhulu kunabakumkani benu.
UYehova uThixo wakho uya kutshintsha intliziyo yakho, neentliziyo zesizukulwana sakho, ukuba umthande ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nomphefumlo wakho wonke, ukuze uphile.
UYehova uThixo wakho uya kuzibeka zonke ezi zibulali phezu kwabatshaba bakho, abakuxolelayo, abanokuxhaphaza.
Ke wena uya kubuya uphulaphule ilizwi likaYehova, ugcine yonke imimiselo yakhe, endikuwiselayo namhlanje.

UYehova uThixo wakho uya kwenza ukuba uphumelele yonke imisebenzi yezandla zakho; uya kukubhaptiza ngabantwana abaninzi, neenkomo ezininzi, neentyatyambo ezininzi. UYehova uza kubuya aphumle ekwenzeni okuhle kuwe, njengokuba aphumle ekwenzeni okuhle ooyise bakho,
ukuba uphulaphule ilizwi likaYehova uThixo wakho, ugcine imigaqo yakhe nemimiselo yakhe ebhaliweyo kulo ncwadi yomthetho; ukuba ubuye kuYehova uThixo wakho ngentliziyo yakho yonke nomoya wakho wonke.
Kuba loo nto ndikuwisela umthetho ngayo namhlanje, ayiyi kuba nzima kuwe, ayiyi kuba ngaphezu kwesandla sakho.
Ayikho emazulwini, ukuze ucinge, Nguwuphi na lowo uza kukhupha ezulu, aze ayithathe, aze ayixelele kuthi, siyenze?
Akakho na kwelinye icala lolwandle, ukuze ucinge, Nguwuphi oza kudlula emlanjeni, azame ukusifumana, aze asixelele, ukuze siyigcine?
Ke kaloku ilizwi likufuphi kakhulu nawe, lisemlonyeni wakho, lisenhliziyweni yakho, ukuze uyenze.
Yabona, mna namhlanje ndizisa phambi kwenu phakathi kokuphila nokulungileyo, nokufa nokubi.

Kuba mna namhlanje ndikuwisela umthetho wokuthanda iNkosi uThixo wakho, ukuba uhambe ngeendlela zakhe ezithandekayo, ugcine imiyalelo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe; ukuze niphile, nikhule, yaye iNkosi uThixo wakho akubhiyozele kuwe kwilizwe oza kungena kulo ukulifumana libe lilifa lakho.
Ke kaloku, ukuba intliziyo yakho itshintshile, yaye awuyi kuphulaphula loo nto, nakuba uqhutywa ngumoya, ubethe isibonda kumadini athile, wabakhonza;
Ndithi kuni namhlanje, ukuba ngokuqinisekileyo niza kuthotywa; ningahlala ixesha elide ezweni elidlulayo phezu kweYorodani, ukuze nilithathe njengelifa.
Ndizixelela namhlanje izulu nehlabathi ukuba zibe ngabaxumi kuni, ukuba ndimise phambi kwakho ubomi nokufa, nokusindisa nokulahlwa; ke ngoko ukhethe ubomi, ukuze uphile wena nabantwana bakho.

ukhethe ukumthanda iNkosi uThixo wakho, umthobele, unxibelelane naye; ngokuba iNkosi ngubomi bakho; nawe uya kwenza ukuba ube neminyaka emininzi ezweni awayesithi awabanika ooyise bakho, uAbraham noIsake noYakobi.
Waye ke uMoses, wathetha la mazwi kuwo onke amaSirayeli.
Wathi kubo, Ndineminyaka engama-120 ubudala namhlanje; andikwazi ukuqhubeka ndihamba phambi kwenu; iNkosi wanditsho wathi, Awuza kudlula eJordan.
UYehova uThixo wakho, yena uya kudlula phambi kwenu; yena uya kuzicima ezi zinto iintlanga phambi kwenu, nizithathele ilizwe labo; uYoshuwa naye uya kuhamba phambi kwenu, njengoko wathi iNkosi.
UYehova uya kwenza kubo, njengokuba wenza kuSihon noOg, ookumkani baka-Amoreyi, abo wabulala nabo nelizwe labo.
UYehova uya kuzinikela phambi kwenu, nize nizenza zonke izinto endikumwisela umthetho ngazo.
Nibe namandla, nibe makholwa; musa ukukhathazeka, ningabikho nomsindo ngenxa yabo; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho uyahamba nawe; akakushiyanga, akakushiyelanga.

Wabiza ke uMoses uYoshuwa, wathi kuye phambi kwamehlo ooSirayeli bonke, Ube namandla, ube nobubele; kuba wena uya kungena nalabo bantu ezweni awayesithi iNkosi wabanika lona abazalwana babo, ukuba baya kulinika; nawe uya kuyenza ibe yinxalenye yabo.
UYehova, yena ohamba phambi kwakho, yena uya kuba nawe; akakushiyanga, akakushiyelanga; musa ukukhathazeka, ungabi nobubele.
Wabhala ke uMoses lo mthetho, wawunikela kubabingeleli, oonyana bakaLevi, abathabatha inqanawa yomnqophiso kaYehova, nabathetheli bonke bakaSirayeli.
Wabawisela umthetho uMoses, esithi, Xa kugqitywa iminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe, ngomnyaka wokubuyiselwa ityala, ngexesha lemithendeleko yeentyatyambo,
xa bonke amaSirayeli befika, ukuba babonakaliswe phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, kwindawo ayiyikhethayo; uya kufunda lo mthetho emlonyeni wabo bonke amaSirayeli, ukuze bayiva.
Zihlangane abantu, amadoda namadoda, nabantwana, namaSirayeli asezidolophini zakho, ukuze bathethe, bafunde ukuba babe nomonde iNkosi uThixo wenu, baqonde ukuyenza yonke imithetho yalo mthetho.
