Nabantwana babo, abangaziyo loo mthetho, bakwazi ukuwuva, bafunde ukumhlonela iNkosi uThixo wenu, zonke iintsuku zenu niphilayo ezweni lenu elidlulayo iYorodani, ukuba lilungu lalowo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Imini yokufa kwakho ifikile; zisa uYoshuwa, uye kwitentyatyambo yokungcwaba, ndimwisele khona umthetho. Bafika ke uMosis noYonatan, bahlala etenteni yokungcwaba.
Wabonakala ke iNkosi etentweni, emkhondweni wefuthe; ifuthe lahlala phezu kokungena kwetenteni.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Khangela, uya kuhlala nabazalwana bakho; le ndoda iya kumnyamezela ngokukhawuleza; iya kumlandela uThixo othile welizwe apho isiya khona; iya kundishiya, iya kunqumamisa umnqophiso wam endiwenzayo nayo.

Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini, inkanuko yam iya kutshaya phezu kwakhe; ndiya kubashiya, ndiyifihla ubuso bam kubo, aze aphelelwe lithemba. Ziza kumfika izifo ezininzi nezigulana, aze athi ngaloo mini, Azizange zithiwe na ezi zifo kuthi ngenxa yokuba uThixo wethu akakho phakathi kwethu?
Ke mna ndiya kufihla ngokuqinisekileyo ubuso bam ngaloo mini, ngenxa yobubi bonke obuya kwenzayo, ekuhambeni kwabo kumadini athile.
Ke ngoko, bhaleni le ngoma, niyifundise oonyana bakaSirayeli; bayenze ibe yingoma yabo, ukuze ibe ngumqondiso wam kubo.

Kuba ndiya kumngenisa ezweni eliphumayo ubisi nenkukhu, elizwe endithe ndathetha ngalo kubafazi bakhe; aze aphile, abe mkhulu; ke uya kubuyela kuThixo othile, ayemkhonza; uya kunqula umnqamlezo wam, aya kuwuphula.

Ke kaloku, xa zithe zafika phezu kwabo iimpazamo ezininzi neentlungu, le ngoma iya kuba ngumqondiso kubo; ngokuba iziqhamo zabo aziyi kuyilibala loo nto. Ndiyazi into abayenzayo ngoku, phambi kokuba ndibangenise ezweni endiyithethayo.
Wabhala ke uMoses elo lizwi ngaloo mini, wabafundisa oonyana bakaSirayeli.
UYehova wamwisela umthetho uYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, wathi, Buza namandla, ube nobubele; kuba wena uya kuzisa oonyana bakaSirayeli ezweni endithe ndathi ndiya kubanika lona; mna ke ndiya kuba nawe.
Ke kaloku uMoses wagqiba ukubhalela incwadi amazwi alo mthetho, ukususela ekuqalekeni kuye ekupheleni.
Wathi ke uSolomon kuLevi abathabatha ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, esithi,
Niyithathe le ncwadi yomthetho, niyibeke ecaleni kwebhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova uThixo wenu; ihlale khona ibe ngumqondiso kuwe.
Kuba mna ndiyazi ukuba ungumkhonzi, nomhlaza wesandla sakho; ngoku ke ke, xa ndiphila phakathi kwenu, nikhonze iNkosi; ningakonwaba njani na emva kokuba ndifa?
Zihlanganiseni kum bonke abathetheli bezizwe zenu, nabaphathi bakho bonke; ndithi ke kubo la mazwi, ndikuxelele izulu nehlabathi ukuba zibe ngamaxwebhu kwabo.

Kuba ndiyazi ukuba, emva kokufa kwam, niya kwenza okubi kakhulu, nisuka kwindlela endiyiwisela umthetho ngayo; imihla ezayo iya kubuya intlungu phezu kwenu, ngenxa yokuba niza kwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, niya kumkhumbuza ngomsebenzi wezandla zenu.
Wathetha ke uMoses kuwo onke amagama elo lingoma, ebantwini bonke bakaSirayeli, ukusukela ekuqalekeni kuye ekupheleni.
Ziva, izulu, ndiza kuthetha; Yiva, umhlaba, amazwi omlomo wam.
Inyaniso yam ihambe njengemvula, Ilizwi lam lithabathe intaba-mlilo; Njengemvula ecocekileyo kwimithi ekhulayo, Njengomoya obandayo kwizityalo.
Ndiya kushumayela igama likaYehova, Nivuyisane nobukhulu boThixo wethu.
Uye ngudonga, nemisebenzi yakhe igqibeleleyo; yonke imisebenzi yakhe inyaniso. NguThixo othembekileyo, angabi nobuxoki; ungumntu onobulungisa, ongummangaliso.
Ke kaloku bakwenza okubi kuye; ngenxa yobulungisa babo, bangaba oonyana bakhe. Yiminyaka ephazamisayo, nenyanzelekileyo usapho lwabo.
Nguwo na lo msebenzi owenzayo iNkosi, mna bantu abakhohlakeleyo, abanengqondo? Akukanguye na uBawo wakho, owakwenza wena ukuba ube ngumntu wakhe? Wakwenza wena, wawenza wena.
Khumbula iintsuku zexesha elidlulileyo, ucinge ngezizukulwana zangaphambili; ubuze utata wakho, aze akuxelele; ubuze abakhulu bakho, aze akuxelele.
Xa uNgcwele enika izizwe ilizwe labo, xa ehlula iintlanga, wamisa umda wezinto eziphilayo ngokwenani labantwana bakaSirayeli.
Kuba inxalenye kaYehova yintsapho yakhe; uYakobi yindawo ebeyikhethile yena.
Wamufumana ezweni elibi, Ehlabathini elilahlekileyo, elinobungozi bomoya; Wamgubungela, wamkhusela; Wamkhusela njengomhlaza wemehlo lakhe.
Njengoko i-eagle ekhulisa intaka yayo, ihamba phezulu phezu kweentlanzi zayo, Wakhupha amaphiko akhe ukuba azithathe, Wazithabatha ngeenwele zakhe.
UYehova, yena kuphela, wayemqhuba; Akukho Thixo ongaphandle naye.
Wamenza ahambe phezu kweendawo eziphakamileyo zelizwe, wadla iziqhamo zezityalo; wamnika utywala oluvela kumthi, neoli yeoli esuka kumthi oqinileyo.

Ngenyama yenkomo, nobisi lwezimvu, nomgubo weebhokhwe, nenkukhu yeentyatyambo, neenkunzi zeegusha, neengcuka ezilungileyo zaseBhashani, nengqolowa elungileyo; usele iwayini eyenziwe ngomxube weentyatyambo.
UYeshurun wathambekela, wabetha ngesandla; wena wathambekela, waba mkhulu, ugcwele isonka. Washiya ke uThixo owenzayo, wayeka iRock eyamkhusela.
Bakwenza ukuba abe nobuxoki ngeempawu zangaphandle, Babimisa emnqamlezweni ngoonodoli babo.
Banikela izibingelelo kumadimoni, angamaThixo; amadini abengawaziyo, amadini amatsha abonakala ngathi, amadini abaye bangawakhathali ooyise benu.
Uyasikhumbula ilitye elinokuba ngumzali wakho, Uyasikhumbula uThixo owenzayo.
Wakubona iNkosi, wabathuthuzela; ngokuba noonyana bakhe neentombi zakhe babemkhumbuza.
Wathi, Ndiya kufihla ubuso bam kubo, ndibone ukuba kwenzeka ntoni ekugqibeleni kwabo; Kuba bahlobo olukhohlakeleyo, oonyana abangathembeki.

Bamikela umsindo kum, ngento engumThixonga; bamikela umsindo kum, ngezinto zabo ezingenangqondo. Ke mna ndiya kubanika umsindo ngelizwe elingalo uhlanga; ndiya kubabeka emnqamlezweni ngohlanga olungaqondanga.
Kuba umnqamlezo wam utshisa umlilo, otyhutyha phantsi ukuya kumngxunya wokufa; utyhutyha ihlabathi nemveliso yayo, utyhutyha iziseko zeentaba.
Ndiya kuzibeka phezu kwabo iimpazamo, ndizisebenzise zonke iziqhoboshi zam kubo.
Baza kuphelelwa ngumhlaza, baza kuthotywa ziintsholongwane, nezifo ezibulalayo; ndiya kuzithumela phezu kwabo iintlanzi zomhlaba ezinezintloko zazo, neentlabathi ezinobungozi, ezihamba ngomthi.

Engaphandle, ikrele liya kuwabulala oonyana babo; ngaphakathi kwezindlu zabo, uxinzelelo luya kubakho. Amantombazana amancinci namabhinqa amancinci aya kufa, nabantwana abancinci namadoda amakhulu amnyama.
Ndathi, Ndiya kubasasaza kude, Ndiya kucima yonke inkumbulo yabo ehlabathini.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuye: Ndiyaxoka, ukuba bangatsho na abathunywa babo; ukuba bangaqondanga abathunywa babo, besithi, Siphumelele ngesandla sethu sodwa; akunguye iNkosi owenza ezi zinto zonke.
ISirayeli yintsapho engaqondanga, Akukho kuqonda kubo.
Baye ke, ukuba babe nobulumko, bayazi le nto! Baye ke, ukuba bacinge ngento eya kubakho ekugqibeleni kwabo!
Ingaba inkosi enye iya kuxhaphaza njani izigidi, namadoda amabini aya kwenza ukuba ahambe izigidi ezilishumi? Ukuba isiQithi sabo asibathengise, ukuba iNkosi asibanikezeli.
Kuba ilitye labo alifani nelitye lethu; Nabo abathunywa bethu bayavuma oko.
Umnquba wabo uvela kumnquba weSodoma, nemithi yeGomora; iinkomo zabo zigcwele intsholongwane, iziqhamo zazo zizityebi.
Iwayini yabo ifana notywala lwamakhoboka, Notywala olubulalayo lweebhokhwe.
Andizange ndiyigcine ntoni na loo nto, Ndiyikhusele endlwini yam yezakhiwo?
Ndiya kunika, ndiyihlawule; kwixesha elifanelekileyo imilenze yabo iya kuqhutywa. Imini yokuphazamisa kwabo ifutshane, ukulimala kwabo kukhawuleza kubo.
UYehova uya kugweba abantu bakhe, ubone ububele abakhonzi bakhe; xa ebona ukuba amandla abo aphelile, nokuba akukho namnye oseleyo, nokuba ngumkhonzi nakuba ngumntu okhululekileyo.
Uthi ke, Aphi na ngoku amadini abo, ilitye labo belibalela kulo ukukhuseleka,
abo ThixouThixo abadla utywala lwezibingelelo zabo, besela iwayini yezibingelelo zazo zokusela? Baye bavuka abo ThixouThixo, bakuncede; baye bakukhusela.
Nceda nibone ngoku ukuba mna, mna kuphela; akukho Thixo ngaphandle kwam. Ndiwufa, ndiwusindisa; ndiwubulala, ndiwuphilisa; akukho namnye okwaziyo ukumkhulula esandla sam.
Ndikhuphe isandla sam esibhakabhakeni, ndithethe le nto: Ngokuba ndiphila ngonaphakade,
Xa ndiya kugqiba ikrele lam eliqaqambileyo, ndilithathele ukunyamezela; Ndiya kubabuyisela abathunywa bam, Ndiya kuwagweba abo bangazixoki.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba amagwebu am asele ngegazi, nekrele lam lidle inyama; igazi labo abafayo nabathathelwe engqondweni, intloko yabathetheli boonobumba.
Yibhiyozeleni abantu bakhe, nizizwe; ngokuba uya kuwahlawula abo babulala abakhonzi bakhe; uyasilungisa izihlwele zakhe, aze ahlanze ilizwe lakhe nabantu bayo.
Wafika ke uMoses, naye uYoshuwa unyana kaNun, wathetha onke amagama elo lingoma phambi kwamehlo abantu.
Ke kaloku, xa uMoses egqibile ukushumayela loo mazwi onke kumaSirayeli onke,
wathi kubo, Nizibeke engqondweni yenu amazwi onke endithethayo kuni namhlanje; nithethe kubantwana benu, ukuba bagcine bayenze yonke imiyalelo yalo mthetho.
Akuyi kuba ngamazwi angabikho nto kuwo; kuba zimpilo yenu, ukuze nihlale ixesha elide ezweni lenu elidlulayo iYorodani, nilithathe njengelifa.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses ngaloo mini, wathi,
Yiya phezulu kumatye eAbarim, kwinduli kaNebo yaseMowabhi, entliziyweni yeYerusalem; ujonge ilizwe laseKanan, elinika oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba libe lilifa labo.
Uphele kuloo mnxweme, owunyukayo, uhlangane nabantu bakho abafileyo phambi kwakho; njengokuba uAron, umzalwana wakho, wakufa emnqamlezweni kaHori, wahlangane nabantu bakhe.
ngenxa yokuba nindixhaphaze phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, ngamanzi kaMeriba eKadeshe, emasikweni aseZin; ningamsindisi mna phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Ke ngoko, uya kuyibona le lizwe ngaphaya; awuyi kungena kuloo mhlaba ndiwunika oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Leyo ke intsikelelo kaMoses, umntu kaThixo, awayeyenza oonyana bakaSirayeli phambi kokuba aphele.

Wathi, UYehova waya emnqamlezweni kaSinayin, waphuma phezu kwabo njengelanga eSeyiri; wakhanya ukusuka emnqamlezweni kaParan; waya namawaka amaninzi angcwele, umsi oqhutywa ngamandla esandla sakhe esikunene.
Ngokuqinisekileyo uthanda abantu bakhe; bonke abangcwele bakhe bakwisandla sakho, Bahlangula emantla enyawo lakho, Bonke bafumana amazwi akho.
UMoses usinike umthetho, Intyatyambo yosapho lukaYakobi;
Ke kaloku iNkosi waba ngukumkani eYeshurun, xa abathetheli bakaSirayeli bahlangana ndawonye, zonke iintlanga zikaSirayeli.
URubhen aphile, angafanga; abantu bakhe bangabi mbalwa.
Wathi ngoYuda, Liva, Nkosi, intloko kaYuda, uyibuyisele ebantwini bakhe; ngezandla zakhe ezizimeleyo uya kulwa ngokwakhe; umncede ekuhlaseleni abachasi bakhe.
Wathi ngoLevi, Nkosi, iThummim yakho neUrim yakho ziye kumkhonzi wakho othembekileyo; uyamvavanya eMasha, wathetha naye ngamanzi kaMeriba.
Wathi kuyise nomyeni wakhe, Andibakhathaleli. Akazange athathe inxaxheba yabahlobo bakhe, nabantwana bakhe; ngokuba baphulaphule amagama akho, bagcine umnqophiso wakho.
Baya kukufundisa uYakobi imimiselo yakho, nemithetho yakho kuSirayeli; baya kubeka phambi kwakho intyatyambo yomlilo, nezibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, phezu kwesibingelelo sakho.
UYehova, ubhaptize zonke iimvakalelo zakhe, ube nenceba kwimisebenzi yezandla zakhe; uthabathe izihlunu zalabo abavukayo kuye; uwaphule abo bamxhalabisayo, ukuba bangavumi ukuvuka.
NgoBhenjamin ke wathi, Owuthandayo nguYehova ahlale ekhuselekile phambi kwakhe; iNkosi uyakumkhusela yonke imihla; lowo ukuthandayo iNkosi uphumle phakathi kwemilebe yakhe.
Wathi ngoYosefu, UYehova abhaptize ilizwe lakhe ngezinto ezilungileyo zezulu ngasentla, ngenkungu, namanzi aphakamileyo phantsi.
Kuye kube neentyatyambo ezilungileyo ilanga lizisayo, neentyatyambo ezilungileyo inyanga nganye inokuzinika;
Ngeempawu ezilungileyo zeentaba zamanye amaxesha, Nezinto ezixabisekileyo zeenduli ezindala;

ngezinto ezilungileyo zehlabathi, nazo zonke izinto zayo; nobubele balo mremu obonakalayo emnqamlezweni womlilo. Zonke ezi zihlandlo zosindiso zihlale phezu kweentloko zikaYosefu, phantsi kobuso bokumkani phakathi kwabazalwana bakhe.

Ubuhle bakhe bufana nenyama yenkomo ezalwa kuqala; iindlebe zakhe ziindlebe zebhokhwe yomhlaba; ngazo uya kuzikhupha izizwe, nakwiindawo eziphesheya kwehlabathi. Ezi zizigidi ezilishumi zikaEfrayim, ezi zizigidi zikaManase.
Wathi ngoZebuloni, Yiphile, Zebuloni, xa uphumayo; nawe, Issakari, ezitentileni zakho.
Baza kuzibiza iintlanga ziye emnxwemeni, baza kunikela khona izibingelelo zobulungisa; baya kwenza isidlo sabaninzi belwandle, nezityalo ezifihlakeleyo kumthi.
NgoGadi ke wathi, Kusindisiwe lowo uyenzayo ilizwe likaGadi libe libanzi; uGadi uya kuhlala khona njengelion, elahlisa umlenze neentloko.
Wakhetha ilizwe elilungileyo kuye; inxalenye yokumkani yagcinwa kuye. Ke kaloku, xa abakumkani bezizwe besamkelana, wazenza izigwebo zikaYehova, nezigqibo zakhe kuSirayeli.
Wathi ngoDan, UDan ungumntwana welili, uphumayo eBhashani.
Wathi ngoNafetali, UNafetali ugcwele inceba kaYehova, uzele ubulumko bakhe; uya kuthatha ilizwe elunxwemeni nokumzantsi.
Ngo-Ashere wathi, U-Ashere ungcwele kunabo bonke oonyana; athandeke kubazalwana bakhe, ilizwe lakhe libe likhulu ngeoli.
Izitshixo zeengcango zakho zibe yintsimbi nentsimbi engenasici; ubutyebi bakho buhlale iintsuku zobomi bakho.
Akukho namnye ofana noThixo kaYeshurun, Ohamba phezu kwezulu ukuze akuncede, ngaphezu kwelanga ngobuhle bakhe.
UThixo wexesha eliphakamileyo ngumgangatho wakho okhuselekileyo, Amathambo akhe emihla ngemihla aya phantsi kwakho; Wakhupha umkhosi wakho phambi kwakho, esithi, Bakhulule.
Ke uSirayeli uya kuhlala ekhuselekileyo; imbewu kaYakobi iya kuhlala yodwa kwilizwe lengqolowa newayini entsha, apho izulu likhupha khona umsi.

Kuhle wena, uSirayeli! Nguwuphi na ofana nawe, abantu abasindisiweyo nguYehova? Umgquba wakho, nomncedisi wakho, nekrele lakho eliqaqambileyo, nguye. Abathunywa bakho baya kuphumla phambi kwakho; uya kuhamba phezu kwezikhululo zabo.

Wanyuka ke uMoses, wasuka ezindaweni eziphakamileyo zaseMowabi, waya emnqamlezweni weNtlambo kaNebo, phezulu kwePisga, entliziyweni yeYericho; wambonisa khona iNkosi ilizwe lonke, ukusuka eGiliyadi ukuya eDan,
lonke ilizwe likaNafetali, nelizwe likaEfrayim noManase, nalo lonke ilizwe likaYuda, ukuya elwandle lwaseMedithera,
neNtshona, ekumzantsi, nomhlaba onke ophantsi kolwandle waseYericho, umzi wezityalo zeziqhamo, ukuya eSoari.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuye, Eli lilizwe endilibambise ngalo kuAbraham noIsake noYakobi, ndisithi, Ndiya kulinika iziqhamo zakho; ndenza ukuba uyibone ngamehlo akho, kodwa awuyi kungena kuyo.
Wafa ke khona uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, eMowabhi, njengoko watsho iNkosi.
Wamzika ke iNkosi emlanjeni waseMowabhi, ngaphesheya kweBhete-peori; akukho namnye owaziyo indawo yesibingelelo sakhe, kude kube namhlanje.
Ke kaloku uMoses wayeminyaka imakhulu amabini anamashumi mabini ezelwe, xa efa; amehlo akhe ayemhle, wahlala enamandla.
Baye ke oonyana bakaSirayeli belibalisa uMoses, ezindaweni eziphakamileyo zaseMowabhi, iintsuku ezimashumi mathathu; zagqitywa imihla yoliliba nobingelelo lukaMoses.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, wazele ngumphefumlo wobulumko; ngokuba uMoses wayemise izandla zakhe phezu kwakhe. Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli kuye, bakwenza njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Ke kaloku, akukho mprofeti wavuka eSirayeli njengoMoses, owaziyo iNkosi ngobuso nobuso.
Akukho namnye owenzayo onke amaphawu namathandabuzo, awathumelela wona iNkosi ukuba akwenze eYiputa, kuFaro, kubo bonke abaphathi bakhe, nelizwe lakhe lonke.
Akukho namnye owenzayo isandla esinamandla, okanye esenza izinto ezibuhlungu, njengokuba wazenza uMoses phambi kwamadoda aseYiputa onke.
Josh: Ke kaloku, emva kokufa kukaMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, iNkosi wathi kuYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, umncedisi kaMoses.
Wathi, UMoses umkhonzi wam ufile; ngoko ke ngoku vuka uyeke lo mlambo iYorodani, wena nolu bantu bonke, nifike ezweni endilibazisa lona oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Yonke indawo oza kuyibeka khona inyawo lenu, ndiyaninika yona, njengokuba ndathi kuMoses.
Ukusuka emasikweni, naseLibanoni, ukuya kumlambo omkhulu uEfrayim, lonke ilizwe lakwaHeti, kuya kulwandle olukhulu kwelasempumalanga, luza kuba lilizwe lakho.
Akukho namnye oza kukumelana nawe zonke iintsuku zobomi bakho; njengokuba ndandikho noMoses, ndiya kuba nawe; andikushiyelanga, andikukushiyanga.
Uhlale unamandla, ube nobubele; kuba wena uya kuzisa le ndoda ukuba ithathe njengelifa ilizwe endilibazile ooyise.

Kuphela ube namandla, ube nobubele obukhulu, ulinde ukuba wenze umthetho onke wamwisela wona uMoses, umkhonzi wam; ungayitshintshi ngasekunene nakwesobunxele, ukuze uphumelele kuwo onke amanyathelo akho.
Le ncwadi yomthetho ihlale ingaphaya komlomo wakho; ufunde kuyo busuku nobusuku, ukuze ugcine wenze konke okubhaliweyo kulo; ngoko ke uza kwenza kakuhle, ngoko ke uya kuphumelela.
Musani ukuxhalabisa, nize nibe namandla; musani ukuxoka, nize nigweme intliziyo yenu; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kuba nawe kuzo zonke iindawo oza kuzithatha.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wabawisela umthetho abathetheli babantu.

Wathi, Yiya phakathi kwethutyana, sithi kubo abantu, Nilungiselele isonka; kuba emva kweentsuku ezintathu niza kudlula loo Yordani, ukuba ningangeni niyithathe ilizwe, elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Wathetha ke uYoshuwa kumaSirayeli, namaGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase.
Wathi, Khumbulani ilizwi uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, alilithethayo kuni, esithi, UYehova uThixo wenu uya kukunika ukuphumla, aninike eli lizwe.

Amabhinqa enu, nabantwana benu, nenyama yenu yobisi, bahlale kuloo lizwe uMoses wamnika lona ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani; ke nina bonke amadoda anamandla okulwa, niyihambe phambi kwabazalwana benu, nibe nemikhosi, nibancedise;

kude kube iNkosi wabanika isiphumlo, njengokuba wamnikeni niyo; nabo ke bathathe ilizwe iNkosi uThixo wenu ababunikela kulo; emva koko niya kubuyela ezweni lenu elinokuba likhaya lenu, elisentshonalanga yeYorodani, elinika lona uMoses umkhonzi kaYehova.
Baphendula ke uYoshuwa, besithi, Zonke izinto ozithumeleleyo thina siza kuzisenza, naphi na apho usithumelela khona siyaya.
Siwuphulaphule uMoses ngazo zonke izinto, siza kukuphulaphula nawe; kodwa iNkosi, uThixo wakho, abe nawe, njengokuba waba noMoses.
Wonke umntu othi waphulaphula umyalelo wakho, akayi kuthobela amagama akho, kufuneka afumane ukufa; ube nomonde nje, ube nobubele.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, wathumela abantu ababini abacamngcayo eSitiyim, wathi, Yiya niyibone le lizwe, neYerusalem. Baye ke baya, bafika endlwini yomfana omtshakazi, igama lakhe liRahabhi, bahlala khona.
Ke kaloku kwathiwa kukumkani waseYeremiya, besithi, Yabona, abantu abathile baseSirayeli bafika apha ngaloo busuku, ukuba bajonge ilizwe.
Wathi ukumkani waseYeremiya wamthumela kuRahabhi, esithi, Thola phandle abantu abangene endlwini yakho; kuba bafika ukuba babone ilizwe lonke.
Ke kaloku lo mfazi wabathabatha amadoda amabini, wawafihla; wathi ke, Ewe, abantu bafika kum, kodwa andizange ndizi ukuba bayaphi.
Xa yayithe yagqitywa, kwixesha lokuvala isango ledolophu, uManzi wagqiba kwelokuba avule umngxunya wedolophu, kodwa wayengenakukwazi ukuwuvala.
Ke kaloku wayebakhuphile phezu kwendlu, wabafihla phantsi kweziqhamo zelinen, ebezibeka khona.
Amadoda kakumkani ayewaphulaphula ngendlela yokuhamba kwelaseJordan. Baphuma ke, kwavalwa isango.
Ke kaloku, phambi kokuba baphumle abaphambukeli, uRahabhi wanyuka waya kubo phezu kwendlu.
Wathi kubo, Ndiyazi ukuba iNkosi wamnika lona eli lizwe; ke kaloku thina sikhathaza ngenxa yenu, nabo bonke abahlali kuloo ndawo batshisa ngenxa yenu.

Kuba siye sazi ukuba iNkosi wahlamba amanzi eMlambo oMthubi phambi kwenu, xa niphuma eYiputa; siye sazi nantoni na ebeniyenze kuSihon noOg, ookumkani ababini baka-Amori abasentshonalanga yeYorodani, nantoni na nabanikele ngayo.
Ke kaloku, sithe sazi, intliziyo yethu yatshisa, namadoda onke aphulukana nobubele ngenxa yenu; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wenu nguThixo emazulwini ngasentla, nasehlabathini ngezantsi.
Ke ngoko, mna ke, ndicela, zinikele kum igama likaYehova, ukuba uya kuba nesonka kusapho lwam; ngokuba ndaba nesonka kuwe; ndininike uphawu oluqinisekileyo.
ukuba ugcine ubomi bukayise wam, nomyeni wam, nabazalwana bam, neentombi zam, nazo zonke izinto zabo, ukuze sisindiswe kukufa.
Bathi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Intliziyo yethu iya kuba yintliziyo yenu; ukuba ungazixelela nabani na into esiyenzayo, siza kwenza kuni ububele nobuxoki, xa iNkosi esiya kusinika ilizwe.
Wabakhupha ke ngentsontelo ngefestile; ngokuba indlu yakhe yakhiwa ngasemngciphekweni womzi, yena wahlala emngciphekeni.
Wathi kubo, Yiya entliziyweni yenduli, ukuze abathunywa bakho bangakufumanani; nifihle khona iintsuku ezintathu, de babuye abathunywa benu; emva koko nihambe indlela yenu.
Bathi ke amadoda kuye, Siza kuhlala sikhululekile kulo mzekeliso wethu owenza ukuba siswe;
ukuba, xa sifika kuloo lizwe, ungayibophelela loo msonto ongwevu kwifestile ebesikhuphile kuyo; uthabathe uyise wakho noyise wakho, nabazalwana bakho, neentsapho zakho zonke, uzibeke ekhaya lakho.
Nabani na oza kuphuma endlwini yakho, aze afile ngetyala lakhe; asiyi kuba netyala nathi; ke nabani na oza kuba netyala nawe endlwini yakho, siya kuba netyala nathi.
Ke kaloku, ukuba uya kuxela umntu into esiyenzayo, siza kuba sikhululekile kuloo mnqamlezo owenza ukuba siphe.
Wathi yena, Kube njalo njengoko nisithiyo. Yabasusa, baphuma; wabeka intambo emnyama kwifestile.
Bathi ke, bafike emnqamlezweni, bahlala khona iintsuku ezintathu, de babuye abo abawalandelayo. Baye bafuna abo abawalandelayo yonke indlela, bangabafumananga.
Ke kaloku abo madoda mabini athabathela emlanjeni, badlula, bafika kuYoshuwa, unyana kaNun; bamxelela zonke izinto ezibangelwayo.
Bathi kuYoshuwa, Ngokuqinisekileyo iNkosi wanikela eli lizwe liphela esandla sethu; bonke abahlali balo baphelelwe luxolo ngenxa yethu.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wavuka ekuseni, wasuka eSitiyim, waya eYordan, yena namadoda onke aseSirayeli naye; bamisa khona itente phambi kokuba badlule.
Emva kweentsuku ezintathu, abathetheli bahamba phantsi kwesixeko
wabawisela umthetho abantu, esithi, Xa nibona ababingeleli bakaLevi bethabatha itekisi yomnqophiso kaYehova uThixo wenu, phumani ezindaweni zenu niyilandele.
Ke kaloku, gcinani umgama phakathi kwenu nebhokisi, njengemitha elilodwa; musa ukudlula kuyo; ukuze nikwazi indlela yokuhamba yenu; ngokuba ningazange nihambe ngaloo ndlela.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Buyiselani; ngokuba ngoMgqibelo iNkosi uza kwenza phakathi kwenu izinto ezimangalisayo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubabingeleli, Niyithathe ibhokisi yomnqophiso, nihambe phambi kwabantu. Bayithatha ke, bahamba phambi kwabo.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Namhlanje ndiza kuqala ukukwenza ube mkhulu phambi kwamehlo ooSirayeli bonke; ukuze bakwazi ukuba mna ndikhona nawe, njengokuba ndaye noMoses.
Bathi kubo oombingeleli abathabatha ibhokisi yomnqophiso, Nithi, Xa nifika emngciphekweni wamanzi eYorodani, hlalani kumlambo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Nxibelelani apha, niva amazwi kaYehova uThixo wenu.

Wathi uAron, Niyazi ngale nto ukuba uThixo ophilayo uphakathi kwenu, nokuba uya kuzikhupha phambi kwenu iinkomo zaseKanan, neentyatyambo zeHeti, neentyatyambo zeHivi, neentyatyambo zePerizi, neentyatyambo zeGirgashi, neentyatyambo zeAmori, neentyatyambo zeYebhusi.
Yabona, itekisi yomnqophiso kaYehova wehlabathi liphela ihamba phambi kwenu, iye eYordan.
Ke ngoko, nithatheni amadoda amabini anamashumi mabini ezitribhu zakwaSirayeli; isizwe ngasinye sinomntu omnye.
Ke kaloku, xa izinyawo zababingeleli abathabatha ibhokisi kaYehova, uThixo wehlabathi liphela, zithe zatshisa amanzi eYordan, amanzi aphumayo aya kumisa, aza kuhlala emthini omnye.
Ke kaloku abantu basuka ezitentileni zabo, badlula eJordan; ababingeleli bethwala ibhokisi yomnqophiso phambi kwabo.
Ke kaloku, kwakuba lixesha lokuvuna, xa umlambo iYorodani udlula ngaphaya kweendawo zakhe zonke; bafika ke ababingeleli abathabatha isiqulatho kumlambo, amadolo abo athabathela emngxunyeni wamanzi.

Amanzi ahamba phantsi, athabathela ukuphuma; afike ekumzini ka-Adam, okwiSarethani, wabekwa emngxunyeni omnye; amanzi ahamba ezantsi kulwandle olufileyo, athabathela ukuphuma, athabathela ukuphuma. Badlula ke abantu eYerusalem.
Ababingeleli abathabatha itekisi yomnqophiso kaYehova bahlala phantsi kwindawo epholileyo, phakathi kweYorodani; bonke amaSirayeli ke badlula phezu kwendawo epholileyo, de ilizwe lonke liphele.
Yathi ke iNkosi kuYoshuwa, xa ilizwe lonke ligqibile ukudlula eYordan, esithi,
Nciphiseni amadoda alishumi elinambini kubo bonke abantu, isizwe ngasinye sinomntu omnye;
Nithi kubo, Nciphiseni phakathi kweYorodani iithayile ezilishumi elinambini, ecaleni apho babeka khona amehlo abo ababingeleli; nizithatheni nani, nizibeke kwindawo yenu yokuphumla le busuku.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wababiza amadoda alishumi elinambini, ayewamisela kumaSirayeli, umntu ngamnye kwisizukulwana ngasinye.
Wathi kubo uYosefu, Yiya phambi kwebhokisi kaYehova uThixo wenu, nifike phakathi kweYordan; nithabathe umntu ngamnye itye elilodwa phezu komqolo wakhe, itshe ngalinye losapho lwakwaSirayeli.
Le nto imele ibe ngumqondiso phakathi kwenu; xa niza kubuza abantwana benu ngemihla ezayo, besithi, Zithini ezi zinto?
nithi kubo, Amanzi eYorodani athabathe phantsi phambi kwebhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova; xa yadlula iYorodani, amanzi ayethutyana. Ezi zithambeka zibe ngukumbuso kubantwana bakaSirayeli ngonaphakade.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, njengokuba uYoshuwa wabawiselayo; bathabathe iithayile ezilishumi elinambini phakathi kweJordan, njengesithili ngasinye isithili ngasinye, njengoko iNkosi abewiselayo uYoshuwa; bazithabatha, bazibeka endlwini yabo yokugcina.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wamisa iithayile ezilishumi elinambini phakathi kweJordan, apho ababingeleli abathabatha intonga yomnqophiso besima khona; zikhona namhla.

Ke kaloku ababingeleli abathabatha isiqulatho bahlala phantsi phakathi kweYorodani, de kwagqitywa konke iNkosi abewisela umthetho uYoshuwa ukuba akwenze, njengoko uMoses abewisela umthetho uYoshuwa; abantu ke bakhawuleza badlula.
Ke kaloku, xa bonke abantu baphelelwe lixesha lokudlula, isiqwenga seNkosi sadlula, nababingeleli nabo; abantu ke bejonge.
Badlula ooRubhen, noGadi, nengxenye yesizukulwana sikaManase, begqobhoza phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, njengoko uMoses wabawiselayo.
Badlula phambi koYehova, ezindaweni ezithe tyaba zaseYeremiya, ukubhiyozela ukulwa, amawaka angamashumi mane madoda alungiselelwe ukulwa.
Ngomhla lowo iNkosi wamvusa uYoshuwa phambi kwamehlo ooSirayeli bonke; bamhlonela yonke imihla yobomi bakhe, njengoko babemhlonela uMoses.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuYoshuwa, esithi,
Uthi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Beka umthetho oombingeleli abathabatha itekisi yomnqophiso womthetho, ukuba bakhuphe eJordan.
Wathi ke uYoshuwa kubabingeleli, Nikhuphe eYordan.

Ke kaloku, ababingeleli abathabatha ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova baphuma emlanjeni; kwathi xa izinyawo zabo zathi zithabathe indawo entsundu, amanzi eYorodani abuyela, adlula emantla ayo, njengokuba kuqala.
Baphuma ke abantu eYordan, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yokuqala; bamisa iintaba eGalgali, ngasentshonalanga yeYerusalem.
Iithayile ezilishumi elinambini, ababezithabatha eYordan, uYoshuwa wazimisa eGilgal.
Wathi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Xa ekugqibeleni abantwana benu bebuza abazali babo, besithi, Zithini ezi zinto?
sithi kubo, AmaSirayeli athabathe iJordan ngendawo emanzi.
Kuba iNkosi, Thixo wenu, wamisa iJordan phambi kwenu, de nidlule; njengokuba emise umlambo oMthubi phambi kwethu, de sihambe.
ukuze ziqonde zonke iintlanga zehlabathi ukuba amandla kaYehova anamandla amakhulu; ukuze niyihlonele iNkosi, uThixo wenu, mihla le.

Ke kaloku, abakumkani bonke baka-Amori, abasemazantsi eJordan, nabakumkani bonke baka-Kanan, ababeselwandle, beva ukuba iNkosi wamisa iYordan phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, de sadlula; zatshisa intliziyo zabo, zaba buhlungu ngenxa yabaseSirayeli.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuYoshuwa, Yenza izitshizi zelitye eliqinileyo, uthabathe amadoda aseSirayeli kathathu.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wazenza izitshizi zesilivere, wabatholisa oonyana bakaSirayeli kwindawo ebizwa ngokuba yiNtlambo yeentsontelo.
Kuba bonke amadoda aphumayo eYiputa, onke amadoda okulwa, ayefa emasikweni, ngendlela; ngoko ke wakwenza njalo.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aphumayo eYiputa ayethunyelwe; ke bona oonyana abazalwa entlango, ekuhambeni kwabo ukusuka eYiputa, babengathunyelwe.

Ke kaloku abantwana bakaSirayeli babehamba emasikweni iminyaka emashumi mane, de bafa bonke oonyana bokulwa abaphuma eYiputa; ngenxa yokuba bengaziphulaphuli ilizwi likaYehova; iNkosi ke wavuma ukuba bangabonanga eli lizwe, awayethetha ngalo kubazalwana babo ukuba alisinike lona, ilizwe elinokutyhutyha ubisi nemvu.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathunga noonyana babo, abo uThixo wawaphakamisa endaweni yabo; abazange bathungelwe, ngokuba akukho namnye wabathungileyo ehambayo.
Ke kaloku, xa ilizwe lonke lithe lathunywa, bahlala emkhosini, de baphiliswe.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Namhlanje ndiyikhuphile phezu kwenu inkanuko yamaYiputa; ngoko kwabizwa igama lesi sixeko ngokuba yiGalgali, de kube ngaloo mini.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakaSirayeli bamisa izikhephe eGalgali, ezityeni zaseYirekhi. Bayenza iPasha ngomhla weshumi elinesine lenyanga, kusasa;
Ke kaloku, ngosuku olulandelayo kwePasika, badla ukutya okusuka ezweni, isonka esingenawo umgubo, nengqolowa eyotywe.
Ke kaloku i-manna yayeka, ngomhla wokutya kwabo ubisi oluvela kuloo lizwe; abaSirayeli abazange babe nayo i-manna. Badla iziqhamo zelizwe laseKanan ngaloo nyaka.

Ke kaloku, xa uYoshuwa ephakathi kweYeremiya, waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona umntu ehlala phambi kwakhe, enesklabi emlonyeni wakhe. Wafika ke uYoshuwa kuye, wathi kuye, Ingaba ungumnye wethu na, okanye ungumnye wababi bethu?
Wathi ke uYoshuwa, Akukho nto; mna ndafika ndingumphathi womkhosi kaYehova. UYoshuwa wahlangula ngobuso bakhe ehlabathini, wathandaza, wathi, Yintoni leyo oyitshoyo nkosi yam kumkhonzi wayo?
Wathi uKumkani womkhosi kaYehova kuye, Khuba izihlangu zakho; ngokuba indawo apho uhlala khona ingcwele. UYoshuwa wakwenza njalo.
Iindonga zikaYeremiya zazivalwe, ngenxa yabantwana bakaSirayeli; akukho mntu waphumayo, akukho mntu wafikayo.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Yabona, ndiyimise esandla sakho iYeremiya, nokumkani wayo, namadoda amakhulu ayo.
Umele ujikeleze lo mzi xesha elinye, namadoda akho onke anamandla; wenze njalo iintsuku ezintathu.
Bathabathe oombingeleli ababini izidumbu ezisixhenxe zeenkomo phambi kwebhokisi yomnqophiso; ngomhla wesixhenxe nijikeleze umzi amaxesha asixhenxe, bona ababingeleli baphume ngezidumbu.
Ke kaloku, xa ubona ukuba baphucula ngeebhokhwe kangangeeyure ezilishumi elinambini, abantu bonke baya kwenza umsindo omkhulu; ke ngoko idonga ledolophu liya kugwa, wonke umntu ahambe ngokuthe ngqo.
UYoshuwa unyana kaNune wababiza ababingeleli, wathi kubo, Nciphise ibhokisi yomnqophiso; ababingeleli abasibhozo bathabathe izidumbu phambi kwebhokisi kaYehova.
Wathi kubo abantu, Yiya ngaphambili, nijikeleze lo mzi; namadoda anezixhobo ahambe phambi kwebhokisi kaThixo.
Ke kaloku, xa uYoshuwa ethethe nabantu, ababingeleli ababini abanezithunywa ezisixhenxe, behamba phambi koYehova, bephucula izithunywa zabo; itekisi yomnqophiso kaYehova yalandela emva kwabo.
Amadoda anezithuthi ahamba phambi kwababingeleli abadubula iinkunzi zeenkomo; amagwebu alandela ibhokisi. Iintliziyo zababingeleli zaqhubeka zidubula iinkunzi zeenkomo.
Wathi ke uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Musani ukubhiyozela, nikhuphe umsindo wenu; musani nokuthetha lizwi nalinye, de kube yimini endithi kuni, Yibhiyozeleni; nibhiyozele ngoko.
Wayijikelezisa ke inqanawa kaYehova umzi, ijikeleze olunye ixesha. Baye abantu babuyela esixekweni, bahlala khona ngelo busuku.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wavuka emveni kwemini, ababingeleli baphakamisa ibhokisi kaYehova.
Iindawo eziphakamileyo zesibhakabhaka ziye zahamba ngaphaya kweendawo eziphakamileyo zesibhakabhaka, ziye zahamba ngaphaya kweendawo eziphakamileyo zomlilo.
Ke kaloku ngomhla wesibini bajikeleza umzi olunye, babuyela entabeni. Bakwenza njalo iintsuku ezintandathu.
Ke kaloku ngomhla wesixhenxe, bavuka kusasa, bajikeleza umzi ngendlela efanayo; ke kaloku bajikeleza amaxesha asixhenxe. Ngomhla owodwa tegene kuphela abajikeleze amaxesha asixhenxe.
Ke kaloku, kwathi ke kube lixesha lesixhenxe, xa ababingeleli bephumile ngeebhokhwe, uYoshuwa wathi kubo bonke abantu, marhuqa; ngokuba iNkosi wanikela kuni lo mzi.

Lo mzi, nazo zonke izinto ezingaphakathi kuwo, kufuneka zibe zingcwele kuYehova; uRahabhi kuphela umkhonzi, uya kuhlala ephila, naye wonke umntu onendlu yakhe, ngenxa yokuba wafihla abo sibathunyelwe kubo.
Ke kaloku, uhlale kude nezinto ezingenanto; ukuba nizithathe ngazo naziphi na izinto, niza kuzisa intlungu nobuhlungu kwisiqithi samaSirayeli.
Yonke isilivere, negolide, nantoni na eyenziwe ngobhedu, nentsimbi, zingcwele kuYehova; ziya kungena kwikhaya likaThixo.

Ke kaloku ababingeleli baphucula iinkunzi zeenkomo, abantu ke bavuma. Bathi ke, xa beva isandi sezinkunzi zeenkomo, bavuma ngovuyo olukhulu, udonga lwawela phantsi; bonke ke baphuma ngesandla, bathatha umzi.
Zazibulala ngeqhwa zonke izinto ezisemzini, amadoda namabhinqa, amancinci namadala, neenkomo, neebhokhwe, neeeseyile.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathi kubo amadoda amabini, abagqugquzelayo eli lizwe, Ngeni endlwini yobhizi-bhizi, niyikhuphe ngaphandle yena nosapho lwakhe lonke, njengokuba nithe nathi kuye.

Bathi ke abo madoda amancinci, abagqugquzelayo, baphuma uRahabhi, noyise, nomyeni wakhe, nabazalwana bakhe, nazo zonke izinto zakhe; baphuma nabo bonke oonyana bakhe, bababeka ngaphandle komkhosi wakwaSirayeli.
Bawutshisa lo mzi wonke, nazo zonke izinto ezikuyo; kodwa isilivere, negolide, neempahla zentsimbi, nezixhobo zentsimbi, zabazisa kwindlu kaYehova.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wamshiya uRahabhi, umkhonzi, nosapho lwakhe, nazo zonke izinto zakhe; wahlala phakathi kwabaSirayeli kude kube ngaloo mini; ngokuba wabafihla abo bantu abaye bathunyelwe nguYoshuwa ukuba babone iYerusalem.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wabhiyozela abantu ngaloo xesha, wathi, Ube ngumbulelo phambi koYehova umntu oza kukwakha lo mzi waseYeremiya; unyana wakhe omdala uya kufa xa emisa isiseko sawo, nonyana wakhe omncinane uya kufa xa emisa iindonga zawo.
Waye iNkosi noYoshuwa; waba negama lakhe lonke ilizwe liphela.

Ke kaloku oonyana bakaSirayeli baphulaphule kakubi ngezinto ezithunyelweyo. Wathi ke uAkani, unyana kaKarmi, unyana kaZabdi, unyana kaZera, wesizwe sikaYuda, wathabatha kuzo izinto ezithunyelweyo; waza iNkosi waxoka kakhulu kuSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathumela abantu ukusuka eYeremiya waya eAyi, ecaleni kweBhete-aven, esemntla kaBhetheleli; wathi kubo, Yiya phezulu, nijonge ilizwe. Baye ke aba bantu benyuka bajonge iAyi.
Babuyela kuye uYoshuwa, bathi, Akukho mntu wonke omele ahambe; thumela amadoda angamakhulu amabini, okanye anamawaka amathathu, aye eAyi; musa ukuxolela iqela lonke, kuba kukho abantu abambalwa apho.
Baya phezulu abantu abamalunga namawaka amathathu, babaleka phambi kwamadoda aseAi.

Amadoda aseAyin athabathela abantu abamashumi mathathu anesithandathu, ayewathabatha, waya eShebharim, wabetha amaSirayeli ngasekunene kwendlela. Kwabakho abantu abaneentliziyo ezibi kakhulu ngenxa yoxinzelelo lwamanzi.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa warhoxa iimpahla zakhe, waya phantsi ngobuso bakhe ehlabathini phambi kwebhokisi kaYehova, waya kutsho emveni kwemini. Bakwenza njalo namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli, batyhala umsi ezindlebeni zabo.

Wathi uYoshuwa, Ewe, Nkosi yethu uThixouThixo, kutheni na ukuba uthabathe abantu aba badlule iYordan? Ukuba sithunyelwe emlonyeni wama-Amori, ukuze siqhutywe? Kungenxa yoko le nto siza kuphumla kwelinye icala leYordan.
Ndithi ntoni na, Nkosi yam? Ngokuba amaSirayeli ajikelezile phambi kwamagosa akhe.
Ke kaloku baya kukwazi ooKanana, nabahlali bonke belizwe; baya kusijikeleza, bathabathe igama lethu ehlabathini; uza kwenza ntoni na ke igama lakho elikhulu?
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Yiya phezulu; kutheni na ukuba uphumle ngobuso bakho?
AbaSirayeli bathini na? Baphulaphule umnqophiso wam, endiwamwiselayo ukuba bawugcine; bathabathe izinto ezimiselwe ukufa; batshi Óbo, batsho ubuxoki, babezifihla phakathi kweempahla zabo.

Ngoko ke, abaSirayeli abakwazi ukumelana nabachasi babo; bajika bebaleka; ngokuba baya kubekwa phantsi ngoku, ukuze bagwetywe. Andiyi kuba nawe kwakhona, ukuba nize ningawuphelisa lo mcimbi phakathi kwenu.

Yiya, ugcine abantu bengcwele; sithi kubo, Ugcineni ningcwele ngoMgqibelo; ngokuba utsho iNkosi uThixo kaSirayeli, Zikhona izinto ezimiselweyo phakathi kwenu, ooSirayeli; awunakumelana nabachasi bakho, de nizisuse.

Ngomso, nifikeni ngaphambili isizukulwana ngasinye. Isizukulwana esikhethiweyo nguYehova siza kufika phambi kwenu iqela ngeqela; iqela elikhethelwe nguThixo liza kufika phambi kwenu intsapho ngomntwana wayo; intsapho eliyikhethayo uThixo iza kufika phambi kwenu umntu ngamnye.
Ke kaloku lowo ufunyenweyo enezinto ezifunyanisiweyo, uya kuqhutywa ngomlilo, naye nazo zonke izinto zakhe; ngokuba waphula umnqophiso kaYehova, waza wenza into engalunganga kuSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wavuka ekuseni, wabeka amaSirayeli afike phambi kwakhe ngokwesizukulwana ngasinye; sathathwa isizukulwana sikaYuda.
Zafika iintsapho zakwaYuda, yathi intsapho kaZera iqhutywa; yathi intsapho kaZera iqhutywa ngomntu ngamnye, yathi intsapho kaZabdi iqhutywa.
Ke kaloku kwafika usapho lukaZabdi, ndoda ngendoda; wathathwa uAkani unyana kaKarmi, unyana kaZabdi, unyana kaZera, wesizwe sikaYuda.
Wathi uYoshuwa kuAkani, Unyana wam, nikela ngoku uzuko kuYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, unqume kuye; ndixelele into oyenze; musa ukuyifihla kum.
Waphendula ke uAkani kuYoshuwa, wathi, Kulungile; ndenze inyaniso phambi koYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, ndiyenze loo nto.

Ke kaloku, ndabona phakathi kwezithuthi zethu, ibhatyi entle evela eBhabheli, nesilivere ezilishumi elinambini, nentsimbi yegolide eyishumi elinesiqingatha sesilivere; ndazifuna, ndazithatha; zihleli zifihlakele phantsi komhlaba ngaphakathi kwetenki yam, nesilivere ngaphantsi kwayo.
Wathumela ke uYoshuwa abathunywa, babaleka beya etentweni; yabona, ifihlakele entweni yakhe, nesilivere phantsi kwayo.
Zazithabatha ezi zinto ziphuma kwitenki, zazisa kuYoshuwa, nakubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; bazibhengeza phambi koYehova.

Wathabatha ke uYoshuwa noSirayeli bonke, uAkani unyana kaZera, nesilivere, nempahla ethe tyaba, nentonga yegolide, nabantwana bakhe nabafazi bakhe, neenkomo zakhe, neebhokhwe zakhe, neentyatyambo zakhe, netente yakhe, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, waya eNtaba ka-Akore.

Wathi ke uYoshuwa, Kutheni na ukuba ninikele thina le ntlungu? Namhlanje iNkosi uya kukunikela intlungu. Ke kaloku bonke amaSirayeli bamthabatha ngamatye; nabo abaseleyo bamthabatha ngamatye, babatshisa ngomlilo.
Bamisa phezu kwakhe umqolo omkhulu weetafile, ukhona namhla; wabuyela ke iNkosi ekubeni buhlungu inkanuko yakhe; ngenxa yoko kwabizwa igama lendawo leyo ngokuba yiNtaba ka-Akore, de kube namhlanje.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Musa ukuxoka, ungabi nethemba; thabathe namadoda onke nawe, uye eAyi; bona, ndimnikela kuwe ukumkani waseAyi, nabantu bakhe, nomzi wakhe, nelizwe lakhe.
Yenza ku-Ai nokumkani walo, njengokuba wenze kuYeremiya nokumkani walo; kuphela ukuba le xesha niyithathe iimpahla zayo, nezinto zayo eziphilayo, zibe zenu; nibeke abantu bokulinda ngasemva komzi.
Wathi ke uYoshuwa, naye wonke umkhosi wakhe, athabathe isikhephe, aye eAyi. UYoshuwa wakhetha amawaka amashumi mathathu, abemi abakhethiweyo, wabathumela kusasa.
Wathi kubo, Ncokolani; fikelelani ngasemva komzi, nilinde. Musani kuphuma kude kuye; nihlale nilungiselele bonke.
Ndiya kunyuka ndifike kumzi, mna nabantu bonke abahamba nam. Xa abantu baka-Ayi bephuma bezibulala nathi, njengokuba babesenza ngaphambili, siza kubaleka phambi kwabo.
Bathi baya kusilandela, de sibakhuphe emzini; kuba baya kuthetha ukuba, Bahamba phambi kwethu, njengokuba bahambe kuqala. Xa siza kubaleka,
uthabathe wena indawo yakho efihlakeleyo, udibanise lo mzi; iNkosi uThixo wakho uya kuwunikela esandla sakho.
Ke kaloku, xa uthabathe lo mzi, uyifake emnqamlezweni; wenze oko iNkosi wathiyo. Lo ngumthetho wam.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wabathutha basuka. Bahamba belinde phakathi kweBethel neAi, kumntla weAi. Ke ke uYosuwa wachitha loominiwomini kunye naba bantu abantu.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, evuka ekuseni, wathabatha inqanawa, waya eAyi, yena namadoda amakhulu kaSirayeli.
Bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli ababenokulwa naye, banyuka befike kumzi, bamisa itente emntla ka-Ayi; kwakukho umlambo phakathi kwabo nomzi.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathabatha amadoda angamakhulu amahlanu, wawabeka ezingxoweni phakathi kweBheteli neAi, ngasemzantsi komzi.
Ke kaloku amaYuda athatha indawo yawo, iqela eliphambili lisentshonalanga yedolophu, neqela elincamathelayo lisentshonalanga yayo. UYoshuwa wahla ngaloo busuku elwandle.

Ke kaloku ukumkani waseAyi, xa ebona loo nto, wakhawuleza waphuma emveni kwemini, yena namadoda akhe onke, ukuba ahlasele amaSirayeli, phambi kwesiqithi seYorodani; akawazi ke ukumkani waseAyi ukuba abantu befihlakele ngasemva komzi.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, naye onke amaSirayeli, wabonakala ngathi wahlaselwa; babaleka besuka esiya emhlabathini.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseAyi afunyanwa, ukuba alandele kubo; balandela uYoshuwa, bakhutshwe kumzi.
Akukho namnye umntu osele eHayi, naseBheteli, ongaphumanga emva kwaSirayeli; bashiya umzi uvulekile, belandela amaSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Nciphisa isithunywa esikwisandla sakho ukuya eAyi; ngokuba ndiya kukunika lo mzi. UYoshuwa ke wakhupha isithunywa sakhe kuye umzi.
Ke kaloku, ekwenzeni kwakhe oko, abo bafihlakeleyo bavuka ngokukhawuleza, baphuma befika emzini; bawuthatha umzi, bawucinezela ngamanzi.

Ke kaloku amadoda ase-Ayi ajonge ngasemva, wabona umphunga womzi unyuka phezulu ezulu; abazange babe nethuba lokuphuma naphi na; kuba amaSirayeli, aye emlilweni wendawo engqongileyo, wabuyela emva kubo.
Ke kaloku, uYoshuwa nabaSirayeli bonke bebona ukuba lo mzi uthathelwe yiyo iqela elixhobisayo, yaye umsi wakhe unyuka; ke ngoko babuyela, bahlasela amadoda aseAi.

Baphuma namadoda edolophini athabathela kubo; abamadoda aseAyi babekwa phantsi phakathi, nabaSirayeli ngapha nangapha; amaSirayeli ayewabulala, de kube akukho mntu ushiyekile, nokuba akukho mntu usele.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wase-Ayi bawuthatha ubomi, bamthabatha waya kuYoshuwa.

Ke kaloku, xa amaSirayeli egqibile ukubulala oonyana bonke baka-Ai, abase-Etiyopiya, nakwa-Efrayim, apho babehamba nabo, babuyela eAyi ngesandla seqhwa; ke ngoko, amaSirayeli onke abuye eAyi, wabulala abantu bayo.
Bafa ngaloo mini amadoda namabhinqa amawaka alishumi elinambini, bonke abantu baka-Ai.
UYoshuwa akazange akhuphe isandla sakhe, esiphakamisa isithunywa sakhe, de wabulala bonke abahlali baseAi.
AmaSirayeli ke athathe iinkomo, nempahla yomzi, yaba ngabo; njengoko iNkosi abewiselayo uYoshuwa.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa watshisa iAyi, wayilungisa ibe yindawo ethe tyaba ngonaphakade, ibe yinqaba kude kube ngaloo mini.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wase-Ayi wamtshisa emthini, waya emini. Xa ilanga lithe laphuma, uYoshuwa wabawisela umthetho, bawukhupha umphefumlo wakhe, bawuthutha ekungeneni kwesango ledolophu; bamisa phezu kwayo imfumba enkulu yezityalo, ezikhona namhla.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wayala isibingelelo kuYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, emnqamlezweni weEbhali.

njengoko uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabawisela umthetho oonyana bakaSirayeli, (njengoko kubhalwe kwincwadi yomthetho kaMoses), isibingelelo samatye a Óngaqengqelwanga, ezingenawo intsimbi; banikela phezu kwayo izipho eziqhuty resenzeni, nezipho zoxolo kuYehova.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wabhala khona phezu kwezityalo ikopi yomthetho kaMoses, awayewubhalela oonyana bakaSirayeli.

Bonke amaSirayeli, namadoda amakhulu abo, nabaphathi babo, nabagwebi babo, babehlala ngapha nangapha kwebhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, bejongene nababingeleli bakaLevi abayithabathayo; inxalenye yabo yabeka phambi komthi weGerizim, nengxenye yabo yabeka phambi komthi weEbhali; njengokuba uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabawisela umthetho ngaloo mini, xa kwaqala ukubhaptizwa abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wafunda ke uYoshuwa onke amagama omyalelo, iimbandezelo nobulali, ngokwezinto ezibhalwe kwincwadi yomyalelo.
Wafunda ke onke amagama aMoses awawiselayo; akawushiyanga mnye; wafunda kuwo wonke umkhosi wamaSirayeli, nabafazi, nabantwana, nabakhenkethi abahamba phakathi kwabo.

Ke kaloku, xa bonke ookumkani abasemazantsi eJordan beva ngale nto, ookumkani basezindulini, nakwiindawo eziphantsi komhlaba, nazo zonke iziqithi zelwandle olukhulu ukuya eLibanoni, ookumkani bamaHeti, namaAmore, namaKanana, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebhusi.
Bathe bahlangane, babe linye iqela, ukuba badibane noYoshuwa namaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abahlali baseGibheyon beva into awayeyenze uYoshuwa eYeremiya naseHayi,
Bathi ke, baphume neengcamango zobuxoki, bethi, Siza kuba ngabathunywa abavela kude; bathwala ezibhokhweni zabo iinkomo ezindala, neebhokhwe zewayini ezindala, eziphukileyo, ezilungisiweyo.
Bezigqoka izihlangu ezindala, ezitshatyalalisiweyo, neengubo ezindala; isonka sazo sonke saba sitshizi, sibe mnyama.
Bathi ke kuye uYoshuwa, emkhosini eGalgali, bathi kuye namadoda aseSirayeli, Siyavela kwilizwe elincinane; nceda, senze nathi umnqophiso woxolo.
Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli kubo abo baseHiveyi, Kungenxa yokuba nihlala ndawonye nathi; siza kwenza njani umyalelo nani?
Bathi ke kubo uYoshuwa, Siyakuba ngabakhonzi bakho. Wathi uYoshuwa kuye, Ubani na wena? Uvela phi?
Bathi kubo, Sivela ezweni elifutshane kakhulu thina abakhonzi bakho, ngenxa yegama likaYehova uThixo wakho; sazi zonke izinto zakhe, nazo zonke izinto azenzayo eYiputa,
nezinto azenzayo kumakumkani ababini baka-Amori, ngasentshonalanga yeJordan, uSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni, noOg ukumkani waseBhashani, abe eAshtarothi.
Bathi ke kuthi abathetheli bethu, nabantu bonke belizwe lethu, Nithatheni isonka sendlela yenu; nihambe nidibana nabo, nithi, Siyimikhonzi yenu thina; nceda nikwenze umyalelo nathi.
Lo mkhenkce, sawulungiselela endlwini yethu ngemini saphuma siza kuni, wawushushu; kodwa ngoku ubone ukuba uncinane kangakanani na, uye waphuka.
Lezi zibhotile zewayini zathi, xa siziphuculayo, zazitsha; ke bona, ziqhekekile kakhulu; iimpahla zethu nezihlangu zethu zigqityiwe ngenxa yokuhamba kwethu okude.
Badla oonyana bakaSirayeli ukutya kwabo; ke kaloku abawubuzanga iNkosi ukuba bayenze ntoni.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wakwenza nabo uxolo, wamenza umnqophiso wokubavumela ukuba baphile; abathetheli bakaSirayeli babhiyozela ukuba baya kwenza oko.
Ke kaloku, emva kokwenza umnqophiso ngemihla emithathu, bafumanisa ooSirayeli ukuba abo bantu babeziintlanga zabo, behlala eduze kwabo.
Basuka ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bafika ngemini yesithathu emizini yabo: eGibheyon, neKefira, neBherothi, neKiriyati-yearim.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli bangawahlaseli; ngokuba abathetheli babo babethe babhiyozela iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli; bonke abantu ke babhiyozela abathetheli.
Baphendula ke abathetheli, bathi, Sithe sabhiyozela iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli; ngoko ke ngoku asikwazi ukuwabetha.
Siza kwenza oku: siya kubavumela ukuba baphile, ukuze ingabikho intliziyo yobuxoki kaThixo phezu kwethu, ngenxa yokuba saphula umthetho wethu.
Bathi oonyana bakakumkani, Bahlale ubomi. Baye ke babe ngamagqabi namanzi kubo bonke abantu, njengokuba besithi oonyana bakumkani.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wababiza abaGibheyoniti, wathi kubo, Mhlawumbi nithutha nathi, nisithi, Sihlala kude nani, nakuba nihlala apha phakathi kwethu?
Ke ngoko, mna ke ndithi kuni, niyilelwe. Baninzi phakathi kwenu abaya kuba ngabakhonzi ngonaphakade, bathabathi-nxaxheba emakhayeni am aThixo wam;

Baphendula ke uYoshuwa, besithi, Kuba kwathiwa kuthi ngokucacileyo, ukuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, wamwisela umthetho uMoses, umkhonzi wakhe, ukuba aninike eli lizwe liphela, nakuba alishiye bonke abantu bayo abathe wafika kubo; saxolisa kakhulu ngenxa yenu ngobomi bethu, sakwenza oko.
Ke ngoko, thina ngoku sikwisandla sakho; wenze kuthi oko kubonakala kuwe kulungileyo nokulungileyo.
Wakwenza ke uYoshuwa njalo, wabakhusela ebantwini bakaSirayeli; bangawabulalanga.
Wathi uYoshuwa ngaloo mini abaGibheyoniti, ukuba babe ngamagqabi, nabenzi bamanzi kubo bonke abantu, nesonka esingcwele sikaYehova, kwindawo ebeya kuyikhethela iNkosi; besenza njalo mihla le.

Ke kaloku, xa uAdoni-zedeki ukumkani waseYerusalem efundile ukuba uYoshuwa wathabatha iAi, wayibulala ngomlilo; ngokuba wenza iAi nokumkani wayo njengokuba wayeyenze iYeremiya nokumkani wayo; ke kaloku wafunda ukuba abantu baseGibheyon bamisa nabaSirayeli, baba phakathi kwabo.
Waxoka kakhulu, yena nabantu bakhe; ngokuba iGibheyon ibiyidolophu enkulu, njengenye yezixeko zokumkani; ibe yaba mkhulu kunaye uAi; bonke amadoda ayo aye ngamadoda amakhulu.

Wathumela ke uAdoni-zedeki ukumkani waseYerusalem, kuHoham ukumkani waseHebron, noPiram ukumkani waseYarmuthi, noYafiya ukumkani waseLakishi, noDebiri ukumkani waseEgloni.yehoshele amaYuda eJerusalem.
Wathi, Yiya nindincede ndihlasele iGibheyon; ngokuba yenze uxolo noYoshuwa nabantwana bakaSirayeli.

Ke kaloku abakumkani ababini baka-Amori, abakumkani baseYerusalem, naseHebhoni, naseYarmuthi, naseLakishi, naseEgloni, bahlanganisana ndawonye; baphuma nabo bonke amajoni abo, bamisa iintaba eGibheyon, bayihlasela.

Amadoda aseGibheyon athumela kuYoshuwa, emkhosini eGalgali, athi, Musa ukushiya abakhonzi bakho; ndiza ngokukhawuleza, usisindise, usixelele; ngokuba bonke ookumkani baka-Amori abasemazantsi entaba bahlangana nathi.
Waphuma ke uYoshuwa eGiliyadi, yena neqela lakhe lonke, namadoda akhe onke akhethiweyo.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Musa ukuxoka kubo; kuba ndibamise esandla sakho; akukho namnye wabo oza kuhlala phambi kwakho.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wahamba yonke imini, esuka eGilgal, wafika kubo ngokungxama.
UYehova wabaphazamisa phambi kwaSirayeli; abaSirayeli bababulala ngokubulala okukhulu eGibheyon, bathabathela emva kwabo kwindlela yokuya eBhete-horoni, bababetha kude kube seAzeka neMakeda.

Ke kaloku, xa bebaleka phambi kwamadoda aseSirayeli, phantsi kwendlela esuka eBhete-horon, iNkosi wabathutha phezu kwabo iintaba-mlilo ezinkulu eziphuma emlilweni, zifike zifike eAzeka; bafa; babeninzi abafileyo ngenxa yeentlambo-mlilo, kunabo abafileyo ngesikrele samaSirayeli.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathi kuYehova, ngaloo mini iNkosi awiselayo amaAmori kumaSirayeli, phambi kwamadoda onke aseSirayeli, esithi, Ilanga, phumla phezu kweGibheyon; inyanga, phumla phezu kweNtaba ka-Ajaloni.
Ke kaloku ilanga lamisa, nenyanga yamisa, de le lizwe libhiyozele abachasi bayo; njengoko kubhalwe kwincwadi kaYashar. Ilanga lamisa phakathi kwezulu, lilinde malunga nemini epheleleyo, lize liphume.
Akuzange kubekho imini efana nale, phambi kwayo, nokuba emva kwayo, ukuba iNkosi aphulaphule umsindo womntu njengowo; kuba iNkosi wayebhiyozela ngenxa yamaSirayeli.
Wabuya ke uYoshuwa, naye wonke uSirayeli, waya esixekweni eGilgal.
Ke kaloku abo bakumkani abahlanu babaleka, bafihlakela ekufumaneni, eMakedoni.
Ke kaloku kwaziswa uYoshuwa, kusithiwa, Abakumkani abahlanu bafunyanwe befihlakele emngxunyeni eMakedaya.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathi, Nqumle iintyatyambo ezinkulu emlonyeni wentaba, nibeke khona abantu ukuba bayigcine.
Ke kaloku, musa ukuma; landelani oothunywa benu, nibahlasele ngasemva kwabo; ningaze bafike emizini yabo; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wenu portela esandla sam.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa namadoda amaSirayeli bahlasela kakhulu, de bagqibe ukuwabulala bonke; abo bambalwa abafikeleleyo baphuma befika emizini yabo enezitena.
Ke kaloku bonke abakhonzi babuyela kuYoshuwa, bekhuselekile, emkhosini eMakedhe. Akukho mntu wathetha lutho ngamadoda aseSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathi, Vula umngxunya wesango, nizikhuphe kum ezikumkani zihlanu.
Bathabathela ke abakumkani abahlanu, baphuma emngxunyeni, abakumkani baseYerusalem, naseHebhoni, naseYarmuthi, naseLakishi, naseEgloni.

Ke kaloku Komkani uYoshuwa, xa bebathumelela abakumkani kuye, wabiza amadoda onke aseSirayeli; wathi kumadoda amakhulu omkhosi ahamba naye, N Óza, nibeke izandla zenu ezinyaweni zababukumkani bano. Bafika ke, resenze izandla zabo ezinyaweni zawo.
Umgcini-mnqamlezo uya kunika lo mnqamlezo umyalezo othi, "Into nganye le misonto imele intyatyambo encinci. Lo mnqamlezo umele ube yinxalenye yeqela elipheleleyo lamagqwetha.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wabetha ookumkani abo, wababulala, wawatshisa kumatye amahlanu; babashiywa apho de kube semini.
Ke kaloku, xa ilanga lihla, uYoshuwa wathi, Babakhuphe kumatye, babeka emngxunyeni womgca apho babefihle khona; babeka izityalo ezinkulu emngxunyeni womngxunya, zikhona namhla.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathabatha iMakeda ngaloo mini, wambulala ukumkani wayo ngeqhwa, naye wonke umntu okwidolophu leyo; wayiphelisa yonke into ekhoyo kulo mzi, akazange ashiye nanye. Wakwenza kukumkani weMakeda njengokuba wayewenza kukumkani waseYeriko.
Wahamba ke uYoshuwa, naye onke amaSirayeli, esuka eMakeda waya eLibna, wahlasela.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wayinika iLibna nokumkani wayo esandla samaSirayeli. UYoshuwa wababulala bonke abakwidolophu ngeqhwa, akashiyenga mntu ophelelayo; wamenza ukumkani walo njengokuba wayemsenza ukumkani waseYeriko.
Wahamba ke uYoshuwa, naye onke amaSirayeli, esuka eLibna waya eLakishi; bamisa izikhephe phezu kwayo, bahlasela.
Wayisa iNkosi iLakishi esandla samaSirayeli; uYoshuwa wayithabatha ngemini yesibini, wabulala bonke abakhoyo kuyo ngeqhwa, njengokuba wayeyenze kwiLibna.
Ke kaloku waya uHoram ukumkani waseGezere, ukukunceda iLakishi; uYoshuwa wambetha yena neqela lakhe, angashiyanga mnye.
Wahamba ke uYoshuwa, naye onke amaSirayeli, ukusuka eLakishi waya eEgloni; bamisa izikhephe phezu kwayo, bahlasela.
Bayithatha ngaloo mini, babulala bonke abakhoyo kuyo ngeqhwa; uYoshuwa wayala yonke into ekhoyo kuyo, njengokuba wayeyenze iLakishi.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, naye onke amaSirayeli, waya phezulu eEgloni waya eHebron, wahlasela.

Bayithatha, babulala ukumkani wayo, nabo bonke abakhoyo kuyo, nabahlali beedolophu zayo, ngeqhwa; akazange ashiye nabani na ophelelayo; njengoko bekwenzele eEgloni, bayihlambululela yonke, nayo yonke into ekhoyo kuyo.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, nabo bonke amaSirayeli, babuyela behlasela iDebiri.
a jezdcům, kteří se nacházejí na pohoří, které se nachází nad námi, vkdávat se na nás, vkdávat se na nás, vkdávat se na nás.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wahlasela loo mhlaba wonke, ilizwe eliphakamileyo, nelizwe laseNtshona, nelizwe elincinane, neendawo eziphakamileyo, nabakumkani babo bonke; akazange ashiye nabani na ophilayo, wabulala zonke izinto eziphefumlayo, njengoko iNkosi uThixo kaSirayeli abewisela umthetho.
Wawahlasela uYoshuwa, esuka eKadeshe-barnea waya eGaza, nalo lonke ilizwe laseGoshen, waya eGibeyon.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wahlasela ookumkani abo bonke nelizwe labo ngaxeshanye; ngokuba iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, wayebhiyozela ngenxa yabaseSirayeli.
Wabuya ke uYoshuwa, naye wonke uSirayeli, waya esixekweni eGilgal.
Ke kaloku, xa uYabini ukumkani waseHazori efundile loo nto, wathumela kuYowabhi ukumkani waseMadoni, nakukumkani baseShimron naseAkshafini, esithi,
namakumkani asezindulini zasempuma, elwandle lwaseGalili, elunxwemeni lweJordan kwelasempuma, kumazantsi asentshonalanga, nasezinduli portela, nasemaphandleni eDori ngasempuma.
Wathumela ke kumaKanana emazantsi, namantshona, nakumaAmori, namaHethi, namaPerizi, namaYebhusi ezweni eliphakamileyo, namaHivi phantsi komnqamlezo weHermon, elunxwemeni lwaseMizpa.
Baphuma nabo onke amaqela abo, inqwaba enkulu yamajoni, efana neengqekembe zesihlabathi eziselwandle ngobukhulu, namakhwenkwe neemoto zokulwa zininzi kakhulu.
La makumkani onke ahlanganisene, bamisa iintaba ngamanzi eMerom, ukuba badlale naSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi kuYoshuwa, Musa ukuxoka kubo; kuba ngomhla wesibini ngaloo xesha ndiya kubanika bonke abafileyo phambi kwamadoda aseSirayeli; iinkunzi zazo uya kuzitshisa, nezithuthi zazo uya kuzicima.
Wafika ke uYoshuwa, naye wonke umkhosi wakhe, wabahlasela ngaphaya kwamanzi eMerom, wabetha.

Wabanikela iNkosi phantsi kwesandla samaSirayeli; amaSirayeli ayewabulala, wawalandelakela yonke indlela eya eSidon enkulu, waya eMisrephothi-mayim, waya emzantsi-mpuma kumhlaba waseMizpa. Bawabetha, abashiyenga nabani na ophilayo.
Wazenza ke uYoshuwa njengokuba wathi iNkosi kuye; waluka iinqanawa zazo, waza watshisa izithuthi zabo.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wabuyela, wathabatha iHazori, wambulala ukumkani wayo ngeqhwa; iHazori yayiye intloko yale mimandla yonke.
Bababulala bonke abakhoyo kuyo ngeqhwa, babenqula ngokugqithiseleyo; akukho nto iphilayo yashiyayo; uYoshuwa wacima uHazori.
Wazithatha ke uYoshuwa onke la madolophu ekumkani, nabakumkani babo, wababulala ngeqhwa, wabala ngokugqithiseleyo, njengoko uMoses umkhonzi kaYehova abewisela umthetho.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli akayitshisa nanye idolophu yazo, eyakhiwa phezu kweentaba zawo, ngaphandle kweHazori; uYoshuwa wayitshisa.
Zonke iimpahla zalawo madolophu, nazo zonke iintlanzi zawo, amaSirayeli azenza zibe yimpahla yabo; kodwa bonke abantu babulala ngeqhwa, de bagqibe ukufa kwabo; abashiyenga mntu ophilayo.
UYehova wamwisela umthetho uMoses, umkhonzi wakhe; wazisa uMoses kuYoshuwa; uYoshuwa wabaphulaphula. Akubikho nanye into eyayingasebenziyo kubo bonke abo iNkosi awawisela umthetho ngayo uMoses.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathabatha elo lizwe lonke, ilizwe eliphakamileyo, nelizwe liphela laseNtshona, nelizwe liphela laseGoshen, nelizwe elincinane elingentla, noMlambo iJordan, nelizwe eliphakamileyo likaSirayeli, nelizwe elincinane elingentla,
ukususela emnqamlezweni weHalakhi, onyuka eSeiri, waya eBhaali-Gadi, elunxwemeni lweLibanoni phantsi komnqamlezo weHermon; wathabatha ookumkani babo bonke, wawabulala.
UYoshuwa wahlasela ookumkani abo bonke, ixesha elide.
Akukho dolophu enye eyenza uxolo nabaSirayeli, ngaphandle kwabaHivi abahlala eGibheyon; bonke abaSirayeli bathabathela ngazo ngokulwa.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wazenza intliziyo zabo zibe zinzima, ukuba bahlasele amaSirayeli, ukuze baqhutywe ngokugqithiseleyo, bangabi nesonka, njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.

Waye ke uYoshuwa ngaloo xesha, wabulala ooAnaki ezweni eliphakamileyo, eHebroni, naseDebiri, naseAnabhi, nakwilizwe liphela eliphakamileyo likaYuda, nakwaSirayeli; uYoshuwa wabaphazamisa ngazo zonke izixeko zabo.
Akukho nanye yabantwana bakaAnaki eshiyeke ezweni lakwaSirayeli; kuGaza kuphela, naseGati, naseAshdodi, kwahlala abanye.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wathabatha ilizwe lonke, njengokuba wathi iNkosi kuMoses; uYoshuwa wamnika amaSirayeli eli lizwe njengelifa labo, ngokwezizwe zazo. Yaphumla ke ilizwe emfazweni.

Ke kaloku, aba bantu banjengokumkani baloo lizwe, abawahlasela oonyana bakaSirayeli ngaphaya kweYorodani, ecaleni lolwandle olusentshonalanga, bathabathela ilizwe labo, ukusuka emlanjeni weArnoni waya emantla eHermon, nelizwe lonke elunxwemeni lweYorodani ecaleni lolwandle olusentshonalanga:

uSihon ukumkani wama-Amori, wayehlala eHeshbon; waba ngukumkani ukusuka eAroeri, entliziyweni yentaba kaArnon, phakathi kwentaba, naphesheya kweGiliyadi, waya emlanjeni weYabhoki, umda weenyana baka-Amon.
Walawula nakwindawo esemaphandleni yeJordan, ukusuka elwandle lwaseGalili kuya elwandle olufayo, ukuya eBhete-yeshimote, nasempumalanga phantsi kweentaba zePisga.
Bathabathe ilizwe likaOgi ukumkani waseBhashani, owamkelwa ngabaseRefayi, owahlala eAshtaroti naseEdrei.
Wayilawula intaba kaHermon, neSaleka, nayo yonke iBhashani, ukuya kumda wamaGeshuri namaMahaka, nengxenye yeGiliyadi, ukuya kumda kaSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni.

UMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, nabazalwana bakaSirayeli babetha oonyana bakaSirayeli; uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabanika ilizwe labo njengentsapho yakwaRubhen, neentsapho zakwaGadi, neentsapho zakwaManase.

Ke kaloku abo abakumkani, abawabethayo uYoshuwa nabantwana bakaSirayeli ngasentshonalanga yeJordan, ukususela eBhaali-Gadi, elunxwe ÓliLibanoni, waya emnqamlezeni weHalaka, onyuka eSeyirimogi; uYoshuwa wabanika ilizwe labo izizwe zakwaSirayeli, ibe yindawo yabo, yabahlula phakathi kwabo.

Iindawo eziphakamileyo, neziqithi eziphantsi kolwandle, noMlambo iYorodani, neziqithi eziphakamileyo, nemihlaba, neNtshona, ilizwe labaHeti, nabaAmori, nabaKananhi, nabaPerizi, nabaHivi, nabaYebhusi. Loo makumkani:
ukumkani waseYeremiya, omnye; ukumkani waseAyi, ecaleni kweBheteli, omnye;
ukumkani waseYerusalem, omnye; ukumkani waseHebron, omnye;
ukumkani waseYarmuthi, omnye; ukumkani waseLakishi, omnye;
ukumkani waseEgloni, omnye; ukumkani waseGezere, omnye;
ukumkani waseDebiri, omnye; ukumkani waseGedere, omnye;
ukumkani waseHorma, omnye; ukumkani waseAradi, omnye;
ukumkani waseLibna, omnye; ukumkani waseAdulam, omnye;
ukumkani waseMakedha, omnye; ukumkani waseBheteli, omnye;
ukumkani waseTaphuya, omnye; ukumkani waseHefere, omnye;
ukumkani waseAfek, omnye; ukumkani waseLasaroni, omnye;
ukumkani waseMadoni, omnye; ukumkani waseHazori, omnye;
uKumkani waseShimron, uMeron, omnye; uKumkani waseAkshafe, omnye;
ukumkani waseThanakhi, omnye; ukumkani waseMegido, omnye;
ukumkani waseKedeshi, omnye; ukumkani waseYokneyam eKarmele, omnye;
ukumkani waseDori, osemazantsi eDori, omnye; ukumkani wamaGoyim, eGalgali, omnye;
ukumkani waseThirsa, omnye; bonke abakumkani babe ngamathathu ananye.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa waba mkhulu, waphila iminyaka emininzi. Wathi iNkosi kuye, Ukhulule kakhulu ke ngoku; lisele ilizwe elikhulu elinokuqhutywa;
Eli lilizwe eliseleyo: onke amaphondo eeFilisti, neGeshuri,

ukusuka kumlambo uShihore, umda waseYiputa ngasentshonalanga, waya kumda weEkroni, ethe yaba yilizwe lakwaKanan; ilizwe labaphathi Óbahlanu bakaSirayeli baseGaza, neAshdod, neAshkelon, neGmogi, neEkroni, kunye nelizwe lamaAvithi.
ilizwe lonke lakwaKanana, ukusuka eAraha, eya kuSidoni, ukuya eAfeki, umda wamaAmori;
ilizwe labahlali baseGibaleni, neLibanoni yonke esempumalanga, ukususela eBhali-Gadi phantsi komnqamlezo weHermon, ukuya ekudeni kweHamati.

Ke kaloku bonke abahlali bezinto eziphakamileyo, ukusuka eLibanoni ukuya eMisrephothi-mayim, onke amaSidoni, ndiya kuwakhupha phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; uqiniseke ukuba ndiya kubanika ooSirayeli eli lizwe libe yipropathi yabo, njengokuba ndathi kuwe.
Ke ngoko ngoku, yahlula eli lizwe phakathi kwezizwe ezithoba, nengxenye yesizukulwana sikaManase, ibe yindawo yabo.
Ke kaloku isiqingatha sakwaManase, nesizwe sakwaRubhen nesizwe sakwaGadi, bathathe ilizwe, uMoses awabanikela ngalo ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani; uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabanika lona.
Wasuka eAroere, esembindini weNtaba kaArnoni, waya kumzi ophakathi kweNtaba; wahlanganisa zonke iziqithi zeMedebha, waya tegene ukuya eDiboni;
nazo zonke izixeko zikaSihon ukumkani wamaAmori, owayekumkani eHeshbon, ukuya kumda weenyana baka-Amon.
IGiliyadi, nelizwe labaGeshuri, nabaMahaka, yonke intaba kaHermon, nayo yonke iBhashani, ukuya eSaleka;
lonke ubukumkani bukaOgi, eBhashani, owayelawula eAshtarathi naseEdreyi; wayeye waba nguwo wakutshabalalisa ooRefayi; uMoses wababulala, wawakhupha.
Ke kaloku abaSirayeli bangawakhuphi amaGeshuri namaMahaka; bahlala phakathi kwabaSirayeli kude kube ngaloo mini.
Ke isizukulwana samaLevi, uMoses akayinika ilizwe; izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamandla zikaYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, yinxalenye yabo, njengoko wathi kubo.
Le nto uMoses wayinika isizukulwana samaRubeni, ngokwezindlu zazo:
Umda wabo wawusuka eAroyeri, esembindini weNtaba kaArnoni, nomzi ophakathi kweNtaba, nayo yonke ilizwe eliphakamileyo lidlula eMedebha;
iHeshboni, nezixeko zayo zonke ezikwindawo ethe tyaba, neDiboni, neBamoth-bhaali, neBhathi-bhaali-meoni;
neYahazi, neKedemothi, neMefaathi,
neKiriyatiyim, neSibhama, neZerethi-shahari, entliziyweni yentaba, elunxwemeni;
iBhethe-pheore, neendawo eziphakamileyo zePisga, neBhethe-yeshimote.

Zonke iidolophu zendawo ethe tyaba, nelizwe lonke likaSihon ukumkani wama-Amori, owalawula eHeshbon; uMoses wambetha yena, nabathetheli bakaMidiyani: uEvhi, noRekem, noTsuri, noHuri, noRebha, abathetheli ababehlala kuloo lizwe, abakhonzayo uSihon.
AbaSirayeli babulala noBhalamu, unyana kaBheore, umprofeti, ngekhefu, phakathi kwabo abafayo.
Umda wakwaRubhen ngasemzantsi, nguMlambo iYorodani. La madolophu namachibi awo laziwa ngokuba yimimandla yesizwe sakwaRubhen ngokweefama zazo.
Le nto uMoses wayinika isizukulwana sikaGadi, ngokwezindlu zazo.
Umhlaba wabo wawunguYasere, nazo zonke izixeko zaseGiliyadi, nengxenye yelizwe lakwaAmmon, ukuya eAroyeri, entliziyweni yeRabha.
Ukusuka eHeshboni waya eRamathi-Mizpa, neBetonim; ukusuka eMahanayim waya kumda weDebiri.

Kwilali, iBhete-haram, neBhete-nimra, neSukoto, neZafon, eminye imimandla yokumkani kaSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni; umda wayo wasemantla wawunguYorodani, waya esiphelweni selwandle lweGalili, ngasentshonalanga yeJordan.
La madolophu, nezixeko zazo, ngumhlaba onikezelwe kwisizukulwana samaGadi ngokweefama zabo.
Le nto uMoses wayinika isiqingatha sesizukulwana sikaManase, ngokwesizwe saso;
Umhlaba wabo wawusuka eMahanayim, waya kuyo yonke iBhashani, lonke ubukumkani bukaOgi ukumkani waseBhashani, nazo zonke izixeko zikaYaire eziseBhashani, ziidolophu ezimashumi mane.
Ingxenye yeGiliyadi, neAshtarothi neEdreyi, imizi yokumkani kaOg eBhashani, yanikezelwa oonyana bakaMakiri unyana kaManase, ibe yinxalenye yosapho lwabantwana bakaMakiri ngokweefama zabo.
Yaye ke loo nto ilizwe uMoses aliyihlukanisile, ezindaweni eziphakamileyo zaseMowabhi, ngaphesheya komlambo iYorodani, eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku isizukulwana samaLevi, uMoses akayinika ilizwe; iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, ungumthwalo wabo, njengoko wathi kubo.
Ke kaloku ilizwe likaKanan lahlukaniswa phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; uEleyazare, umbingeleli, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, namadoda amakhulu eentsapho zakwaSirayeli ahlula phakathi kwabo.
Ilizwe lanikezelwa ngezizwe ezithoba nesiqingatha, ngokuqhutywa kwesiqhamo, njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngalo ngoMoses.
Ke kaloku uMoses wabanika izizwe ezibini namashumi amabini anesibini ilifa labo, ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani; ke kumaLevi akazange wabanike ilifa phakathi kwabo.

Ke kaloku oonyana bakaYosefu babe ziintsapho ezimbini, uManase noEfrayim; abaLevi ke abaye bafumana inxalenye kuloo mhlaba, ngaphandle kwemizi yokuhlala kuyo, nezityalo zazo ezingqongileyo, izithixo zabo nezinto zabo.
Bahlula ke oonyana bakaSirayeli ilizwe, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Bafika ke oonyana bakaYuda kuYoshuwa eGalgali. Wathi kuye uKalebe, unyana kaYefune, umKenizi: Uyazi loo nto iNkosi wathi ngayo kuMoses, indoda kaThixo, malunga nawe nam, eKadesi-barnea.
Ndiyiminyaka imashumi mane ndineminyaka, xa uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wandithumela eKadeshe-barnea ukuba ndwendwele eli lizwe; ndabuya ndenza ingxelo enyanzelekileyo, njengokuba kwathiwa kum.
Ke kaloku abo baphumayo nam, bamisa intliziyo yabantu; ke mna ndalandela iNkosi uThixo wam ngentliziyo yam yonke.
Wathi ke kum uMoses ngaloo mini, Ilizwe olihamba phezu kwalo liya kuba liwe kuwe nabantwana bakho ngonaphakade; ngokuba walandela iNkosi uThixo wam intliziyo yakho yonke.

Ke kaloku, bona, iNkosi wandigcina ndiphila iminyaka emashumi mane anesihlanu, njengoko wathiyo, ukususela ekubeni wathetha ngaloo nto kuMoses, xa amaSirayeli ehamba emlilweni; mna namhlanje ndineminyaka engamashumi asibhozo anesihlanu.
Ndiyaqhubeka ndinamandla namhlanje, njengokuba ndandinamandla ngaloo mini uMoses wandithumelayo; ngoku ndikwazi ukuphuma empilweni, njengokuba ndandikwazi oko.

Ke ngoko, ndininike le ndawo iphakamileyo iNkosi wamxelela ngayo ngaloo mini; niva ke ngelo xesha ukuba kukho amaAnaki apho, nemizi emikhulu enezikhephe; kodwa ndiya kuwakhupha ngesandla soYehova, njengoko wathi.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wabambisa uKalebe, unyana kaYefune, wamnika iHebron ibe yilizwe lakhe.
Ke kaloku iHebron yaba nguKalebhe, unyana kaYefune, umKeneziti, ukusukela ngaloo mini; ngokuba walandela iNkosi uThixo kaSirayeli intliziyo yakhe yonke.
Ke kaloku igama likaHebron lalinguKiriyati-Arba, ngegama likaArba, umntu omkhulu kubo bonke ooAnaki. Ilizwe laphumla emfazweni.
Ke kaloku ilizwe elinikezelwe isizukulwana sikaYuda, ngokwezihlanga zazo, lifike kumda waseEdom eMzantsi-mpuma, kulwandle lwaseZin, ngasempuma.
Umda wabo wasempuma waqala kwisiphelo sasentshonalanga selwandle olufayo, kwibhayi ejonge emntla.
waya kwelasempumalanga kwendlela yeSkorpion, waya eZin, wanyuka waya kwelasempumalanga yeKadeshe-barnea; waya eHeshroni, waya eAdari, wajika waya eKarka.
waya e-Asmoni, wadlula emlanjeni waseYiputa, waza waphuma elwandle. Lo ngumhlathi wabo wasempuma.
Umda wasempumalanga wawungulwandle olufayo, wafika ekungeneni kweYordani; umda wasentshona wawuqala emlanjeni wolwandle, apho uYordani uphuma khona.
wanyuka waya eBhathi-hogla, wadlula eBhathi-arabha ngasentshonalanga, waya esityeni sikaBohani unyana kaRubhen.

wanyuka waya eDebiri, esuka emlanjeni ka-Akhore; wajika waya ngasentshonalanga, waya eGalgali, elijongene nomngxunya we-Adummim, elunxwemeni olusempumalanga; wadlula emanzini ase-En-shemeshi, waphela e-En-rogeli.

Wanyuka ke umda waya emlanjeni kaBhen-hinnom, ecaleni lomnqamlezo wasempumalanga wedolophu yamaYebhusithi, leyo yiYerusalem; wa Óya phezulu kwindawo ephezulu yenduli esemzantsi-mpuma yomlanjeni kaHinnom,mogini osentshonalanga womlanjeni wamaRefayim.
Ukusuka phezulu komnqamlezo, umda wahamba waya emlanjeni wamanzi kaNeftoha, waya ezidolophini zentaba kaEfron, wahla waya eBhala (leyo yiKiriyati-yearim).
Usuka eBhala, wajika waya ngasentshonalanga, waya emnxwemeni waseSeiri; wahamba ngecala lasempumalanga lomnqamlezo wenduli kaYesimeleni, leyo yiKeshaloni; wahla waya eBhete-shemesi, wadlula eTimna.
waya kwelaseEkroni ngasentshonalanga, wajika waya eShikereoni, waya kwintaba kaBhala, wafika eYabneel, waphela elwandle.
Umda wasempuma wawungulwandle olukhulu. Lo mda ujikeleze ilizwe labantwana bakaYuda, ngokwezihlanga zabo, ngazo zonke izizwe.
UYehova wamnika uKalebe, unyana kaYefune, intsapho phakathi kwabantwana bakaYuda; iKiriyati-arba, leyo yiHebron. IArba nguyise kaAnake, njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho uYoshuwa.
Ke kaloku uKalebe wakhupha abaAnaki abathathu eHebron, nguSheshai noAhimani noTalmai, oonyana bakaAnaki.
Waphuma khona waya kubomi baseDebiri; (igama layo ngaphambili belinguKiriyati-seferi).
Wathi ke uKalebe, Umntu onqumlayo iKiriyati-seferi, aze ayithathe, ndiya kumnika intombi yam uAksha ukuba abe ngumfazi.
Wayihlasela uOthniyeli, unyana kaKenazi, umzalwana kaKalebi; ke kaloku uKalebi wamnika uAksha intombi yakhe ukuba abe ngumfazi wakhe.
Wafika ke kuOthniyeli, wamnyamekela ukuba ambuze utata wakhe indawo yomhlaba; waphuma ke phezu kweeseyile zakhe, wathi kuye uKalebe, Yintoni oyifunayo?
Wathi kuye, Nceda ndizalise; ngokuba usinike ilizwe elincinane eNtshona, ndininike namanzi acocekileyo. UKalebe wamnika amanzi acocekileyo aphezulu namanzi acocekileyo aphantsi.
Eli lilizwe elinikezelwe isizukulwana sikaYuda, ngokweefama zabo.
Iidolophu zabo, ecaleni lomnxweme wasempumalanga, elunxwemeni lwaseEdom: iKabseyeli, neEdere, neYaguri,
neKina, neDimona, neAdada,
neKedesh, neHasoro, neItnani,
uZife, noTelemem, noBealothi,
iHatsore-hadatha, neKeriyothi-hezroni, leyo yiHatsore;
uHaman, noShema, noMolada,
neHazari-Gadda, neHeshmoni, neBhat-peleti,
uHazari-shuhali, noBheershebha, noBiziyotiya,
uBhala, noIim, noEzem,
iEltoladi, neKeshili, neHorma,
neSikelegi, neMadmana, neShansana,
neLebhaothi, neShilihim, neAyin, neRimon; zonke ezi zixeko zazimashumi amabini ananye nezidolophu zazo.
Ngasempumalanga: iEshtaoli, neTsora, neAshna,
neZanoa, neEn-ganimi, neTaphuya, neEnam,
uYarmuthi, noAdulami, noSokho, noAzeka,
neShaharayim, neAdithaim, neGedera, eyaziwa ngokuba yiGederothaim: imizi elishumi elinanye neentaba zayo.
noZenan, noHadasha, noMigdal-Gadi,
noDiliyani, neMizpa, noYokteyeli,
neLakishi, neBozkati, neEgloni,
noKaboni, noLamashe, noKitlisi,
neGederoti, neBhete-dagoni, neNaama, neMakedaya: imizi elishumi elinamithandathu neentaba zazo.
Ke kaloku iLibna, neEtere, neAshan,
uYifta, noAshna, noNezib,
iKeyila, neAkzib, neMaresha: amadolophu asithoba neentaba zawo.
neEkron, nezixeko zayo, neelali zayo;
nazo zonke izixeko ezisemantla eEkroni, ezikufutshane neAshdod, nezixeko zazo.
neAshdodi, nezixeko zayo neelali zayo; neGaza, nezixeko zayo neelali zayo, kuze kufike emlanjeni waseYiputa, elwandle olukhulu.
Kwilizwe eliphakamileyo: uShamire, noYatiri, noSokho,
neDana, neKiriyati-shana (leyo yiDebiri),
uAnabhi, noEshtemo, noAnim,
iGoshen, neHolon, neGilo: izixeko ezilishumi elinanye nezixeko zazo.
noArabha, noDuma, noEshan,
neJanim, neBhete-taphuwa, neAfeka,
neHumtha, neKiriyati-arba (leyo yiHebron), neTsiyon: amadolophu asithoba neelali zawo.
neMaoni, neKarmele, neZipho, neYuta,
neYizreyeli, neYokdeyam, neZanoha,
iKayin, neGibeha, neTimna: imizi elishumi neentaba zazo.
neHahuli, neBhathi-suru, neGedori,
iMaharathi, neBhethe-anothi, neEltekoni: amadolophu asithandathu neelali zawo.
neKiriyati-bhaali (leyo yiKiriyati-yearimi), neRabha: amadolophu amabini, neelali zawo.
Embindini wesango kwakukho iBhethe-arabha, neMidin, neSekaka,
neNibshani, nedolophu yewayini, neEngedi: ziidolophu ezintandathu neelali zazo.
Ke kaloku abazalwana bakaYuda abazange bakhuphe abo baseYebhusini, ababehlala eYerusalem; behlala ke amaJebhusini phakathi kwabantwana bakaYuda eYerusalem kude kube namhlanje.
Ilizwe laba oonyana bakaYosefu laqala eYordan, ngaseJerihoni, elunxwemeni olusentshonalanga yeJerihoni; lanyuka lisuka eJerihoni libe yimpucuko, ibe yindawo enqamlezeneyo iBheteli.
Usuka eBheteli, eli liLuzi, waya kwilizwe lamaArki, ukuya eAtarothi.
waya ezantsi ezweni lakwaYaflethi elunxwemeni, waya eBhete-horoni esezantsi, waya eGezere, wafika emazantsi elwandle.
Ke kaloku uManase noEfrayim, oonyana bakaYosefu, bafumana ilizwe labo.
Eli lilizwe likaEfrayim, ngokweedolophu zabo; umda wabo wasempumalanga wawusuka eAtarathi-addari waya eBhete-horoni esezantsi;
waya elwandle. Esuka eMikmetathi emntla, wajika umzantsi-mpuma waya eTaanathi-shilo, wadlula kuyo waya eYanoa emzantsi-mpuma.
Wawela eYanoa waya eAtaroti, noNahara; wadlula eYeremiya, waphuma eJordani.
Ukusuka eTaphuya, umda wahamba waya kutshona kwelanga, ufike emlanjeni weKana, waza waphuma elwandle. Lowo ngumhlaba wesizwe samaEfrayim ngokweefama zawo.
Ziquka nazo zonke izixeko, nezidolophu, zakwaEfrayim ezibekwe phantsi kwelizwe likaManase.
Abakanani abahlala eGezere ababangabakhuphi; bahlala amaKanana phakathi kwabantwana bakaEfrayim, de kube ngaloo mini; babeyimisebenzi yomsebenzi.

Lo mmandla wanikezelwa ngesixhenxe kwisizukulwana sikaManase, unyana omdala kaYosefu. UMakiri, unyana omdala kaManase, waba nguyise kaGiliyadi; kuba ifama kaMakiri yaba ngamadoda anamandla okulwa, bafumana uGiliyadi noBhashan.

Eli lizwe ke lafika kwabanye oonyana bakaManase, ngokweefama zabo: iifama zikaAbiezer, neefhamu kaHeleki, neefhamu kaAsriyeli, neefhamu kaShekem, neefhamu kaHefer, neefhamu kaShemida. Ezi ziifama zonyana bakaManase unyana kaYosefu, ngokweefama zabo.
Ke kaloku uZelofehadi, unyana kaHeferi, unyana kaGiliyadi, unyana kaMakiri, unyana kaManase, akazange abe nabantwana portela; lamagama abo nguMahla, noNowa, noHogla, noMileka, noTirsa.

Bafika kuElezare umbingeleli, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, namadoda amakhulu, bathi, UYehova wathi kuMoses ukuba aninike ilizwe phakathi kwabazalwana bethu. Wabanika ke uYoshuwa ilizwe phakathi kwabazalwana bakayise wabo, njengokuba iNkosi abewisela umthetho.
Wafumana ke uManase iziqithi ezilishumi, ngaphandle kweGiliyadi noBhashani, ngasentshonalanga yeJordan.
Kuba oonyana bakaManase, oonyana bakaSirayeli, bafumana ilizwe kunye nabantwana babo. Ilizwe laseGiliyadi laliyilifa lezinye izizukulwana zikaManase.
Umda kaManase wawusuka eAshere waya eMikmetathi, ngasentshonalanga yeShekem; wadlula emazantsi, waya kubomi baseEn-taphuya.
Ilizwe elijikeleze iTaphuya laliyiManase; kodwa lo mzi weTaphuya, umda kaManase, waba nguEfrayim.

Ke kaloku umda wahla waya emlanjeni weKana; ngasempumalanga yomngxunya kwakukho izixeko zikaEfrayim, kodwa zaziphakathi kwezixeko zikaManase. Umda kaManase wawusuka ecaleni lomnqamlezo womngxunya wasentshonalanga, ufike elwandle.
Ilizwe laseMpuma lalinguEfrayim, nelizwe laseNtshona lilungu likaManase. Ulwandle lwaluye lwaba ngumda waseNtshona kaManase; lwafika eAshere ngasemntla, noIssakare ngasemzantsi.

Ke kaloku, ezweni lika-Issakare no-Ashere, uManase wafumana iBhete-shan, neYibleyam, nabahlali baseDori, neEndori, neTaanakhi, neMegidido, ngazo zonke izixeko zazo. Umntu wesithathu wayenguNafothi, othetha ukuba iintaba.
Ke abazalwana bakaManase abazange bakhuphe abahlali baloo mzi; kuba amaKanani ayeqhubeka ehlala kuloo lizwe.
Ke kaloku, xa amaSirayeli enamandla kakhulu, bamisa ooKanani ukuba babe ngabancedisi; kodwa abazange babakhuphe.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaYosefu kuYoshuwa, Kutheni na ukuba usinike inxalenye enye kuphela yelizwe? Sibantu abaninzi; ngokuba iNkosi usibhaptizile kakhulu.
Waphendula uYoshuwa wathi kubo, Ukuba nininzi kakhulu, nokuba indawo enqamlezeneyo kaEfrayim incinane kuwe; nyukani nifike emithini, nithabathe isiqhamo senu kwilizwe lamaPeriziti namaRefayi.

Bathi ke kubo, Ilizwe elintaba-mlilo alikwazi ukusitsala; bonke abaKanana abahlala ezweni eliphantsi baneemoto zokulwa zentsimbi, abo baseBhete-shan nasezidolophini zazo, nalabo baseNtshona yeYizreyeli.
UYoshuwa wathi kubo oonyana bakaYosefu, uEfrayim noManase, esithi, Intsapho yenu inkulu kakhulu, ninamandla kakhulu; ningaba nenxalenye enye.
Iintaba zesiqhamo ziya kuba zakho; ziqhoboshela, ziye zibe zakho zonke. Uza kuzikhupha iziKananhi, nakuba baneemoto zokulwa zentsimbi, nabanamandla kakhulu.
Ibandla liphela lakwaSirayeli lahlangana eShilo, bamisa khona itente yokuhlangana; ilizwe ke lafika phantsi kwabo.
Ke kaloku izizwe ezisixhenxe zakwaSirayeli azizange zifumane ilifa labo.
Wathi ke uYoshuwa kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Niza kuhlala ixesha elingakanani nize nihambe niyithathe ilizwe, elinika lona iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi benu?
Bakhetheni abantu abathathu kwisizukulwana ngasinye; ndiya kubathumelela, ukuba bahambe phantsi kwelizwe, babhale ngayo, babonise indlela yokwahlula ngayo; baya kumbuyela.
Baya kuyihlula ilizwe libe ngamacandelo asixhenxe; uYuda uya kuhlala ezweni lakhe elunxwemeni lwasempumalanga, nabantwana bakaYosefu bahlale ezweni labo elunxwemeni lwasempumalanga.
Nizibhalela iziqendu ezisixhenxe, nizithumelele apha kum; ndiza kukubopha iinqununu kwenu apha phambi koYehova uThixo wethu.

Ke kaloku amaLevi angeke abe nenxalenye phakathi kwenu; kuba ukukhonza njengombingeleli kuYehova yinxalenye yabo. UGadi, noRubhen, nesiqingatha sesiqithi sikaManase, bathathe ilizwe labo ngaphaya kweYorodani, emazantsi elwandle, elibabunika uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova.
Ke kaloku abo madoda baphuma, uYoshuwa wathi kubo, Yiya niyihambe ilizwe, nilibhale, nibuye kuni; ndiza kukutyhilani amasuntswana apha eShilo phambi koYehova.
Bahamba ke abo madoda, batyelela ilizwe, bayibhale kwincwadi, imizi ngemizi, ibe ziinxalenye ezisixhenxe; babuyela kuYoshuwa esixekweni, eShilo.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wabeka iziqhamo zazo eShilo phambi koYehova, wahlula khona uYoshuwa eli lizwe kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngokwesizwe ngasinye.
Waphuma umjikelo wokuqala wesizwe sikaBhenjamin, ngokwesizwe saso; umhlaba wabo wawuphakathi kwelizwe likaYuda nelizwe likaYosefu.
Kwicala lasentshonalanga, umda wabo wawuqala eYordani, wahamba phantsi komngxunya waseYeremiya osemazantsi, waya emaphandleni asentshonalanga, waphuma entlango yaseBhethe-aven.
Wadlula khona waya ecaleni lasekunene leLuzi, leyo yiBheteli; wahla waya eAtaroti-adare, elunxwemeni olusentshonalanga yeBhete-horon esezantsi.
Ukusuka kwintaba ejonge iBhete-horon emzantsi, umda wajika waya kwelaseMpuma, waya eKiriyati-bhaali (leyo yiKiriyati-yearimi), emzini wamaYuda. Lo mda waba ngasemzantsi.
Icala lasempumalanga laqala ecaleni leKiriyati-yearimi, icala elinxwemeni, lifike emlanjeni wamanzi kaNeftoha.

Wawela umda phantsi komnqamlezo ojonge emlanjeni kaBhen-hinnom, ekugqibeleni kwelali yamaRafayim ngasempumalanga; wawela umnqamlezo kaHinnom, ecaleni lolwandle olusentshonalanga lomzi wamaJebhusi, waya ezantsi eEn-rogeli.
Wajika waya ngasentshonalanga, waya eEn-shemesi, waqhubeka waya eGeliloto, elijongene nomngxunya waseAdummim, wahla waya esinqeni sikaBohani unyana kaRubhen.
Wadlula ecaleni lasentshonalanga elijonge elunxwemeni lweYorodani, waya phantsi elunxwemeni.
Wadlula ke umda ecaleni laseBet-hogla elunxwemeni olusentshonalanga, waphela ecaleni lolwandle olufileyo olusentshonalanga, apho umlambo iYorodani uphuma khona. Lo ngumda wasempuma.
Umlambo iYordana waba ngumda wecala lasempumalanga. Lowo ngumimandla ojikeleza yonke ilizwe elinikezelwe izizwe zikaBhenjamin.
