Isizwe samaBhenjamin, ngokweefama zazo, ziidolophu ezi: iYericho, neBhete-hohla, neEmek-kezisi;
iBhethe-araba, neZemarayim, neBheteli,
uAvwim, noFara, noOfra,
iKefari-ammoni, neHofeni, neGebha: imizi elishumi elinambini neentaba zayo.
neGibheyon, neRama, neBherothi,
iMizepa, neKefira, neMoza,
neRekem, neIrpayeli, neTarahala,
iTsela, neHalefe, nemizi yamaYebhusi (leyo yiYerusalem), neGibeha, neKiriyati: imizi elishumi elinambini needolophu zazo. Eli lilizwe labafazi bakaBhenjamin.
Waphuma umjikelo wesibini wesizukulwana samaSimeoni, ngokwesizwe sazo; umhlaba wabo wawuphakathi kwelizwe likaYuda.
Ummandla wabo waba yiBhereshebha, eyaziwa ngokuba yiSheba, neMolada,
uHazari-shuhali, noBhala, noEzem,
iEltoladi, neBethuli, neHorma,
neTsikelage, neBhethe-markabhothi, neHazari-shusha,
iBhethe-libaothi, neSharuhen: imizi elishumi elinambini neentaba zayo.
neAyin, neRimon, neEther, neAshan: amadolophu amane neelali zawo;
nazo zonke izixeko ezijikeleze la madolophu, ukuya eBhahalathi-bheri (le yiRama emzantsi); lo ngumhlaba wesizwe samaSimeoni ngokwezihlanga zawo.
Ilizwe likaSimeon lathathwa ekungeneni kukaYuda; ngokuba uJuda wayenamazwe amaninzi kunaye. Ke kaloku abantu bakaSimeon bafumana ilizwe labo phakathi kwehlabathi kaYuda.
Ityala lesithathu laphuma kuZebulon, ngokwesizwe sayo; umda wabo wafika eSaridi.
waya eMarala ngasentshonalanga, wafika eDabheshethi, wafika emngxunyeni waseYokneyam.
Usuka eSaridi, wajika waya kutshona kwelanga ngasempumalanga, waya kwilizwe laseKislothe-taboro, wadlula eDaberati, wanyuka waya eYafiya.
Wasuka apho waya kwelasempumalanga, waya eGati-heferi, neEth-kazini; waphuma eRimoni, wajika waya eNeha.
Kwicala lasempumalanga, umda ujikeleza waya eHanathoni, waphuma eNtaba kaYifta-yeli.
IKathathi, neNahalali, neShimron, neIdala, neBetheleyimu; ziidolophu ezilishumi elinambini nezixeko zazo.
Ezi ziidolophu nezixeko zazo, ilizwe likaZebulon ngokweefama zabo.
Utolo lwesine lwaphuma kuIssakare, ngokwesizwe sakhe.
Umhlaba wabo wawunguYezreyeli, noKesuloti, noShunem,
iHaparayim, neSiyone, neAnaharate,
iRabhithi, neKishiyon, neEbezi,
neRemeti, neEn-ganimi, neEn-hada, neBhethe-pazezi.
Umda ufike kuTabhore, noShahazuma, neBhat-shemeshe, waphuma eYordani: ziidolophu ezi lishumi linamithandathu neentaba zawo.
Lezi ziidolophu, nezixeko zazo, ngumhlaba wesizwe samaSirayeli, ngokweefama zabo.
Uthotho lwesihlanu lwaphuma kwisizukulwana sika-Ashe, ngokwesizukulwana sayo.
Umhlaba wabo wawunguHelekathi, noHali, noBheteni, noAkshafi,
uAllammeleki, noAmade, noMishale; ngasemntla umda ufike eKarmeleni, neShihore-Libnate.
wajika waya emazantsi eBhete-dagoni, wabetha uZebulon, noLwandle lweYifta-eli, wadlula emntla kuBhethe-emeki noNeyeli, wadlula eKabuli ngasekhohlo.
waya eAbhadoni, noRehobhi, noHamoni, neKana, waya eSidon enkulu.
Wajika ke umda waya eRama, wafika eTire, emzini ogqityiweyo; wajika waya eHosa, waphela elwandle, kwilizwe laseAkzib.
I-Uma, ne-Afeki, neRehobhi: amadolophu angamashumi mabini anesibini, neelali zawo.
Lezi ziidolophu, nezixeko zazo, ngumhlaba wesizukulwana samaAsheri ngokweefama zawo.
Utolo lwesithandathu lwaphuma kuNafetali, ngokwesizwe sakhe.
Umda wabo wawusuka eHelephi, ne-Eden yaseZaanannim, waya eAdami-nekeb, noYabnayeli, waya eLakumi, waphela eYordan.
Ke kaloku umda udlula ngasentshonalanga ukuya eAznothi-taboro, waya eHukoko; wadibana noZebulon emazantsi, noAshere emazantsi, noYuda eJordan emazantsi.
Iidolophu ezinemigangatho yayiziSidim, neZeri, neHamati, neRakati, neKinnerethi,
uAdama, noRama, noHasoro,
neKedesh, neEdreyi, neEnhazore,
iIron, neMigdal-eli, neHorem, neBhahati-anathi, neBhahati-shemeshi: amadolophu alishumi elinambini neelali zawo.
Lezi ziidolophu nezixeko zazo, ilizwe lesizwe samaNafetali ngokweefama zawo.
Utolo olusixhenxe lwaphuma kwisizukulwana samaDan, ngokweziqu zabo.
Umhlaba wabo waba yiTsora, neEshtaoli, neIr-shemeshi,
uShahalabini, noAyaloni, noIthala,
uElon, neTimna, neEkron,
iElteke, neGibhethon, neBhalathi,
uYudu, noBhene-beraki, neGathi-rimoni,
Mna uYarkoni noRakhoni, nendawo ejonge iYopa.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaDan, benzima ukuba bathathe ilizwe labo; baya phezulu, bahlasela iLeshemi, bayithatha, bayibulala ngeqhwa, bahlala khona; batshintsha igama leLeshemi libe nguDan, ngokwegama likaDan utata wabo.
Lezi ziidolophu nezixeko zazo, ilizwe lesizwe samaDan, ngokweefama zabo.
Ke kaloku, begqibile ukuhlula ilizwe ngamasebe ayo, oonyana bakaSirayeli banika uYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, amasebe phakathi kwabo.
Wayemnika, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo, lo mzi awayewucela, iTimnathi-sereha, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim; wayilungisa loo mzi, wahlala kuwo.

Ezi ziinxalenye zomhlaba, awazinikezele ngazo uEleyazare umbingeleli, noYoshuwa unyana kaNun, namadoda amakhulu eentsapho zesizukulwana samaSirayeli, ngoqhawulo-mtshato, eShilo, phambi koYehova, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana. Bagqiba ngoko ukuhlukanisa ilizwe.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuYoshuwa, esithi,
Utsho kuSirayeli ukuba bakhethe imimandla yokhuselo, endithetha ngayo kuni ngoMoses.
Wonke umntu obulala umntu ngokungxama, ngaphandle kokufunayo, uya kungena esinye sazo izixeko, aze akhuseleke khona kumhlobo wakhe ofuna ukuxolela umphefumlo wakhe.

Umntu lowo kufuneka ahambe esinye sezixeko ezi, ahlale emngxunyeni wesango lesi sixeko, acacise ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kumadoda amakhulu esi sixeko; athabathe abo amadoda amakhulu baya kumzi, babanike indawo yokuhlala phakathi kwabo.
Ukuba lo mhlobo ofuna ukuxolela uyala, abathetheli bangamnika loo mntu; ngokuba babulala umnqamlezo wabo ngento engalindelekanga, bebengabaxoleli ngaphambili.
Bahlale kuloo mzi, de bavele phambi kwentlanganiso, naphezu kokufa kukambingeleli omkhulu ophetheyo ngaloo mihla; ke ngoko baya kubuyela endlwini yabo, emzini apho babesuka khona.
Bamisa ke iKedesh eGalili, emazantsi entaba kaNafetali; neShekem emazantsi entaba kaEfraim; neKiriyati-arba (leyo yiHebron), emazantsi entaba kaYuda.

Ngasemzantsi-mpuma weYorodani, ngaphesheya kweYeremiya, bakhetha iBezero, esiqithi esiphakamileyo, kwisizukulwana samaRubeni; neRamoti, eGiliyadi, kwisizukulwana samaGadi; noGolan, eBhashani, kwisizukulwana sikaManase.

Ezi ziidolophu ezikhethiweyo kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, nakwabakhenkethi abahlala phakathi kwabo; ukuze umntu onqumlayo umntu ngengozi akwazi uku Óya kuzo, aze angafa yindoda yobuxoki, phambi kokuba ifike ecaleni kohlangamogi.
Bafika ke abathetheli beentsapho zakwaLevi kuElezare umbingeleli, noYoshuwa unyana kaNun, nabathetheli beentsapho zezinye izizwe zabaSirayeli.
Bathi kubo eShilo, ezweni laseKanan: UYehova wamwisela umthetho ngesandla sikaMoses, ukuba nisinike imimandla yokuhlala kuyo, nezixeko ezijikelezayosimiselwa kuzo iinkomo zethu.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuLevi, ezweni labo, ezi dolophu namachibi azo, njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma isiqhamo sokuqala kusapho lwakwaKahati; oonyana bakaAron umbingeleli, abaLevi, bafumana ezweni likaYuda noSimeon noBhenjamin imimandla elishumi elinambini.
Amanye oonyana bakaKahati afumana, kusapho lwamaSirayeli aseEfrayim, naseDan, nakwishumi elinesibini lesizwe sikaManase, idolophu ezilishumi.
Oonyana bakaGershoni babeneedolophu ezilishumi elinambini, ezisuka kusapho lwesizwe samaSirayeli, naseAshere, naseNaphtali, nengxenye yesizukulwana samaManase eBhashani.
Oonyana bakaMerariya, ngokweefama zabo, bafumana eSizwe sikaRubhen, naseGadi, naseZabulon, imimandla elishumi elinambini.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli babanika amaLevi, ngoqhawulo-mtshato, la madolophu namachibi awo, njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMoses.
Banika izizwe zikaYuda noSimeon ezi dolophu, zaziwa ngamagama azo.
Baye bafika kubo oonyana baka-Aron, abasuka kusapho lwakwaKehati phakathi kwabaLevi; ngokuba ityala lokuqala laphuma kubo.
Babibanika iKiriyati-arba, eyiyo iHebron, kunye neendawo zayo ezijikelezayo, entlango kaYuda; uArba wayengumntwana kaAnaki.
Ke kaloku izityalo, nezidolophu ezijikeleze lo mzi, zaba zinikezelwe kuKalebe unyana kaYefune, zibe yindawo yakhe.
Babinika oonyana baka-Aron umbingeleli iHebron, umzi wokhuselo kulowo wabulala umntu, kunye neLibna.
neYatiri, neEshtemoa,
iHolon, neDebiri,
neAyin, neYuta, neBhat-shemesh; nganye yazo iintaba zayo. Ezi ziidolophu ezisixhenxe ezisuka kuloo mmandla amabini.
Kwisizwe sikaBhenjamin babanika iGibheyon, neGebha,
neAnathothi, neAlmon, nganye yazo neentaba zayo; ezi ziidolophu ezine.
Zonke izixeko zamadoda amakhulu ka-Aron zaba zilishumi elinamithathu, nezindlu zawo.
Ezinye iintsapho zakwaKehati, eziseleyo phakathi kwabaLevi, zafumana izixeko ngesiqendu sikaEfrayim, ngoqhawulo-mtshato.
Bayifumana iShekem, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim, umzi wokhuselo kulowo wabulala umntu; neGezere,
neKibzayim, neBhete-horon, nganye yazo neentaba zayo; ziidolophu ezine.
Kwisizwe sikaDan bafumana iElteke, neGibhethoni,
neAyaloni, neGath-rimmoni, nganye yazo neendawo zayo eziphakathi. Ezi ziidolophu ezine.
Engxenyeni yesizukulwana sikaManase bafumana iTahanake, neGati-rimoni; nganye yazo neendawo zayo zokuhlala. Ziidolophu ezimbini.
Zonke izixeko eziseleyo zeentsapho zakwaKehati zaba zilishumi, nezindlu zawo.
Abafazi bakaGershoni, abaLevi, bafumana engxenyeni yesizukulwana sikaManase iGolan eBhashani, umzi wokhuselo kulowo ubulala umntu; neBhe-estoreha, ngazo zonke iziqithi zayo: ziidolophu ezimbini.
Kwisizwe sika-Isakare kwathiwa nguKishon, noDaberati,
neYarmuthi, neEn-ganimi; nganye yazo iintaba zayo. Ziidolophu ezine.
Kwisizwe sika-Ashe, uMishayeli noAbdon;
neHelekathi, neRehobhi, nganye yazo neentaba zayo; ezi ziidolophu ezine.
Kwisizwe sikaNafetali bafumana iKedesh eGalili, umzi wokhuselo womfazi, neHamote-dore, neKartane, ngazo zonke iziqithi zazo; ziidolophu ezintathu.
Zonke iintsapho zakwaGershoni zaba ziidolophu ezilishumi elinamithathu, nezityalo zazo.
Abafazi bakaMerariya, amanye amaLevi, bafumana kwisizukulwana sikaZebulon iYokneyam, neKartha,
neDimna, neNahalale, nganye yazo neentaba zayo; ezi ziidolophu ezine.
Kwisizwe sikaRubhen: iBesere, neYahazi,
neKedemothi, neMefaathi, nganye yazo neentaba zayo; ziidolophu ezine.
Kwisizwe sikaGadi bafumana iRamoti eGiliyadi, umzi wokhuselo kulowo ubulalayo umntu; neMahanayim;
neHeshboni, neYaseri, nganye yazo neentaba zayo; zonke ezi ziidolophu ezine.
Zonke iintsapho zakwaMerari, ezigqibeleleyo phakathi kweentsapho zakwaLevi, zaba ziidolophu ezilishumi elinambini ngotolo.
Zonke iidolophu zakwaLevi zaba zilishumi elinambini nesibhozo, nezixeko eziphakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Zonke ezi dolophu, enye nganye ibenemihlaba ejikeleze kuyo; kwaba njalo kuzo zonke.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wamnika amaSirayeli lonke ilizwe, awayeyamnqula ukuba awabaniki ooyise; bayithathe yahlala kuyo.

Wabanika ke iNkosi ukuphumla ngazo zonke iinkalo, njengoko wayethe wabhiyozela abazalwana babo; akukho namnye wabachasi babo okwaziyo ukumelana nabo. UYehova wabanikela bonke abachasi babo esandla sabo.
Akukho nanye yazo zonke iziprofeto ezilungileyo, iNkosi awathetha ngazo kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ephazamisekile; zonke zavela.
Wazibiza ke uYoshuwa izizukulwana zakwaRubhen, nezizukulwana zakwaGadi, nesiqingatha sesizukulwana sikaManase.
Wathi kubo, Niyenze yonke into uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, awawisela umthetho ngayo; nindiphulaphule zonke izinto endithethayo kuni.
Akukho namnye wenu owashiya abazalwana benu abaSirayeli, ukususela kule mihla idlulileyo ukuya kuloo mini; nigcinele ukwenza yonke imisebenzi iNkosi uThixo wenu awawiselayo.

Ke kaloku iNkosi, uThixo wenu, wabanika ubuxoki abazalwana benu, njengokuba wathi; ngoko ke mna ke ndithi kuni, Yiya nibuye ezweni lenu elisemthethweni, elininike lona uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani.

Ke kaloku, gcinani ngokungqongqo ukuba nizigcine imiyalelo nemithetho kaMoses awawisela kuwe: ukuthanda iNkosi uThixo wakho, nokuhamba ngeendlela zakhe, nokuthobela imimiselo yakhe, nokuzibophelela kuye, nokumkhonza ngentliziyo yenu yonke nomphefumlo wenu wonke.
Wababhaptiza ke uYoshuwa, wabavumela bahambe; baya endlwini yabo.

Ke kaloku isiqingatha sesizwe sikaManase, uMoses wabanika ilizwe eBhashani; ke isiqingatha sesibini sakwaManase, uYoshuwa wabanika abazalwana babo, ngasentshonalanga yeJordan. Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, xa wayeyalela ukuba bahambe, wababhaptiza.
wathi, Yiya endlwini yakho ngezinto zakho ezikhulu, nezimvu ezininzi, nesilivere, negolide, nentsimbi, nentsimbi, nempahla emininzi; udibanise nabazalwana bakho ezo zinto nizikhuphe kumagosa enu.

Basuka ke ooRubhen noGadi, nesiqithi seshumi lesizwe sikaManase, babuyela eGiliyadi, ilizwe lenkcubeko yabo, apho babelifumana khona intsapho yabaseSirayeli eShilo, elunxwemeni lwaseKhanani, njengokuba iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngoMoses.
Bafika ke eGalilothi, elunxwemeni lweYorodani, elikwilizwe laseKanan; balungisa khona isibingelelo esikhulu, esimangalisayo, emlanjeni.
Babeva ke ooSirayeli abantu besithi, Yabona, amaRubhen namaGadi, nengxenye yesiqithi sikaManase, balungiselela isibingelelo kumda weKanan, eJordan, ngasemzantsi-ntshona wamaSirayeli.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli beva ngale nto, ibandla lonke lahlangana eShilo, ukuba lihambe libhideke nabo.
Bathumela ke oonyana bakaSirayeli uPhenehasi, unyana kaElazare ukumkani, kuRubhen, noGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, ezweni laseGiliyadi.
Bathumela naye oonyana bakakumkani abalishumi, omnye kusapho ngalunye lwakwaSirayeli; ngamnye waba ngumfazi wendlu yomntwana wakhe phakathi kwezizwe zakwaSirayeli.
Bafika ke kubo ooRubhen, noGadi, neshumi lesizwe sikaManase eGiliyadi, bathetha nabo bathi,
Isithi ibandla liphela likaYehova, Yintoni na le nto niyenzayo ngoThixo kaSirayeli? Yintoni na le nto niyishiya ngayo intliziyo yenu iNkosi namhlanje, nikhangeleni isibingelelo, nithi, Siyakuxolela.
Ingaba intlungu kaPeor ayizange ibe ncinci kuthi? Siyaqhubeka singacocwanga kuyo, nanjengoko ubhubhise abantu bakaYehova.
Namhlanje ke, nisukani kukumlandela iNkosi; ukuba namhlanje ningamthobeli iNkosi, ngomhla wesibini uya kutshabalalisa ibandla lonke lamaSirayeli.

Ngoko ke, ukuba ilizwe lakho lilungile, vuka ufike ezweni likaYehova, apho icebo likaThixo lihlala khona, uthathe indawo yethu phakathi kwethu; kodwa musa ukunyanzelisa iNkosi, nakusi, ngokwakha isibingelelo ngaphandle kwesibingelelo sikaThixo wethu.
Khumbula uAkani, unyana kaZera; ngokuba waphula umthetho ngezinto ezilahlekileyo; ngoko ke kwafika intliziyo yobuxoki phezu kwebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli; akafanga yena kuphela ngenxa yesono sakhe.
Baphendula ke ooRubhen, noGadi, nengxenye yesizukulwana sikaManase, kumadoda amakhulu eentsapho zakwaSirayeli, bathi,
UThixo onamandla, iNkosi; uThixo onamandla, iNkosi; yena uyazi, nabaSirayeli nabo bayazi; ukuba sikwenzele loo nto ngenxa yobuxoki, okanye ngenxa yobuxoki kuYehova, musa ukusikhusela namhlanje.
Ukuba siyile esi sibingelelo sokuba siyeke iNkosi, nokuba silungiselele phezu kwayo izipho eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezipho zesonka, nezipho zoxolo, iNkosi ngokwakhe athabathe isigqibo sakhe.

Ke kaloku, sakwenza oko ngenxa yokuba sikhathazekile; sazixolela ukuba bangathi abantwana benu ngosuku olulandelayo kubantwana bethu, besithi, Yintoni enokwenzekani nani no térheni ngoYehova uThixo kaSirayeli?

UYehova wenza iJordan ibe ngumda phakathi kwethu nani, nibantwana bakaRubhen neGadi; ningabakho namnye umnikelo eNkosini. Ke ngoko, bazalwana benu banokubangela ukuba bazalwana bethu bayeke ukukhonza uThixo.
Ke kaloku sathi, Siyakwakha isibingelelo, asiyi kuba ziintsontelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nakuba zizipho;

kodwa ibe ngumqondiso phakathi kwethu nani, naphakathi kwezizukulwana zethu ezizayo, ukuba sikhonza iNkosi phambi kwakhe ngeempawu zethu zokunqula, nezibingelelo zethu, nezibingelelo zethu zoxolo; ukuze abantwana benu bangathi kubantwana bethu ngonaphakade, Akukho nxalenye yenu kuYehova.

Sathi ke, Xa besithi kuthi nathi nabantwana bethu ngaloo ndlela, siya kuphendula sithi, Yabona le mifanekiso engumqondiso yesibingelelo sikaYehova abayenzayo abazalwana bethu; ayisiyonto yokungcwatywa, ayisiyonto yokusindisa; iyakuba ngumvuzo phakathi kwethu nani.

Asiyi kunyamezela iNkosi, asiyi kumshiya ngaloo mini, ngokwakha isibingelelo esitsha sezinto eziqhutywa ngamandla, nezonka, nezibingelelo, ngaphandle kwesibingelelo soYehova uThixo wethu, esingaphambili kwetentile yakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa uPhinehasi, umbingeleli, namadoda amakhulu emkhosini, oonyana bakaSirayeli, beva into abayenzayo oonyana bakaRubhen noGadi noManase, bayavuya.
Wathi kubo uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare ukumkani: Namhlanje siyazi ukuba iNkosi ungunye wethu; ngokuba ningabikho nobuxoki kuye kuloo nto. Ngokunikhuselile oonyana bakaSirayeli ekungeneni kukaThixo.
Ke kaloku uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare ukumkani, nabathetheli bakhe, babuyela kubo ooRubhen noGadi baseGiliyadi, babeya kubantwana bakaSirayeli ezweni laseKanan, babaxelela konke okuthethwayo.
Bayavuya oonyana bakaSirayeli, beva oko, bawuthanda uThixo; abazange baphinde bathethe ukuba baya kulwa nabo, ukuba baphulaphule ilizwe lakwaRubhen nakwaGadi apho behlala khona.
Bathi oonyana bakaRubhen noGadi igama lesibingelelo, nguMqondiso; bathi, Yimbonakaliso phakathi kwethu, ukuba iNkosi nguThixo.
Zathi zidlula iintsuku ezininzi, iNkosi wamisa amaSirayeli kuwo onke amaxhoba abo ajikelezayo. UYoshuwa wayesele eneminyaka emininzi.
Wathi ke uYosefu, wabiza bonke amaSirayeli, namadoda amakhulu abo, neentloko zabo, nabagwebi babo, nabaphathi babo, wathi kubo, Ndikhulu kakhulu.
Nibone konke iNkosi uThixo wenu akwenzele ezo mazwe onke ngenxa yenu; nguYehova uThixo wenu lowo wahlasela ngenxa yenu.
Yabona, ndininike ilizwe leentlanga eziseleyo, neentlanga endizihlaselayo, ukuba libe yinxalenye yenu ngokweemfazwe zenu, ukusuka eJordan ukuya kulwandle olukhulu lwasempumalanga.
UYehova uThixo wakho, yena uya kuzikhupha phambi kwenu, aze azikhuphe; niyithathe ilizwe labo libe yipropathi yenu, njengokuba iNkosi uThixo wenu wathetha kuni.
Ke ngoko, zinikele kakhulu, nizigcine, nizenza zonke izinto ezibhaliweyo kwincwadi yomthetho kaMoses; musa ukusuka kuyo ngasekunene nakwesobunxele.
Musani ukudibana neentlanga ezisele phakathi kwenu; musani ukuthetha amagama amadini abo, nize ningabhiyozeli ngegama labo; musani ukuzikhonza, nangamakhonkco.
Ke yena iNkosi, uThixo wenu, niwubambe ngokuqinileyo, njengokuba niwenzayo naphezu koko.
UYehova wakhupha phambi kwenu iintlanga ezinkulu, ezinamandla; akukho namnye okwaziyo ukuma phambi kwenu, kude kube namhlanje.
Umntu ngamnye kuni uya kuhlasela amawaka; ngokuba iNkosi, uThixo wenu, ungumfazi onokulwa ngenxa yenu, njengokuba wathi.
Ke ngoko, gcinani kakuhle ukuba nithande iNkosi uThixo wenu.
Ke kaloku, ukuba mna ke ndiya kubuya, ndizibophelela kubomi babantu baloo mazwe asele phakathi kwenu, ndize ndithabathe amadoda abo, ndizithunge nabo,

kwazini ukuba iNkosi uThixo wenu akaze aqhubeke nokuzikhupha ezi zinto zihlanga phambi kwenu; ziya kuba ngumbulelo kuni, ziye zibe ngumqolo kuni, zibe yintloko yenu, zibe ngamagqabi entliziyweni yenu, zibe ziziqhamo emehlweni enu, de niphele kuloo ndawo ilungileyo iNkosi uThixo wenu akunika yona.

Ndiya kuhamba namhlanje ngendlela yazo zonke izinto ezikwihlabathi; niyazi intliziyo yenu yonke, nomoya wenu wonke, ukuba akukho nanye yezithembiso ezilungileyo iNkosi uThixo wenu awathethayo kuwe, eyonakeleyo; zifike zonke, akukho nenye ithile eyonakeleyo.

Ke kaloku, njengokuba zonke izinto ezilungileyo iNkosi, uThixo wenu, awathetha ngazo, zafika phezu kwenu, ke ngoko iNkosi uya kuzizisa phezu kwenu zonke izinto ezingalunganga awathetha ngazo, de akufumaneni nikhululwe kuloo mhlaba mhle wamnika wona.

Ukuba niyiphula umnqophiso kaYehova uThixo wenu, owabawisela umthetho wona ukuba niwugcine, niye nikhonza amadini athile, niwukhonze; ngoko neminqweno kaYehova iya kuqhutywa phezu kwenu, niphele ngokukhawuleza ezweni elilungileyo resenzayo.
Wazihlanganisa ke uYoshuwa zonke iintsapho zakwaSirayeli eShekem, wabiza oombingeleli bakaSirayeli, nabathetheli babo, nabagwebi babo, nabaphathi babo; bafika, babe phambi koThixo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Ngaphesheya komlambo bahlala ngaphambili ooyise benu, uTera, utata kaAbraham noNahore; babekhonza amadini athile.
Ke mna ndathabatha uAbraham, umzali wenu, ukusuka ngaphesheya komlambo, ndimqhuba ezweni lonke laseKanan; ndamnika iziqhamo ezininzi, ndamnika uIsake.
noIsake ndamnika uYakobi noEsau; kuEsau ndamnika intaba kaSeyiri, ibe yintsapho yakhe; ke uYakobi nendlu yakhe bahla eYiputa.
Ndathumela ke uMoses noAron, ndabetha iYiputa ngeentlungu endizenzayo phakathi kwayo; emva koko ndazikhupha.
Ke kaloku, xa ndabakhupha abazalwana benu eYiputa, nafikani kulwandle; abaYiputa babewalandela ngeemoto zokulwa nabaqhubi bamabhayisikili, bafike emlanjeni oMthubi.

Ke kaloku bathandaza kuYehova, wabeka umnyama phakathi kwenu nabaseYiputa; wazisa phezu kwabo umlambo, wabagubungela; nibona ngamehlo enu into endiyenzayo kumaSirayeli; nihlala esiqwini iintsuku ezininzi.
Ndanizisa ezweni lama-Amori, ahlala ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani; baya kulwa nani; ndabanikela entliziyweni yenu, ndawacima phambi kwenu, niyithathe ilizwe labo njengelifa.
Ke kaloku uBalaka, unyana kaSipore, ukumkani wakwaMowabi, wenyuka waya kulwa namaSirayeli; wathumela wabiza uBhileham, unyana kaBeore, ukuba akulamle.
Ke mna andifuni ukumphulaphula uBhileham; yena ke wakubambisa, waza wamsindisa ebantwini bakaBhalaka.
Yathi nidlula iYorodani, nafika eYeremiya; nabahlali baseYeremiya bahlasela kuni, namaAmori, namaPerizi, namaKanana, namaHeti, namaGirgasi, namaHivi, namaJebhusi; ndabanikela phantsi kwesandla sam.
Ndazisa iintaka-ntlaba phambi kwenu, zazikhupha, izikumkani ezibini zeAmori; awuzange ukwenze ngeqhwa lakho, nokuba ngumtya wakho.
Ndaninika ilizwe elingenamsebenzi kulo, nemizi engakhe wayilungisa, nihlala kuyo; nidla izityalo zenkomo nezityalo zeolibhi, engake nizityale.

Ke ngoko ke, hloniphani iNkosi, nikhonzane naye ngentliziyo yenu yonke, ngokuqinisekileyo; nizikhuphe ezo zinto zingcwele abazikhonzayo abazalwana benu ngaphaya komlambo, naseYiputa, nisebenzele iNkosi.

Ke kaloku, ukuba kunzima kuwe ukukhonza iNkosi, khetheni namhlanje ngubani na oza kumkhonza: ngaba amadini abazalwana benu ababewakhonza ngaphesheya komlambo, okanye amadini eAmori, ilizwe labo nihlala kulo; kodwa mna nosapho lwam siza kukhonza iNkosi.
Baphendula ke abantu, besithi, Asiyi kushiya iNkosi sikhonza amadini athile.

UYehova, uThixo wethu, wayeye wamkhupha nathi nabazalwana bethu eYiputa, ezweni lendlu yobulungisa, wazenza ezo zinto zikhulu ezimangalisayo phambi kwamehlo ethu; wabakhusela kwindlela yethu yonke, phakathi kwezizwe zonke apho sadlula khona.
UYehova wakhupha phambi kwethu iintlanga zonke, namaAmori ahlala kuloo lizwe; nathi siya kukhonza iNkosi, ngokuba yena nguThixo wethu.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo, Ningawukhonzanga iNkosi; kuba nguThixo ongcwele yena; unguThixo ozinikeleyo; akayi kuthotywa intlungu yenu, nezono zenu.
Ukuba niya kushiya iNkosi, nikhonza amadini angaphandle, uya kuguqula imilenze yakhe kuwe, anikhokelele engozini, anilahle, emva kokuba ekwenzeni okuhle.
Bathi ke abantu kuYoshuwa, Hayi; siya kumkhonza iNkosi.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo, Niye niyimibhiyozo yenu, ukuba ningamkhethi iNkosi ukuba niwusebenzele. Baphendula bathi, Siyimibhiyozo.
Bathi ke uYoshuwa kubo, Nizisuse ngoko izitha zakwamanye amazwe eziphakathi kwenu, nizibeke intliziyo zenu kuYehova uThixo kaSirayeli.
Bathi ke abantu kuYoshuwa, Siza kukhonza iNkosi uThixo wethu, siyakumthobela.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wenza umnqophiso nabantu ngaloo mini eShekem, wabeka kubo imimiselo nemimiselo.
Wazibhala ke uYoshuwa ezi zinto kwincwadi yomthetho kaThixo; wathabatha itye elikhulu, wayimisa phantsi kwee-oaks ezinkulu, ecaleni kongcwele lukaYehova.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu, Yabona, ilitye eli liza kuba ngumqondiso kuthi; liza kuziva zonke izinto iNkosi awathethayo nathi; liza kuba ngumqondiso kuni, ukuba ningamthobeli uThixo wenu.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wabalantela abantu, ngamnye waya ezweni lakhe.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, wafa uYoshuwa unyana kaNun, umkhonzi kaYehova, eneminyaka eyishumi elinamakhulu amabini.
Bayamzika ezweni lakhe, eTimnathi-se-Sera, elunxwemeni lwaseEfrayim, ngasentshonalanga yenduli kaGaash.
Bakhonza ke amaSirayeli iNkosi zonke iintsuku zokuphila kukaYoshuwa, nazo zonke iintsuku zokuphila kwabakhulu abaphilayo emva kwakhe, ababebona zonke izinto azenzayo iNkosi kubaSirayeli.

Iithambo zikaYosefu, abaSirayeli babezikhuphile eYiputa, zazingcwatywa eShekem, kwinxalenye yelizwe uYakobi ayeyithengise oonyana bakaHamori, uyise kaShekem, ngezinto zesilivere ezilikhulu; le ndawo yaba yintsapho kaYosefu.
Wafa ke uEleyazare, unyana ka-Aron; wabanjwa eGibeha, emnqamlezweni owawunikezelwe kuPinehasi, unyana wakhe, entlango kaEfraim.
Judg: Ke kaloku, emva kokufa kukaYoshuwa, babuza oonyana bakaSirayeli iNkosi, besithi, Yintoni isizukulwana esimele sihambe kuqala ukuhlasela amaKanani?
Waphendula iNkosi wathi, Baya kuphuma amaYuda; bona, ndilinikela ilizwe esandla sabo.
Bathi oonyana bakaYuda kubazalwana babo, oonyana bakaSimeon, Yiya nathi ezweni elithunyelwe kuthi, sithethene nabaKanani; ke siya kungena nani ezweni lenu. Wahamba ke uSimeon nabo.
Ke kaloku uYuda wahlasela, ke iNkosi wawanikela amaKanani namaPerizi esandla sabo; babulala kumawaka alishumi amadoda eBezeke.
Bafumana khona uAdoni-bezeke, bakulwa naye; babetha abaKanani nabaPerizi.
Ke kaloku uAdoni-Bezeke wabaleka; balandela ke, bathabathela kuye, bamisa iinwele zesandla sakhe, nezinyawo zakhe.

Wathi ke uAdoni-bezeke, Abakumkani abamashumi asixhenxe, abaneentloko zezandla zabo neentloko zeenyawo zabo ezicutyiweyo, bathabathela phantsi kwetafile yam; ngoku ke uThixo wandihlawula oko ndenzayo kubo. Bayamthabatha waya eYerusalem, wafa khona.
Ke kaloku abantu bakaYuda bahlasela iYerusalem, bayithabatha; babulala abahlali bayo ngesandla, bamisa umzi ngomlilo.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, bahla oonyana bakaYuda, bahlasela amaKanana ahlala ezweni eliphakamileyo, nelizwe laseNtshona kwelaseMpuma, na Iinduli eziphantsi.
Bahlasela amaKanani ahlala eHebron; (igama likaHebron linguKiriyati-arba), babulala uSheshai, noAhimani, noTalmai.
Basuka apho, bahlasela abahlali baseDebiri; (igama lakhe ngaphambili lalinguKiriyati-seferi).
Wathi ke uKalebe, Umntu onqumlayo iKiriyati-seferi, aze ayithathe, ndiya kumnika intombi yam uAksha ukuba abe ngumfazi.
Wayihlasela uOthniyeli, unyana kaKenazi, umzalwana omncinane kaKalebi; ke kaloku uKalebi wamnika uAkhaza intombi yakhe ukuba abe ngumfazi wakhe.
Wafika ke kuOthniyeli, wamnyamekela ukuba ambuze utata wakhe indawo yomhlaba; waphuma ke phezu kweeseyile zakhe, wathi kuye uKalebe, Ufuna Ithini na?
Wathi kuye, Nceda ndizalise; ngokuba usinike ilizwe elincinane eNtshona, ndininike namanzi acocekileyo. UKalebe wamnika amanzi acocekileyo aphezulu namanzi acocekileyo aphantsi.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaKeni, umyeni kaMoses, benyuka nabo oonyana bakaYuda, basuka kumzi weentyatyambo zamatye, befika emasikweni kaYuda, eNtshona yelizwe laseArad; baye bahlala phakathi kwabantu abakhona.
Ke kaloku waya uYuda nabazalwana bakhe abasuka eSimeon, bahlasela amaKanani ahlala eTsefati, babulala umzi wonke; ngoko ke kwabizwa igama lakhe ngokuba yiHorma.
Ke kaloku uYuda wahlasela iGaza, neAshkeloni, neEkron, nganye nendawo yayo ejikelezayo.
Waye iNkosi namaYuda; bathabathe ilizwe elinxweme, kodwa abakwazi ukutyhila abantu abasemazantsi ehlabathi, ngokuba babenazo iimoto zokulwa zentsimbi.
Wabanika uKalebe iHebron, njengoko watsho uMoses; wayalela khona oonyana bakaAnaki abathathu.
Ke kaloku ooYebhusi abahlali eYerusalem, abazalwana bakaBhenjamin abangawakhuphi; ke ngoko bahlala ooYebhusi phakathi kwabantwana bakaBhenjamin, eYerusalem, de kube kuloo mini.
Baye ke oonyana bakaYosefu benyuka bafika eBheteli; iNkosi waba nabo.
Bathumela abantu ukuba bajonge iBheteli; igama layo ngelo xesha belinguLuzi.
Babebona abaphambukeli umntu ophuma emzini, bathi kuye, Sibonise indlela yokungena kumzi, siza kukunika uxolo.
Wababonisa ke; babulala abantu balo mzi ngeqhwa; lo mfazi ke nosapho lwakhe bonke, bavumela ukuba bahambe.
Waya ezweni labaHeti, wakhiwa khona umzi, wabiza igama lakhe ngokuba nguLuzi; lelo ligama lakhe namhla.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseManase akazange akhuphe abahlali baseBhat-shan, nabaseTaanaki, nabaseDori, nabaseYibleham, nabaseMegido, nezixeko zazo; kuba amaKanani ayethanda ukuhlala kuloo lizwe.
Ke kaloku, xa amaSirayeli enamandla kakhulu, bamisa abaKanani ukuba babe ngumsebenzi wabo; kodwa bangawakhuphi ngokugcwele.
Ke kaloku uEfrayim akawakhuphi amaKanani ahlala eGezere; amaKanani aye ahlala phakathi kwabo.
Ke kaloku uZebulon akawakhuphi abantu abahlali eKitron, nakwaNahaloli; abaKanani bahlala phakathi kwabo, babe yimisebenzi yomsebenzi.
Ke kaloku uAshere awasikhuphi abahlali baseAkko, nabaseSidon, nabaseAhlabhi, nabaseAkzibhi, nabaseHelibahi, nabaseAfeki, nabaseRehobhi.
Ke kaloku abahlali baka-Asere bahlala phakathi kwabaKanani belizwe, ngokuba bangawakhuphi.
Ke kaloku uNafetali akawakhuphi amaSirayeli ahlala eBhethe-shemeshi, nakwiBhethe-anathi; wahlala phakathi kwabaKanani belizwe; abantu baseBhethe-shemeshi, neBhethe-anathi, babe ngabakhonzi bakhe.
Bathi ke amaAmori athabathe abantu bakaDan, babeka phantsi ezweni eliphakamileyo, bangawavumelanga ukuba bakhuphe emazantsi.
Ke kaloku abaAmori bagqiba ekuhlaleni emnqamlezweni kaHereshe, eAyaloni, naseShaalbime. Ke kaloku unyana kaYosefu waba namandla kakhulu; ke ngoko abaAmori babe ngabasebenzi.
Umda wama-Amori wawusuka emngxunyeni weSkorpion waya eShela, wadlula khona.

Wanyuka ke umbingeleli kaYehova ukusuka eGiliyadi waya eBokimi, wathi, Ndinikhuphele phezulu eYiputa, ndiningenise kuloo lizwe endilibazile ooyise benu; ndathi, Andiyi kuphulaphuli umnqophiso wam nani.
Musani kwenza umnqophiso nabantu baloo lizwe; kufuneka niphule izibingelelo zabo. Ke kaloku, ningandiphulaphuli; yintoni na le nto niyenze?
Ke ngoko, ndithi kuni ngoku: Andiza kuwakhupha phambi kwenu; baya kuba ziintsontelo ezintabeni zenu, amadini abo aya kuba yinto yokuzibulala.
Ke kaloku isithunywa sikaYehova sathetha ezi zinto kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli. Bathi ke abantu ngezwi elikhulu,
Bathi igama lendawo leyo nguBokim; banikela khona izibingelelo kuYehova.
Ke kaloku, xa uYoshuwa eshiye abantu, bahamba oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngamnye ukuba athathe ilizwe lakhe.
Bakhonza ke abantu iNkosi zonke iintsuku zokuphila kukaYoshuwa, nazo zonke iintsuku zokuphila kwabakhulu abaphilayo emva kwakhe, ababezibona zonke ezo zinto ezinkulu iNkosi awazenzayo kuSirayeli.
Wafa ke uYoshuwa, unyana kaNun, umkhonzi kaYehova, eneminyaka eyishumi elinamakhulu amabini.
Bayamzika ezweni lakhe, eTimnathi-heresi, elunxwemeni lwaseEfraim, ngasentshonalanga yentaba kaGaashi.
Ke kaloku, emva kokufa kwaloo mihla yonke, kwavuka imihla enye, engayaziyo iNkosi, nantoni na eyayenza kuSirayeli.
Bakwenza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli okubi emehlweni kaYehova, bakhonza amaBaali.
Bashiya iNkosi, uThixo wabazali babo, owabakhupha ezweni laseYiputa; balandela, bakhonza amadini eentlanga ezijikelezayo kubo; babemkhumbuza iNkosi intliziyo.
Bayeka iNkosi, bakhonza uBhaali neAstorethi.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yobuxoki bakhe kuSirayeli, iNkosi wabanikela emlonyeni wabagxeki, bathabathe impahla yabo; wabathengisa kumagosa abo ajikelezayo, abakwazi ukumelana nabo.

Kuzo zonke iindawo apho amaSirayeli ephuma khona ukulwa, isandla sikaYehova sakuba phezu kwabo, ukuba abahlasele; njengoko wayethe wathethayo, njengokuba wababhiyozelayo. Bafikelela kuxinzelelo olukhulu.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wavusa abagwebi, abathetheli, ababebakhusela kulabo babulalayo.

Ke kaloku, abaphulaphuli beenkundla zabo abangabathobeli iNkosi, bakhonza amadini athile, bewunikela kubo; basuka ngokukhawuleza kwindlela ababehamba kuyo ooyise babo, ekwenzeni imimiselo kaYehova; bangayenzanga njengoko babesenza ooyise babo.

Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi wayewavusa emehlweni abo umgwebi, iNkosi waba naye lowo mgwebi, wawasindisa emazulwini abo, zonke iintsuku zobomi balo mgwebi. UYehova wayala ngenxa yabo, xa bephuka phantsi kwabo babebaphazamisayo, babebatyhalayo.

Ke kaloku, xa umgwebi efa, abantu babuya beyenza ngcono indlela yabo kunabazali babo, belandela amadini athile, bewakhonza, bezinikela kubo; abazange bayeke izigqibo zabo ezibi, nendlela yabo enobuxoki.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxoka kakhulu kuSirayeli, wathi, Le lizwe liphulaphule umnqophiso wam endiwuwisela ooyise babo, bangamxelelanga.
ke mna ndiya kuyeka ukuba ndikhuphe phambi kwabo nanye ilizwe, elishiyayo uYoshuwa xa efa.
Kuba ndiya kubavavanya ngazo amaSirayeli, ukuba bangayigcina njani indlela kaYehova, behamba ngayo, njengokuba bahamba ngayo ooyise babo.
Wazishiya ke iNkosi ezo lizwe; awazikhuphi ngokukhawuleza, aze azinikezele esandla sikaYoshuwa.
Ezi ziintlanga, iNkosi wazishiya kuloo lizwe, ukuba avavanye oonyana bakaSirayeli, abazange badlule kuwo onke amabhinqa aseKanaan.
Wakwenza oko, ukuba afundise ukulwa izizukulwana ezitsha zabaSirayeli, abazange bahlasele emfazweni.
Amazwe amahlanu, ookumkani bakaFilisti, nabo bonke abaKanani, nabaSidoni, nabaHivi, abahlala eLibanoni, ukusuka entlango kaBhaali-Hermon, ukuya kuthi ga eHamati.
Wazishiya ukuba bavavanye oonyana bakaSirayeli, ukuba bangawaphulaphuli na amazwi kaYehova, awawuthethelayo ooyise babo ngoMoses.
Bahlala ooSirayeli phakathi kwamaKanana, namaHeti, namaAmori, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaYebhusi.
Bazala oonyana babo, banika oonyana babo oonyana babo; babekhonza amadini abo.
Bakwenza oonyana bakaSirayeli okubi emehlweni kaYehova; balibala iNkosi uThixo wabo, bakhonza amaBaali nama-Ashere.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxolela amaSirayeli, wabathengisa kuKushan-risathaim, ukumkani waseAram eNaharayim, eMesopotamia; bakhonza oonyana bakaSirayeli iminyaka esibhozo.
Ke kaloku bathandaza kuYehova, wavusa umntu ukuba awasindise; nguOthniyeli unyana kaKenazi, umzalwana omncinane kaKalebe.
Wathi uMoya kaYehova kuye, waba ngumgwebi wamaSirayeli, waya emfazweni. UYehova wamnika esandla sakhe uKushan-risathaim, ukumkani waseAram; waza uOthniyele wambetha.
Ilizwe laphumla iminyaka emashumi mane, de kwafa uOthniel unyana kaKenazi.
Baye ke oonyana bakaSirayeli baqhubeka besenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; ngenxa yokuba babesenza oko kubi, iNkosi wamqinisa uEgloni ukumkani wamaMowabi phezu kwaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uEglon wathabatha naye oonyana baka-Ammon noAmaleki; waya, wahlasela amaSirayeli, bathatha umzi weentyatyambo.
Bakhonza ooSirayeli uEglon ukumkani wakwaMowabi iminyaka elishumi elinamihlanu.

Baye ke oonyana bakaSirayeli bathandaza kuYehova, wabeka kubo umsindisi, uEhudi unyana kaGera, wesizwe sikaBhenjamin, umntu osebenza ngesandla esisekhohlo. Bayamthumela oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba athathe intlawulo yabo kumkani wakwaMowabi, uEglon.
Ke kaloku uEhude waba enze ikrele elinamacala amabini, ubude bayo buyimitha elishumi; waligxotha emlonyeni wakhe okunene phantsi kweempahla zakhe.
Wanikela umnikelo ku-Eglon ukumkani wakwaMowabi; wayengumntu othambileyo kakhulu.
Ke kaloku, xa uEhudi egqibile ukunikela umvuzo, wathumela abantu abawuthabathayo.
Ke kaloku wabuyela, waya eGilgal, ecaleni kweebhotwe eziphakamileyo, wathi, Ndinelizwi elifihlakeleyo kuwe, nkosi yam. Wathi ukumkani, Nxibelelani! Baphuma bonke abakhonzi bakhe.
Wathi ke uEhudi kuye, xa ehlala phantsi ekhayeni lakhe, egumbini eliphezulu elipholileyo; wathi uEhudi, Ndinelizwi kum kuThixo. Ke kaloku ukumkani wavuka ukusuka esihlalweni sakhe,
Ke kaloku uEhude waphakamisa isandla sakhe esikhohlo, watsala isigwebo kwisifuba sakhe esisekunene, wayibeka emlonyeni womkani.
Ke kaloku isandla sayo safika phantsi emva kweqhina, utywala lwazivala phezu kwayo. UEhudi akawukhuphi kelosi; yaphuma ngasemva kwakhe.
Waphuma ke uEhudi, waya kwindlu yangasemva; wavala imingxuma yegumbi eliphezulu emva kwakhe, wayitshixa.
Ke kaloku, xa wayesele ephuma, bafika abakhonzi bakhe, bafumanisa izibuko legumbi eliphezulu litshixiwe; bathi ke, zvona ukuba uhlala phantsi kwigumbi langaphakathi.
Ke kaloku, balinde, de baphoxeke; ke kaloku akazange avule izibuko. Bathabatha ngoko isitshixo, bavula izibuko; ke bona, ukumkani wabo walala emthini, efile.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa belindela, uEhude waphuma; wadlula ngaphaya kweempawu, waphuma waya eSeira.
Ke kaloku, xa efika, waphucula intsimbi entlango kaEfrayim. Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli baya phantsi naye entlango; uEhudi ngowokuqala kubo.

Wathi kubo, Mlandeleni mna; ngokuba iNkosi wanikela umkhosi wenu waseMowabhi esandla sam. Baya phantsi ke emva kwakhe, bathabathe iinqanawa zeYorodani ezisuka eMowabhi, abavumelenga nabani na ukuba adlule.
Ke kaloku babulala kumaMowabhi amawaka angamashumi mabini, bonke abo madoda anamandla amakhulu; akukho namnye waphumayo.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini iMowabi yabekwa phantsi kwaSirayeli; ilizwe laphumla iminyaka emashumi asibhozo.
Emva kuka-Ehude kwakukho uShamgare, unyana kaAnate; wabulala amawaka asithandathu ooFilisti ngentambo yenkomo. Wasindisa noSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, emva kokufa kuka-Ehude, babuyela oonyana bakaSirayeli besenza okubi phambi koYehova.
Wabathengisa ke iNkosi kuYabini, ukumkani wakwaKanan, owalawula eHazori; umphathi womkhosi wakhe wayenguSisera, owayehlala eHaroshethi Haggoyim.
USisera wayenazo iinqanawa zentsimbi ezimakhulu asithoba; wabaphazamisa ooSirayeli ngesandla esibi, iminyaka emashumi mabini. Baye bathandaza kuYehova.
Ke kaloku uDebora, umprofeti, umfazi kaLapidothi, waba ngumgwebi kumaSirayeli ngaloo mini.
Waye ehlala phantsi kwepali kaDebora, phakathi kweRama neBheteli, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim. Bafika ke kuye oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba bagqibele iimpazamo zabo.

Wathumela wabiza uBharaki, unyana ka-Abinoham, waseKedesh eNaphtali, wathi kuye, UYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, uthi, Yiya, uhlanganise amadoda amawaka amabini eentsapho zikaNaphtali noZabulon, uwakhuphe emnqamlezweni weTabori.
Ndiya kumtsala uSisera, umphathi womkhosi kaYabhini, namachiza akhe namadoda akhe, kuye emlanjeni weKishon; zvona ndimnika esandla sakho.
Wathi kuye uBharaki, Ukuba uya kuhamba nam, mna ndiya kuhamba; kodwa ukuba awusayi kuhamba nam, andiyi kuhamba.
Wathi uDebora, Kulungile, ndiya kuhamba nawe; kodwa akuyi kubakho ubuhle kuwe kule ndlela; ngokuba iNkosi uya kumnika uSisera indoda. Wahamba ke uDebora noBharaki waya eKedesh.
UBharaki wayalela uZebulon noNafetali ukuba bahlangane eKedeshi. Amawaka amabini amadoda amlandela; waya naye uDebora.
Ke kaloku uHebhere, umKenithi, washiya amaKenithi, oonyana bakaHobab, umyeni kaMoses; wamisa itente yakhe ecaleni komthi omkhulu waseZaanannim, okwiKedesh.
Waxelela ke uSisera ukuba uBharaki, unyana ka-Abinoyam, wanyuka waya emnqamlezweni weTabhore.
Ke kaloku uSisera wabiza zonke iinqanawa zakhe zentsimbi, ezilikhulu elinamashumi asithoba, namadoda akhe onke, esuka eHaroshethi Haggoyim, waya emlanjeni waseKishon.

Wathi uDebora kuBharaki, Yiya; kuba le yimini apho iNkosi wanikela khona uSisera esandla sakho; iNkosi uya kuhamba phambi kwakho. Wahla ke uBharaki emnqamlezweni weTabori, namadoda amawaka alishumi amlandela.
Ke kaloku uBharaki ehamba, iNkosi wamkhulisa uSisera, neemoto zakhe zonke, nemfazwe yakhe, phambi kweqhwa likaBharaki. USisera wehla kwimoto yakhe, waya ngenyawo.
Ke kaloku uBharaki walandela izithuthi zomkhosi, waya eHaroshethe Haggoyim; bonke abantu bakaSisera bafa ngeqhwa; akukho namnye wabaseleyo.
Ke kaloku uSisera wabaleka ngeenyawo waya etentweni kaYayeli, indoda kaHebhere umKenithi; ngokuba kwakukho uxolo phakathi kukaYabhin ukumkani waseHazori nendlu kaHebhere.
Waphuma ke uYayeli, wadibana noSisera, wathi kuye, Yiya, nkosi yam, yiya; musa ukukhathazeka. Wenza ke uSisera ukuba afike etentweni yakhe, wamgubungela ngebhedi.
Wathi, Nceda, ndininike amanzi; kuba mna ndinomkhenkce. Yavula ibhotile yobisi, yamnika ukutya, wamgubungela.
Wathi kuye, Thina emngxunyeni wetente; ukuba umntu efika akubuza, Ukhona na umntu apha? sithi, Akukho.
Ke kaloku uYayeli, umfazi kaHebhere, wathabatha isibonda setente, nomqolo, waya kuye ngenyameko; ke kaloku wayelele ephumle, ethambileyo. Wabeka isibonda engqondweni yakhe emhlaba, waza wafa.

Ke kaloku wafika uBharaki, elandela uSisera. Waphuma uYayeli ukuba amfikelele; wathi, Yiya, ndiza kukuxelela indoda oyifunayo. Wafika ke naye, yabona iSisera ilele phantsi emehlweni akhe, efile, intonga yetente imile ngasemva kwakhe.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini uThixo wabetha uYabini ukumkani wakwaKanan phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Bathi ooSirayeli, beqhubeka benamandla ngoYabin ukumkani wakwaKanan, de bawuphelisa.
UDebora noBharaki unyana ka-Abinoham babhiyozela ngaloo mini ingoma le, besithi:
Xa abathetheli baseSirayeli behamba phambili, Xa abantu benikela ngethemba labo, Niwubule iNkosi.
Ncokolani, ningakumkani; nicinge, ningamagqwetha; ndiza kuvuma iNkosi; ndiza kuvuma iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli.
Nkosi, xa waphuma eSeyiri, xa wawuhamba usuka ezweni laseEdom, ihlabathi latshisa, amazulu akhupha amanzi, amafu akhupha amanzi),
Iintaba zatshisa phambi koYehova, UThixo waseSina, phambi koYehova uThixo kaSirayeli.
Kwiintsuku zikaShamgare unyana kaAnate, kwiintsuku zikaYayeli, izikhululo zeenqwelo-moya zaba zingenanto; abahamba ngezithuthi bahamba ngeendlela ezijikelezayo.
Ubomi basezidolophini baphumle eYiputa; baphumle, de ndifike mna uDeborah, ndeza ndaba ngumntwana eYiputa.
Ke kaloku, bakhetha amadini amatsha; kwathi kufike umkhosi ezingxoweni zesixeko; akufuneki ukuba kubekho isikhuselo okanye isigwebo phakathi kwamawaka amane aseSirayeli.
Intliziyo yam iya kuba ngabaphathi bakaSirayeli, Abamnikelayo ngokwabo phakathi kwabantu. Lombani iNkosi!
Nithi, nina abahamba ngeebhokhwe ezimhlophe, nihlala ngamatye acocekileyo, nani abahamba ngendlela, khumbulani oku!
Ngaphaya kwengxolo yamagqwetha, ezindaweni zokusela amanzi, bachaza izikhululo zikaYehova, izikhululo zabahlali bakhe baseSirayeli. Ke kaloku abantu bakaYehova baya phantsi emasangoni omzi.
Yivule, uyivule, uDeborah! Yivule, uyivule, ubhale ingoma! Yivule, uBharaki, uthabathe abadumileyo bakho, unyana ka-Abinoham.
Ke kaloku abo bambalwa abaseleyo baya phantsi kumadoda amakhulu; abantu bakaYehova baya ezantsi kum, baya kumatye.
Bavela kuEfrayim, abaneentyatyambo zakwaAmaleki; uBhenjamin wafika nabantu bakho emva kwakho; bavela eMakiri abathetheli, nabasuka eZebulon abathabatha isandla somphathi.
Abakumkani baka-Issakare babe noDebora; uIssakare waba noBharaki, ehamba emva kwakhe kwelaseNtshona. Kwiintsapho zakwaRubhen kwakukho ukucinga okuninzi, nokubuza intliziyo.
Kutheni na ke nihlala phakathi kweendawo zokugcina iinkomo, niphulaphule umgcini-bhokhwe ephikisa izimvu zakhe? Kwiintsapho zakwaRubhen kwakuninzi ukukhangela intliziyo.
UGiliyadi wahlala ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani; noDan, kutheni na uhlala phantsi kweenqanawa? UAshere wahlala elwandle, wahlala ezidolophini zawo.
Ke kaloku abantu bakaZebulon babeka ubomi babo emngciphekweni, noNafetali ezindaweni eziphakamileyo.
Bafika ookumkani, bahlasela. Bahlasela ookumkani bakaKanan eThanakhe, ngamanzi aseMegido; kodwa abathathenga igolide.
Ezulu, iinkwenkwezi ziye zahlasela; Kwindlela zabo eziphakamileyo zahlasela uSisera.
Umlambo uKishon wabasusa, umlambo omtsha, umlambo uKishon. Yiya, mphefumlo wam, ube namandla!
Ke kaloku, iinwele zemahashe zatyhila umsindo, xa amakhwenkwe akhe anamandla ehamba, ehamba.
Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova, Lahla iMeroshe; lahla abantu bayo ngokubi kakhulu; ngokuba abafikanga ukuncedisa iNkosi, ukuba bancedise iNkosi kumadoda anamandla.
Ubhaptizwe phakathi kwabafazi uYayeli, indoda kaHebhere waseKeni; ubhaptizwe phakathi kwabafazi abahlala ezindlwini.
Wacela amanzi, wamnika ubisi; wazisa umgubo emlonyeni olungileyo.
Wayitsala ngesandla sakhe isibonda setentile, Ngesandla sayo esikunene umqolo womsebenzi. Wabetha uSisera, watshisa intloko yakhe; Watyhala, waphuca icala leentloko zakhe.
Waba phantsi enyawo lwakhe, wawela, walala khona; waba phantsi enyawo lwakhe, wawela khona; apho wawela khona, apho wawela khona efile.

Uyise kaSisera wajonga ngefestile, wayalela ngasemva kweengcango, wathi, Kutheni na ukuba iinqanawa zakhe zithatha ixesha elide ukubuya? Kutheni na ukuba iinyawo zeenqanawa zakhe zithatha ixesha elide ukuphuma?
Waphendula umfazi wakhe owaziyo, waqhubeka ethetha ngokwakhe,

Baya kufumana, baza bahlukanise iimpahla zabo ezilahlekileyo: indoda nganye ibe nentombazana enye okanye ezimbini; izihlangu ezinombala oqaqambileyo zibe yimpahla yobuxoki kaSisera, nezihlangu ezinemibala ephindwe kabini zibe ziiingubo zobukrelekrele zeentloko zam. Zonke izinto ziya kuba zizigqobhozo.
Ke kaloku, Nkosi yam, bafa bonke abathunywa bakho; ke bona bonke abakuthandayo babe njengelanga, xa liphuma kumandla alo. Kwabakho uxolo kwilizwe iminyaka emashumi mane.
Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli benze okubi emehlweni kaYehova; wabanikela esandla samaMidiyani iminyaka esixhenxe.
Ke kaloku amaMidiyani aye anamandla kakhulu, abe buhlungu kakhulu. Bathi ke ooSirayeli bazenza izifihlakalo eziphakamileyo, nakwiingxowa-mlilo, nasezikhuselweni.
Ke kaloku, xa oonyana bakaSirayeli bekhula iziqhamo zabo, kwafika amaMidiyani, namaAmaleki, namanye amazwe asempumalanga, wabahlasela.
Bathabathela isikhephe kuloo mhlaba, babulala iziqhamo, zafika zisiya eGaza; zingashiya nantoni na ephilayo kuSirayeli ukuba ibe yinyama yokutya, nokuba yinkomo, okanye inkomo, okanye isilwanyana.
Baye benyuka, nabo impahla yabo, neetente zabo, njengamaqela eentyatyambo; abazange bakwazi ukubhalwa, bona neengqekembe zabo; baye befika kuloo lizwe ukuba lilahle.
UMidiyani wabangela ukuba amaSirayeli ahlwempuzeke kakhulu; ke kaloku amaSirayeli ayelela kuYehova.
Ke kaloku batsho oonyana bakaSirayeli kuYehova ngenxa kaMidiyani.
wathumela kubo umprofeti, wathi, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Ndinikhuphe eYiputa, kwilizwe lendlu yobulungisa.
Ndabakhusela esandla samaYiputa, nasezandla zazo zonke izithunywa zenu; ndabazikhupha phambi kwenu, ndabanika ilizwe labo.
Ndathi kuni, Ndiye ndinguYehova uThixo wenu; musa ukukhonza amadini eAmori, ilizwe labo nihlala kulo; kodwa ningandiphulaphuli.

Wafika ke umbingeleli kaYehova, wahlala phantsi komthi omkhulu we-oyile eOfra, owanguYowashe, owaseAbhiezer; waza uGideyon, unyana wakhe, wayetshisa ingqolowa emngxunyeni, ukuze ayifihla kumaMidiyani.
Wabonakala ke umbingeleli kaYehova kuGideyon, wathi, UYehova unguwe, mntu onamandla.

Waphendula ke uGideyon, wathi, Ndicela, nkosi yam; ukuba iNkosi unguthixo wethu, kutheni le nto ezi zinto zonke zithe zathiwa kuthi? Zithini na zonke ezo zinto zimangalisayo ebezithetha ngazo izizukulwana zethu, besithi, UYehova awasikhuphanga njani eYiputa? Ke ngoku iNkosi usishiye, wasinika kumaMidiyani.
Wabuyela kuye iNkosi, wathi, Yiya ngobukrelekrele bakho, usindise amaSirayeli ebantwini bakaMidiyani; mna ndikuthumelele.
Wathi ke uGideyon, Ndicela, Nkosi yam; ndiya kusindisa njani amaSirayeli? Ngokuba intsapho yam incinci kakhulu eManase, mna ke ndimncinane kwindlu yam.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Kuba ndiya kuba nawe; uya kuwabulala bonke amaMidiyani, njengendoda eyodwa.
Wathi ke uGideyon kuye, Ukuba mna ndithe ndabonakele phambi kwakho, nceda undinike uphawu, ukuba nguwe othetha nam.
Nceda, musa ukushiya, de ndibuyele, ndithabathe umnikelo wam, ndiwubeke phambi kwakho. Wathi ke iNkosi, Ndiya kuhlala, de ubuye.

Ke kaloku uGideyon waya ngaphakathi, wapheka inkunzi yebhokhwe encinci; waza wenza izitya ezingabikho manzi ezili-10 zesilivere zomgubo. Wabeka inyama entolongweni, nesonka esingenanto emngxunyeni, wazikhupha kwangaphandle kuye umthunywa phantsi komthi weoyile, wayinikela.
Wathi kuye umbingeleli kaThixo, Yithathe inyama nesonka, uzibeke phezu kwalo mthi, uthele isonka. UGideyon wakwenza njalo.
Uthe ke umbingeleli kaYehova, ngentlawulelo yentsimbi esandla sakhe, watshisa inyama nesonka; kwaphuma umlilo emthini, watshisa inyama nesonka. Ke kaloku umbingeleli kaYehova wahamba.
Ke kaloku uGideyon, xa ebona ukuba yintsingiselo kaYehova, watsho wathi, Hayi, Nkosi yethu uThixo! Ndiye ndayibona intsingiselo kaYehova ngobuso nobuso;
Wathi ke iNkosi kuye, Uxolo; musa ukukhathazeka; awuyi kufa.
Ke kaloku uGideyon walungisa khona isibingelelo kuYehova, wayibiza ngokuba yiNkosi yoxolo; ihlala mihla le eOfra yama-Abhiezer.

Wathi ke iNkosi kuye ngaloo busuku, Yithathe inkunzi yenkomo kayise wakho, inkunzi encinane yesibini, eneminyaka ilishumi elinesixhenxe; udibanise isibingelelo sikaBahali, esingudade wakho, uyicime i-Ashere ecaleni kwayo.

Yakha ke isibingelelo esifanelekileyo kuYehova uThixo wakho, phezulu kuloo ndawo iphakamileyo; uze uthathe inkunzi yenkomo yesibini, uyilungiselele ibe yisonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, ngemithi yomthi we-Ashere oza kuyitshisa.

Wathi ke uGideyon, wathabatha abantu abalishumi abakhonzi bakhe, wamenza njengokuba wathi kuye iNkosi. Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba wayexhalabile ngosapho lwakhe namadoda edolophu yakhe, wakwenza ngaloo busuku, akwenzenga ngaloo mhla.

Ke kaloku, bavuka abantu balo mzi emveni kwemini, babona ukuba isibingelelo sikaBhaali siqhutywe phantsi, ne-ashere ebekwe ngaphaya kwayo itshelelwe; inkunzi yebhokhwe yesithathu yanikezelwa kwisibingelelo esitsha.
Bathi ke omnye komnye, Nguwuphi na owenza loo nto? Ke kaloku bakhangela, babuza ngazo zonke iinkalo; kwathiwa kubo, UGideyon unyana kaYowashe wayenza.
Bathi amadoda edolophini kuYowashe, Thoba unyana wakho ngaphandle, ukuba aphile; ngokuba waphula isibingelelo sikaBhaali, wabetha i-ashere esembindini wayo.

Wathi ke uYowashe kubo bonke abasecaleni kwakhe, Niya kulwa noBhaali na? Nifuna ukumsindisa na? Nabani na ozama ukuhlasela uBhaali uya kufa phambi kwemini; ukuba nguThixo uBhaali, akwazi ukuzikhusela, xa kuqhutywa isibingelelo sakhe.
Wabizwa uGideyon ngaloo mini ngegama elithi Yerubabhali, ngokuba waphula isibingelelo sikaBhali.
Ke kaloku bonke amaMidiyani, namaAmaleki, namadoda asempuma, bahlangana ndawonye; badlula iJordan, bamisa iintaba eNtaba kaYizreyeli.
Wafika uMoya kaYehova kuGideyon; waphucula intsimbi, wababiza ooAbhiezeri ukuba balandele.
Wathumela abathunywa kuwo onke amaYuda aseManase, awazibiza ukuba balandele kuye; kwakunye noAshere, noZebuloni, noNafetali. Baye ke baya kumnqamla.
Wathi uGideyon kuThixo, Ukuba ufuna ukusindisa amaSirayeli ngesandla sam, njengokuba watshoyo,

Ndiyabona, ndiza kubeka iinwele zesundu kwindawo yokuhlambela; ukuba ubisi luya kubakho kwiinwele zosundu kuphela, yaye yonke indawo ejikeleze kuyo iya kutshisa; ngoko ndiza kwazi ukuba uya kusindisa amaSirayeli ngesandla sam, njengoko uthe wathi.
Yathi ke loo nto. Wavuka uGideyon emveni kwemini, watshisa iinwele zoboya, watshisa phantsi umkhenkce, ibhotile yonke yamanzi.

Wathi ke uGideyon kuThixo, Musa ukuba nobuxoki kum; ndiza kukucela into enye kuphela: ndiza kukuvavanya iinwele zomvu kathathu, ndizitshise iinwele zempuphu ngale xesha, ndize ndenze ilizwe libe limanzi.
Ke kaloku uThixo wenza njalo ngaloo busuku; iinkomo kuphela ezishiyekileyo, zonke izityalo zehlabathi zazithe tyaba.

Ke kaloku uYerubhi-bhahali, lowo nguGideyon, wavuka ekuseni, yena namadoda akhe onke, wamisa inqaba elwandle lweHarodi. Inqaba yamaMidiyani yaba ngasentshonalanga yabo, elunxwemeni, ecaleni komthi kaMore.
Wathi iNkosi kuGideyon, Uninzi kakhulu abantu bakho kum, ukuba ndibanikezele amaMidiyani esandla sabo; ukuze abaSirayeli bangabhiyozela kum, besithi, Sisindisiwe ngumandla wethu.

Ke kaloku, bhala kuloo mkhosi, usithi: Wonke umntu okhathazekile noxinzelelweyo abuyisele umva esuka emnqamlezweni kaGiliyadi. Baye ke abantu abamashumi mabini anesibini amawaka babuyela ekhaya labo; kwahlala amadoda angamakhulu asixhenxe.

Wathi iNkosi kuGideyon, Bakhona abantu abaninzi kakhulu; ubakhuphe phantsi emanzini, ndiya kubabalalisa khona kuwe. Ukuba ndithi, Lo mntu uya kuhamba nawe, lo mntu uya kuhamba; kodwa ukuba ndithi, Lo mntu awusayi kuhamba nawe, lo mntu awusayi kuhamba.
Wathi ke uGideyon wabakhupha amadoda aya emanzini; wathi ke kuye iNkosi, Yahlula abo batyhala amanzi ngeelwimi zabo, njengokuba yenza ikati, nalabo abaguquguqukayo ukusela.
Abafazi abamakhulu mathathu bahlambela amanzi, bewazisa ngezandla zabo emlonyeni wabo; bonke abo baphelelwe ngamanzi bahlambela.
Wathi iNkosi kuGideyon, Ndiza kunisindisa ngamadoda amawaka amathathu alahlekayo, ndibamise ooMidiyani esandla sakho; onke amanye ahambe endlwini yakhe.
Ke kaloku uGideyon wathumela amaSirayeli amanye endlwini yabo, wagcina abo bamakhulu mathathu; baya kuthatha isonka sabo, neembombo zabo. Iqela lakwaMidiyani liphantsi kwakhe elunxwemeni.
Wathi iNkosi kuye uGideyon ngaloo busuku, Yiya phantsi, uthabathe umkhosi; ngokuba ndiwumise esandla sakho.
Ukuba ke uyaxoka, uthabathe noPurha, umkhonzi wakho, uye emkhosini.
Yiva ke into abathethayo; emva koko uza kuhlala unamandla, uze uhlasele icamp. Wahla ke yena noPurha, umkhonzi wakhe, waya esiphelweni secamp, apho kwakukho amagwebu.

Ke kaloku amaMidiyani, nama-Amaleki, namadoda onke asempumalanga, aye ehlathini, afana neengcambu ezininzi; iinkomo zawo zazininzi njengengxubevange esembindini wolwandle; akukho mntu wayekwazi ukuzibala.

Wafika ke uGideyon, kwathi umntu ethetha nephupho lakhe kumhlobo wakhe, wathi, Ndaphupha; yabona ibhotile yesonka esijikelezayo sesheyibhi siphuma, sijika-jika sisiya kwisiqithi samaMidiyani, sabetha intela, ibe le ntela iqhutywa, yawela.
Waphendula udade wakhe, wathi, Akukho nto leyo ngaphandle kwekrele likaGideyon, unyana kaYowashe, umSirayeli; uThixo wanikela esandlani sakhe amaMidiyani neqela lonke.
Ke kaloku, xa uGideyon eva iphupho, nokuqonda kwayo, wahlangula, wamkhonza uThixo; wabuyela emkhosini wakwaSirayeli, wathi, Yiya phezulu; ngokuba iNkosi usindise iqela lakwaMidiyani esandla sam.
Wawahlula amadoda angamakhulu amathathu abe ziindidi ezintathu, wamnika umntu ngamnye isidumbu, nebhotile yodonga elingenanto, enesitshizi somlilo ngaphakathi.
Wathi kubo, Nceda nindibone, niyenze njengoko ndiyenzayo; xa ndifika ekugqibeleni kwethutyana, nikwenze ngokufanayo noko ndikwenzayo.
Xa ndithi, mna nabo bonke abahamba nam, siphume ngeebhokhwe zethu, niphume ke nina ngeebhokhwe zenu, ndawonye, ejikeleze ithamsanqa lonke, nitshoni, Yiya kuYehova noGideyon.

Wafika ke uGideyon, namadoda amawaka aye naye, esiphelweni sethuthi, ekuqalekeni kwesiqingatha sobusuku, emva kokuba kutshintshwe abakhuseli; baphucula izidumbu zabo, batshisa iinkomo ezisezandla zabo.

Ke kaloku amaqela onke mathathu aphucula izidumbu zawo, atshisa iibhotile zakhe; ezandla zabo ezikhohlo bezinezithunywa, emehlweni abo ekunene bezinezidumbu; batsho bathi, Ikhephe likaYehova noGideyon.
Wahlala umntu ngamnye kwindawo yakhe, ejikeleze inqaba; lonke iqela lakwaMidiyani labaleka, livutha, lithutha.

Ke kaloku, xa izidumbu ezimakhulu mathathu zaphuka, iNkosi wakwenza ukuba abantu abasenyuvesi batshintshe iikrwada zabo ngazo zonke iintlanga; amaqela asuka esiya eBhete-shitha, esiya eZerera, waya emngxunyeni kaAbele-mehola, eTabhathi.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli asuka eNaphtali, noAshere, nabo bonke uManase, babizwa, balandela ooMidiyani.

Ke kaloku uGideyon wathumela abathunywa kuwo onke amagalelo aseEfrayim, esithi, Nciphisaneni nabaMidiyani, niyithathe amanzi eYorodani phambi kwabo, ukuya eBhat-bara. Babizwa ke bonke amadoda aseEfrayim, bathatha amanzi eYorodani, waya eBhat-bara;

Bathabathe abathetheli ababini bakaMidiyani, uOrebhi noZebhebi; babulala uOrebhi esiqwini sikaOrebhi, noZebhebi esiqwini sewayini sikaZebhebi; balandela amaMidiyani, bazisa iinwele zikaOrebhi noZebhebi kuGideyon, owayekwiJordan.
Bathi oonyana bakaEfrayim kuGideyon, Yintoni le nto usenza ngayo loo nto kuthi? Kutheni na ukuba ungasibizanga, xa wasiya ukuhlasela amaMidiyani? Baye bamqwalasela ngoxolo.
Wabaphendula wathi kubo, Ndiyenze ntoni na ndifana nani? Iinkomo eziseleyo zikaEfrayim aziyi kuba zingcono na kunazo zonke iinkomo zosapho lwam, uAbhiezer?
UThixo wabeka esandla sam uOrebe noZebhe, abathetheli bakaMidiyani; ndingakwenza ntoni na ndifana nani? Ke kaloku, xa wayethetha loo nto, bamisa intloko yabo kuye.
Ke kaloku uGideyon waya eYordan, wadlula, yena namadoda akhe amawaka amathathu. Baye balahleka, ke bona balandela.
Wathi kubo amadoda aseSukoti, Nceda ninikele oonyana bam isonka; ngokuba baphelelwe lukhulu, ndithi ke ndiya kulandela uZebha noSalmuna, abakumkani bakaMidiyan.
Bathi ke abathetheli baseSukoti, Ngaba sele uthabathe uZebha noSalmunna? Siza kunikela nini isonka kumajoni akho?
Wathi uGideyon, Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi enika isandla sam kuZebha noZalmuna, ndiya kukutyhila inyama yenu ngeentyatyambo zesi Izulu neentyatyambo zamatye.
Ke kaloku wanyuka waya ePhenuyeli, wababuza ngokunjalo; babemphendula ngokufanayo namadoda aseSukoti.
Wathi ke kumadoda asePhenuyeli, Xa ndithe ndabuya ngokukhuselekileyo, ndiya kuyiphula le ntlambo.

Ke kaloku uZebha noSalmuna babe eKarkore, nabo banemfazwe elimalunga namawaka alishumi elinambini; abo bonke abaseleyo kumfazwe wamaSirayeli asempumalanga; kuba kwabulawa amawaka amakhulu amabini anamashumi amabini, abantu abanesandla esinamandla.
Ke kaloku uGideyon wanyuka ngendlela yabahlali beentlanganiso, ekumzantsi-mpuma weNobha neYogbheha; wahlasela iqela lakwaSirayeli ngokungxamisekileyo, baziva bekhuselekile.
Ke kaloku uZebha noZalmuna, abakumkani ababini bakaMidiyan, babaleka; wabaphulaphula, wathabathela kubo, waphazamisa lonke iqela labo.
Ke kaloku uGideyon, unyana kaYowashe, wabuyela emfazweni, ekungeneni kweHeres.
Wathabatha unyana omncinane waseSukoti, wambuza; wabhala kuye loo mntwana amagama eenkosi zaseSukoti, nabakhulu bayo, abamashumi asixhenxe anesibhozo.
Wafika ke uGideyon kubomi baseSukoti, wathi, Fumana uZebha noZalmuna! Nindixolele ngenxa yabo, nisithi, UZebha noZalmuna niwathathele na? Ngaba siza kubanika isonka abantu bakho abaxakekileyo?
Wathabathela amadoda amakhulu edolophini, wafundisa abantu baseSukothi, wabagweba ngamatye entlango neengcambu.
Wakhupha phantsi itower yasePhenuyeli, wabulala amadoda edolophini.
Wabuza ke uZebha noSalmuna, wathi, Bathini na abo madoda niwabulalayo eTabori? Baphendula bathi, Bafana nani; babonakala ngathi ngunyana wokumkani.
Wathi uGideyon, Babebazalwana bam, oonyana boyise wam; njengoko iNkosi ephilayo, ukuba nibagcinele ubomi zvona, andizange ndikubulala.
Wabuyela kuYetere, unyana wakhe omkhulu, wathi, Babulala. Ke kaloku uYetere akazange asuse ikrele lakhe; ngokuba wayeyintombi, wakhathazeka.
Ke kaloku uZebha noSalmuna bathi, Yiya, yenza ngokwakho; kuba umntu uhukumwa ngumandla wakhe. Wafika ke uGideyon, wababulala, wathabatha iinkunzi zenyanga ezingxoweni zeenkomo zabo.
Bathi ke amadoda aseSirayeli kuGideyon, Uza kuba ngukumkani kuthi wena, nonyana wakho, nonyana wonyana wakho; ngokuba usisindisile eMidiyani.
Wathi ke kubo uGideyon, Andiyi kuba ngukumkani wenu mna, naye unyana wam angaba ngukumkani kwenu; iNkosi uya kuba ngukumkani wenu.
Wathi ke, Ndinesicelo esinye: Nindinike nizo zonke izikhonkwane zeentyatyambo zegolide, ezisuka kwizinto eninikwe ngazo emfazweni. Kuye kwaba yinkcubeko yama-Ishmayeli ukugqoka izikhonkwane zegolide.
Baphendula bathi, Siza kuzinika ngokuvuyisayo. Bathi ke ke, bakhupha iingubo; umntu ngamnye wabeka phezu kwazo isiqingatha seentyatyambo zakhe zegolide.

Ke kaloku ubunzima beentyatyambo zegolide, awazicelayo, babe ngamasentimitha amabini anamashumi mabini; ngaphandle kwezityalo, nezikhonkwane, nezihlangu ezingwevu, ababezigqoka ookumkani baseMidiyani, neengxowa-mali ezinxibe iinkomo zazo.

Ke kaloku uGideyon wayenza le golide ibe yi-ephod, ibhanti lombingeleli; wayibeka eOfra, emzini wakhe. Bathi ke bonke amaSirayeli baphulaphule umyalelo kaThixo, beyamkhonza khona loo nto; yaba yintombi kuGideyon nosapho lwakhe.
Ke kaloku abaMidiyani bahlaselwa ngamadoda aseSirayeli, bengenakuvuka kwakhona. Kwabakho uxolo ezweni minyaka imashumi mane ngemihla kaGideyon.
Ke kaloku uYerubahali, unyana kaYowashe, wabuyela endlwini yakhe, wahlala.
Ke kaloku uGideyon wayeneenonyana abamashumi asixhenxe aphuma emlonyeni wakhe; ngokuba waba neentombi ezininzi.
Wazala unyana nomyeni wakhe, owayehlala eShekem; wathi igama lakhe nguAbhimeleki.
Wafa ke uGideyon, unyana kaYowashe, eneminyaka emihle yobudala; wabanjwa esibhedlele sikaYowashe uyise, eOfra yamaAbhiezer.
Ke kaloku, xa uGideyon efa, abaSirayeli baphinde babuya bekhohlakele kuThixo, bakhonza amaBhaali; bakwenza uBhaali-berithi ibe nguThixo wabo.
Balibala iNkosi uThixo wabo, owabasindisela kumagosa abo onke ajikeleze kubo.
Ke kaloku abazange bathembeke kwindlu kaYerubahali, uGideyon, ngenxa yezinto zonke ezilungileyo awazenzayo kumaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uAbhimeleki, unyana kaYerubahali, waya kubazalwana benkosi yakhe eShekem; wathi kubo, nakulo lonke ikhaya lenkosi yakhe, esithi,

Nceda nibuze bonke abantu baseShekem, nithi, Yintoni engcono kuni? Ukuba noonyana bakaYerubahali abamashumi asixhenxe onke babe ngukumkani wenu, okanye umntu omnye abe ngukumkani wenu? Khumbulani ukuba mna ndinyama yenu negazi lenu;
Bathi oonyana bakamama wakhe kubo bonke abantu baseShekem zonke ezi zinto; balandela uAbhimeleki, ngokuba bathi, Ngumhlobo wethu.
Bamnika uAbhimeleki izinto zesilivere ezimashumi asixhenxe, zasuka endlwini kaBhaali-berithi. Waziqesha ngazo iinkunzi zeenkomo, abantu abakhohlakeleyo; balandela yena.

Wafika endlwini kayise, eOfra, wabulala abazalwana bakhe abamashumi asixhenxe, oonyana bakaYerubabhi-bhaali, phezu kwelitye elinye. UYothame ke, unyana omncinane kaYerubabhi-bhaali, waphuma wafihlakela.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu baseShekem, neBhete-Milo, bahlangana phantsi komthi omkhulu okwindawo ephakamileyo eseShekem, babe ngukumkani uAbhimeleki.
Wathi ke uYothama, xa kuthe kwaziswa loo nto kuye, wanyuka waya phezulu komnqamlezo wentaba kaGerizim, wathi kubo ngezwi elikhulu, Nindixeleleni, nina abathetheli baseShekem, ukuze Thixo anixelele.
Imini enye zaphuma izityalo, ukuba zikhethe ukumkani kubo; zathi kumthi weoli yeoli: Uyikumkani kuthi.
Wathi ke kum umthi weoli, Ndiyishiye na ioli yam, endiyinika uThixo nobantu, ndiye ndahamba ndiqhutywe phezu kwemithi?
Zathi izityalo kumthi we-ficus, Yiza ube ngukumkani kuthi.
Waphendula ke umthi womnquma wathi kubo, Ndiya kushiya na utywala lwam olumnandi noluhle, ndihambe ndihamba phezulu kumatye?
Zathi izityalo kwisityalo somnquma, Yiza ube ngukumkani kuthi.
Wathi ke umnquba kuye, Ndiyishiye na iwayini yam entsha, eyonwabisayo amadini namadoda, ndiye ndazihamba ngaphezu kwemithi?
Ke kaloku imithi yonke yathi kumthi wesiqhamo, Yiza ube ngukumkani kuthi.
Wathi umnqamlezo kumatye, Ukuba mna ngokwenene ndingukumkani wenu, niza niphumle phantsi kwesithunzi sam; kodwa ukuba akunjalo, umlilo uphume kumnqamlezo, utshise iikedari zaseLibanoni.
Ke ngoko, ngaba wenza ngokuchanekileyo, ngokholo olulungileyo, usenza uAbhimeleki ukumkani? Ngaba wakwenza okulungileyo kuYerubhayeli nosapho lwakhe? Ingaba wenza kuye njengoko wayefanele?
Khumbula ukuba utata wam wahlasela ngenxa yenu, wabeka ubomi bakhe emngciphekweni, ukuze akusindise ebantwini bakaMidiyani.

Ke nina, namhlanje, nibuyele endlwini yoyise wam, nibulala oonyana bakhe abamashumi asixhenxe phezu kodonga olunye, nakwenza uAbhimeleki, unyana womkhonzi wakhe, ukuba abe ngukumkani wabahlali baseShekem, ngokuba ungumhlobo wenu.
Ke ngoko, ukuba nisebenze ngokunyanisekileyo nangokuthembekileyo kuYerubahali nosapho lwakhe namhlanje, nithandeni ke uAbhimeleki, naye athandeni nani.
Ke kaloku, ukuba akunjalo, umlilo uphume kuAbhimeleki, uwutshise wonke umntu waseShekem noweBhete-milo. Umlilo uphume kuwo onke abantu baseShekem noweBethe-milo, uwutshise wonke umntu kaAbhimeleki.
Wabaleka ke uYotam, waphuma waya eBheri, wahlala khona; kuba wayemthanda uAbhimeleki, umzalwana wakhe.
UAbhimeleki waba ngukumkani kuSirayeli iminyaka emithathu.
Wathumela ke uThixo umphefumlo ombi, wamisa ingxaki phakathi kuka-Abhimeleki namadoda aseShekem; babuya behlasela uAbhimeleki.
Wakwenza oko uThixo, ukuze igazi labo, elibulala oonyana bakaYerubahali abamashumi asixhenxe, libuyiselwe kuAbhimeleki, umzalwana wabo, lowo wababulalayo, nakubantu baseShekem, abo bamncedayo.
Ke kaloku, abahlali baseShekem bamisa abantu eziphakameni zeentaba, ukuba babezikhusela kuye; bonke abadlulayo ngaphaya kwabo, babatyhala. Kwathi kwaziswa uAbhimeleki loo nto.
Ke kaloku uGaali, unyana kaEbedi, waya eShekem nabazalwana bakhe; abahlali baseShekem bathembela kuye.
Ke kaloku baphuma emasimini, bathabathe iziqhamo zazo, bazitshise, babhiyozela; bafika endlwini kaThixo wabo, badla, basela, baphulaphula uAbhimeleki.

Wathi ke uGaali, unyana kaEbedi, Nguwuphi uAbhimeleki? Nguwuphi uShekem, ukuba sisebenze kuye? Akunjalo na ukuba ngunyana kaYerubahali? UZebulon akanguye na umphathi wakhe? Nceda nisebenze kusapho lukaHamori, uyise kaShekem! Sisebenze njani kuAbhimeleki?
Yaye wathi ku-Abhimeleki, Zihlanganise zonke iinqanawa zakho, uphume. Wathi ke uAbhimeleki ku-Abhimeleki, Ndiyakuthanda ukuba aba bantu babe ngasemva kwam; ndibakhuphe.
Ke kaloku uZebulon, umphathi womzi, wayeva amazwi kaGaali unyana ka-Ebedi, waxoka kakhulu.
Wathumela abathunywa kuye uAbhimeleki ngokufihlakeleyo, esithi, Yabona, uGahali unyana kaEbedi nabazalwana bakhe zvola iShekem; bona bakhulisa lo mzi phezu kwakho.
Ke ngoko, namhlanje ngemini, wena namadoda akho nifike nifihle emasimini.
Ngomso, xa ilanga liphuma, uhlasele lo mzi. Xa uGaali namadoda akhe ephuma ukukuhlasela, wenze kubo konke okusemandleni akho;
Waphuma ke uAbhimeleki, naye wonke umkhosi wakhe, ngobusuku, wafihla eShekem, waba ziindidi ezine.
Ke kaloku uGaali, unyana ka-Ebedi, waphuma waya phantsi, wahlala ekungeneni kwesango ledolophu; ke kaloku uAbhimeleki nesingabo zakhe zaphuma ezifihlakeleni.
Wababona ke uGaali, wathi kuZebulon, Yabona, abantu bekhupha phantsi ukusuka emazantsi entaba. Waphendula uZebulon wathi, Ubona izithunzi zeentaba, ucinga ukuba zimadoda;
Waphendula ke uGaali, wathi, Yabona abantu bephuma emazantsi elizwe; iqela elinye livela kwindlela yentyatyambo yamaNgqina kaYehova.
Wathi ke uZebulon kuye, Yintoni na ngoku ilizwi lakho elikhulu, osithiyo, Uthini na uAbhimeleki, ukuba sisebenze naye? Ingaba akunjalo abo bantu abawenzileyo intloko yakho? Yiya kulwa nabo.
Waphuma ke uGaali, wabeka phantsi abantu bakaShekem, bahlasela uAbhimeleki.
Ke kaloku uAbhimeleki wamlandela, waza uGaali wabaleka; babulawa abantu abaninzi, baba phantsi kude kube kukungena kwesango.
Wahlala ke uAbhimeleki eAruma; waza uZebulu wakhupha uGaali nabazalwana bakhe eShekem, ukuba bangahlali khona.
Kwathi ke ngomhla olandelayo, abantu bakaShekem baphuma ezweni; kwaziswa uAbhimeleki.
Wathi ke, athabathe amadoda akhe, wabahlula abe ziindidi ezintathu, wafihla ezweni. Ke kaloku wayebona abantu bephuma emzini, wavuka, wahlasela.
Ke kaloku uAbhimeleki, neentsapho zakhe, zahamba, zamisa indawo ekungeneni kwesango ledolophu. Zathi ke iintsapho ezimbini zahlasela abo basemaphandleni, zababulala.
Wahlasela uAbhimeleki lo mzi ngaloo mini yonke, wawuthatha, wambulala wonke umntu ohlala kulo; waza waphula loo mzi, wayitywina ngamanzi.
Ke kaloku, abathetheli abakwintloko yaseShekem bayazi loo nto, bafika endlwini kaThixo kaBherithi, apho kukhuselwe khona.
Wava ke uAbhimeleki ukuba bahlangana apho.
Wanyuka ke, yena namadoda akhe onke; wathabatha umqolo, wamisa iziqhamo, wazibeka emlenzeni wakhe. Wathi kumadoda aye naye, Yiya, niyenze loo nto mna nindibona ndiyenzayo.

Ke kaloku bonke abantu bathabathe iziqhamo, balandela uAbhimeleki; babezibeka phezu kwendlu ekhuselekileyo, bayitshisa ngomlilo, nayo yonke into engaphakathi kuyo. Bafa ke bonke abantu abakwintloko kaShekem, amashumi amawaka amadoda namadoda.
Ke kaloku uAbhimeleki waya eTebhesi, wayijikeleza, wayithatha.
Ke kaloku kwakukho inqaba eqinileyo ngaphakathi komzi; bonke amadoda namabhinqa asemzini athabathela kuwo, batshixisa iinqanawa zabo, benyuka phezulu kwintlambo yenqaba.
Ke kaloku uAbhimeleki waya kwintombi, wayihlasela; wafika ke ekungeneni kwentombi, ukuze ayitshise ngomlilo.
Umfazi omnye wakhupha iithayile ezikhulu zokutshiza phezu kwentloko yakhe, waza waphula intliziyo yakhe.
Ke kaloku wayalela ngokukhawuleza unyana wakhe ophethe izithuthi zakhe, wathi kuye, Sula ikrele lakho, ndibulala; ukuze abantu bangathi, Umfazi wambulala. Unyana wakhe ke wamtshisa, waza wafa.
Ke kaloku, xa amadoda aseSirayeli ebona ukuba uAbhimeleki ufile, aye kuwo onke amaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uThixo wambuyisela kuAbhimeleki ububi bakhe, obuwenzayo kuyise, ngokubulala abazalwana bakhe abamashumi asixhenxe.
Ke kaloku uThixo wabahlawulisa amadoda aseShekem konke ububi babo; kwathi kwafika phezu kwabo isibingelelo sikaYothamu, unyana kaYerubahali.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku zikaAbhimeleki, wavuka uThola, unyana kaPhuha, unyana kaDodo, wabasindisa amaSirayeli; wayeseSizwe sika-Isayakare, waya eShamire, entlango kaEfraim.
Waba ngumgwebi wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mabini anamithathu; wafa, wabanjwa eShamire.
Emva kwakhe waphuma uYaire, umGiliyadi; waba ngumgwebi wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mabini anesibini.
Waba neentombi ezimashumi mathathu, zihamba ngeebhokhwe ezilishumi elinambini; balawula izixeko ezilishumi elinambini eGiliyadi. Ezi zibizwa ngokuba ziidolophu zikaYaire, kude kube namhlanje.
Wafa ke uYaire, wabulawa eKamoni.

Baye ke oonyana bakaSirayeli beqhubeka besenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; bakhonza amaBhaali, neeAshtorethi, namadini aseAram, naseSidon, naseMowabhi, nabaseAmmon, nabaseFilisti. Bashiya iNkosi, bangawusebenzisi.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxolela amaSirayeli, wawathengisa kumaFilisti namaAmmoniti.
Ke kaloku ngowonyaka lowo, izizwe ezo zazingca amaSirayeli; zineminyaka elishumi elinamithandathu zazingca ooSirayeli bonke abahlala ngasentshonalanga yeYorodani, eGiliyadi, ilizwe lamaAmore.
Ke kaloku badlula oonyana baka-Ammon iJordan, ukuba badibane noYuda, noBhenjamin, noEfrayim; amaSirayeli ahlupheka kakhulu.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuye iNkosi, besithi, Sikhe sazinikele kuwe; sishiye uThixo wethu, sakhonza amaBaali.
Waphendula iNkosi wathi, Xa amaYiputa, namaAmori, namaAmmonita, namaFilisti,
Amadoda aseSidoni, namadoda aseAmaleki, namadoda aseMahoni, athabathe iinwele zenu; nani ke nitsho kuni kum: Andikusindisi na ebantwini babo?
Ke nina nindishiye, nikhonza amadini athile; ngoko ke ndiza kukusindisa nangakumbi.
Yiya, utsho kuThixo owazikhethileyo; akufuneki ukuba akusindise ngexesha lengxaki yakho!
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuYehova, Siphelele; senze kuthi konke okulungileyo emehlo akho; kodwa ngoku nceda usisindise.
Basusa ke phakathi kwabo amadini angaphandle, bakhonza iNkosi; akakwazi iNkosi ukumelana nokubona ukuba abaSirayeli begula.
Babizwa oonyana baka-Ammon, bamisa itente eGiliyadi. Bahlangana ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bamisa itente eMizpa.
Bathi abathetheli bamaGiliyadi omnye kunye, Nabani na oza kuqala ukuhlasela oonyana baka-Ammon, uya kuba ngukumkani kubo bonke abahlali baseGiliyadi.
UYefeta waseGiliyadi waba ngumfazi onamandla; uYifeta wayenguGiliyadi ubaba wakhe, umkakhe ke wayengumfana onesondo.
Ke kaloku umfazi kaGiliyadi wamzala oonyana; baba mkhulu ke umfazi wakhe, bamkhupha uYefta. Bathi kuye, Awuza kuba nenxalenye yosapho lwethu, ngokuba ungunyana womnye umntu.
Ke kaloku uYefeta wabaleka abazalwana bakhe, waya kuhlala ezweni laseTobhi. Bahlangana naye abantu ababi kakhulu, baphuma nabo zvola.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, bafika oonyana baka-Ammon behlasela amaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku kwathi ke, abakhulu baseGiliyadi bahamba, ukuba babuyele uYefeta ezweni laseTobhi.
Bathi kuye, Yiza ube ngukumkani wethu, ukuze sife nabantwana baka-Ammon.
Wathi kubo uYefeta, Mna, ningandixoki na, nindikhuphe endlwini yoyise wam? Nivela ntoni na kum namhlanje, xa nikwingxaki?
Bathi ke amadoda amakhulu eGiliyadi kuye, Yiyo loo nto sibuyela kuwe ngoku; ndiza nathi, sibhideze oonyana baka-Ammon, nawe ube ngukumkani kubo bonke abahlali baseGiliyadi.
Wathi uYefeta, Ukuba ke mna ndiya kubuyela ukuba ndibe nokulwa nabantwana baka-Ammon, yaye iNkosi wandinika bona, ngaba ndiza kuba ngukumkani wenu?
Bathi oombingeleli baseGiliyadi, UYehova ungumqondiso phakathi kwethu; ngokuqinisekileyo siza kwenza ngokwelizwi lakho.
Wahamba ke uYefeta nabakhulu baseGiliyadi; abantu bakwenza ukuba abe ngumlawuli wabo, abe ngukumkani wabo. Wathetha ke onke amagama akhe phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Wathumela ke uYefeta abathunywa kukumkani weenyana baka-Ammon, esithi, Unantoni na phakathi kwam nowe, ukuba uya kungena ukuhlasela ilizwe lam?
Waphendula ukumkani wama-Ammon abathunywa bakaYefeta, wathi, Xa amaSirayeli enyuka eYiputa, bathabathe ilizwe lam ukusuka eArnoni waya eYabhoki, nakwiJordan yonke; ngoku ke, uyibuyisele ngoxolo.
Ke kaloku uYefeta wathumela abathunywa kuye ukumkani wamaAmmon, wathi,
wathi, Itsho loo nto uYefeta: AmaSirayeli akayi kuthatha ilizwe lakwaMowabhi, okanye ilizwe lamaAmmon.
Ke kaloku, xa amaSirayeli aphuma eYiputa, badlula emhlabathini, befike elwandle oluMnyama, bafika eKadeshe.

Wathumela ke uSirayeli abathunywa ukumkani waseEdom, esithi, Nceda usivumele sidlule ezweni lakho. Ukumkani waseEdom akawuphulaphuli; bathumela kukumkani wakwaMowabi ngelizwi elifanayo; wayeka naye. Wahlala ke uSirayeli eKadeshe.

Ke kaloku bahamba ngeendawo ezifihlakeleyo, bejikeleza ilizwe laseEdom nelizwe laseMowabhi; badlula ecaleni elisentshonalanga lakwaMowabhi, bamisa iintaba ngaphaya kweArnoni. Abangangeni ezweni leMowabhi, ngokuba uArnoni ungumda wabo.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli athumela abathunywa kuSihon ukumkani wamaAmori, owalawula eHeshbon, besithi kuye, Nceda sihambe ngelizwe lakho siye kwindawo yethu.
Ke kaloku uSihon akakholwanga kuSirayeli ukuba ahambe kwelakhe ilizwe; wathabatha wonke umkhosi wakhe, waya eYahazi, wabanjwa siSirayeli.
Ke kaloku iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, wamnika uShehon nemikhosi yakhe yonke esandla samaSirayeli; bababulala; amaSirayeli athathe ilizwe lonke lamaAmori, abemi balo mhlaba.
Zazithabatha zonke, ukusuka eArnoni waya eYabhoki, nasuka emlanjeni waya eYorodani.
Ke ngoko, ukuba iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, wakhupha amaAmori phambi kwabantu bakhe bakaSirayeli; ke wena unelungelo ntoni na lokuba uyithathele?
Awuyi kuthatha na loo nto uKemoshi, uThixo wakho, akunika yona? Ngokunjalo nathi siza kuthatha loo nto iNkosi, uThixo wethu, asinika yona.
Ungcono na wena kunaBalaka, unyana kaSipore, ukumkani wakwaMowabhi? Uthe wadibana na namaSirayeli, wahlasela na?

Xa amaSirayeli ehlala eHeshboni, naseAroeri, nezixeko zayo ezijikelezayo, nakwiidolophu zonke ezisecaleni kweArnoni, iminyaka engamawaka amathathu; kutheni ke ukuba nize nizibuyisele ngelo xesha lonke?
Mna andikwenzelanga ntoni na; wena ke usenza ntoni na, ukuba unxibelelane nam? UYehova, umgwebi, athethe namhlanje phakathi kwamaSirayeli namaAmmon.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wama-Ammon akazange acinge ngokuthunyelwe kwakhe nguYefeta.
Wafika uMoya kaYehova kuYefeta; wadlula eGiliyadi naseManase, wadlula eMizpa eGiliyadi, waphuma khona waya kumaAmmoniti.
Ke kaloku uYefeta wenza idini kuYehova, esithi, Ukuba uya kubanika oonyana baka-Ammon esandla sam,
Yonke into ephuma emngxunyeni wendlu yam, ifike ndimhlangabeze, xa ndithe ndabuya ndikhuselekile kumkhosi wama-Ammon, iya kuba yiyo iNkosi; ndiya kuyinikela ibe lidini elinyukayo.
Wahamba ke uYefeta, wahlasela oonyana baka-Ammon; iNkosi wabanika esandla sakhe.
Wabulala izixeko ezimashumi mabini, ukususela eAroyeri, waya kwelaseMinithi, wafika eAbeli-keramim, ngokubulala okukhulu; babekwa ke oonyana baka-Amon phantsi kwesandla samaSirayeli.

Wafika ke uYefeta endlwini yakhe, waya eMizpa. Ke kaloku ngubani na oza kumnqamla, ngaphandle konyana wakhe odlala ngeebhokhwe? Waye ngumntwana wakhe kuphela; akazange abe nenkosi okanye intombi enye.
Ke kaloku, akubonayo, warhoxa iimpahla zakhe, wathi, Hayi, intombi yam! Mna ndinikhokelele buhlungu noxinzelelo olukhulu; ngokuba ndenze isibingelelo kuYehova, andizukusiphula.
Wathi ke yena, Ubaba wam, ubulale idini kuYehova; yenza kum njengokuba wathethayo, ngokuba iNkosi wabuyisela umva abathunywa bakho oonyana baka-Amon.
Wathi ke, Ndicele into enye kuphela; ndinike iinyanga ezimbini ukuba ndihambe ngeendawo eziphakamileyo kunye nabahlobo bam, ndililinde, ngokuba andizange nditshate.
Wathi kuye, Yiya; wamvumela ke ukuba ahambe iminyaka emibini. Waye waya emazantsi edolophu, yena neentombi zakhe, belilila ngenxa yokuba akaze atshate.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezibini, wabuyela kuyise. Wakwenza kuye njengoko wayesithiyo; akayi kuhlala nomfazi; kwathi ke oko kwaba ngumthetho kumaSirayeli.
ukuba minyaka le ziphume iintombi zakwaSirayeli imihla emine, zikhumbula intombi kaYefeta waseGiliyadi.

Ke kaloku amadoda kaEfrayim abiza amaqela akhe, adlula eZafoni, athi kuYefeta, Wathi ke, Uthe wahamba njani ukuhlasela oonyana baka-Ammon, usixelele ukuba sihambe nawe? Siza kukucima indlu yakho ngaphakathi kuwe.
Waphendula uYefeta, wathi, Ndinemfazwe enkulu ndimi nosapho lwam nabantwana baka-Ammon; ndakubiza wena, kodwa awundisindisi ebantwini babo.
Ke kaloku, ndithe ndabona ukuba ningandincedanga, ndabeka ubomi bam entliziyweni yam, ndadlula ndahlasela oonyana baka-Ammon; iNkosi wandikhusela; ngaba ke nani niza nini namhlanje nithini na?
Ke kaloku uYefeta wahlanganisa bonke amadoda aseGiliyadi, waya kulwa noEfrayim. Amadoda aseGiliyadi ayewabulala; ngokuba amaEfrayim ayethi, Intsapho yenu yaseGiliyadi iphuma kuEfrayim naseManase.

Amadoda aseGiliyadi athabathe iziqithi zomlambo iYordana, eziya eEfrayim. Ke kaloku, xa umntu osuka eEfrayim ephumayo esithi, Ndize ndidlule, amadoda aseGiliyadi ayembuza esithi, Uye uEfrayim na? Ke kaloku, Ukuba uthi, Hayi,

Bathi, Kulungile; sithi iSibholethe. Ke kaloku xa ethetha ukuba iSibholethe, ngenxa yokuba akayi kukwazi ukuthetha igama ngokuchanekileyo, bathabathela kuye, bambulala emngxunyeni womlambo weYorodani: kwabulawa amawaka amane anamashumi mabini ooEfraim ngaloo mini.
Ke kaloku uYefeta waba ngumgwebi wakwaSirayeli iminyaka esithandathu. Wafa ke uYefeta waseGiliyadi, wabulawa edolophini laseGiliyadi.
Emva kwakhe, uIbsan waseBetheleyimu waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli.

Waba neentombi ezimashumi mathathu, neentombi ezilishumi elinambini; wazenza iintombi zakhe zibe ngamadoda angaphandle kosapho lwakhe, waza wazisa amadoda angamashumi mathathu omtshakazi ngaphandle kosapho lwakhe, abe ngamabhinqa oonyana bakhe. U-Ibshan waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli iminyaka esixhenxe.
Wafa ke uIbhan, wabanjwa eBhethelemi.
Emva kwakhe uElon, wesizwe sikaZebulon, waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli iminyaka elishumi.
Wafa ke uElon, wabanjwa eAyaloni, ezweni likaZebulon.
Emva kwakhe, uAbdon, unyana kaHilele, wasePiratoni, waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Waba neentombi ezimashumi mane, neendodana zeentombi ezilishumi elinambini, zahamba ngeesile ezisixhenxe; waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli iminyaka esibhozo.
Wafa ke uAbdon, unyana kaHileli, wabanjwa ePirathoni, eEfrayim, kwindawo enqamlezeneyo yamaAmaleki.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakaSirayeli baqhubeka besenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; iNkosi wabanikela esandla samaFilisti iminyaka emashumi mane.
Ke kaloku kwabakho umntu, igama lakhe nguManayo, waseTsora, wesizwe sikaDan; indoda yakhe yayingenabantwana, ayizange ibe nendoda.
Wabonakala kuye umbingeleli kaYehova, wathi kuye, Yabona, awunabantwana; ke bona, uza kukhulelwa, uya kuzalisa unyana.
Ke ngoko, qaphela ukuba ungaselanga iwayini, nokuba yiyiphi na into engcolileyo; ukuba ungadla nantoni na engalunganga.

Yabona, uza kukhulelwa, uzalise unyana; akufuneki ukuba kubekho intsontelo ebusweni bakhe; ngokuba lo mntwana uya kuba nguNazireli kaThixo ukususela emntwini wakhe; yena uya kuqala ukusindisa amaSirayeli kumaFilisti.

Wafika ke umfazi kumfazi wakhe, wamxelela wathi, Kwafika kum umntu kaThixo; yabona, ubuso bakhe befana nobuso besithunywa sikaThixo, bubuhlungu kakhulu. Andimbuze ukuba uyaphi, naye andicacisi igama lakhe.

Wathi ke kum, Yabona, uza kukhulelwa, uzalise unyana; ngoko ke, musa ukusela iwayini, nantoni na emnandi, ungadla nto engalunganga; ngokuba lo mntwana uya kuba nguNazireli kaThixo ukusukela ekuzalwa kwakhe, kuze kube yimini yokufa kwakhe.
Wathandaza ke uManono kuYehova, wathi, Ndicela, Nkosi yam, ukuba umntu kaThixo owawuthumelayo aphinde afike kuthi, zvola ukuba sikwazi njani ukuxolela lo mntwana oza kuza.
Waphendula uThixo uManawo; wabuyela umprofeti kaThixo kumkakhe, xa wayesendleni; kodwa uManawo, umfazi wakhe, akanguye naye.
Wahamba ngokukhawuleza, wamxelela umfazi wakhe, esithi, Yaye apha; kuba umntu lowo wamfikayo mna ngelo xesha wabonakala.
Wavuka ke uManoya, walandela umfazi wakhe; waya kuye lo mntu, wathi kuye, Ingaba wena owathetha nomfazi wam? Wathi yena, Ndiye.
Wathi ke uManoya kuye, Xa ilizwi lakho lithe lavela, siza kwenza ntoni na ngemithetho yobomi bomntwana?
Waphendula ke umbingeleli kaYehova, wathi, Yonke into endiyithethayo yena indoda yakho kufuneka iyenze.
