Akuyi kudla nantoni na ephuma kwisityalo seentyatyambo, angatshisa iwayini, nokuba yiyo nayiphi na into enomsindo; akuyi kudla nantoni na engcolileyo. Kuzo zonke izinto endiyamwisela umthetho ngazo, kufuneka azigcine.
Wathi uManawo kwisithunywa seNkosi, Nceda, hlala, siza kukulungiselela inkunzi yenkomo.

Wathi ke umbingeleli kaYehova kuye, Ukuba ndiya kuhlala, andizukudla isidlo sakho; kodwa ukuba ulungiselele idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, linikezele kuYehova. UManowayi akayazi ukuba yayiyimbingeleli kaThixo.
Wabuza ke uManawo isithunywa sikaYehova, esithi, Lithini igama lakho, ukuze sikwazi ukukuhlonipha, xa kwenziwe amazwi akho?
Wathi ke yena, Kutheni na ukuba ubuza igama lam? Kunzima kakhulu ukuliqonda.
Wathabatha ke uManowayi inkunzi yebhokhwe, nomnikelo wesonka, wamnikela kuYehova phezu kodonga. Ke kaloku iNkosi wenza into emangalisayo emehlweni kaManowayi nomyeni wakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa umnqamlezo esuka kwisibingelelo wanyuka waya esibhakabhakeni, isithunywa sikaYehova sanyuka esibhakabhakeni. Wakubona ke uManawo nomfazi wakhe loo nto, bawela emlonyeni wabo emhlabeni.
Ke kaloku isithunywa sikaYehova asibonakali kwakhona kuManawo nomfazi wakhe. Waqonda ke uManawo ukuba yayisisithunywa sikaThixo.
Wathi uAron kumfazi wakhe, Nceda, siya kufa; kuba sabona uThixo.

Waphendula ke umfazi wakhe, wathi, Ukuba iNkosi wayefuna ukusibulala, akazange athathe idini lethu eliqhutywa ngamanzi nomnikelo wethu wesonka; akazange asibonise zonke ezi zinto, akazange asixelele zonke ezi zinto ngoku.
Wazala umfazi umntwana, wabiza igama lakhe nguSamsoni. Wakhula ke uSamsoni; iNkosi wamsindisa.
Waqala uMoya kaYehova ukumvusa, waye eMahanaye-Dan, phakathi kweZora neEshtaoli.
Ke kaloku uSamsoni wenyuka waya eTimna, wabona khona indodakazi yeFilisti.
Wabuya ke, waxela utata wakhe nomama wakhe, esithi, Ndibone eTimna indoda yaseFilisti; ngokuninike yena ukuba abe ngumkakhe.

Waphendula utata wakhe nomama lakhe, wathi, Ingaba akukho mfana ofanelekayo phakathi kwabahlobo bakho, naphakathi kwabantu bethu bonke? Uya kungena kuBafilisti abangathotywanga, ukuze uthathe indoda? Wathi ke uSamsoni kuyise, Yinikele yena kum; kuba ulungile kum.
Abazali bakhe abazange bacinge ukuba le nto ivela kuYehova, ukuba ukhangela ithuba lokwenza into ngabaFilisti. Ke kaloku amaFilisti aye alawula kumaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uSamsoni wahla waya eTimna, yena noyise nodade wakhe. Bathe ke befika kwizityalo zewayini zaseTimna, kwathi ke ilili elincinci liphuma linyanzelisa kuye.
Wathi uMoya kaYehova kuSamsoni, wamisa ilili ngezandla zakhe ezimnyama, njengokuba emisa inkunzi yebhokhwe. Akawuxelela ubaba wakhe namama lakhe into awayeyenzayo.
Wahla ke, wathetha nomkakhe; wamthanda kakhulu unyana wakhe.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, xa wayebuyela ukuba ayise, wajika waya kujonga isiqu selili; yaye kwakukho ngaphakathi kwayo inkunzi yeenkomo, nenyama encinci.
Ke kaloku wathabatha umxube ngezandla zakhe, wayidla emehlweni akhe. Wafika ke kuyise nodade wakhe, wabanika nabo, babadla; kodwa awawazisa ukuba wathabatha umxube emlonyeni wale liyon.
Wahla ke uyise ukuba abone loo mfazi; waza uSamsoni wenza khona isidlo, njengokuba kuthethwa ngabantwana.
Ke kaloku, xa abantu bekubona, bakhetha oonyana abamashumi mathathu ukuba babe ngaye.
Wathi ke kubo uSamsoni, Ndiza kukuxelela intsingiselo; ukuba niyichaza kum imihla yesixhenxe yemikhosi, ndiza kuninika izihlangu ezimhlophe ezimashumi mathathu, nezigqoko ezilishumi elinambini.
Ukuba ke ningandixelelanga loo nto, mna ke nindinike nizigqoko zelinen ezimashumi mathathu, nezihlangu ezilishumi elinambini. Bathi ke kubo, Sitshoni ingxaki yenu, siyiva.
Waphendula ke wathi, Kwinto edlayo kwaphuma into edlayo; kwaye kwinto enamandla kwaphuma into emnandi. Baye bengenakukwazi ukuphendula loo nto iintsuku ezintathu.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, bathi kumfazi kaSamsoni, Uncede umfazi wakho ukuba acacise kuthi intsingiselo yengcamango; okanye siza kukutshisa wena nosapho lwabazali bakho, ukuze nife. Uthi thina apha, ukuze nithule?

Umfazi kaSamsoni wayalela phambi kwakhe, wathi, Mna uyamthandazela; awundithandeli mna; ubeke isilingo kubomi bam, kodwa ungamxelela loo nto. Waphendula wathi, Andimxelela nabazali bam; ndingakuxelela ntoni na wena?
Ke kaloku, imihla esixhenxe yentlanganiso, wathandaza. Kwathi ngomhla wesixhenxe wamxelela; kuba wayemxelela ngokuqhubekayo; ke yena waphendula abantu bakhe.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, phambi kokuba ilanga liphume, abantu bomzi bathi kuye, Yintoni emnandi kunamafutha? Yintoni enamandla kunaleli? Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ukuba ningabi nenyama yenkomo yam encinane yokulima, ningayi kuxela inyaniso yam.

Wathi uMoya kaYehova kuye, waya eAshkeloni, wabulala abantu abamashumi mathathu phakathi kwabo; wathabatha izinto zabo, wabanika iimpahla zabo abo bachazayo inyaniso. Wabuyela endlwini yoyise, ecinezelwe yintliziyo yakhe.
Ke kaloku umfazi kaSamsoni wanikezelwa kumnye wabahlobo bakhe, owayengumntu olungileyo kuye.

Ke kaloku, kwathi ke ngemihla yokuvuna ingqolowa, uSamsoni wathabatha inkunzi yebhokhwe, waya kutyelela umfazi wakhe. Wathi, Ndiya kungena endlwini kamfazi wam. Utata wakhe akawuvumelenga ukuba afike.
Wathi, Ndiyazi ukuba uyamxolela; ngoko ke ndimnika umhlobo wakho. Udade wakhe omncinane akabikho mhle na? Nceda uthathe yena endaweni yakhe.
Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ndiza kuhlala ndingekho mthethweni ngaloo mini, ukuba ndenze okubi kumaFilisti.
Waphuma ke, wathabatha iintaka ezilikhulu elinamashumi mathathu; waza wazingca unyawo olunye nolunye ngebini, wabeka umnquba kumqolo ngamnye.
Wazitshisa izithuthi, wazisa iintaka phakathi kweengqolowa ezihlala zimile zamadoda aseFilisti; waza watshisa imiqulu yengqolowa ethe tyaba, nengqolowa ethe tyaba, namagqabi eeolives.

Bathi ke abaFilisti, Yintoni eyenze loo nto? Baphendula besithi, USamsoni unyana-mntwana womntu waseTimna; ngokuba umkakhe wanikezelwa kumhlobo wakhe. Baya ke amaFilisti, bamcinezela yena noyise, bafa.
Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ngokuba niyenze loo nto, andiyi kuphumla, ndenze inyaniso kwenu.
Wabahlasela, wabulala abaninzi kubo; wahla ke, wahlala ekungeneni komngxuma welitye laseEtham.
Baya phezulu amaFilisti, bamisa iintaba eYudea, basasazeka eLehi.
Bathi ke abantu bakaYuda, Niza nini ukuhlasela nathi? Baphendula besithi, Siza kungena ukubopha uSamsoni, ukuze siyenze kuye njengokuba wayesenza kuthi.

Ke kaloku, amawaka amathathu amadoda aseYuda athabathela ekufumaneni umngxunya welitye laseEtam; bathi kuSamsoni, Awazi na ukuba abaFilisti baba ngukumkani kuthi? Uthini na owenzayo kuthi? Waphendula uSamuweli wathi, Ndibayenze ntoni na loo nto, njengokuba babendisenzayo?
Bathi kuye, Sithe safika ukukubopha, ukuze sikunike kumadoda aseFilisti. Wathi uSamsoni, Uthini na kum, ukuba ningandibulala nani?
Bathi ke kubo, Siyavuma; siza kukubopha nje, sizinikezele kubo, asiyi kukufa. Bawubopha ngoko ngentambo ezimbini ezintsha, bawukhupha phezulu emlanjeni.

Ke kaloku, efika eLehi, abaFilisti baphuma emveni kwakhe, bevuma. Wathi uMoya kaYehova waba phezu kwakhe; izibonda ezisemqolo yakhe zathi zifana neentyatyambo zelinen ezenziwe ngomlilo, zaba phantsi ezintloko zakhe.
Wafumanisa isisu seeseyile esitsha, wayithatha, wabulala ngaso amadoda amawaka.
Wathi ke uSamsoni, Ndiye ndazenza ngazo iinkunzi zeegusha, ndizibeke phezu kweegusha; ngazo iinkunzi zeegusha ndabulala amadoda amawaka.
Ke kaloku, xa egqibile ukuthetha, wathabatha isisu sakhe; kwathiwa igama lendawo leyo yiRamathe-lehi.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba wayethambileyo kakhulu, wayalela iNkosi wathi, Uwunika umkhonzi wakho lo xolo olukhulu; ngaba ke ngoku ndiya kufa ngethambileyo, ndifike esandla sabangathotywa?
Wawuvula uThixo umngxunya okwiLehi, amanzi aphuma kuwo; wasela ke uSamsoni, wabuya amandla akhe, waphila kwakhona. Ke kaloku kwathiwa igama lempu iEn-hakhore, eLehi; likhona kude kube ngoku.
Ke kaloku uSamsoni waba ngumgwebi wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mabini, ngemihla yamaFilisti.
Ke kaloku uSamsoni waya eGaza, wabona khona indoda enobuxoki; wesuka waya kuhlala naye.
Ke kaloku kwaziswa amadoda aseGaza, athi, USamsoni ukho apha. Bayijikelezisa ke loo ndawo, bamlinda yonke imini emnyango wedolophu; baphumla yonke imini, besithi, Xa kuvuka ubusuku siza kumbulala.

Ke kaloku uSamsoni wahlala khona kude kube liphakathi kwemini. Wavuka ke, wathabatha izivalo zesango ledolophu, nezingcango ezibini, waza wazikhupha, namakhonkco nawo onke; wazisa phezu kwemilenze yakhe, wabathwala phezulu komnqamlezo ojonge eHebroni.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, wathandana nomfazi omnye eNtaba kaSoreki; igama lakhe lalinguDelaya.

Baya kuye abathetheli bakaFilisti, bathi kuye, Khangela, ukuba ungamxolela, ukuze akuxelele ntoni na amandla akhe amakhulu, nokuba singawuphumelela njani, ukuze sikwazi ukumbophelela, ukwenze angasebenzi; siya kukunika thina ngamnye iisekeli zesilivere ezilishumi elinanye.
Wathi ke uDalilaya kuSamsoni, Nceda ndixelele ukuba yintoni amandla akho amakhulu, nokuba ungabandlululwa njani, ukuze ungabikho.
Waphendula uSamsoni wathi kuye, Ukuba umntu undibophelela ngeentambo ezisixhenxe ezitsha, ezingatshiyi, ndiya kuba mncinane njengokuba ngumntu onke.
Ke kaloku abathetheli bakaFilisti bamnika izibonda ezisixhenxe ezitsha, ezingabi zitshizi; wamtyhila ngazo.

Ke kaloku amadoda afihlakele egumbini. Wathi kuye, USamsoni, abaFilisti baya kuwe! Wayiphulaphula ke intambo zesithunywa sakhe, njengokuba iphuca intambo xa ifika kumlilo; ngoko ke, isitshixo sobukrelekrele bakhe asifumaneki.
Wathi ke uDalilaya kuSamson, Mna uyayixolela intliziyo yakho; mna uyayixolela intliziyo yakho. Nceda ndixelele ngoku ukuba ungabithwa njani.
Wathi kuye, Ukuba umntu uyandibophelela ngokuqinileyo ngentambo entsha engasebenziswanga, mna ndiya kuba mkhulu njengaye nabani na.

Wathabatha ke uDalilaya iintsontelo ezintsha, wamnqula ngazo. Wathi kuye uDalilaya, emehlweni emadoda afihlakeleyo endlwini yakhe: AbaFilisti baya kuwe, uSamsoni! Ke kaloku watsala izithontsi ezisuka emqolo wakhe, zathi ziyimisonto.

Wathi ke uDalilaya kuSamsoni, Uye wandixhalabisa ngelo xesha liphela, wathetha ndim ubuxoki; ndizazise ukuba ungatywinwa njani. Wathi yena kuye, Ukuba uza kuzibopha iinwele zam ezisixhenxe zibe yintyatyambo yoboya bakho, uze uzicinezele ngentambo, mna ndiya kuba mncinane njengendoda enye.

Ke kaloku, xa wayelala, wabeka iinwele zakhe emgqubeni, waza wazigxininisa ngentambo. Wathi kuye ke, Bathe abaFilisti baya kuwe, uSamsoni! Wavuka ke ephupheni lakhe, wasusa intambo, nobhedu, kunye nomgqubi.
Wathi kuye, Ungathi njani ke, Ndikuthanda, xa ungamthobeli mna? Lo ngumhla wesithathu ungenzi mntu olungileyo kum, ungandixelela into efihlakeleyo yobukrelekrele bakho obukhulu.
Ke kaloku wayemxelela ubusuku nemini, de waba nesifo sokufa ngenxa yayo.

Wathi ke kuye, Akukho mqengqelelo luye lwafika ekhanda lam; kuba ndinguNazireli kaThixo ukususela ekuzalwa kwam; ukuba kwenziwe umqengqelelo ekhanda lam, unamandla am aya kumshiya, ndibe mncinci njengabanye bonke amadoda.

Ke kaloku, xa uDalilayi ebona ukuba wamxelela zonke izinto zakhe, wathumela kumadoda amakhulu amaFilisti, esithi, Yiya nibuye kwakhona; ngokuba amxelela zonke izinto zakhe. Bafika ke amadoda amakhulu amaFilisti, bethwala isilivere ngezandla zabo.
Wayimisa ukuba aphumle, ibe intloko yakhe iphantsi komqolo wakhe; yabiza umfazi, waza wamisa iziqhamo ezisixhenxe zeenwele zakhe. Waqala ke uDavide ukuwuxhaphaza, yaye amandla akhe amshiya.
Wathi ke yena, USamsoni, abaFilisti baya kuwe. Wavuka uSamuweli ephupheni lakhe, wathi, Ndiya kuphuma njengokuba ndaphuma ngaphambili, ndizikhusele. Akakwazi ke ukuba iNkosi wamshiya;
Bathi ke abaFilisti, bathabathela kuye, bakhupha amehlo akhe; bamthabatha waya eGaza, bamnqamlelisa ngamakhonkco entsimbi, wamisa ingqolowa kwindlu yokugcina.
Ke kaloku iinwele zeκεφαλi yakhe zaqala ukukhula kwakhona, emva kokuba zixutywe.
Ke kaloku abathetheli bakaFilisti bahlangana, ukuba benze isibingelelo esikhulu kuDagon uThixo wabo, ukuze baphumle; bathi ke, UThixo wethu wanikela uSamsoni, umkhosi wethu, esandla sam.
Ke kaloku, xa abantu bekubonayo, bawuthandazela uThixo wabo; bathi, UThixo wethu wanikela emlonyeni wethu umkhosi wethu, lowo wawulahla ilizwe lethu, wababulala abaninzi bethu.
Ke kaloku, xa ingqondo yabo yaba phezulu kakhulu, batsho besithi, Nxibelelaniseni uSamsoni ukuba adlala nathi. Babiza ke uSamsoni ebhedini, wadlala kubo; bamisa phakathi kwemithi.
Wathi ke uSamsoni kunyana wakhe owawumqhuba ngesandla, Nceda undibeke apho ndikwazi khona ukuva iithayile ezixhasayo indlu kaThixo, ukuze ndenze inkxaso kuzo.
Ke kaloku indlu yayigcwele amadoda nabasetyhini; bonke abathetheli bakaFilisti babekhona; kwathi phezu kwetafile kwaba ngamawaka amathathu amadoda nabasetyhini, ebona uSamsoni edlala.
Wathandaza ke uSamsoni kuYehova, wathi, Nkosi yam uThixo, khumbula mna; nceda, Thixo wam, ndininike ubutyebi obunye kuphela, ukuze ndiphindele ngamehlo am onke amabini kumaFilisti ngento enye.

Ke kaloku uSamsoni waphakamisa isandla sakhe, waya kumatye amabini aphakathi, ahleli phezu kwendlu kaThixo; wabeka icala lakhe elikunene elilodwa, necala lakhe elingasekhohlo elilodwa, waza watsala ngazo.

Wathi uSamsoni, Ndifa kunye nabaFilisti. Wabetha ke ngesandla sakhe samandla onke; indlwini yawela phezu kwabathetheli nangaphezulu kwabantu bonke abakhoyo kuyo. Wabulala abantu abaninzi emehlweni akhe, kunabo ayewabulala ephilayo.

Bathi ke abazalwana bakhe, nosapho lonke loyise, bathabathela kuye; bamthabatha, bamfihla phakathi kweZora ne-Eshtaoli, ekungeneni komkakhe uManowa. USamsoni waba ngumgwebi wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mabini.
Ke kaloku kwabakho umntu okuthiwa nguMika, wayehlala ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfraim.

Wathi kuyise, Kuthe kwathabatha umntu ekholweni lakho iingelosi ezilishumi elinanye zesilivere; ndakuva ke ukuba uthetha ngaye lo mkhweli. Yabona, le golide ndinayo; ndayithatha. Wathi uyise, UYehova akubhaptize wena, mwana wam.

Wazibuyisela umyeni wakhe ezo shekeli zesilivere ezilishumi elinanye ezilikhulu; wathi umfazi wakhe, Ndizinika lemali kuYehova, kumntwana wam, ukuba yenze idini eliqingqiweyo, ligqitywe ngesilivere; ngoko ke ngoku ndiyibuyisela kuwe.
Wazibuyisela isilivere kumyeni wakhe; umyeni wakhe wathabatha iishekeli ezimakhulu amabini, waza wazisa kumenzi wesilivere, waya kwenza ngazo isibingelelo; sabekwa endlwini kaMika.
Ke kaloku uMika wayenebhedi ephakamileyo, wayenza i-ephod, neentyatyambo zendlu kaThixo; wamisa omnye wabo oonyana bakhe ukuba abe ngumbingeleli wakhe.
Ngaloo mihla, kwabakho amaSirayeli angakumkani; umntu ngamnye wayesenza oko kwakulungileyo emehlo akhe.
Ke kaloku kwabakho uLevi omncinci osuka eBhetelehem yaseYuda, osuka kusapho lukaYuda, wayehlala khona.
Washiya uBetheleyimu waseYuda, wafuna indawo yokuhlala kuyo; waya endlwini kaMika, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfraim.
Wathi kuye uMika, Uvela phi na? Waphendula wathi, NdingumLevi osuka eBhetelehem yaseYuda, ndifuna indawo yokuhlala kuyo.
Wathi kuye uMika, Uhlale nam, ube ngumzali wam, ube ngumbingeleli wam; ndiza kukunika ishekeli ezilishumi zesilivere ngonyaka, nempahla ethe tyaba, nesonka sakho. Wafika ke lo mLevi.
Wavuma uLevi ukuba ahlale naye; waba lo mntwana njengomnye wabantwana bakhe.
Ke kaloku uMika wamisa lowo mLevi; lo mntwana waba ngumbingeleli wakhe, wayehlala endlwini yakhe.
Wathi uMika, Namhlanje ndiyazi ukuba iNkosi uya kundilungisa, ngokuba lo mLevi ungumbingeleli wam.
Ngazo ezo mihla amaSirayeli akazange abe nokumkani; ngazo ezo mihla isizukulwana samaDan safuna indawo yokuhlala kuso; ngokuba besingayifumananga inxalenye yabo phakathi kwezizukulwana zamaSirayeli.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaDan, bathumela amadoda amahlanu anamandla eentsapho zabo, ukusuka eZora nase-Eshtaoli, ukuba ajonge ilizwe, ukuba alibone; bathi kubo, Yiya nilibone ilizwe. Bafika abo madoda emazantsi entlango kaEfraim, balala ekhaya likaMika.

Ke kaloku, bafika ecaleni kwendlu kaMika, bayazi ilizwi lendodakazi yeLevi. Baye badlula, bambuza wathi kuye, Uthini na owenza ukuba ufike apha? Ukwenza ntoni na kule ndawo? Ngaba ukhona ngenxa yokuba ukho apha?
Wathi ke kubo into ayenze ngayo uMika kuye, wathi, Umqeshile mna; ndaba ngumbingeleli wakhe.
Bathi ke kuye, Nceda ubuze uThixo kuthi, ukuba ihambe njani indlela yethu.
Waphendula ke umbingeleli, wathi kubo, Yiya niphumle; iNkosi ijonge indlela yenu.

Bahamba ke abo madoda amahlanu, bafika eLayishe; bababona abantu abakhoyo khona, ukuba behlala ngokukhuselekileyo, ngokwemimiselo yamaSidoni, bephumle, bekhuselekile; babenazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo kubo, kwakungekho mntu ubalaseleyo phakathi kwabo; behlala kude namaSidoni, bengenakuthethwa ngabanye.
Ke kaloku abo madoda babuyela eTsora neEshtaoli; bababuza oonyana babo, bathi, Nifumane ntoni na?
Bathi ke kubo, Yiya, sihlasele; siyazibona ilizwe, yaye lilungileyo kakhulu. Nihlala njani? Musani ukulibazisa; phumani niyithathe ilizwe.
Ke kaloku, xa nifika khona, niza kufumana abantu abangaziyo nto, nelizwe libanzi; uThixo walinika isandla sam, ilizwe elinokuthethwa ngazo zonke izinto ezifunayo intliziyo yenu.
Basuka ke eSora nase-Eshtaoli, amadoda angamakhulu amathandathu aseSizwe sikaDan, alungiselelwe ukulwa.
Ke kaloku, behamba ngendlela, bamisa inqaba eKiriyati-yearimi, eYuda; ngenxa yoko igama lendawo esemantla yeKiriyati-yearimi libizwa ngokuba yiMahanayi-dan, ngelo xesha.
Basuka apho bahamba besiya ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfraim, bafika endlwini kaMika.

Ke kaloku abo madoda amahlanu, ajonge ilizwe laseLayishe, baphendula kubazalwana babo, besithi, Niyazi na ukuba esinye sezindlu zintathu sine-ephod, neentyatyambo zasekhaya, nemifanekiso engumqondiso egqunywe ngesilivere? Namhlanje niyazi into oza kuyikwenza.
Basuka ke khona, bafika endlwini yomntwana waseLevi, endlwini kaMika, bamsikelela.
Amadoda angamakhulu amathandathu eDan, alungiselelwe ukulwa, aye ekungeneni kwesango.

Ke kaloku abo madoda amahlanu, ajonge ilizwe, aye ngaphakathi, wathabatha isibingelelo, ne-ephod, nezithixo zendlu kaThixo; umbingeleli ke waya ekungeneni kwesango, namadoda angamakhulu amathandathu anezithunywa.
Bathi ke abo madoda, bafika endlwini kaMika, bathabathe imifanekiso engumqondiso, ne-ephod, namadini asekhaya, nemifanekiso engumqondiso yesilivere; wathi kubo umbingeleli, Yintoni niyenzayo?

Bathi kuye, Utshime, ungathethi nto; ndiza nathi, ube ngutata wethu nombingeleli wethu. Akufanelekanga na ukuba ube ngumbingeleli wesizwe sonke sakwaSirayeli, kunokuba ube ngumbingeleli wendlu yomntu omnye?
Ke kaloku umbingeleli wamthanda kakhulu; wathabatha i-ephod, neentyatyambo zendlu kaThixo, nomfanekiso ongumqondiso, waya phakathi kwabantu.
Ke kaloku babuyela, basuka, bebeka abantwana babo, nezinto zabo eziphilayo, nezithuthi zabo phambi kwabo.
Ke kaloku, bathe bedlula kude kakhulu endlwini kaMika, abantu abahlala phantsi kwendlu kaMika babizwa ndawonye, babaphulaphule ooDani.
Ke kaloku, xa besithi emva kwabo, abantu bakaDan babuyela, bathi kuMika, Kuthini na okukubi kuwe, ukuba ubize amadoda akho empilweni?
Waphendula wathi, Nizithabatha izithixo zam endizenzayo, nombingeleli wam, nisuka; ndinayo ntoni na eninzi? Ungathi njani ke, Yintoni engalunganga kuwe?
Baphendula abantu bakaDan, besithi, Musani ukungqubana nathi, ukuze kungabikho nabani na otyhafayo kuwe, wena nosapho lwakho niphele ubomi.
Bahamba ke oonyana bakaDan ngendlela yabo. Wabona uMika ukuba banamandla kunaye, wabuyela waya endlwini yakhe.
Bathabatha ke loo nto uMika ayenzeyo, nombingeleli wakhe, bafika eLayisi, kubantu abakhuselekileyo, abangaziyo into; bathabathela phezu kwabo ngeqhwa, bacinezela umzi wabo.
Akukho namnye wabakhusela; ngokuba behlala kude neSidon, bengenakuthethwa nomnye umntu; lo mzi wawukwilali ecaleni kweBhethe-rehobhi. Bawulungisa umzi, bafudukela kuwo oonyana bakaDan.
Bathi igama lakhe nguDan, ngokwegama likaDan utata wabo, owayengunyana kaSirayeli; ke kaloku ngaphambili igama lomzi lalinguLayish.
Amadoda aseDan amisa khona idini labo; uYonathan, unyana kaGershoni, unyana kaMoses, naye nonyana bakhe babe ngababingeleli kwisizukulwana samaDan, de kube lixesha lokuthwala eli lizwe.
Basebenzisa imifanekiso engumqondiso kaMika, awayeyenzayo, zonke iintsuku zokuba indlu kaThixo eSilo.
Ke kaloku, ngale mihla, akubikho ukumkani kuSirayeli. Kwabakho umLevi omnye, wayehlala emazantsi entaba kaEfrayim, wathabatha umfazi wesifazane waseBhetelehem yaseYuda, waba ngumfazi wakhe wesibini.
Waye, ke, ekhohlakele kuye; wayishiya, wabuyela endlwini yoyise, waya eBhetelehem yaseYuda. Wahlala khona iinyanga ezine.

Wafika kuye umfazi wakhe, ukuba athethe naye ngothando, ukuze amthumele kwakhona; wathabatha nomkhonzi wakhe, neesile ezimbini, waza wamzisa endlwini yoyise. Yabona ke yena udade wayo, wayithandazela.
Ke kaloku unyana wakhe, uyise womfana, wamxelela ukuba ahlale; waba naye iintsuku ezintathu, edla, esela, ehlala khona.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, bavuka kuqala; wamisa unyana wakhe ukuba ahambe. Wathi ke uyise wendodakazi yakhe kumyeni wakhe, Yidla kuqala, ukuze ube nobuchule; emva koko uya kuhamba.
Bahlala ke bobabini, bedla basela ndawonye. Wathi uyise wendodakazi yakhe, Nceda uhlale le busuku, ube nesondlo.
Ke kaloku lo mntu wavuka ukuba ahambe; umyeni wakhe wamnyanzela ukuba ahlale khona; waba khona naleyo busuku.
Ke kaloku, ngemini yesihlanu, wavuka ekuseni ukuba ahambe. Wathi ke uyise wendodakazi yakhe kuye, Yidla ukutya, ukuze uqiniseke; uhlale kude kube lixesha lobusuku. Badla ke bobabini ndawonye.

Wavuka ke lo mntu ukuba ahambe, yena nomfazi wakhe, nomkhonzi wakhe. Wathi unyana wakhe-mntwana, uyise wowesifazane: Yabona, sele kugqityiwe isidlo sangokuhlwa; ndiza kukucela ukuba uhlale apha ngemini, kuba imini idlulile; hlala uphumle, ube nesonka esimnandi, uze ufike endlwini yakho ngoLwesibini kusasa.
Ke kaloku lo mntu akathandabuzi ukuhlala busuku obunye; wavuka, waphuma, waya eYebhusi (leyo yiYerusalem), naye neenkomo zakhe ezibini ezenziwe isikhephe, nomyeni wakhe.
Ke kaloku, befike eJebushe, ubusuku buphelelwe lixesha. Wathi umkhonzi kunkosi wakhe, Yiya, sihlale kuloo mzi wamaYebhusi, siphumle kusasa.
Wathi ukumkani wakhe, Akunjalo; asiyi kungena kumzi wamaSirayeli, apho abantu abakhoyo bebengabaSirayeli; siya kudlula eGibeha.
Wathi ke, Yiya, sifike eGibeha, okanye eRama, sihlale ekuseni kwelinye lawona makhaya.
Bahamba ke; ilanga laphuma, bafika eGibeha, elikwiBhenjamin.
Bahlala khona eGibheha, baphumla khona; bafika ke, baphumla emgwaqweni womzi; kwakungekho mntu wabafumanayo endlwini yabo ukuba baphumle.
Ke kaloku, ngobusuku obuthile, kwafika umntu omdala osuka ekwenzeni umsebenzi wakhe emasimini; lo mntu wayevela kwintlambo kaEfrayim, wahlala eGibeha; abantu baloo ndawo babenguBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku, xa ejonge, wabona lo mkhweli kwindawo evulekileyo yomzi. Wathi umfazi omdala kuye, Uyaphi na? Uvela phi?

Wathi kuye, Sihamba sisuka eBhetelehem yaseYuda, siye emazantsi elizwe eliphakamileyo laseEfraim, apho ndihlala khona; ndafika ke eBhetelehem yaseYuda, ngoku ndiya endlwini kaYehova; akukho namnye uyamthabatha ekhaya.
Sinayo ingqolowa, nesonka seebhokhwe zethu; sinesonka nesiselo sewayini nathi, nam, umkhonzi wakho, nomntwana ohamba nathi; asifuni nantoni na.
Wathi ke lo mntu omdala kuye, Uyamkelekile endlwini yam; ndiza kukulungiselela yonke into oyifunayo; kodwa musa ukuchitha imini kwindawo yomhlaba.
Wamthabatha ke waya endlwini yakhe, waza wazisa iinkunzi zebhokhwe; bahlamba izinyawo zabo, badla, basela.

Ke kaloku, ngelixa bedlala, bona abantu ababi balo mzi bagubungela indlu; babetha umngxunya, batsho nomntu omdala, umnini wendlu, bathi, Thola ngaphandle lo mfazi owafika endlwini yakho, ukuze sithethe naye.
Waphuma ke umnini wendlu, wathi kubo, Hayi, bazalwana bam! Musani ukwenza okubi; lo mntu ungumkhenkethi wam; musani ukwenza loo nto ibuhlungu.
Khangela, kukho intombi yam eyimfanakazi, nenkosikazi yakhe; ndiya kubazisa ngaphandle kuwe ngoku; uyenze kubo konke okunqwenelekayo emlonyeni wakho; kodwa kumntu lowo ungayenzanga loo nto ibuhlungu.
Ke kaloku amadoda awathandabuzi ukumxelela. Wathabatha ke uLevi umkakhe, wamthumela phandle kubo; babemxolela, beyamnqula yonke imini; xa kuvuka ubusuku, bavumela ukuba ahambe.
Ke kaloku, xa kuvuka ubusuku, wabuyela lo mfazi endlwini apho umphathi wakhe ehlala khona; wawela emngxunyeni wendlu, walala khona, de kube limini.
Wavuka ke unyana wakhe ekuseni, wavula isango lendlu, ukuba ahambe indlela yakhe; yabona loo mkakhe-mkakhe phantsi emnyango, enezandla zakhe emngxunyeni wesango.
Wathi kuye, Yiya, sihambe. Ke kaloku akukho mntu waphendulayo; wamthabatha ke phezu kweebhokhwe zakhe, waya ekhaya.
Wafika ke endlwini yakhe, wathabatha isikebhe, wammisa ibe ziinxalenye ezilishumi elinambini, ngamalungu ngamalungu; wabathumela kuwo onke amasango kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku bonke abakubonayo bathi omnye komnye, Akukho nto injalo ibonakeleyo, nayenziweyo, ukususela ngemini abaSirayeli baphuma ngayo eYiputa; sithi ke, kufuneka siyenze into; sithi ke.
Baphuma ke bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, besuka eDan ukuya eBher-shebha, nelizwe laseGiliyadi, bahlangana ndawonye njengendoda enye phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Ke kaloku, abathetheli bonke abantu beentsapho zakwaSirayeli bathatha indawo yabo engqungqutheleni yabantu bakaThixo; kwaba ngamawaka angamakhulu amane, amadoda ahamba ngeenyawo, asebenzisa ikrele.
Babeva oonyana bakaBhenjamin ukuba amaSirayeli afike eMizpa, basithi ke amaSirayeli, Sixelele ukuba kwenzeka ntoni na loo nto ibuhlungu.
Wathi uLevi, umfazi wowesifazane obulawayo, Ndafika eGibeha kaBhenjamin, mna nenkosikazi yam, ukuba sihlale kusasa.
Ke kaloku, ngobusuku, bafika emva kwam abantu baseGibeha, bagubungela ikhaya, befuna ukundibulala; babhinqa umfazi wam othile, waza wafa.
Ndamthabatha, ndayamquma ngamacandelo, ndazithumela kumaphondo onke ehlabathini lakwaSirayeli; ngokuba bayenze loo nto ingalunganga nenyanzelekayo kuSirayeli.
Ke ngoko, mna oonyana bakaSirayeli bonke, thethani, nindixelele ukuba nicinga ntoni.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bavuka, bethi ngamnye njengomntu omnye: Akukho namnye kuthi oza kungena endlwini yakhe; akukho namnye wethu oza kubuyela endlwini yakhe.
Le nto siza kuyisenza eGibeha; siya kukhupha kuyo, njengokuba kuthethwa ngazo.

Siza kuthatha abantu abalishumi kumakhulu, kuzo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, namadoda amawaka amakhulu, namadoda amawaka amaninzi, ukuba bathuthe izinto zokutya kumkhosi; ukuze, xa umkhosi efika eGibeha kaBhenjamin, abe nethuba lokuwagweba onke amabinzana anobuxoki awenziwe kumaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseSirayeli aye endlwini kaThixo, ahlanganisene njengendoda enye.
Izizwe zakwaSirayeli zathumela amadoda kuzo zonke izizukulwana zikaBhenjamin, zisithi, Yintoni le nto inobungozi obugqithisileyo eya kwenzeka phakathi kwenu?
Ke ngoko, nikelani namadoda amabi eGibeha, ukuze siwafile, sisuse ububi phakathi kwabaSirayeli. Babantu bakaBhenjamin ke abazange baphulaphule oonyana babo abaSirayeli;
Ke kaloku baphuma emizini yabo, bahlangana eGibeha, ukuba babhideke nabaSirayeli.

Ke kaloku amadoda aseBhenjamin ahlanganisane ngaloo mini, esuka emizini yabo, amawaka angamashumi mabini anesithandathu asebenzisa ikrele; kwakunye namadoda anamakhulu asixhenxe akhethiweyo, abahlali baseGibeha.
Ngabo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, kwakukho amadoda angamakhulu asixhenxe akhethiweyo, esebenzisa isandla esisekhohlo; ngamnye wabo wayekwazi ukutshisa iithayile phantsi kweenwele, akabi necala.
Ke kaloku, ngaphandle kukaBhenjamin, amaSirayeli ahlanganisene amadoda angamakhulu amane amawaka, asebenzisa ikrele; onke la madoda aqeqeshiwe.
Baye ke oonyana bakaSirayeli benyuka bafika eBheteli, babuza uThixo, bathi, Nguwuphi oza kuqala phakathi kwethu ukuhlasela abantu bakaBhenjamin? Waphendula iNkosi wathi, UYuda uya kuqala.
Bavuka ke amaSirayeli emveni kwemini, bamisa inqaba eGibeha.
Baphuma oonyana bakaSirayeli, bahlasela oonyana bakaBhenjamin, bamisa isikhundla sokulwa nabo eGibheya.
Baphuma oonyana bakaBhenjamin eGibheha, babulala kumaSirayeli amawaka amashumi mabini anesibini emkhosini ngaloomini.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseSirayeli athabathe intliziyo yakhe, wabuyela endlwini yabo apho ayehlala khona mhla wokuqala.

Baye ke oonyana bakaSirayeli benyuka, bathandaza phambi koYehova, de kube sebusuku; babuza iNkosi, bathi, Siya kuphinda sikhuphe ukuhlasela abazalwana bethu, oonyana bakaBhenjamin? Waphendula iNkosi wathi, Nikhuphe nithabathele kubo.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesibini, bafika amadoda aseSirayeli ahlasela uBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku amaBhenjamin aphuma eGibeha, adibana nabo; babulala abantu abalishumi elinambini elinamawaka kumaSirayeli, bonke besebenzisa ikrele.

Baye ke bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, iqela lonke, banyuka beya eBheteli; bahlala khona, bathandaza phambi koYehova; baphumla ngaloo mini de kube semini, banikela izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo kuYehova.
Babebuza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli iNkosi ukuba bayenze ntoni na. Yaye ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaThixo yayikhona ngaloo mini,

Wathi ke uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazar, unyana ka-Aron, ekhonza phambi kwayo: Bathi ke, Siya kuphinda sikhuphe ukuhlasela oonyana bakaBhenjamin, abazalwana bethu, okanye siya kuyeka? Waphendula iNkosi wathi, Yiya; ngokuba namhlanje ndiya kubanika isandla sakho.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli abeka abantu abafihlakeleyo phezu kweGibheya.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesithathu, benyuka bahlasela oonyana bakaBhenjamin, bamisa isikhundla eGibheya, njengokuba babeyenze ngaphambili.

Baphuma ke oonyana bakaBhenjamin ukuba bahlangane nabo, baqhutywa besuka kumzi; baqalisa ukubulawa kwabaSirayeli, njengokuba kwangaphambili, ezindaweni ezivulekileyo, nakwiindlela, enye ihamba eBheteli, enye ihamba eGibheya, amadoda angamashumi mathathu.
Bathi oonyana bakaBhenjamin, Siyababetha njengangaphambili. Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Siye sihambe, siyabatsala kude kumzi, ukuba bafike kwiindawo zendlela.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseSirayeli asuka endawo yawo, aye eBhayi-thamari; ke amaSirayeli afihlakeleyo aphuma ezweni lakhe, afike eGibheya.
Ke kaloku amawaka alishumi elineshumi, abantu abakhethiweyo bakaSirayeli, bahlasela iGibheya; ukulwa ke kwaba lukhulu kakhulu. Amadoda aseBhenjamin awayazi ukuba isihlwele safika.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wabetha amaBhenjamin phambi kwaSirayeli; oonyana bakaSirayeli babulala ngaloo mini kumaBhenjamin amadoda angamashumi mabini anesihlanu amawaka anamakhulu mahlanu, onke asebenzisa ikrele.
Babona ke oonyana bakaBhenjamin ukuba bahlaselwe; kuba amadoda aseSirayeli athathe indawo phambi kweeBhenjamin, ngenxa yokuba amaSirayeli ayewabalalisa abantu ababebafihla eGibheha.
Ke kaloku abo bafihlakeleyo basuka befika eGibeha, basasazeka, babulala bonke abakwidolophu ngeqhosha.
Ke kaloku madoda aseSirayeli athethe nabafihlakeleyo, ukuba bakhuphe umphunga omkhulu osuka kumzi, ukuze kube ngumqondiso.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseSirayeli abuyela umva emfazweni. Bathi oonyana bakaBhenjamin baqala ukuwabulala amaSirayeli, abamalunga namathathu; bathi ke, Siyawabetha njengakwimfazwe yokuqala;
Ke kaloku, xa umnqamlezo womphunga wawuqala ukunyuka ukusuka kuloo mzi, abantu bakaBhenjamin babuyela ngasemva, babebona umlilo wale dolophu iphela ukhuphuka ezulu.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseSirayeli abuyela kubo; abantu bakaBhenjamin baphoxeka, ngokuba babebona ukuba ingozi ifike kubo.
Babaleka ke phambi kwamadoda aseSirayeli, besuka ezweni elimnyama; abakwazi ukushiya ukulwa. Amadoda aseSirayeli aphuma emadolophini, ayewabulala apho.
Bazijikelezisa oonyana bakaBhenjamin, bathabathela ngaphaya kwabo, babatyhala phantsi ngento elula, emazantsi-mpuma eGibheha.
Bafa ooBhenjamini amawaka alishumi elinamithandathu, bonke abemi abanamandla.

Amanye amaSirayeli ajikeleze, abaleka esiya emhlabathini omnyama, waya kumthi ka-Rimon. AmaSirayeli ke ayewabulala amadoda amawaka amahlanu kwiindawo zendlela; bayawalandela befika eGidomu, wababulala amawaka amabini.
Ke kaloku, bonke ooBhenjamin abafayo ngaloo mini babe ngamawaka amashumi amabini anesixhenxe, abantu abathabatha ikrele; bonke abo bamadoda amakhulu.
Ke kaloku amawaka anamanci mane amadoda abuyela, asuka esiya emlilweni, waya kumthi kaRimon; bahlala khona iinyanga ezine.

Ke kaloku babuyela amadoda aseSirayeli ezweni likaBhenjamin, wabulala onke la madolophu ngesandla sekhephu, namadoda, nezinto eziphilayo, nazo zonke izinto ababezifumana; nawo onke la madolophu abawafika kuwo, wabatshisa umlilo.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseSirayeli aye eMizpa, athi, Akukho namnye kuthi oza kunika intombi yakhe umfazi kumntu waseBhenjamin.
Baye ke abantu bafika eBheteli, behlala khona phambi koThixo kude kube sebusuku, belilindela ngelizwi elikhulu, nolilindela ngokubi.
Bathi, Nkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, kutheni na ukuba kubekho oku kuSirayeli? Kutheni na ukuba kubekho isizukulwana esiseSirayeli namhlanje?
Ke kaloku abantu bavuka kusasa, balungisa khona isibingelelo, banikela ngeentyatyambo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, neentyatyambo zoxolo.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Nguwuphi na umntu phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli, ongafikanga engqungqutheleni phambi koYehova? Baye basenza isibingelelo, esithi, Wonke lowo angafikanga phambi koYehova eMizpa, kufuneka aphele.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bakhathazeka ngenxa yabazalwana babo, oonyana bakaBhenjamin; bathi, Namhlanje kuthethwa isizukulwana esinye eSirayeli.
Siza kubafumana njani amadoda abo abaseleyo? Kuba sithe sathi ngelizwi likaYehova, ukuba asibanike nabantwana bethu ukuba babe ngamadoda.
Bathi ke, Zithini na izizwe zakwaSirayeli ezingafikanga kuYehova eMizpa? Bafumanisa ukuba akukho namnye osuka eYabhesi-gileyadi afike emkhosini, ukuze ahlangane.
Babala ke abantu, bafumanisa ukuba akukho namnye kumadoda aseYabhesi eGiliyadi akhona.
Ke kaloku ibandla lathumela amawaka amabini anamashumi mabini, amadoda akhethiweyo phakathi kwabo, bethi, Yiya eYabhesi-gileyadi, nibulala bonke abakhoyo kuyo ngeqhwa, namadoda nabantwana.
Bathi, Le nto niyenzayo; bulala onke amabhinqa namabhinqa onke, asele entliziyweni yomfazi.
Bafumanisa phakathi kwabahlali baseYabheshi eGiliyadi, amabhinqa angamakhulu amane, amadodakazi, angazange ahlangane nomfazi; bathabathela ke kubo emkhosini waseShilo, ezweni laseKanan.
Ke kaloku ibandla lonke lathumela izilumkiso zoxolo kubafazi bakaBhenjamin, elunxwemeni lweRimon.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseBhenjamin abuyela ngaloo xesha, ayewafumana amabhinqa aseYabhesi eGiliyadi, abo bashiyeke; ke kaloku abazange babe nenani labo bonke.
Ke kaloku abantu bakhathazeka ngenxa kaBhenjamin, ngokuba iNkosi wenza umngxunya phakathi kwezizwe zakwaSirayeli.
Bathi amadoda amakhulu ebandla, Abafazi bakaBhenjamin babulawa; siza kubafumana njani amabhinqa abo bantu abaseleyo?
Bathi ke, Kufuneka kubekho ooyise abaseleyo kuBhenjamin, ukuze kungabikho isizukulwana esiseSirayeli silahlekile.
Ke thina asikwazi ukubanika oonyana bethu ukuba babe ngabafazi; ngokuba sithe sathi, AbaSirayeli, Kubikele umntu onika umfazi kumntu waseBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku, bona, kukho isikhumbuzo sonyaka sikarhulumente eShilo, esentshona yeBheteli, ngasentshonalanga yendlela iphumayo eBheteli iye eShekem, emzantsi weLebona.
Bathi ke kumadoda aseBhenjamin, Yiya, ufihlakele ezityeni zewayini.

Uthe ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses: Yabona, xa iinkunzi zeenkomo zaseShilo ziphuma zidlale, niphumeni ngaphaya kwezityalo zewayini; nithatheni ngamnye kuni indoda phakathi kwabafazi baseShilo, niye ezweni likaBhenjamin.

Ke kaloku, xa abazali babo, nabazalwana babo, besiya kuthi, bethi, Nceda, zinikele kubo ngenxa yethu; ngokuba asibathatheli amadoda abo emfazweni, nize nizinike abantwana benu kubo; ngoko ke, akuyi kubakho monakalo kuwe.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaBhenjamin oko, bathabathe ngamnye umfazi omtshakazi, xa bedlala, bamthabatha ukuba abe ngumfazi wakhe; babuyela ezweni labo, babezilungisa iidolophu zabo, babehlala kuzo.
Ke kaloku basuka oonyana bakaSirayeli kuloo xesha, babuyela ezweni labo, ngamadodakazi abo, ngamachibi abo, ngamnye ezweni lakhe.
Ngaloo mihla, kwabakho amaSirayeli angakumkani; umntu ngamnye wayesenza oko kwakulungileyo emehlo akhe.
